== Location ==

A deep gnome researcher can be found near the '''northern edge of the Great Cavern''' outside [[Ail'Vorith]], in the area where the Deep Gnomes are conducting experiments on the local water.

This is the same general area where creatures such as [[a synthetic ooze]], [[a bubbling oozeling]], and [[a failed experiment]] can be encountered.

== Quest Involvement ==

During [[House Varros (Quest)]], [[Vaslir Kiannes]] sends the player to the northern edge of the cavern to investigate the Deep Gnome experiments and collect [[Sample of Tainted Water]].

The researchers are part of the Deep Gnome presence in this area.

== Faction ==

Killing a deep gnome researcher results in a faction loss with:

{{Faction|Citizens of Gizmopolis|-}}

* Conversation
You say, "Hail, a priest of Tilustra."

: a priest of Tilustra says, "Welcome friend. Are you here seeking knowledge?"

You say, "Knowledge?"

: a priest of Tilustra says, "Is there something specific you wish to know, or are you here to meditate on the lessons that Tilustra has set before us?"

You say, "Lessons?"

: a priest of Tilustra says, "Our great goddess of knowledge ensures that each of our lives is made up of innuberable decisions, all intertwined, all adding to the greater wisdom of the whole."

: a priest of Tilustra says "All life on Eth-ur, wether acting, failing, succeeding, or learning, moves us toward a greater, unimaginable wisdon and a true vision of her light."

You say, "Tilustra?"

: a priest of Tilustra says, "Tilustra..."

: ''a priest of Tilustra raises his hands in prayer.''

: a priest of Tilustra says, "...is the patronage of sages, which, I might add, is why it's no coincidence that you've found our temple here in Sageside."

You say, "Sageside?"

: a priest of Tilustra says, "Oh yes! Sageside is the world-renowned district of Night Harbor, where you'll find great learned orders of magic users, researchers, and academics. It's a wonderful place for the curious mind."

}}

Yes, pots | known_loot = | factions = | opposing_factions = | related_quests = }} === Dialogue === "Oh... Welcome, welcome! Please take a look round, grab some clay, and make yourself a nice pot or a little figurine!"
When the player asks 'Who is Porbor'
"Yes! Porbor is more than just the god of pots, he's the patron of the deserving, and looks after those in need."
"Porbor, our wondrous god of pots, watches over you!"
"What, the god of pots?! I see that look, But everyone appreciates a pot from time to time, no?"
"When the oft empty pot is full, who do they thank? Even if they don't directly say or think it."
"What if you were to stumble upon a pot filled with coins? You'll be thinking about Porbor for certain."
"Porbor is a god of small miracles, appreciated by those who find comfort in simple things. And aws such, his followers match those of even the greatest gods."
a priest of Porbor smiles at you.

== Location ==

A priest of Eltindra can be found in the '''Sojourners / Traveler's District''' of [[Night Harbor]].

He is located along the '''north wall''' inside the building between:

* [[Survivalist Faiza]]
* [[Outdoorsman Gahira]]

The priest refers to the location as a shrine to [[Eltindra]].

== Dialogue ==

:a priest of Eltindra says, "Welcome to our humble shrine, friend. I see the patroness of travelers has blessed your journey here."

:a priest of Eltindra says, "How may I assist you?"

:a priest of Eltindra says, "Eltindra is the goddess of travel and exploration."

:a priest of Eltindra says, "Those who are curious and brave enough to explore the vast lands of Aëthoril do so with her blessing."

== Eltindra ==

According to the priest, [[Eltindra]] is the goddess of '''travel and exploration''' and the patroness of travelers.

The priest's dialogue indicates that this location is a shrine dedicated to Eltindra.

== Possible Birchshade Connection ==

{{QuestNote|'''Unconfirmed:''' This NPC may be connected to the optional [[Laeran Birchshade]] / [[Birchshade Family Bracelet]] side quest, but no interaction has yet been verified.}}

The [[Birchshade Family Bracelet]] given by [[Laeran Birchshade]] bears a prayer to [[Eltindra]]:

:''A bracelet made of polished wooden beads, each expertly engraved with a logograph. When read in order, they write out a prayer to Eltindra.''

Laeran tells the player to find his uncle, [[Raelewyn Birchshade]], in the '''Traveler's District of [[Night Harbor]]'''.

Because this priest is located in the Traveler's District and tends a shrine to Eltindra, this area may be relevant when searching for [[Raelewyn Birchshade]].

However, Laeran specifically identifies [[Raelewyn Birchshade]] as the person who should be shown the bracelet, so the bracelet should not be handed to the priest unless an interaction is confirmed.

A priest of Yuum.title: A priest of Yuum
A priest of Yuum.content: {{Namedmobpage | imagefilename = phicon.png | width = 200px | caption = | race = Human | class = | level = | agro_radius = | run_speed = | zone = Night Harbor | respawn_time = | AC = | HP = | HP_regen = | mana_regen = | attacks_per_round = | attack_speed = | damage_per_hit = | special = | location = | description = What a priest of Yuum says: a priest of Yuum says, "Hail, traveler. Have you come seeking a blessing of safe passage?" a priest of Yuum says, "From Yuum, of course! The god of voyages, twin brother of Gyffre, and patron deity of all Ba'Haara." a priest of Yuum says, "We honor Yuum and Gyffre with the grand statues that grace our city's harbor." a priest of Yuum says, "Magnificent, aren't they? They were one of the conditions for signing the Twilight Accord." a priest of Yuum says, "I'm no authority on the subject, but it was an agreement of sorts between the Seafarers Consortium and the... Langsdorfian League." a priest of Yuum says, "The Seafarers Consortium is the official title for the Ba'Haara of Night Harbor. It legitimizes our presence here and gives us a unified voice in governmental matters." a priest of Yuum says, "Ah, but here I am rambling about city politics. That is not really my concern." a priest of Yuum says, "An awful lot, if you ask me. They would tear down our beloved statues in an instant if it would benefit their coin purse. The only god they worship is money... not even Trem!" a priest of Yuum says, "Oh, Trem? Trem is the God of Commerce and Contracts. The Ba'Haara recognize Trem's divinity, though few oft seek his blessing. We're a humble people." a priest of Yuum says, "Regardless, if you so desire, you can visit his place of worship in Highpoint Terrace. I harbor no judgment." a priest of Yuum smiles gently. a priest of Yuum says, "Here, as in Eth-ur! There are writings that claim Yuum and Gyffre brought many peoples to Eth-ur from far away to aid the gods in a great conflict." a priest of Yuum raises his hand to his chest. a priest of Yuum says, "Which people, they do not say, but I know in my heart that it is the truth for the Ba'Haara." a priest of Yuum says, "The Ba'Haara are seafarers through and through. Yuum grants us sanctuary on the seas, and we never stray far from them." a priest of Yuum says, "Dare I say we're more at home on the water than we are here in Night Harbor!" a priest of Yuum chuckles softly. a priest of Yuum says, "Though people of all kinds congregate here, Night Harbor truly belongs to the Ba'Haara. We settled this land well before there was even a city." a priest of Yuum pauses briefly, considering his words. a priest of Yuum says, "I suppose the Langsdorfian League played some part in making it what it is today... but I'd never admit it. They care not for anything that doesn't line their own pockets!" a priest of Yuum gazes out toward the statue of Gyffre, a mournful expression crossing his face. a priest of Yuum says, "...The God of Portals. Like Yuum, the Ba'Haara view him in the highest regard, and yet our prayers do not seem to reach him. We fear he is lost... or worse." a priest of Yuum says, "What happened to him, we cannot say, but we'll continue to make offerings in hopes that one day his presence is felt again. Oh, what a truly glorious day that will be." | known_loot = | common_loot = | factions = | opposing_factions = | related_quests = }}

== Location ==

Cook Deepbite can be found in the '''Deepgulp Goblin area''' near the [[Great Cavern Sea]] in [[Ail'Vorith]].

He is found among the other Deepgulp Goblins in this region.

== Combat Information ==

* '''Race:''' Goblin
* '''Class:''' Necromancer
* '''Level:''' 14-15

Cook Deepbite is confirmed to be a Necromancer.

== Faction ==

Killing Cook Deepbite results in the following faction changes:

{{Faction|Clan Deepgulp|-}}
{{Faction|Citizens of Ail'vorith|+}}
{{Faction|Ail'vorith Exiles|+}}

== Loot ==

Cook Deepbite appears to share much of the same common loot table as the surrounding Deepgulp Goblins, including items such as [[Cloth Scraps]] and [[Tattered Rawhide Boots]].

Observed coin drops from Goblins in this area are approximately '''5-13 Copper'''.

Cook Deepbite can also drop:

* [[Crude Gatorhide Cap]]

== Location ==

[[Freysia Riftrend]] is located in the eastern [[Underdocks]] of [[Night Harbor]].

She can be found accompanied by her Fire Elemental on an upper floor of the building.

== Description ==

Freysia Riftrend is a Human Elementalist associated with the Descendian Order, a group of mercenaries operating in Night Harbor.

Freysia has an arrangement with [[Vaslir Vharkith]] of [[House Varros]], who ordered a special package through her.

However, an elementalist named [[Belot]] betrayed the Descendian Order and stole several valuable items, including Vharkith's package.

Freysia refuses to send her own mercenaries to recover the stolen goods without compensation, but offers the player an opportunity to recover the package while helping the Descendian Order deal with the betrayal.

== Quest Involvement ==

=== House Varros ===

Freysia is involved in Part 5 of [[House Varros (Quest)]].

After completing the Nerolir assignment, [[Vaslir Vharkith]] gives the player a [[Letter to Freysia Riftrend]] and instructs them to travel to the Underdocks.

The letter explains that Vharkith's previous apprentice failed to return with his order and that a new courier has been sent in his place.

==== Deliver the Letter ====

Find Freysia in the eastern Underdocks.

Give her the [[Letter to Freysia Riftrend]].

{{QuestNote|Handing the letter to Freysia does not award experience or faction.}}

Freysia explains that Vharkith's order has been stolen and must be recovered by the player.

==== Recover the Stolen Order ====

Freysia identifies the thief as [[Belot]], an elementalist formerly associated with the Descendian Order.

Belot betrayed the organization to the Deepcut bandits, resulting in the deaths of several members.

Freysia believes Belot is hiding in one of the Deepcut bandit camps or the mines behind them.

The player must locate Belot and recover [[Vharkith's Order]].

==== Return the Order ====

Once the order has been recovered, return it directly to [[Vaslir Vharkith]] in [[Ail'Vorith]].

{{exp}}
{{Faction|House Varros|+}}

The player is promoted to senior apprentice after completing this assignment.

== Dialogue ==

=== Receiving Vharkith's Letter ===

After handing Freysia the [[Letter to Freysia Riftrend]]:

:Freysia Riftrend says, "Varkith sent you, did he? I'll tell you the same thing I told his last messenger. I don't have his order. If you want it for your master, you'll have to retrieve it yourself."

You say, 'Where is his order?'

:Freysia Riftrend says, "One of our number, an elementalist named Belot, betrayed us to the Deepcut bandits and got several of her brethren killed. She also absconded with several valuable items including the package for your master."

''Freysia Riftrend crosses her arms.''

:Freysia Riftrend says, "Now, the Descendian Order are mercenaries. I can't be sending our lads out to fight for free, but I also can't have the word getting out that you can double cross us."

:Freysia Riftrend says, "So maybe we can help each other. The scuttlebutt is that Belot is holed up at one of the Deepcut Bandit camps... or maybe in the mines behind them. If you put down enough of them, you should find her. Once that treacherous little snake is dead, we save face and you get your master's package."

=== Asking About the Bandits ===

You say, 'Where are the bandits?'

:Freysia Riftrend says, "Go out that big gate that the ships use and head into the caverns to your right, if you go in far enough, the place is lousy with them."

== Quest Items ==

* [[Letter to Freysia Riftrend]] – Delivered to Freysia during Part 5 of [[House Varros (Quest)]].
* [[Vharkith's Order]] – Stolen by [[Belot]] and recovered for [[Vaslir Vharkith]].

== Related NPCs ==

* [[Vaslir Vharkith]] – Commissioned the special order.
* [[Belot]] – Former associate who betrayed the Descendian Order and stole the package.

== Notes ==

* Freysia is accompanied by a Fire Elemental.
* Delivering Vharkith's letter does not award experience or faction.
* Freysia does not provide the requested package directly; the player must recover it from Belot.
* The recovered order is returned to Vharkith, not Freysia.
* See [[House Varros (Quest)]] for the complete walkthrough.

Suggested Raid Size: 24 players (4 groups) with a minimum of: 3 tanks

Key Takeaway: Keep the raid on the balcony. Fight the important mobs on the balcony.

Fight Details:

The fight starts upon killing the trigger mob.
The main hallway spawns a bunch of red ghosts (20-50).
2 Drakes spawn ([[Malen`Kai]] and [[Dala`Nar]]) that have breath attacks, the breath attacks are Cone-based and hit for ~2000 damage (Dala`Nar is fire Based).
It is suggested to have 2 tanks split the drakes against each banner on the balcony and face them away from the raid.

| dialog = Haredi says, 'Greetings! Are you interested in the practice of aetherical studies?'

You say, 'Aetherical studies?'

Haredi says, 'Oh yes, the flows of aether throughout the world are a wonderful thing to behold! I myself am a practitioner of aethernautical manipulation. It is my hope to one day become a Doctore of the Academy.'

Haredi beams a proud smile at you.

You say, 'Doctore of the Academy?'

Haredi says, 'Is it not every student's dream to become a Doctore, backed and funded by the Chartered Academy of Arcane Inquiry?'

Haredi says, 'I still have much to learn before I would even be considered for the role, but I plan on thoroughly enjoying my journey along the way!'

Haredi says, 'Inquisitive people like yourself remind me that there are still so many questions out there that need answering. Thank you for your curiosity in my story, friend!'

Haredi offers an appreciative smile.



}}

Miral the Dark Elf.content:
{{NeedsInfo}}
{{Namedmobpage

}}

== Location ==

[[Miral the Dark Elf]] is located on the western side of the Foreign Quarter in [[Ail'Vorith]], overlooking the water.

== Description ==

Despite her name, Miral is a High Elf who possesses a crate of Nerolir, an elven cider banned within Ail'Vorith.

Miral obtained the cider during a raid against travelers heading toward the Bight.

She also mentions being pursued by bounty hunters and making money by selling their corpses to Esveth.

Miral offers dialogue concerning volunteering for an unspecified task, although the minimum level required to participate has not yet been confirmed.

== Dialogue ==

=== Initial Greeting ===

You say in Deep Common, "Hail, Miral the Dark Elf."

:Miral the Dark Elf says, "Karzzul. You are another bounty hunter or you looking to volunteer?"

=== Volunteering ===
{{NeedsInfo}}

{{QuestNote|The following dialogue was observed at level 23. The minimum level required to volunteer has not yet been confirmed.}}

You say in Deep Common, "I am looking to volunteer."

:Miral the Dark Elf says, "You look a bit green for what I have planned. Ask me again once you've survived a few more...well, a lot more battles."

=== Bounty Hunter ===

You say in Deep Common, "I am a bounty hunter."

:Miral the Dark Elf says, "They're always sending fools to kill me. I make some decent pocket change selling their corpses to Esveth."

=== Asking About Nerolir ===

During Part 4 of [[House Varros (Quest)]], players can ask Miral about Nerolir after speaking with [[Nyxia Ak'kin]].

You say, 'Hail, Miral the Dark Elf'

:Miral the Dark Elf says, "Karzzul. You another bounty hunter or you looking to volunteer?"

You say, 'I'm looking for some Nerolir'

:Miral the Dark Elf says, "Ah you heard about the raid, I take it? That was a fun one. Caught the fools flat footed heading towards the Bight."

:Miral the Dark Elf says, "I did snag a crate of Nerolir from them. Price is 10 silver a bottle."

Give [[Miral the Dark Elf]] 10 silver.

:Miral the Dark Elf says, "Enjoy. One of the only things I miss from home."

You receive [[Bottle of Nerolir]].

== Quest Involvement ==

=== House Varros ===

Miral is involved in Part 4 of [[House Varros (Quest)]].

After [[Vaslir Vharkith]] requests a [[Bottle of Nerolir]], the player can ask [[Nyxia Ak'kin]] in the Foreign Quarter bar where to find it.

Nyxia explains that she does not have any Nerolir but suggests speaking with "the dark elf."

The player can then travel to Miral on the western side of the Foreign Quarter, overlooking the water.

Ask Miral about Nerolir to learn that she acquired a crate during a raid against travelers heading toward the Bight.

Miral provides a [[Bottle of Nerolir]] in exchange for a 10-silver coin hand-in.

The bottle must then be delivered to [[Vaslir Vharkith]] to continue the quest.

=== Volunteering ===
Miral also offers dialogue concerning volunteering for an unspecified task.

At level 23, attempting to volunteer results in Miral telling the player that they need more battle experience.

{{NeedsInfo}}

{{QuestNote|The minimum level required to volunteer, the nature of the task, and any associated quest or rewards have not yet been verified.}}

== '''Dialogue''' ==

Polietta Two-tone says, "Awake-awake! The sleepy sun peeks through, and blinks his golden eyes across the glade-glade..."

Polietta Two-tone says, "I tug his beard of fire till skies turn blue, then skip away before he can upbraid-braid."

Polietta Two-tone says, "The flowers stretch, still yawning in their beds-beds. I dim the faerie lanterns with care-care..."

Polietta Two-tone says, "The wasps grumble, rubbing their heavy heads, while I spill laughter bright as morning air-air."

Polietta Two-tone says, "Now hear me sing-sing, the Court of Summer calls! Their banners woven from the morning's flame-flame..."

Polietta Two-tone says, "They dance on winds through sunlit halls, and crown the dawn with joy in Summer's name-name."

Polietta Two-tone says, "So dawn begins with giggles, pranks, and song-song. A pixie's trick to pull the day along-long."

Sersil Tangleroot.content:
{{Namedmobpage

| caption           = Picture taken during Early Access

| race              = Wood Elf

| location          = Across from the Fungi Lift
| description       = Just some cult member preaching about the Seven Courts or whatever.
* Conversation

You say, "Hail, Sersil Tangleroot."

: ''Sersil Tangleroot beams a wide smile in your direction.''

: Sersil Tangleroot says, "There is wisdom in the tenets of the Fae Realm! Will you hear their message, traveler?"

You say, "Message?"

: ''Sersil Tangleroot spreads his arms in a gesture that encompasses everything around him.''

: Sersil Tangleroot says, "All of Evershade Weald would not be as it is without the benevolence of our fae benefactors. It was not through the grace of any gods that our forest has thrived over the course of many cataclysms."

: Sersil Tangleroot says, "It is only through the intervention of the Fae Realm that we survived here at all, so why should we imprison ourselves in a world which has so often sought to cast us out?"

: Sersil Tangleroot says, "We Faelewyn should disassociate ourselves with the other races of this land, and embrace the teachings and comforts of the Seven Courts. Only then can our people finally be at peace."

: Sersil Tangleroot says, "Spread this message to any kind who would hear it, so that they too can revel in the wisdom of learning from the fae."

You say, "Seven Courts?"

: ''Sersil Tangleroot widens his smile at you, encouraged by the show of curiosity.''

: Sersil Tangleroot says, "I am but a herald of the Servants of the Seven Courts. Many here would call us a cult, but we are mere worshippers of those who have shown to be our true deities."

: Sersil Tangleroot says, "Anyone can witness with their own eyes the grace that the Fae and their rulers have gifted upon this land. Thus our faith belongs to them, and only them."

You say, "Cult?"

: ''Sersil Tangleroot chuckles lightly and shakes his head.''

: Sersil Tangleroot says, "We are no more a cult than any church who offers their faith to a higher being. Is it a crime to simply wish to return to the true home in which we belong?

You say, "What rulers?"

: Sersil Tangleroot says, "There are seven courts within the realms of the fae, but two hold dominion over all others."

: Sersil Tangleroot says, "The King of the Summer Court, Eleryon, and his sibling the Queen of the Winter Court, Sylneira."

: Sersil Tangleroot says, "Both rule over the realms that are our true home."

You say, "What true home?"

: Sersil Tangleroot says, "From the moment our people took shelter within the Fae Realms, Aethoril was no longer our home."

: Sersil Tangleroot says, "We returned to these lands as strangers and were greeted by hostility and contempt."

: Sersil Tangleroot says, "That is why the Faelewyn people should leave this world behind, to take up our rightful place alongside the Fae. A people and a world which embrace and welcome us openly."

: Sersil Tangleroot says, "Don't you agree?"

You say, "No?"

: ''Sersil Tangleroot offers you a small bow of his head, the man's ever-present smile not faltering.''

: Sersil Tangleroot says, "I wish you no ill will in that case, my friend. It is only a matter of time before the tenets of the Fae are heeded by all within Evershade."

: Sersil Tangleroot says, "Until such time, I bid you safe travels."

You say, "I agree"

: ''Sersil Tangleroot beams at you brightly and offers a deep bow of gratitude.''

: Sersil Tangleroot says, "It warms my heart to hear that there are those who still agree with our cause."

: Sersil Tangleroot says, "Perhaps in the future there may be a way for you to aid us servants further. Until that time, my friend, may the Seven Courts watch over you."

== Location ==

Vaslir Maryn is located in the upper portion of [[Ail'Vorith]], in the same general area as [[Vaslir Vharkith]].

She stands beside the large fountain. [[Vaslir Kiannes]] is also located nearby.

{{QuestNote|If you have already located [[Vaslir Vharkith]], Maryn is very close by. Look around the fountain in the same upper section of the city.}}

== Quest Involvement ==

Vaslir Maryn is involved in Part 3 of [[House Varros (Quest)]].

After recovering [[Vharkith's Research Notes]], [[Vaslir Vharkith]] sends the player to Maryn with a bag of [[Corpse Dust]] and requests another flask of [[Essairyl]].

Upon speaking with Maryn:

:Vaslir Maryn says, "Karzzul, apprentice. I trust you have a good reason for interrupting my research?"

:Vaslir Maryn says, "Corpse dust, is it? I assume that means the idiot sent you and that he needs more essairyl."

:Vaslir Maryn says, "I'm afraid I used up the last of my stock on yesterday's binding."

:Vaslir Maryn says, "You'll have to talk to Vaslir Kiannes... unless you feel like gathering more essences for me."

Maryn provides the player with an alternative to speaking with [[Vaslir Kiannes]]: gather elemental essences for her.

== Elemental Essences ==

When asked about the essences, Maryn explains how Essairyl is made:

:Vaslir Maryn says, "Yes, we elaborate essairyl from the essences left behind when an elemental is destroyed."

:Vaslir Maryn says, "If you wish to hone your skills somewhat, I suggest traveling beyond the walls of the city and hunting down elementals in the southern part of this cavern. A rogue group of summoners has established a presence there. The type of elementals they are summoning are ideal sources reagents."

:Vaslir Maryn says, "Kill them and harvest four air and four earth essences. Give them to me along with the corpse dust."

The player must bring Maryn:

* 4 [[Air Essences]]
* 4 [[Earth Essences]]
* [[Corpse Dust]]

{{QuestNote|The required essences come from '''Air''' and '''Earth''' elementals. Water elementals found around the shores of Ail'Vorith are not required for this step.}}

== Creating Essairyl ==

After receiving the required essences and Corpse Dust:

:Vaslir Maryn says, "You return and with the essences. That is a welcome surprise, although competence while in the service of the idiot may not work in your favor."

''Vaslir Maryn begins feeding the essences into a series of tubes and glass receptacles. After some time she fills a flask with a silvery liquid and hands it to you.''

The player receives:

* [[Essairyl]]

Maryn then says:

:Vaslir Maryn says, "You are a promising young elementalist. In the future, should you desire to work for a competent instructor, you know where my laboratory is."

:Vaslir Maryn says, "May you hear, kulzzan."

The [[Essairyl]] can then be returned to [[Vaslir Vharkith]] to continue [[House Varros (Quest)]].

== Location ==

Vaslir Kiannes is located in the upper portion of [[Ail'Vorith]], in the same general area as [[Vaslir Vharkith]] and [[Vaslir Maryn]].

He can be found near the fountain where Maryn is located.

{{QuestNote|If you have already located [[Vaslir Maryn]] or [[Vaslir Vharkith]], Kiannes is very close by in the same upper section of the city.}}

== Quest Involvement ==

Vaslir Kiannes is involved in Part 3 of [[House Varros (Quest)]].

After [[Vaslir Vharkith]] sends the player to obtain a [[Flask of Essairyl]], [[Vaslir Maryn]] explains that she has none remaining and suggests speaking with Kiannes as an alternative to gathering elemental essences for her.

You say, 'Hail, Vaslir Kiannes.'

:Vaslir Kiannes says, "Karzzul, varsa ai Neth'xan! What brings you to me today?"

You say, 'Can you help me get essairyl?'

:Vaslir Kiannes says, "You want essairyl? I need it for my bindings, and you are obviously not ready to perform a binding of your own."

''Vaslir Kiannes laughs heartily.''

:Vaslir Kiannes says, "I assume you are one of our dear Vharkith's pawns. He's always sending you poor fellows to ask for the fruits of our labor. I assume you are hoping to trade us some corpse dust for the essairyl, as usual."

''Vaslir Kiannes makes a disapproving sound in his throat.''

:Vaslir Kiannes says, "Well, I'm afraid my price has gone up. If you want to please your master, you'll have to earn my essairyl."

You say, 'I will earn it.'

:Vaslir Kiannes says, "There are a group of deep gnomes near the northern edge of our great cavern. They are conducting experiments on the impurities in the water there."

''Vaslir Kiannes nods his head approvingly.''

:Vaslir Kiannes says, "Industrious little fellows. Almost a shame to dispose of them. Quite useful, they can be. Yes, indeed. Quite useful."

:Vaslir Kiannes says, "But research needs as they say. Research needs. Bring me some of their water samples. Ten should be enough for my current project."

:Vaslir Kiannes says, "Give me the samples along with the corpse dust, and you'll have your essairyl."

== Tainted Water Samples ==

Kiannes asks the player to collect water samples from the deep gnome experiments near the northern edge of the Great Cavern.

The player must bring Kiannes:

* 10 [[Sample of Tainted Water]]
* [[Corpse Dust]]

[[Sample of Tainted Water]] can be obtained from creatures associated with the deep gnome experiments, including:

* [[a bubbling oozeling]]
* [[a failed experiment]]
* [[a synthetic ooze]]

{{QuestNote|This is an alternative to gathering [[Essence of Elemental Air]] and [[Essence of Elemental Earth]] for [[Vaslir Maryn]]. Only one route is required to obtain the [[Flask of Essairyl]].}}

== Creating Essairyl ==

After receiving 10 [[Sample of Tainted Water]] and the [[Corpse Dust]]:

{{exp}}
{{Faction|House Varros|+}}

''Vaslir Kiannes uncorks one of the sample vials, takes a dropper from a nearby flask of red liquid, and adds a bit to the sample.''

''Vaslir Kiannes swishes the vial and watches intently as the red drops become a blue swirl.''

:Vaslir Kiannes says, "Fascinating. This may be useful indeed."

''Vaslir Kiannes turns back to you with a satisfied chuckle.''

:Vaslir Kiannes says, "Here is a vial of essairyl as promised, my dear gnome slayer."

You receive [[Flask of Essairyl]] from [[Vaslir Kiannes]].

The [[Flask of Essairyl]] can then be returned to [[Vaslir Vharkith]] to continue [[House Varros (Quest)]].

Vaslir Vharkith.title: Vaslir Vharkith
Vaslir Vharkith.content:
{{Namedmobpage
| name = Vaslir Vharkith

== Location ==

[[Vaslir Vharkith]] is located in the upper section of [[Ail'Vorith]], near [[Vaslir Maryn]] and [[Vaslir Kiannes]].

=== Directions ===

Starting from the Foreign Quarter:

# Cross the bridge into Ail'Vorith proper.
# Turn right inside the city gates and continue toward the bank.
# Face the bank entrance. Behind you is a large vaulted tunnel leading toward the city's interior docks.
# Enter the tunnel. At its far end, turn right.
# Locate the building containing a teleporter on your right. The ramp leading to it can be difficult to see in the darkness.
# Take the teleporter to the upper city.
# After exiting, look toward the steep incline beyond the nearby octagonal building.
# Follow the incline upward until you reach the elevated ledges.
# Continue up either of the ramps leading to the area occupied by Vharkith and the other vaslir.

{{QuestNote|Vaslir Vharkith is located above the main city streets. Players searching at ground level may have difficulty locating him without using the teleporter.}}

== Description ==

Vaslir Vharkith is a member of [[House Varros]] who supervises apprentices conducting research and retrieving materials on his behalf.

He presents himself as an accomplished practitioner of the magical arts, claiming to have spoken the Winding Words and to have studied under the immortal head of House Varros.

His dialogue reveals an arrogant, demanding, and ambitious personality. He frequently belittles his apprentices, dismisses the abilities of other researchers, and openly discusses his plans for advancement within the house.

Vharkith's research involves summoning, elemental essences, and specialized reagents. His assignments require the player to travel outside Ail'Vorith, recover stolen research materials, and obtain supplies from other practitioners.

During [[House Varros (Quest)]], the player progresses from a newly assigned apprentice to Vharkith's senior apprentice.

== Quest Involvement ==

=== House Varros ===

[[Vaslir Vharkith]] is the principal quest NPC throughout Parts 2 through 5 of [[House Varros (Quest)]].

Players are introduced to Vharkith after completing the initial assignments given by [[Vaslir Naiyth]] in the Obsidian Academy.

The quest involves several assignments that culminate in the player being promoted to senior apprentice.

==== Part 2: Recover Vharkith's Research Notes ====

After receiving an introductory letter from [[Vaslir Naiyth]], the player must deliver it to Vharkith.

{{exp}}

Vharkith explains that an escaped Wood Elf slave stole his research notes and fled toward the [[Great Cavern Sea]].

The escaped slave is [[Laeran Birchshade]].

The player is instructed to recover [[Vharkith's Research Notes]] and return them to Vharkith.

{{QuestNote|Although Vharkith instructs the player to hunt down the escaped slave, [[Laeran Birchshade]] can also be spoken with. This interaction can lead to a separate optional quest involving the [[Birchshade Family Bracelet]]. See [[House Varros (Quest)]] for details.}}

==== Part 3: Obtain a Flask of Essairyl ====

After receiving [[Vharkith's Research Notes]], Vharkith instructs the player to obtain a [[Flask of Essairyl]].

:Vaslir Vharkith says, "Now, I don't suppose you know what essairyl is? Of course you don't. You'll have to start knowing these things if you expect to become a senior apprentice. Run along to Vaslir Maryn and tell her I need another flask of it."

He gives the player [[Corpse Dust]] to exchange for the reagent.

The player can obtain the [[Flask of Essairyl]] through either of two routes:

* [[Vaslir Maryn]] – Collect four [[Essence of Elemental Air]] and four [[Essence of Elemental Earth]], then return them with the corpse dust.
* [[Vaslir Kiannes]] – Collect ten [[Sample of Tainted Water]] from the deep gnome experiments and return them with the corpse dust.

Only one route is required.

==== Part 4: Obtain a Bottle of Nerolir ====

After receiving the [[Flask of Essairyl]], Vharkith awards experience and requests a new reagent.

{{exp}}

He explains that Nerolir, an elven cider, contains the level of malic acid required for his research.

Because the cider is banned within Ail'Vorith, the player must locate a source in the Foreign Quarter.

[[Nyxia Ak'kin]] suggests speaking with the dark elf, leading the player to [[Miral the Dark Elf]].

Give Miral 10 silver to receive a [[Bottle of Nerolir]].

Return the bottle to Vharkith.

{{exp}}

Vharkith then assigns the player to recover a special order from [[Night Harbor]].

He provides the [[Letter to Freysia Riftrend]], which the player must deliver to an elementalist in the [[Underdocks]].

==== Part 5: Retrieve Vharkith's Order ====

Vharkith sends the player to [[Freysia Riftrend]] in the eastern [[Underdocks]] of [[Night Harbor]].

Freysia explains that an elementalist named [[Belot]] betrayed the Descendian Order and stole several valuable items, including Vharkith's package.

The player must locate Belot among the Deepcut bandits and recover [[Vharkith's Order]].

Return the order to Vharkith in [[Ail'Vorith]].

{{exp}}
{{Faction|House Varros|+}}

Upon receiving the order, Vharkith promotes the player to his new senior apprentice.

=== Promotion to Senior Apprentice ===

After receiving [[Vharkith's Order]], Vharkith recognizes the player for completing the assignment originally entrusted to his previous senior apprentice.

:Vaslir Vharkith says, "Varsa ai Neth'xan! You have finally lived up to my expectations, Senior. Yes, that's right. Since you completed Senior's task, you are now my new senior apprentice. If the old one should somehow find his way back here, you may do with him as you will."

Vharkith explains that he has no senior apprentice robes remaining and that the player must obtain a robe independently.

He concludes by telling the player to return later, when he may have another assignment.

== Dialogue ==

=== Initial Assignment ===

During the player's introduction to Vharkith, he describes himself as an accomplished researcher with connections to the leadership of House Varros.

:Vaslir Vharkith says, "Yes, I am a student of the immortal head of our house himself! Now you are realizing just how beneficial it will be for you to serve one with my connections."

=== Research and Apprentices ===

Vharkith frequently comments on the poor survival rate of his apprentices and the perceived incompetence of other elementalists.

He also remarks on the importance of keeping certain research activities outside the political affairs of House Varros.

=== Dialogue After Part 5 ===

After completing Part 5 and being promoted to senior apprentice, hailing Vharkith produces the following response:

You say in Deep Common, "Hail, Vaslir Vharkith."

:Vaslir Vharkith says, "Karzzul, Senior. I am still busy with my project. Return to me later."

{{QuestNote|'''Quest Progression Status (October 19, 2026):''' At level 24 with Amicable House Varros faction, no additional assignment was offered after completing Part 5.

It is unknown whether further assignments have not yet been implemented, require a higher character level, require additional House Varros faction, or have another prerequisite.

The full dialogue and walkthrough for all known assignments can be found in [[House Varros (Quest)]].}}

== Quest Items ==

=== Items Given to the Player ===

* [[Corpse Dust]] – Given after returning Vharkith's Research Notes.
* [[Letter to Freysia Riftrend]] – Given after returning the Bottle of Nerolir.

=== Items Received from the Player ===

* [[Vharkith's Research Notes]] – Recovered from [[Laeran Birchshade]].
* [[Flask of Essairyl]] – Obtained through [[Vaslir Maryn]] or [[Vaslir Kiannes]].
* [[Bottle of Nerolir]] – Obtained from [[Miral the Dark Elf]] for 10 silver.
* [[Vharkith's Order]] – Recovered during Part 5.

== Related NPCs ==

* [[Vaslir Naiyth]] – Introduces new apprentices to Vharkith.
* [[Vaslir Maryn]] – Provides an opportunity to obtain essairyl.
* [[Vaslir Kiannes]] – Offers an alternative method of obtaining essairyl.
* [[Laeran Birchshade]] – Escaped slave who possesses Vharkith's research notes.
* [[Nyxia Ak'kin]] – Provides information about locating Nerolir.
* [[Miral the Dark Elf]] – Supplies the Bottle of Nerolir.
* [[Freysia Riftrend]] – Contact in the Underdocks responsible for Vharkith's special order.
* [[Belot]] – Elementalist who stole Vharkith's order.

== Notes ==

* Vharkith's assignments are documented through Part 5 of [[House Varros (Quest)]].
* Completing Part 5 awards experience and positive House Varros faction.
* Players are promoted to senior apprentice but do not receive senior apprentice robes.
* Further assignments are suggested by Vharkith's dialogue, but the requirements for continuing remain unknown.

Bard Starter Quest (Night Harbor).title: Bard Starter Quest (Night Harbor)
Bard Starter Quest (Night Harbor).content:
{{Quest | imagefilename = phicon.png | width = 100px | caption = Placeholder Image |Start Zone = [[Night Harbor]] |Quest Giver = [[Jamee Langris]] |Minimum Level = 1 |Classes = [[Bard]] |Related NPCs = [[Guard Jeskal]] |Related Items = [[Severed Ring Finger]] }} == Reward ==
  • [[Jamee's Coin]]
  • [[Azure Enameled Golden Bangle]]
* Experience == Walkthrough == === Part 1 - Req. Lvl 1=== ''[[Jamee Langris]] is on the Azure Veils faction.'' '''Can start quest at level 1''' Placeholder until actual item names and dialogues can be added: Give newbie note to Jamee Langris, receive a note titled "Jamee's List of Names". The note contains a list of gifts for people around Night Harbor. [[File:BardQuest NPC Locations.jpg|thumb|NPC Positions for Gifts for our Dear Friends Quest]] You say, ''Where is Harbormaster Daoud?'' : Jamee Langris says, "Old Daoud is a wonderful friend of ours. Such a truly observant man, with a fantastic memory. It's incredible how much freight and how people move through the harbor in a given day, and yet there's Daoud smoking his pip and remembering every little detail. Such a gifted man." : Jamee Langris say, "You'll likely find him in his office at the docks, or walking nearby smoking his pipe and taking in... everything." : Jamee Langris winks at you. '''Hand the Pouch of Rare Tobacco to [[Harbormaster Daoud]]''' : Harbormaster Daoud takes the pouch of tobacco and immediately puts it to his node, breathing in a mighty breath. : Harbormaster Daoud says, "Aaahh... Master Jamee amazes me with his ability to find things that even I cannot." : Harbormaster Daoud laughs deeply. : Harbormaster Daoud slyly hands you a small metal parchment vial. : Harbormaster Daoud says, "You'll not want to tamper with that, lest the contents be dissolved. Goodbye now. Master Jamee has my many thanks!" * You receive Small Metal Parchment Vial from Harbormaster Daoud. You say, ''Where is Guard Jeskal?'' : Jamee Langris says, "One's infatuations do make for interesting study. Our lovely guard is quite the case. Fortunately one of our dangers really seems to cool the flames our poor guard builds up standing out there in the sun all day. She's provided the perfumed silken sash to help him get through the day." : Jamee Langris puts a finger to his chin. : Jamee Langris says, "Actually, I think it'll have the opposite effect. Imagine that. What a tease." : Jamee Langris says, "Either way, he's recently lost his posting in Highport Terrace, so you'll find him at the Northern City Gate." : Jamee Langris says, "It's a shame really. He must have been bitter about losing his cushy posting in such a posh part of the city." '''Hand the Perfumed Silken Sash to [[Guard Jeskal]]''' : Guard Jeskal takes the sash from you and immediately puts it to his face for a moment before hiding it under his breastplate. : Guard Jeskal says, "I can't wait to see her again!" : Guard Jeskal appears to look through you, while smiling and thinking of something else. : Guard Jeskal hands you a small metal parchment vial, while looking quickly to see if anyone is watching. : Guard Jeskal says, "I got this from the councilman. Please be careful in returning it to your people." * You receive Small Metal Parchment Vial from Guard Jeskal. You say, ''Where is Cordellius Hollmion?'' : Jamee Langris says, "Cordellius is quite the character. He's a slithery one and so full of ambition. We've found what he needs, but we'll see how long it's him we're friendly with. He's playing a tricky game, and he might soon find that we're better situated by making that known." : Jamee Langris says, "Don't worry, he's harmless. You'll find him in the small library within the Spellbinder's Spire in Sageside. Don't get confused and find yourself in the larger library across the way." '''Hand the Small Eye Shaped Mirror to [[Cordellius Hollmion]]''' : Cordellius Hollmion takes the mirror and stares at you for a moment, scowling. : Cordellius Hollmion says, "Take this and begone." : Cordellius Hollmion looks over his shoulder for a moment and then tosses a small metal parchment vial into your hand. : Cordellius Hollmion says, "Away with you." * You receive Small Metal Parchment Vial from Cordellius Hollmion. You say, ''Where is Elrind?'' : Jamee Langris says, "Elrind? People, including his family, do so underestimate that young man. He needs to get out more, and maybe we should see to that soon. But, in the meantime, his time spend in the Steel Talon's garrison library is proving to be quite illuminating." '''Hand the Tiny Leatherbound Book to [[Elrind Steele]]''' : Elrind Steele takes the book and smiles broadly at it before pressing it against his chest. : Elrind Steele says, "I can't wait to read this tonight after supper! He's always so good at finding these things." : Elrind Steele smiles while shaking his head and looking at tiny leatherbound book again. : Elrind Steele holds up a small metal parchment vial proudly before handing it to you. : Elrind Steele says, "This time, I think I've found something he'll be just as excited about. But it's for his eyes only. Take care with it." * You receive Small Metal Parchment Vial from Elrind Steele. You say, ''Where is Jiselle?'' : Jamee Langris says, "Sweet 'Gentle' Jiselle. She is a sincere and rare jewel of a person, with such an unfortunately complicated family. It weighs heavily on her, so I hope the flower will lift her spirits some, as she does so love them." : Jamee Langris says, "You will find her tending to the ill in the Wayfarer's Hospice adjacent to the Traveler's Camp." '''Hand the Framed Pressed Flowers to [[Jiselle Heyley]]''' : Jiselle Heyley takes the framed flowers and stares at them for a moment, seeming to melt a little; looking a mix of nostalgic, joyful, and wistful. : Jiselle Heyley says, "I can't begin to think of where he found them. I haven't seen one of these flowers since my brother and I were children. : Jiselle Heyley sighs deeply, looking at the framed flowers again. : Jiselle Heyley puts her hand in yours, opening it to place a small metal parchment vial between your palm and hers. : Jiselle Heyley says, "Jamee is a good man. I hope this helps him. You should excercise extreme caution in getting it back to him." * Your receive Small Metal Parchment Vial from Jiselle Heyley. You say, ''Where is Assistant Researcher Farland?'' : Jamee Langris says, "He's one of our newer friends... a member of that group of archaelogists from Easthymn, here to explore the various holes they keep finding in the ground in this region. Dreadful work if you ask me, but the things they discover are quite interesting. As are the people that are interesting in those interesting things." '''Hand the Vial of Cloudy Liquid to [[Assistant Researcher Farland]]''' : Assistant Researcher Farland takes the small vial and peers through it for a moment, before deftly hiding it up his sleeve. : Assistant Researcher Farland says, "Did you tamper with this?" : Assistant Researcher Farland seems to assess you briefly. : Assistant Researcher Farland says, "I assume not, since you're still standing. You may want to wash your hands either way." : Assistant Researcher Farland pulls a small smetal parchment vial out of his belt and hands it to you. : Assistant Researcher Farland says, "If the substance does its job, I'll likely have something more for him later. Take care not to lose that note on your way back. He'll want to read of my discovery." * Your receive Small Metal Parchment Vial from Assistant Researcher Farland. '''Combine the six Small Metal Parchment Vials in the provided Small Courier Bag to create the item form of the Small Courier Bag.''' '''Head back Jamee Langris with the Small Courier Bag.''' : Jamee Langris takes the bag from you and pockets the handful of scrolls, then looks at you with a smile. : Jamee Langris says 'Splendid work! I hope your first jaunt around the city in service to our greater good found you well. You're probably parched. Take this coin to the barkeep at our tavern across from the stage and he'll give you a drink.'
* Your faction standing with [[The Azure Veils]] got better.
{{exp}} === Part 2 - Req. Lvl 2 to start=== Jamee Langris says, "So, what do we do with you next?" Jamee Langris says, "I've got it! It's about time we send you on a real adventure!" You say, ''A real adventure?'' : Jamee Langris says, "Oh yes, an adventure indeed! Unfortunately, you're not quite at the stage where you can live glamorously off your good looks and well-established name. But never fear, dear... you'll get there." : Jamee Langris says, "From now on, you'll live a life of danger... and utility! Just think of how much inspiration you'll gather for your great songs of gallantry. Oh, and having a scar or two makes for fascinating party conversation and pillow talk." : Jamee Langris says, "... I'll get to the point. I've promised someone a piece of information about a certain not-so-secret smuggling operation. Scout out the camp along the western coast, in the shadow of Fallen Watch." : Jamee Langris says, "While you're out there, if you happen to find a smuggler wearing a ruby-inlaid gold ring, please retrieve it... preferably with the finger still attached, if you can manage it. The ring's rightful owner will be grateful." : Jamee Langris says, "You're shaping up to be quite the jack-of-all-trades, which is certainly fortunate for me, as I also have a second task I'd like to ask of you." You say, ''What task?'' : Jamee Langris says, "Well, this one is rather dreary, I'm afraid. A friend of ours took an amulet into the newly excavated tomb outside the city." : Jamee Langris says, "It was meant to allow communion with the dead, but apparently, it still needs some work... or at least, that's the suspicion, given reports of what happened to the person who attempted to use the amulet." : Jamee Langris says, "Ordinarily, we'd have one of the Freebooters' archaeologists find it for us, but they've been having trouble staying alive in there. The Red Mantles are out of the question, as well, since the owner isn't particularly fond of authority figures." : Jamee Langris says, "The amulet itself is silver and bears the engraving of a woman's face. Perhaps they were attempting to speak with a ghastly gal." : Jamee Langris shrugs and pats you on the shoulder, nodding kindly. : Jamee Langris says, "Would you be a dear and bring both the ruby ring and necklace back to me?" Collect the [[Severed Ring Finger]] from [[a smuggler|smugglers]] / [[a wererat|wererats]] from the Smugglers Camp in the [[Shaded Dunes]]. Then collect the [[Engraved_Amulet|Engraved Amulet]] from [[High Marshal Fionna]] in the [[Tomb of the Last Wyrmsbane]]. June 26th Update: -Place the engraved amulet and the severed ring finger into the small leather pouch and hit combine -Give the small leather pouch to Jamee Langris to receive:
  • [[Azure Enameled Golden Bangle]]

Beastmaster Starter Quest (Night Harbor).title: Beastmaster Starter Quest (Night Harbor)
Beastmaster Starter Quest (Night Harbor).content:
{{Quest | imagefilename = phicon.png | width = 100px | caption = Placeholder Image |Start Zone = [[Night Harbor]] |Quest Giver = - |Minimum Level = 1 |Classes = [[Beastmaster]] |Related NPCs = [[Leila Ghasem]], [[Kilia]], [[Yorias]] }} '''Note:''' This quest is for Beastmasters starting in [[Night Harbor]]. For the Faelindral version, see [[Beastmaster Starter Quest (Faelindral)]]. == Reward == * Experience
  • [[Beast Initiate's Cord]]
  • [[Beast Adept's Tunic]]
== Walkthrough == Video Walk-Through {{#ev:youtube|https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=FyEiDoIIhco}} === Part 1 - Req. Lvl 1=== Read [[Hastily Scrawled Note]] you start with as a new Beastmaster Character: 
Recollections of a feverish dream...

I found myself in a forest, running from a pack of
wolves who came close and nipped at my heels.
They would not relent until, finally, I collapsed in a
clearing.
They leapt upon me, biting and tearing at my flesh,
and as I was all but consumed, I did not die. Rather,
I was reborn within the pack, as one of their own.

What could this mean? Perhaps I should visit the
Seekers of the Lost Eye. Their shamans might be
able to help me...

If I recall correctly, their guild is located in
Saltbreeze Park, central to the city and in the
shadow of Highpoint Terrace's Great Guild Hall.

I must make haste.
'''Hand [[Hastily Scrawled Note]] to [[Leila Ghasem]]'''
{{exp}}
Your faction standing with Seekers of the Lost Eye got better. :Leila Ghasem takes the note brusquely, glances over it with knitted brows, then smirks at you. : Leila Ghasem says, "You have done well to bring this note to me. Have you always felt alone among the company of men, as if an outcast? It is because the feral heart of a beast beats within your chest. I welcome you to our order as an initiate." :Leila Ghasem briefly drops her feral demeanor and smiles warmly, her sharp fangs revealing her bestial nature. : Leila Ghasem says, "Your first task is simple. You are to assemble your own necklace using teeth from the local beasts." : Leila Ghasem says, "The battlefield is the ultimate way of knowing another being. The local rats, bats, and jackals should provide sufficient test for an initiate. Take two teeth from each and tie them to this string." You receive [[Worn Leather Cord]] from [[Leila Ghasem]].

'''Head to either the North Gate or West Gate Noob Yards to hunt for [[a large rat]]s, [[a desert bat]]s, and [[a jackal pup]]s.''' : We will be searching for 2 [[Rat Tooth]]s, 2 [[Bat Tooth]]s, and 2 [[Jackal Tooth]]s. Alternatively, these can be bought from vendors. : Combine the 6 items items in the [[Worn Leather Cord]]. You will receive a [[Betoothed Leather Cord]].

'''Hand [[Betoothed Leather Cord]] to Leila Ghasem'''
{{exp}}
Your faction standing with Seekers of the Lost Eye got better. : Leila Ghasem says, "Ah, yes! This is a wonderful necklace. The spacing is good, and these teeth are fine examples. Did you learn more about the creatures you faced in battle? You ought to thank them for teaching you." :Leila Ghasem clasps the necklace in prayer before throwing her head back and letting out a hyena-like cackle. : Leila Ghasem says, "Your necklace now bears the blessing of our order. Wear it proudly, for you are now and official beastmaster of the Seekers of the Lost Eye!" :Leila Ghasem ponders for a moment. : Leila Ghasem says, "Oh! Errol was fumbling around with this pouch and dropped it. I think it would be more useful to you than him, no?" :Leila Ghasem grins broadly. : Leila Ghasem says, "Be safe, . Go train with other young adventurers and return to me when you are more seasoned."
You receive [[Beast Initiate's Cord]] from [[Leila Ghasem]].
You receive [[Pouch]] from [[Leila Ghasem]].
You receive [[Simple Animal Feed]] from [[Leila Ghasem]]. === Part 2 - Req. Lvl 5 === '''Hand [[Beast Initiate's Cord]] to [[Leila Ghasem]]''' :Leila Ghasem takes the necklace from you, looks it over and gives it back to you. : Leila Ghasem says, "You are now bonded to us as a kindred spirit." :Leila Ghasem frowns. : Leila Ghasem says, "We are currently facing a small crisis and we need your help, , and it's not something you should take lightly." : Leila Ghasem says, "One of our members has gone missing. His name is Elian, an initiate like yourself, barely old enough to be a man." :Leila Ghasem tents her fingers, letting out an exasperated sigh. : Leila Ghasem says, "He went missing somewhere near Blackfeather Bazaar. If you could, I would like you to investigate. Ask the locals in the area about him, if you can, and bring back any information you can find." :Leila Ghasem quickly sketches something onto a piece of paper with a stub of charcoal, and hands it to you. You receive [[Description of Elian]] from [[Leila Ghasem]]. : Leila Ghasem says, "Oh, and, do be safe, . Whatever happened to Elian, I would hate to see it happen to you as well." :Leila Ghasem gives you a worried smile, bid you farewell. You receive your items back from [[Leila Ghasem]].

'''Head to Blackfeather Bazaar near the Necropolis in the Northern section of Night Harbor.''' There are a few people we can give the sketch to: :If you give the [[Description of Elian]] to [[a beggar]]: ::a beggar takes the sketch from you, looking it over. :: a beggar says, "Hm, looks kinda familiar... I think I seen him talking to one of the servant girls around here." :: You receive your items back from [[a beggar]]. :If you give the [[Description of Elian]] to [[a servant girl]]: ::a servant girl examines the sketch. :: a servant girl says, "Hm, I don't know him, but I think I've seen him with Kilia. Why don't you ask her?" :: You receive your items back from [[a servant girl]]. :If you give the [[Description of Elian]] to [[Kilia]]: :: Kilia says, "Hm? What's this?" ::Kilia looks over the paper, and an expression of worry crosses her face. :: Kilia says, "Oh, this is Elian alright... I haven't seen him in a few days, I've been getting worried... You all at the guild haven't seen him? This can't be good." ::Kilia hands back the piece of paper. :: You receive [[Evidence of Elian]] from [[Kilia]]. :: Kilia says, "I saw his rat scurrying around here the other night, it usually doesn't leave his side, but I haven't seen the little thing since. I don't know where it has gone, maybe the others at the guild can help? Please, let me know as soon as you find anything." ::Kilia tears up slightly as she bids you farewell.

'''Head back to [[Leila Ghasem]] in the Seekers of the Lost Eye (Guild Hall) and give her the [[Evidence of Elian]] : Leila Ghasem says, "Oh, you've returned! Did you find out anything?" :Leila Ghasem takes the evidence from you, looking it over. :Leila Ghasem sighs to herself : Leila Ghasem says, "You say she saw his rat? What was his name again... Right, Blackwhiser!" :Leila Ghasem nods. : Leila Ghasem says, "Well, the next thing you might want to do is try to find Blackwhisker... Of course, most people in the city have no idea how to tell the rats apart in this place." :Leila Ghasem smirks at you. : Leila Ghasem says, "But we're not most people. Allow me to cast a spell on you that will allow you to converse with beasts. One day, you might be able to learn this ability yourself." :Leila Ghasem waves her hands as she closes her eyes. Suddenly, you hear a rushing sound in your ears, as your throat constricts for a brief second. Then, you feel as if wax has been pulled from your ears, and the cacophony of beast sounds turns into the dull murmur of conversation. :Leila Ghasem smiles at you. : Leila Ghasem says, "Now, go and find Blackwhisker... it will lead us to Elian." : Leila Ghasem says, "That spell will allow you to converse with the many beasts here in the city, though I would concentrate your search in the Harbor district... I'm sure you'll find Blackwhisker among his fellow rats." : Leila Ghasem says, "Oh, and if the enchantment fades before you can complete your mission, you can come back and ask for me to renew it. Just give me this evidence back, so I remember to cast the spell on you." :Leila Ghasem sighs, passing the sketch back to you. : You receive [[Sketch of Elian]] from [[Leila Ghasem]]. : Leila Ghasem says, "Good luck!" :Leila Ghasem waves goodbye to you.

'''Make your way to the Harbor District in Southern Night Harbor. Looking for [[a black rat]], however if one is not available, then you will need to kill [[a brown rat]]s or [[a fat rat]]s until one appears. NOTE: You do not have to talk to the rats. You can skip them and just speak to Whiskey, then move on to the next step. ''' : If you hail [[a brown rat]] :: a brown rat turns to you suddenly. :: a brown rat says, "You speak rat? Learn something new every day." :: You say, "Have you seen Blackwhisker?" :: a brown rat sniffs around. :: a brown rat says, "Pathetic pet rat running around here somewhere." : If you hail [[a fat rat]] :: a fat rat turns to you suddenly. :: a fat rat says, "Amazing! Two-legs not stupid, know how to talk." :: You say, "Have you seen Blackwhisker?" :: a fat rat sniffs around. ::a fat rat says, "Pathetic pet rat running around here somewhere." :: a fat rat chitters loudly. :: a fat rat says, "Easy to take food from, scared of me." : If you hail [[a black rat]] :: a black rat sniffs up at you, recognizing your scent from the guild. :: a black rat says, "Friend? Elian?" :: You say, "Where is Elian?" :: a black rat stands up on his hind legs, sniffing at you. :: a black rat says, "You're looking for Elian as well? Oh no... He never came back when he went with the scary men." :: You say, "What scary men?" :: a black rat skitters about in a circle, then stands up again, sniffing the air. :: a black rat says, "Yes, scary men, smell was strange... like you, but not like you. Do not know where went, but dogs might know." : If you hail [[Whiskey]] (and possibly [[Patches]]) :: Whiskey looks up at you, wagging his tail. :: Whiskey says, "Hail, and well met! How can this humble hound be of service? I hope no trouble is afoot?" :: You say, "Where are the scary men?" :: Whiskey says, "Looking for some scary men?" :: Whiskey says, "Well, there are some different types of scary people who pass through the harbor, some of them men, some of them not..." :: Whiskey says, "Whom, pray tell, are you looking for, someone in particular?" :: You say, "Elian" :: Whiskey says, "Ah, the beastmaster... Yes, I know of him, he often gave me pets when he came by. Such a nice young man. I haven't seen him since he went with those... intimidating travelers." :: Whiskey sighs like any other dog. :: Whiskey says, "Oh, I do believe, I overheard one of their names... Yorias, I believe. Yes, I last smelled the man somewhere on the other side of the harbor..." :: Whiskey says, "Do be careful! I must say, I do not like the cut of that particular man's jib!"

'''Head to the Eastern Harbor (Large Harbor) and slightly inland until you see a little creek with some [[a watersnake]]s. We will follow this path east until right after we pass the smith on the right. There should be [[Yorias]] outside of the building on the left hand side.(advice - Open the city map and find the main entrance to the “The Bends” district — you need to approach its main gate. At the spot where the two Watchmen are standing, turn around and stand with your back to them.) : You say, "Hail, Yorias." :: Yorias looks at you with disdain, spitting on the ground before speaking. :: Yorias says, "Whaddayou want?!" :: You say, "Elian" :: Yorias shrugs at you. :: Yorias says, "Who's that?! What does he look like?!" '''Hand the [[Sketch of Elian]] to [[Yorias]]''' : Yorias takes the parchment from you, looking at it with a sneer. : Yorias says, "Haven't seen this runt, or his little rat, either." : You receive your items back from [[Yorias]]. : You say, "Rat" (Can probably say anything here to be honest) : Yorias snarls at you. : Yorias says, "Enough of your questions, runt!." : Yorias says, "I'm tired of you trying to interfere in my business! Time to die, punk!" : Yorias says, "Bet you wish you left me alone, huh?!" : After Killing [[Yorias]], you will receive a [[Severed Ponytail]] and a [[Skintaker's Note]]. We will be taking these both to [[Leila Ghasem]] in the Seekers of the Lost Eye. '''Turn in the [[Severed Ponytail]], [[Skintaker's Note]], and [[Crumpled Sketch of Elian]] together to [[Leila Ghasem]]
{{exp}} : Leila Ghasem takes the ponytail from you, sniffing it. : Leila Ghasem says, "That's Elian's scent alright... The poor lad..." : Leila Ghasem says, "What did that man say to you before you killed him? Something about Skintakers?" : Leila Ghasem clasps her hands together. : Leila Ghasem says, "This isn't good. The Skintakers are a group of people who follow the teachings of the Spiral, or so it is said. They do not commune and live with beasts, as we do, but instead, they seek the fast path to power" : Leila Ghasem takes a deep breath. : Leila Ghasem says, "This is not the last we hear of them. However, you've done good work today, avenging Elian..." : Leila Ghasem says, "Here, take this as a token of our appreciation." You receive [[Beast Adept's Tunic]] from [[Leila Ghasem]].
