Burnt Out Lightstones.content:
{{Quest | imagefilename = | width = | caption = |Start Zone = [[Night Harbor]] |Quest Giver = [[Jabir Ilhamar]] |Minimum Level = 4 |Classes = WIZ |Related NPCs = [[a willowisp]] |Related Items = [[Burnt-Out Lightstone]] |Quest Rewards= (exp) }} == Walkthrough ==
This quest has a prerequisite. Player needs to complete the Wizard starter quest part 1, before Jabir will provide quest. Player must provide proof of being part of the Academy before [[Jabir Ilhamar]] will accept the burnt out lightstones.


Say What aobut Viridon?

: '''Jabir Ilhamar says,''' "No We haven't found Viridon... but thank you for your concern." : '''Jabir Ilhamar says,''' "I do have another task for you, however. The Academy is in need of burnt out lightstones. If you could bring me four, it would be of great value to us." : '''Jabir Ilhamar says,''' "You'll find wisps floating about the Shaded Dunes." : Jabir Ilhamar nods to you with a worried glance.
Turn in four burnt out lightstones to [[Jabir Ilhamar]].

: Jabir Ilhamar holds the burnt out lightstones in his cupped hands. : '''Jabir Ilhamar says,''' "Oh! Very good indeed! The Academy thanks you."
{{exp}}

This quest is repeatable.

Druid Starter Quest (Faelindral).title: Druid Starter Quest (Faelindral)
Druid Starter Quest (Faelindral).content:
{{Quest | imagefilename = phicon.png | width = 100px | caption = Placeholder Image |Start Zone = [[Faelindral]] |Quest Giver = [[ Sylvarya Starveil]] |Minimum Level = 1 |Classes = [[Druid]] |Related NPCs = [[Sylwine Brightspirit]] | Related Items = Bone Chips }} __TOC__ == Reward ==
  • Scroll [[Minor Frostbite]]
  • [[Fire Beetle Eye]]
  • [[Aspirant Icon of the Gatekeeper]]
  • [[Icon of the Gatekeeper]]
* Experience == Walkthrough == === Part 1 - Req. Lvl 1=== Read [[Rolled Leafscroll]] 
CynderR,
We have sensed the draw of the Wyrdgates within your gaze, young one.
We would welcome you to join the ranks of the Wyrdguard in our mission to protect our kin from unseen threats and see them safely across the whole of Aêthoril.
Seek out High Gatekeeper Sylvarya Starviel within the Sentinel's Gaze; our garrison upon Sentinel's Terrace. You'll find it one platform over from the Fae Lift, or across from the Trader's Terrace.
Present to her this letter, and she shall begin your guidance and help you take your first steps towards navigating the penumbral paths.
Fair shades to you,
Commander Elydris Stormbough
'''1. Ring the bell and take the lift up and make your way to the 'Upper Tier'.
''' '''You can find [[Sylvarya Starveil]] in the un-named half house on the 'Upper Tier'
''' '''Hand [[Rolled Leafscroll]] to [[Sylvarya Starveil]].''' : Sylvarya Starveil accepts the offered letter with a knowing smile and a gentle bow. Her wizened gaze does not settle on yours but instead drifts past your shoulder, as though addressing someone behind you. : Sylvarya Starveil says, "I greet you, whispered one, I am Sylvarya Starveil, the High Gatekeeper of the Wyrdguard," : Sylvarya Starveil says, "I am delighted to be the first to welcome you into the Sentinel's Gaze." : Sylvarya Starveil takes your hand in hers and gently places a simple phial into your open palm, her fingers closing around both your hand and the phial. : Sylvarya Starveil says, "You have been summoned here by our leader, Elydris, because of your promising connection with the spirits of nature. Are you prepared to take the first steps toward becoming a gatekeeper?" : You say, "im prepared to take the first steps" : Sylvarya Starveil says, "As a gatekeeper of the Wyrdguard, your role will be to both support and transport your allies through the Wyrdgates." : Sylvarya Starveil says, "You will find one such gateway here in Evershade Weald, at the base of the northernmost lift that leads toward the caverns inhabited by fae." : Sylvarya Starveil says, "Your first task will be to help nourish and maintain this gateway. Pour the contents of the phial I gave you into the very center of the circular formation of toadstools that you find there." : Sylvarya Starveil says, "Once you have poured an offering from the phial, you must then exhibit a moment of patience as you await... a response." ''You receive [[Simple Phial]] from [[Sylvarya Starveil]].'' '''2. take the lift down at the neighboring platform from where you speak to Sylvarya (Note: [[guard Galen]] is standing by the lift; this is not the newbie lift you start at. It is marked as the Pixie Lift on the [[Faelindral]] map), and stand in the center of the circle of toadstools''' Note: you can see the ring of mushrooms from the platform [[Sylvarya Starveil]] is on if you run around it and look at the ground down below if you have trouble finding it ''/pour toadstools (while holding the [[Simple Phial]] from Sylvarya)'' Note: you need to be right in the center, turn in circles and move to the center and keep trying ''You receive [[Empty Phial]].'' : You pull the stopper and pour out the contents of the phial. Liquid which appears to be simple spring water is swallowed up greedily by the surrounding toadstools, soil and fallen needles. Now all that remains is to await any sort of response... Nothing appears to change so far aside from the odd sensation of being tugged towards the center of this ring of toadstools. You continue to wait patiently... : Your patience is at last rewarded as the pull you feel towards the center of the Wyrdgate grows stronger. A point of light forms at the center of the Wyrdgate; what appears to be the very beginnings of a portal! : The point of light grows no larger than a coin, out of which begins to pour a slow deluge of murky water. This strange fountain must be the reaction that Sylvarya mentioned that you need to take a sample of and return to her. '''3. /take water (while holding the [[Empty Phial]])''' ''You receive [[Strange Reaction Phial]].'' : You use your now-empty phial to collect a sample of the eerie reaction and press the stopper back into the neck of the bottle. : As soon as you've collected what you need, the small portal from which the water had cascaded closes and stems the flow. The remains of the fountain seep into the forest floor, leaving the Wyrdgate in it's natural, serene state, '''4. take the lift back up and return to [[Sylvarya Starveil]].
''' '''give the [[Strange Reaction Phial]] to [[Sylvarya Starveil]].''' '''You receive [[Novice Icon of the Gatekeeper]].''' : Sylvarya Starveil holds the phial up to the light and swirls its murky contents. You perceive the faintest furrow of her brow before she returns her attention to something just over your shoulder, : Sylvarya Starveil says, "I thank you for this, CynderR. We must always be vigilant in our efforts regarding the Wyrdgates, for though they are undoubtedly a great asset to our people, they could also prove to be a great vulnerability if left unchecked." : Sylvarya Starveil says, "I cannot yet explain the results of your efforts to you, but you have at least taken the first step toward becoming a gatekeeper." : Sylvarya Starveil says, "Only one who is capable of viewing the Wyrding could have seen this reaction take place, and thus I present to you this icon to symbolize your rank as a novice." : Sylvarya Starveil says, "I would also have you sent on another task, should you choose to accept it." [[Novice Icon of the Gatekeeper]] === Part 2 - Req. Lvl 1=== UPDATE!! Sylwine Brightspirit is not in the Inn. She is in the Well of Order. As the quests states. '''You say, "what task"''' ''You receive [[Strange Reaction Phial]] from [[Sylvarya Starveil]].'' : Sylvarya Starveil says, "Maintaining the Wyrdgates is our primary responsibility, but it is also our duty to protect our fellow Wyrdguard from any who would see them harm." : Sylvarya Starveil says, "As gatekeepers, we are the ones who bring them into the fray, embolden them through our magics, mend their wounds, and call upon nature's own wrath to lash out against those who oppose us." : Sylvarya Starveil closes her fist, which briefly alights with a brilliant flame that seems to swirl with majestic faerie hues of red, blue, and violet. She snuffs out the demonstration shortly afterward. : Sylvarya Starveil says, "Take the phial that you filled earlier to an ally of ours in the Preservers, Sylwine Brightspirit is a brilliant alchemist who currently heads the Well of Order, and she may have some insight as to what it now contains," '''Head to the Well of Order, [[Sylwine Brightspirit]] is in the front room on the way to the 'Lower Tier'.''' '''Hand [[Strange Reaction Phial]] to [[Sylwine Brightspirit]].''' ''You receive [[Reagent Bag]] from [[Sylwine Brightspirit]].'' : Sylwine Brightspirit blinks in surprise as you hand her the strange phial, : Sylwine Brightspirit says, "From the High Gatekeeper herself? Well, I'd best take a look right away!" : Sylwine Brightspirit says, "Ah, from the looks of that symbol, you're a novice among the gatekeepers. Would you be willing to do me a small favor while I look over the phial?" : Sylwine Brightspirit hands you a small bag with various separated pockets, each for carrying different reagents. '''You say, "what favor"''' : Sylwine Brightspirit says, "The shop is running a little low on some of the more popular reagents. Normally, I have Preservers running around doing this for me, but you have some free time, right?" : Sylwine Brightspirit says, "I need you to find me two royal jellies, two bat wings, and... maybe a couple of bone chips, just in case." : Sylwine Brightspirit says, "You can put them all in that reagent bag and secure it once you're done. I should have this phial sorted out by the time you return. Thanks in advance!" : Sylwine Brightspirit immediately turns her attention to the phial, '''Kill [[a black bat]] for [[Bat Wing]], [[a wasp drone]] for [[Royal Jelly]] and [[a rotting skeleton]] for [[Bone Chips]].''' '''Combine two [[Royal Jelly]], two [[Bat Wing]], and two [[Bone Chips]] in the [[Reagent Bag]].''' ''You receive [[Full Reagent Bag]].'' '''Hand [[Full Reagent Bag]] to [[Sylwine Brightspirit]].''' ''You receive [[Note of Results]].'' : Sylwine Brightspirit looks to be in a dour mood when you arrive, but the sight of your full reagent bag brightens her spirits. : Sylwine Brightspirit says, "Oh, great, you're back! I thought you might have been that awful rogue who just dropped off a horrible-smelling concoction for me to sort through." : Sylwine Brightspirit says, "These are fine specimens... and all neatly organized as well! You have my thanks, and, I hope, some answers for your High Gatekeeper." : Sylwine Brightspirit offers you a rolled leafnote. : Sylwine Brightspirit says, "I put all my findings into that note, but I had to use most of the substance to get any clear results. Where did you say you found that stuff, anyway?" : Sylwine Brightspirit says, "Oh never mind, it's not important. I also included a very important reagent as a measure of thanks for your assistance. I think Sylvarya will appreciate it." : Sylwine Brightspirit says, "Stop by again if you ever need some potions" the note reads: 
High Gatekeeper,
The sample size delivered was quite small, but I was able to determine the source of thedisturbance.
Floral traces corroborate with similar samples that we've received from the Reekbog by our scouting parties. 
The magical nature is also similar to the corrupting presence of the Spiral. 
I hope that you haven't discovered this in the Weald? Please keep me advised.
Spirits preserve you.
-Sylwine
'''head back to [[Sylvarya Starveil]] and give her the [[Novice Icon of the Gatekeeper]] and the [[Note of Results]].''' ''You receive Scroll [[Minor Frostbite]] and [[Aspirant Icon of the Gatekeeper]].'' : Sylvarya Starveil says, "Another task well done. And here you thought they would not succeed." : Sylvarya Starveil gently chuckles to no one in particular. It is clear she was not addressing you with her comment. : Sylvarya Starveil says, "It appears that Sylwine thought quite highly of your assistance as well. This particular reagent is nigh impossible to find out here in the Weald." : Sylvarya Starveil opens the softly glowing pouch, retrieving what appears to be a preserved beetle eye that emits a glow akin to softly burning embers. : Sylvarya Starveil says, "Take this eye and scribe this scroll. You shall be able to call upon the embers that reside in the heart of all faeflies to both sear and hinder your foes." : Sylvarya Starveil says, "I have also taken the liberty of enhancing your icon, as you have proven to be quite resourceful. I believe that you will make a wonderful gatekeeper with the proper guidance." : Sylvarya Starveil says, "You are now free to explore the Weald for a time, but when you feel you are ready, you may present your icon to Commander Elydris Stormbough as a sign that you have gained my approval," '''Rewards:'''
  • Scroll [[Minor Frostbite]]
  • [[Aspirant Icon of the Gatekeeper]]
* Experience === Part 3 - Req. level 4+ === '''Hand [[Aspirant Icon of the Gatekeeper]] to [[Commander Elydris Stormbough]].''' : Commander Elydris Stormbough says, "Sylvarya speaks highly of your potential, young Gatekeeper. I am glad to have the chance to meet and introduce myself." : Commander Elydris Stormbough says, "I am Elydris Stormbough, Commander of the Wyrdguard. I have the honor of being a Gatekeeper, much like yourself. Our ability to bring our allies to and from the fields of battle is an invaluable tactic." : Commander Elydris Stormbough says, "It is a tactic that we must ingrain into younger Gatekeepers as soon as possible. Do you believe that you are ready to learn our ways?" '''You say, "I am ready." : Commander Elydris Stormbough says, "Then I entrust the delivery of an important letter to you, aspirant. Return to Sylvarya and tell her that you are ready to see the paths." : Commander Elydris Stormbough says, "You will be guided through the Wyrding itself and witness firsthand what Gatekeepers are capable of." : Commander Elydris Stormbough says, "Once through the paths, you shall deliver the letter to a human woman named Almina. She shall provide you the means of returning to the Weald." : Commander Elydris Stormbough says, "Go now, aspirant, and may the shades of the Weald protect you." '''She hands you [[Druidic Leafscroll]]''' '''Say to [[Sylvarya Starveil]] "I am ready to see the paths"''' : You say, "I and ready to see the paths" : Sylvarya Starveil says, "The commander must have high hopes if she sent you to see the pathways so soon. So be it." : Sylvarya Starveil says, "Allow me to tether your soul to this place, so that you may use it as an anchor point to return to the Weald." : Sylvarya Starveil says, "I shall then open a gateway through which you may enter the Wyrding for the first time." : Sylvarya Starveil says, "Make sure that you have your letter with you. You are to return any response to me when you arrive back in the Sentinels Gaze." : Sylvarya Starveil says, "Let me know when you are prepared." '''Sylvarya will bind your soul.''' '''You say, "I am prepared."''' '''Sylvarya will teleport you to the [[Sungreet Strand]] Druid ring.''' '''Hand the letter to [[Almina Weepingwind]].''' : Almina Weepingwind says, "You're an aspirant of the Wyrdguard, yes? I'm Almina of the Circle of Scarce Rains. I welcome you to our grove here in Sungreet Strand." : Almina Weepingwind says, "Our two orders often exchange correspondence within these sacred places, as they are natural waypoints for those who traverse the penumbral paths. Was that your first time? You look a little queasy!" : Almina Weepingwind says, "You can bring this letter back to your High Gatekeeper, and that scroll should teach you how to return along the same pathways you used to get here." : Almina Weepingwind says, "Of course, you can always remain here or visit Night Harbor, though the path is quite dangerous being this close to Tel Ekir... so I'd not advise it unless you're confident." '''Almina hands you a letter and the Scroll [[Gate]].''' '''Gate to Evershade Weald and hand the letter to Sylvarya.''' : Sylvarya Starveil says, "Welcome home, aspirant! Not many can navigate the paths so easily for their first time, though you seem to have had no such trouble." : Sylvarya Starveil says, "In time, you will learn to bring yourself and others through many such gateways. For now, you will only be able to use the ones that you designate for your own soul." : Sylvarya Starveil says, "I see you also made contact with the Circle of Scarce Rains. Their current leader was once a resident of Evershade Weald. She would have made a promising Gatekeeper." : Sylvarya Starveil says, "While our two groups are venturing very different paths, it always helps to have allies who share a love for the balance and the natural order." : Sylvarya Starveil says, "Now then, the commander will be eager to hear of your return. Go to her and show this token as proof that I have received Almina's response." '''Sylvarya hands you [[Druidic Token]].''' '''Hand the token to [[Commander Elydris Stormbough]].''' : Commander Elydris Stormbough says, "How was your first foray through the paths, young one? It will not be long before you are able to carry entire scouting parties through the Wyrding." : Commander Elydris Stormbough says, "That is for a future day, however. For now, we have more pressing matters here at home that require your direct attention." : Commander Elydris Stormbough says, "Our archers are currently out countering the orc spies, while our fighters fend off the warriors that descend from the cliffsides." : Commander Elydris Stormbough says, "It shall be your duty to assist our forces by countering the fell magics they utilize through shamanistic rituals." : Commander Elydris Stormbough says, "Take this satchel and fill it with the broken idols of Fellstone shamans. They attempt to aid their forces from the back lines, but that is where our moonfire can still strike." : Commander Elydris Stormbough says, "I would advise you to seek out fellow Wyrdguard or other adventurers in your efforts. Return to me once you have sufficiently quelled the orcs' supporting ranks." : Commander Elydris Stormbough says, "And do not hesitate to utilize your newfound ability to traverse the Wyrding, should the need arise." '''She hands you [[Vine-Strapped Satchel]].''' '''Kill [[a Fellstone shaman]] until you have x4 [[Broken Shaman Idol]]. Combine those in the satchel and receive [[Full Vine-Strapped Satchel]].''' '''Hand the satchel to Commander Stormbough.''' : Commander Elydris Stormbough says, "You have performed admirably, young gatekeeper. A force is nothing without proper support, and you have isolated the orcs from theirs." : Commander Elydris Stormbough says, "These idols reek with the stain of the Spirals, even when broken. Bring them to Sylvarya so that she may continue her investigations." : Commander Elydris Stormbough says, "Thank you again, [name]. We shall call upon you again soon, I am sure." '''She hands you the satchel. Take it to Sylvarya.''' : Sylvarya Starveil says, "The instruments of orc rituals carry with them a corruption that lingers, even after their destruction." : Sylvarya Starveil says, "I will do what I can to cleanse these idols and see if they align with the other elements we have uncovered so far, but you have done well for the Faelewyn today." : Sylvarya Starveil says, "Please accept these gloves as a measure of thanks, [name]. One cannot be too careful in the handling of such dangerous idols." : Sylvarya Starveil says, "You may continue to aid those of the Weald for now. I will have one final task for you once my investigations have concluded." '''She hands you [[Sap-Stained Gloves]].''' '''Rewards:'''
  • Scroll [[Gate]]
  • [[Sap-Stained Gloves]]
* Experience '''If you hail her, she will say the follow:''' : Sylvarya Starveil says, "Continue to aid those of the Weald until you feel you are ready to learn more of the Wyrding. Upon such a time, return the gloves to me so that I may gauge your progress." === Part 4 - Req. Level 8+ === '''Hand [[Sap-Stained Gloves]] to Sylvarya. She will return them.''' : Sylvarya Starveil says, "Your connection to the natural world has grown stronger, aspirant. Verses of your strength sing from you like wind through the reeds." : Sylvarya Starveil says, "The gloves are yours to keep, of course, though you will also need this lodestone if you are ready to assist in my investigations." '''She hands you [[Lodestone]].''' '''You say, "I am ready to assist."''' : Sylvarya Starveil says, "You have been aiding me from the start, if you were not already aware." : Sylvarya Starveil says, "The reaction from the Wyrdgate due to the phial you poured, the study of its contents by Sylwine, as well as the message received from Almina of the Circle of Scarce Rains." : Sylvarya Starveil says, "All were related to a theory of mine; and, upon studying the orcish idols that you last brought me, I have finally reached a conclusion." '''You say, "What conclusion?"''' : Sylvarya Starveil says, "I can say with confidence that there is a second Wyrdgate located within the Weald. One that is under the control of our enemies." : Sylvarya Starveil says, "This may be how a portion of their forces have entered the Weald undetected, and as Gatekeepers, it falls on us to close it." : Sylvarya Starveil says, "Will you use your gifts to aid us in this endeavor, aspirant?" '''You say, "I will use my gifts."''' : Sylvarya Starveil says, "If the orc forces have somehow opened a second gate, it means they have enlisted aid from someone capable of connecting to the Wyrding... a feat their kind is incapable of." : Sylvarya Starveil says, "First we must find the location of this gate, after which we must deal with its creator." : Sylvarya Starveil says, "I recommend camouflaging yourself with nature's embrace and scouring the areas of Evershade upon which the orcs have made their presence known. Avoid the undead if you choose to do this, as their unnatural gaze can pierce our shrouds." : Sylvarya Starveil says, "Search for any signs of a circular formation. It need not be a circle of toadstools such as our own gate. Theirs could be made of flowers, stones, or any other natural phenomenon." : Sylvarya Starveil says, "Once located, you are to place the lodestone within the center of the circle to attune it to its last used destination." : Sylvarya Starveil says, "Return the attuned lodestone to me once you have done this, and may the shades of the Weald protect you, [name]." '''Go to the orc valley and make your way to the ramps that lead up from near the spires that spawn skeletons and rabid dogs just near the road out of the zone. Go up the ramp and then turn left. Head to the end of the road on the cliff and you'll see a moss archway drawn onto the cliff face. This is the moss circle.''' '''While standing near the moss circle and with the lodestone on your cursor, /place lodestone.''' '''You receive [[Attuned Lodestone]]. ***After about 10 seconds three orcs will spawn. These will be the higher level orcs, two guards and one defiler. Run or Gate.''' '''Hand the attuned lodestone to Sylvarya.''' : Sylvarya Starveil says, "What do you think? Yes. Yes, I believe so as well." : Sylvarya Starveil says, "It is as we feared." : Sylvarya Starveil says, "Not only is there a second, active Wyrdgate, but this one has made two distinct connections between the mires of the Reekbog and the shadows of the Deep." : Sylvarya Starveil says, "It would be unwise to draw a conclusion from that alone, but the fact remains that we must sever this connection if our forces are to have any hope of reclaiming the cliffs." : Sylvarya Starveil says, "I entrust this task to you, aspirant, as with your abilities, you should have no trouble temporarily sealing the gateway. You must, however, employ the proper method." '''You say, "What is the proper method?"''' : Sylvarya Starveil says, "Any individual could simply tear away the moss, but this would only provide a short respite. The one who created the gate could return to renew it in short order." : Sylvarya Starveil says, "What we require is a solution capable of removing the moss completely from the stone and preventing its regrowth. I can create such a solution for you, but I need you to bring me the venom sac of both a wasp and a Mezzatrian widow spider." '''You need to kill wasps and [[A Mezzatrian Broodling|Mezzatrian Broodling]] spiders for [[Wasp Venom Sac]] and [[Widow Venom Sac]]. Hand these to Sylvarya.''' NOTE: The venom sacs are often found on Cooking Supplies or shady merchants. * Any spider named Mezzatrian can drop it. They can be found on the platform across the broken bridge. (across the fallen log, up the ramp, behind the waterfall, follow bridges) '''She hands you [[Searing Solution]].''' NOTE: If you fail this part of the quest, simply hand Sylvarya more venom sacs for another solution. : Sylvarya Starveil says, "Here is the solution you require. Pour this upon the moss to destroy it, but be cautious. Such interference with the gateway is sure to spare the ire of the one who created it." : Sylvarya Starveil says, "That is the plan, of course. Once you have drawn out the interloper, you must subdue them to prevent them from ever conjuring another Wyrdgate." : Sylvarya Starveil says, "Lastly, and most importantly, you must place the attuned lodestone once more into the center of the destroyed gateway to seal off the Wyrding completely." : Sylvarya Starveil says, "Return to me with the used lodestone, as well as any evidence of your victory against the orcs' hired hand. Should you require more of the solution, you will have to fetch me another wasp and widow venom sac." '''Go back to the moss circle and, with the solution on your cursor, /pour solution.''' '''After about 10 seconds [[Muleda Murktoe]] will spawn. He is a level 13 Druid and casts Lesser Heal, Burning Embers, and Moon Ember.''' NOTE: Given that he drops a Reekbog Focus and, noted by Sylvarya's dialogue later, Muleda will likely become a Troll once they are implemented. '''Kill Muleda and loot [[Reekbog Focus]].''' '''Stand close to the moss circle and, with the Attuned Lodestone on your cursor, /place lodestone.''' '''You receive [[Used Lodestone]]. After 10 seconds you'll be teleported to Shallow Shoals as part of the moss gate collapsing.''' '''Return the Used Lodestone and Reekbog Focus to Sylvarya.''' : Sylvarya Starveil says, "A druid of the Reekbog was aligned with the orcs? A frightening development, though not entirely surprising. The trolls are notorious survivors, and there could be dozens of reasons as to how they found themselves doing the bidding of the Fellstone Clan." : Sylvarya Starveil says, "Regardless, you have proven yourself a true Gatekeeper, [name]. You have protected the Weald and safeguarded the pathways just as one should." : Sylvarya Starveil says, "Here, a token. Brind this along with your aspirant icon to Commander Elydris Stormbough." : Sylvarya Starveil says, "It is time you are recognized as a full member of the Wyrdguard." : Sylvarya Starveil says, "We thank you, Gatekeeper [name]." '''She hands you [[Druidic Token]].''' '''Hand the [[Druidic Token]] and [[Aspirant Icon of the Gatekeeper]] to the Commander.''' : Commander Elydris Stormbough says, "The High Gatekeeper informed me of your mission, [name]. This token must mean that you have returned triumphant. Well done!" : Commander Elydris Stormbough says, "We are honored to have a talent such as yourself among the ranks of the Wyrdguard." : Commander Elydris Stormbough says, "You have proven yourself beyond the measure of an aspirant and are hereby recognized as Gatekeeper [name]. I present you with this icon as a symbol of your status." : Commander Elydris Stormbough says, "Faelindral sings to your accomplishment!" '''She hands you [[Icon of the Gatekeeper]].''' Bone Chips for Moon Dances.title: Bone Chips for Moon Dances

Beastmaster Starter Quest (Faelindral).title: Beastmaster Starter Quest (Faelindral)
Beastmaster Starter Quest (Faelindral).content:
{{Quest | imagefilename = Beastmaster.png | width = 100px | caption = | Start Zone = [[Faelindral]] | Quest Giver = | Minimum Level = 1 | Classes = [[Beastmaster]] | Related NPCs = [[Captain Relgen Greenblade]], [[Aerin Mossfang]] }} '''Note:''' This quest is for Beastmasters starting in [[Faelindral]]. For the Night Harbor version, see [[Beastmaster Starter Quest (Night Harbor)]].
__TOC__ == Rewards == * Experience * [[Novice Claws of the Keeper]] from Part 1 * [[Spirit-Blessed Shawl]] from Part 2 == Walkthrough == === Part 1 - Req. Lvl 1=== Read [[Request for Aid]] you start with as a new Beastmaster Character: 
A call is put out to any Faelewyn who would heed 
it.

The balance of the Weald is threatened; the natural 
order disturbed.

Those with a connection to the lands and its 
creatures are summoned to Ranger's Rest.

The Ardent Keepers are in need of those willing to 
protect our lands from encroachment.

Seek out the Rest upon Keeper's Terrance, past 
the inn and toward the kennels. Deliver this 
pamphlet to Captain Relgen Greenblade.

From there, your talents shall benefit the 
preservation of all Faelewyn.

High Keeper Caelen Stillbranch
'''Hand [[Request for Aid]] to [[Captain Relgen Greenblade]]'''
{{exp}}
Your faction standing with [[Ardent Keepers]] got better.
Your faction standing with [[Fellstone Orcs]] got worse.

: Captain Relgen Greenblade says, "Ah, you seek to aid the cause? I welcome you, young one." : Captain Relgen Greenblade pauses to regard you with a keen eye, offering a nod as he returns the letter back to you. : You receive [[Request for Aid]] from [[Captain Relgen Greenbglade]].
: Captain Relgen Greenblade says, "You have the scent of the wild on you. Take no offense, for we of the Ardent Keepers wish to preserve the natural order between the beasts of the Weald and Faelindral." : Captain Relgen Greenblade says, "Take this request to Aerin Mossfang in the Quiet Den. She oversees the training of those like yourself who have a connection to bestial sprits."
'''Head to [[Aerin Mossfang]] in the Quiet Den and hand in the [[Request for Aid]].''' {{exp}}
Your faction standing with [[Ardent Keepers]] got better.
Your faction standing with [[Fellstone Orcs]] got worse.

: Aerin Mossfang snatches the pamphlet from your hand, then leans in close to you without regard for personal boundaries. She sniffs the air around you before leaning back with a satisfied nod. : Aerin Mossfang says, "I'm not one for paperwork, but I can tell you just came from Relgen. You have his scent on you. You've also been marked by beast spirits, which makes you more pleasant company than most." : Aerin Mossfang proceeds to fish out a small kit and tosses it into your hands : You receive [[Treatment Kit]] from [[Aerin Mossfang]].
: Aerin Mossfang says, "You must be here to learn how to bond with an animal, correct? Well, your timing is impeccable. We've recently brought in some wounded animals that could use a little attention." : Aerin Mossfang says, "So, are you ready to help?" You say, "Yes I am ready to help." : Aerin Mossfang nods in acknowledgement as she gestures toward the various animal kennels. : Aerin Mossfang says, "We don't just treat animals of the Weald here. All beasts are a part of the natural order, and these ones were victims of ''poachers'' or other unnatural threats." : Aerin Mossfang practically spits the word poachers as Sire snarls in recognition. : Aerin Mossfang says, "We've treated their physical injuries with restorative magic, but they still need salves and remedies to help regain their former strength." : Aerin Mossfang says, "Approach an animal of your choice and offer it your treatment kit, Take a good look first, then return the used kit to me when you're done." Turned in the [[Treatment Kit]] to [[a fatigued jackal]]. "Believe you could turn into various "hurt" animals in the kennels." {{exp}}
Your faction standing with [[Ardent Keepers]] got better.
Your faction standing with [[Fellstone Orcs]] got worse.

: a fatigued jackal attempts to shuffle back into the kennel as you move to treat it, though a few calming words and an outstretched hand eventually incite the creature's curiosity. It moves closer to catch your scent, and you are able to offer a remedy that should help restore its lost vigor. : You receive [[Used Treatment Kit]] from [[a fatigued jackal]].
Turned in the [[Used Treatment Kit]] to [[Aerin Mossfang]]. {{exp}}
Your faction standing with [[Ardent Keepers]] got better.
Your faction standing with [[Fellstone Orcs]] got worse.

: Aerin Mossfang greets you with a feral-looking grin as you return the used treatment kit, then produces a satchel for you and offers it with an outstretched hand. : You receive [[Hunt Satchel]] from [[Aerin Mossfang]].
: Aerin Mossfang says, "Did I mention that was the first step in your bonding? I didn't? Well, now you know. You had to make the choice without an outside influence. So, which of these called out to you?" : Aerin Mossfang glances over to the kennels. : Aerin Mossfang says, "The jackal is an elusive and resourceful beast, with a spirit that some say is more ancient than the founding of Calafrey." : Aerin Mossfang says, "Their determination to survive makes them unpredictable companions, but they're as loyal as any canine and have the bite to match." : Aerin Mossfang says, "It would seem that the one you treated may already be calling to your spirit. Good. Take this scroll and learn to call out to your new companion. Then, tell me when you're ready to continue your bond." : You receive [[Scroll: Jackal Pet Tier 1]] from [[Aerin Mossfang]].
: Aerin Mossfang says, "Good. You've sparked an animal's interest, and now you must earn its trust by hunting alongside it, as one would with any true companion." : Aerin Mossfang says, "You'll need to keep your companion well fed if you want them to perform their best. I've given you some simple animal feed for now, but you'll have to show me that you can provide what's needed to support your partner." : Aerin Mossfang says, "Wolves or bats will be your primary meat sources here in the Weald, so choose whichever suits your palette. Fill the hunt satchel with six portions of either meat, then seal it and return it to me." : Aerin Mossfang says, "Don't worry, little Keeper. This hunting is sanctioned, so long as it pertains to the ritual. Return to me with your filled and combined satchel and we'll complete the bond." Hand in the [[Full Hunt Satchel]] to [[Aerin Mossfang]]. {{exp}}
Your faction standing with [[Ardent Keepers]] got better.
Your faction standing with [[Fellstone Orcs]] got worse.

: Aerin Mossfang licks her lips in an almost predatory manner as you return from your hunt. : Aerin Mossfang takes your satchel and begins emptying the contents into a nearby cooking pot, boiling it into a rich stew. : Aerin Mossfang says, "This is what it means to hunt as one! That which were prey now serve to fuel the predator. The predator trods the land and protects if from threats unnatural." : Aerin Mossfang says, "The beastmaster is a representation of this cycle and how both man and beast are drawn to the protection of the realm." : Aerin Mossfang leans over the cook pot and inhales the scent of the stew bubbling thickly atop the fire. She hands you a spoon. : You receive [[Ritual Spoon]] from [[Aerin Mossfang]].
: Aerin Mossfang says, "Go on, have a taste. Return the spoon to me when you're finished."

Issue the mud command '''/taste stew''' and receive [[Used Ritual Spoon]] while standing near the cooking stew pot.

: You taste the prepared stew, its rich and complex flavors overwhelming your senses. : You offer a second spooful to your companion, who devours it greedily. : The combined efforts of you and your partner have strengthened a bond through the primal act of shared spoils. : You receive [[Used Ritual Spoon]].
Hand in the [[Used Ritual Spoon]] to [[Aerin Mossfang]]. {{exp}}
Your faction standing with [[Ardent Keepers]] got better.
Your faction standing with [[Fellstone Orcs]] got worse.

: Aerin Mossfang says, "With this, the first steps toward a lifelong companionship have been taken. You've protected life, you've taken life, and now you've sustained life." : Aerin Mossfang says, "Take these claws as a symbol of your initiation. I welcome you, , as a novice beastmaster of the Ardent Keepers." : Aerin Mossfang says, "For now, you're free to further your bond with your new partner, but don't stray far. Once those claws have witnessed a fair share of hunts, seek me out again and show them to me. I'll have more for you when I deem you ready." : You receive [[Novice Claws of the Keeper]] from [[Aerin Mossfang]].
=== Part 4 - Req. Lvl 4=== Turn in [[Novice Claws of the Keeper]] to [[Aerin Mossfang]]. : Aerin Mossfang appraises the state of your claws and offers a grunt, followed by a nod of satisfaction. She returns the claws to you. : You receive [[Novice Claws of the Keeper]] from [[Aerin Mossfang]].
: Aerin Mossfang says, "Good! It seems that you and your new companion have had a chance to put these claws to the test." : Aerin Mossfang says, "Though I must ask you, novice... have you been hunting any of the beasts within the Weald on your travels? A simple yes or no will suffice." : Aerin Mossfang crosses her arms and regards you with a cool stare. The dire wolf at her side offers a low, warning growl. You /say YES : Aerin Mossfang nods, her arms uncrossing as she lets out a touch of a sigh. : Aerin Mossfang says, "What, did you think I'd be disappointed? Many of us have been forced to put down more beasts of late, as their aggression grows from some sort of... sickness." You /say What sickness? : Aerin Mossfang lets out a low growl, revealing a glimpse of her pointed canines. : Aerin Mossfang says, "Yes. Perhaps you've seen evidence of it during your hunts on the forest floor." : Aerin Mossfang says, "Man of the local wolf tribes have been afficted. We've lost two packs entirely to the strange madness, as they threw themselves at some of our patrols." : Aerin Mossfang says, "The black wolves in particular have been struggling the most, with the brown and gray packs retreating to their dens within Keepers Bight." : Aerin Mossfang says, "I hate to ask this of you, , but we need someone to help carve out this diseased rot before it spreads any further." You /say What diseased rot? : Aerin Mossfang nods somberly, her gaze turning to Sire, who offers a low whine. She comforts the wolf with a gentle scratch behind his ear. : Aerin Mossfang says, "Take this twine. Cull the rabid members of the black wolf pack and wrap their hides with this." : Aerin Mossfang says, "Bring me four of their hides, wrapped into a bundle. Then we shall see if we can discover the source of this affliction and end it once and for all." : You receive [[Hide Wrapping]] from [[Aerin Mossfang]].
Combine 4 [[Diseased Wolf Pelt]]'s in the [[Hide Wrapping]] and receive [[Bundle of Wrapped Pelts]]. Hand in the [[Bundle of Wrapped Pelts]] to [[Aerin Mossfang]]. {{exp}}
Your faction standing with [[Ardent Keepers]] got better.
Your faction standing with [[Fellstone Orcs]] got worse.

: Aerin Mossfang runs a hand along the diseased remains of the fallen wolves, looking none too pleased. She sniffs at the black fur and recoils with disgust. : Aerin Mossfang says, "These hides have the scent of orcs upon them! Are they the ones afflicting the packs with their rotten magic?" : Aerin Mossfang growls as you hear the distinct grinding of her sharpened teeth. Sire begins to growl alongside her. : Aerin Mossfang says, "These fallen packmates shall not have been culled in vain. I want you to take these diseased pelts to someone who has also heard the cry of the wolves." You receive [[Bundle of Diseased Pelts]] from [[Aerin Mossfang]]. You /say who to [[Aerin Mossfang]]. : Aerin Mossfang says, "Eraeldor Lowmist is the Elder Whisperer of the Preservers. You'll likely find him in their lodge, among the other shamans on Outreach Terrace." : Aerin Mossfang says, "Throw those pelts at his feet and demand to hear what he has to say about it" : Aerin Mossfang says, "He'll also be able to cure you of any afflictions you may have suffered while you were out hunting our rabid brothers and sisters." : Aerin Mossfang says, "Now go!" Hand in the [[Bundle of Diseased Pelts]] to [[Eraeldor Lowmist]]. {{exp}}
Your faction standing with [[Preservers]] got better.
Your faction standing with [[Ardent Keepers]] got better.
Your faction standing with [[Fellstone Orcs]] got worse.

: Eraeldor Lowmist slowly opens his eyes as you approach and deposit the diseased bundle at his feet, meeting your gaze. He offers a genuine but sorrowful smile. : Eraeldor Lowmist says, "Aerin was right to send you to me, young master. Her agitated song could be heard across Faelindral, as can the somber chorus of the wolf spirits." : Eraeldor Lowmist says, "Allow me to cleanse these skins so that their spirits may rest peacefully, knowing their sickness shall spread no further." : Eraeldor Lowmist lowers himself to the bundle of pelts and begins to sing a soft melody. Curative magic washes across the pelts, and the scent of their lingering sickness dissipates. You receive [[Bundle of Cleansed Pelts]] from [[Eraeldor Lowmist]]. : Eraeldor Lowmist slowly returns to his feet while folding his hands politely in front of himself. : Eraeldor Lowmist says, "I can cleanse you as well, if you feel you are afflicted. Else, I believe that the Lady Aerin had wished you to make a demand of me." '''Eraeldor Lowmist can CURE [[Rabies|RABIES]]!!! target and /say cleanse me''' Target [[Eraeldor Lowmist]] and /say I demand : Eraeldor Lowmist says, "You may inform the packmistress that her concerns are well-founded. This malady is indeed brought on by the orc tribes and their twisted use of magic." : Eraeldor Lowmist says, "To what end, I cannot say. They may merely wish to sow confusion for a greater scheme, with the fauna being a tragic casualty." : Eraeldor Lowmist says, "Though, if you wish to prove yourself to the Lady Aerin and appease a portion of her rage, I could provide you with some direction." Target [[Eraeldor Lowmist]] and /say direction : Eraeldor Lowmist says, "The name of the one responsible for the wolves' ailment has been whispered into my ear by the spirits of vengeance... Vorkuul Blighteye." : Eraeldor Lowmist says, "There is no doubt that he is close to the wolves and the source of his crimes. Aerin would reward you for this fiend's head, alongside the cleansed pelts of the fallen." : Eraeldor Lowmist says, "The spirits, too, would be indebted to you. They are being twisted by this orc's malice and by those who follow his teachings. Hunt those who befoul our ways of preservation, and you may draw out their master." '''Killing [[A Fellstone shaman]] in [[Evershade Weald]] should spawn [[Vorkuul Blighteye]] who drops [[Blighted Orc Head]].''' Hand in the [[Bundle of Cleansed Pelts]] and [[Blighted Orc Head]] to [[Aerin Mossfang]]. {{exp}}
Your faction standing with [[Ardent Keepers]] got better.
Your faction standing with [[Fellstone Orcs]] got worse.

: Aerin Mossfang cackled as you show her the head. Her companion, Sire, bellows a victory howl at her side. : Aerin Mossfang says, "Eraeldor heard the name of this orc, you say? If only my own ears were as good as his, Sire and I would've hunted down this root sucker ourselves." : Aerin Mossfang says, "Still, you were given the name of elusive prey and hunted down successfully, while also making sure the pelts have been cleansed of their rot. That alone is worthy of my respect. Here." : Aerin Mossfang removes a hide shawl from her shoulders and slings it over yours. You receive [[Spirit-Blessed Shawl]] from [[Aerin Mossfang]]. : Aerin Mossfang says, "The spirits of fallen pack members have blessed that shawl. I'd say you earned it for delivering the justice they deserve." : Aerin Mossfang says, "You deserve an improvement to those claws as well, but I must conceive a suitable hunt first. Keep them close, and in the future, I will have further instructions for you." === Part 5 - Req. Lvl 8=== : Aerin Mossfang says, "The next stage of your training will involve making an improvement to your novice claws" /say what improvement? : Aerin Mossfang offers you a feral grin. : Aerin Mossfang says, "Yes, you'll need more than simple novice claws if you're to continue your hunts beyond Faelindral." : Aerin Mossfang says, "you've already proven your worth by diminishing the orcish blight, but there's one last test you'll need to perform to get materials you need" : Aerin Mossfang says, "More specifically, I'll have you face off against a much larger Calafreyan beast." /say what is a Calafreyan beast? : Aerin Mossfang says, "Have you journeyed out to Keepers Bight yet? There are reports of black bears in the region that have been straying too close to caravan roads and preying on innocent travelers" : Aerin Mossfang says, "Black bears are typically not an aggressive species, so unfortunately any who have turned hostile must be brought low. You're to set out and test yourself against their strength" : Aerin Mossfang says, "Travel the roads and find any bears that have turned violent. Put them down and return to me with three of their bloodied claws, along with any sign of what could have caused their hostility...should you come across it."" '''Hand 3x [[Blood-Soaked Bear Claw]], [[Poacher's Arrow]], and [[Novice Claws of the Keeper]]'''
: Aerin Mossfang lets out a feral growl, gripping the arrow so hard that she ends up snapping it like a twig. : Aerin Mossfang says, "Humans. Why am I not surprised? Their greed has driven the beasts to madness, and the bears are not the first to suffer from human encroachment upon our lands" : Aerin Mossfang says, "We'll deal with them soon enough. At the very least you ended the creature's agony, and soon their claws will mete out justice through decisive battle." : Aerin Mossfang says, "Here, take the bear claws along with this pattern. There are, however, other components you must gather to craft yourself a weapon of vengeance" : You receive [[Set of Bear Claws]] from [[Aerin Mossfang]].
: You receive [[Keeper Claw Pattern]] from [[Aerin Mossfang]].
: You receive [[Novice Claws of the Keeper]] from [[Aerin Mossfang]].
/say what other components? : Aerin Mossfang says, "Find a leatherworking station or use a kit, whichever is your preference. Affix the claws onto a bear pelt of at least low quality, then stich it together with two rough threads and two sets of cloth padding" : Aerin Mossfang says, "If you have any experience in tailoring or leatherworking, you may already be familiar with the components. if not, then you needn't worry. Just follow the instructions on the pattern" : Aerin Mossfang says, "The combination is simple and you aren't required to make something pretty. Simply...functional. You can buy the items from others if you lack the skill or patience to make them yourself." : Aerin Mossfang says, "Return the fashioned claws and the pattern to me for the final step in their creation" Combine the following items in a leatherworking station or kit:
: 2x [[Rough Thread]] : 2x [[Cloth Padding]] : [[Set of Bear Claws]] : [[Low-Quality Bear Pelt]] : [[Novice Claws of the keeper]] Recipe will be trivial : You craft [[Fashioned Set of Claws]].
Hand in the [[Fashioned Set of Claws]] to [[Aerin Mossfang]]. : Aerin Mossfang nods in satisfaction. : Aerin Mossfang says, "I'll take the pattern from you as well, novice, now that it's no longer needed" : You receive your items back from [[Aerin Mossfang]].
Hand in the [[Fashioned Set of Claws]] and [[Keeper Claw Pattern]] to [[Aerin Mossfang]].
{{exp}}
Your faction standing with [[Ardent Keepers]] got better.
Your faction standing with [[Poachers of Calafrey]] got worse. : Aerin Mossfang appraises the state of the claws and gives a satisfied node : Aerin Mossfang says, "These will do. Now to infuse them with the a spirit of vengeance..." : Aerin Mossfang growls as she closes her eyes and focuses upon the set of claws, drawing forth a primal spirit of vengeance. You feel your blood begin to heat and your adrenaline flow as a sensation of rage threatens to overwhelm you : Aerin Mossfang manages to coax a portion of the spirit into the claws themselves, while also directing what remains into the nearby cauldron, causing it to nearly boil over. She looks at you with a fanged grin and tosses the claws into your possession : Aerin Mossfang says, "These should serve you well enough for your next task, . I assume you can already guess who's to be the target of your next hunt." : You receive [[Vengeful Claws of the Keeper]] from [[Aerin Mossfang]].
DMG:7 DEL:29 STR+2 DEX+1 WIS+1 HP+5 SKILL:SLASH
=== Part 6 - Req. Lvl 8 === /say Who is my next target? : Aerin Mossfang says, "If my duties didn't root me within the Den, I'd be more than willing to join you on this next hunt. though, my instincts tell me that the target you seek is not an expert poacher." : Aerin Mossfang says, "The human poachers in Keepers Bight are typically cunning, avoiding needless aggravation of the local wildlife. they understand they're one mistake away from being tracked down themselves." : Aerin Mossfang says, "Whoever attacked these black bears was sloppy...inexperienced. perhaps some fool wishing to prove themself to their foul brethren" : Aerin Mossfang says, "You're going to find out where this would-be poacher is camping and act the part of their prey in order to lure them out" /say how will I act the part? : Aerin Mossfang steps over to her cauldron and fills a phial with the spirit-infused brew that had been bubbling within : Aerin Mossfang says, "Take this potion. I challenged the raging ursine spirits to infuse it with their essence, and imbibing it will allow you to take on their form...if only for a short time." : Aerin Mossfang says, "You're going to act the part of the poacher's prey in order to lure them out of hiding, only to strike out at them with a fury they'll never suspect" : Aerin Mossfang says, "Now all that remains is to find this poacher's location" : You receive [[Potion of Ursine Rage]] from [[Aerin Mossfang]].
Journey to [[Keepers Bight]]. When you zone drink the potion and turn into a bear. Follow the left wall and pass by the the road to [[Scarwood]] (stay in [[Keeper's Bight]]). Shortly after the road you will come to a small camp with no NPCs, tucked against the wall. /smell tent : You sniff at the ten fabrics, the scent of human musk and sweat now cloying at your sensitive snout. With this scent, you may now be able to smell the poacher and their location /smell poacher : It does not take you long to recognize the scent wafting from the surrounding foliage. The very same human who bears this smell is lingering nearby in hiding, perhaps even watching you at this very moment : You will have to act the part of an oblivous bear in order to draw them out, presenting the perfect opportunity that any aspiring poacher could not pass up. : The nearby tree stands out to you as the obvious choice, as bears are known tor ub their backs against them. This may entice the poacher tor eveal themself to attack a vulnerable target /rub tree : You stand on your hind legs and press your back up against the tree, scratching in earnest. it is a surprisingly pleasant experience until a loosed arrowhead embedsitself into the bark next to your ursine head! : a fledgling poacher says says, "This is it, my chance to finally prove I have what it takes! die, beast!" [[a fledgline poacher]] was white con at 12 When you kill him
{{exp}}
: a fledgling poacher says says, "W-what...you're no normal...bear..." loot [[Fledgling Poacher's Bow]] Hand in the [[Fledgling Poacher's Bow]] and [[Potion of Ursine Rage]] to [[Aerin Mossfang]].
{{exp}}
Your faction standing with [[Ardent Keepers]] got better.
Your faction standing with [[Fellstone Orcs]] got worse. : Aerin Mossfang says, "Well done, Keeper!" : Aerin Mossfang takes the bow in hand and grits her teeth. She immediately snaps the weapon across her knee, tossing one half into the fire beneath the cauldron and the other to Sire as a chew toy. The dire wolf voraciously tears apart the human-scented implement. : Aerin Mossfang says, "you're proving to be a lethal hunter, . Good. The spirit within your claw is appeased for the time being, as is my own rage" : Aerin Mossfang says, "i'm thankful to have a Keeper such as yourself to help enforce the will of the beastial spirits. While I don't dislike my role at the Den, I often find myself wishing to hunt alongside the packs oft he Weald." : Aerin Mossfang says, "Relying on others is also not my strongest trait...Relgen can attest to that" : Aerin Mossfang scoffs : Aerin Mossfang says, "Regardless, you've shown yourself to be reliable once more. Take this as a token of my appreciation and a symbol to others that you're no longer a novice. You're a Keeper now, , a true protector of the Weald." : You receive [[Shroud of the Ardent Keeper]] from [[Aerin Mossfang]].

Bard Starter Quest (Faelindral).title: Bard Starter Quest (Faelindral)
Bard Starter Quest (Faelindral).content:
{{Quest | imagefilename = phicon.png | width = 100px | caption = Placeholder Image |Start Zone = [[Faelindral]] |Quest Giver = [[Pine Brightreed]] |Minimum Level = 1 |Classes = [[Bard]] |Related NPCs = [[Flerri Dawntender the Tailor]], [[Laenyth Windharp]], [[Lorinthal Skybranch]], [[Mistress Naelira]],
[[Sersil Tangleroot]], [[Sylphrena Starfall]], [[Sylvosa Pineweld]], [[Wyrdguard Mithrilvine]] | Quest Rewards = [[Lambent Lute]] [[Ring of introduction]] [[Lute of the Charmed]] [[Lute of the Charmer]] (exp) }} __TOC__ === Part 1 - Req. Lvl 1 === '''Read the [[Perfumed Letter]] you start with as a new Bard character:''' 
,


Your performances have not gone unnoticed, nor the feelings they evoke. We've an eye for those with wanderlust in their gaze and an ear for the yearning in their lyrics.

Faelindral may not be the source of all knowledge, but our Lambent Wanderers would still cultivate all that Aêthoril has to offer while spreading the storied histories of our people.

If this letter strikes a chord, please deliver it to the hands of Pine Brightreed next to the stage of the Willows Whisper, It is a mere jaunt over the span across from the Wayward Branch Inn.

Any guard within Faelindral can provide further directions if you ask.


May I be graced with your next performance,
Naerith Songbird of the Lambent Wanderers
: Pine Brightreed says, "Ah, a new performer! Caught Naerith's eye, did you? Or perhaps her ears." : Pine Brightreed says, "Either way, we always welcome young talent into the Willow. Hopefully you're eager to get started, as one of our top performers just informed us that she isn't able to make the stage tonight." : Pine Brightreed lets out a whimsical sigh. : Pine Brightreed says, "This is an opportunity to get acquainted with some of our more esteemed patrons... albeit not under the best circumstances." : Pine Brightreed takes a satchel from his belt and offers it to you with a wry grin. : Pine Brightreed says, Say, so you think you could do me a little favor? You say, "Hmm.. Ok, I will do you a favor." : Pine Brightreed says, "A lot of people were looking forward to hearing Naerith perform tonight, but unfortunately she's been caught up in some ... other obligations." :Pine Brightreed says, "I need you to gift these vouchers to all the patrons who bought a ticket to Naerith's performance tonight. Take this as a chance to get acquainted with the city!" :Pine Brightreed says, "Since she won't be available, the vouchers are good for one other free performance of their choice." :Pine Brightreed says, "You'll be looking for Sylvosa Pineweld, Wyrdguard Mithrilvine, Listener Maplebloom, Lorinthal Skybranch, and Sersil Tangleroot," :Pine Brightreed says, "Bring back their original tickets along with any remaining vouchers, and I'll make sure that you get some time in the spotlight!" :Pine Brightreed says, "And if you need more information on any individual patron, just ask. I should be able to point you in their general direction, at least." You receive [[Ticket Satchel]].
[[File:Image 2026-06-25 104226940.png|thumb|Ticket Satchel]] You receive [[Bundle of Vouchers]].
[[File:Image 2026-06-25 103950750.png|thumb|Bundle of Vouchers]] ==== Part 1a (Delivery) ==== Delivery Walkthrough Summary: Head up to the Traders Terrace.
* '''[[Sylvosa Pineweld]]''' is in the smelting area. Head over to Ranger's Rest and take the lift down.
* '''[[Wyrdguard Mithrilvine]]''' is right at the bottom of the Keeper's Lift. Head back up and over to the shaman trainers.
* '''[[Listener Maplebloom]]''' is at the campfire at the Balanced Branch. Head (back to Trader's area; up; left at druids; all the way) to (top of the) Pixie Lift.
* '''[[Sersil Tangleroot]]''' is across from the lift. Note: See Sersil description below. Go back down to near the Traveler's Lift. Right, across the bridge at base of bank ramp and inside.
* '''[[Lorinthal Skybranch]]''' is in the tree trunk on the platform south of the Traveler's lift, behind the trader's area. Delivery Walkthrough: You say, "Hail, Sylvosa Pineweld." : Sylvosa Pineweld wipes the sweat from his brow and grumbles, begrudgingly accepting the voucher in exchange for his ticket. : Sylvosa Pineweld says, "A real shame, that is. Naerith's voice seems to somehow soothe both my mind and aching body, but there's no helping it." : Sylvosa Pineweld says, "I'll just have to bear through it until she's next available. Here's my ticket, and thanks for letting me know." You receive [[Pineweld's Ticket]] from Sylvosa Pineweld.
You receive your items back from Sylvosa Pineweld.
You say, "Hail, Wyrdguard Mithrilvine." : Wyrdguard Mithrilvine says, "Roots and ash! I was really looking forward to this performance after my shift was over!" : Wyrdguard Mithrilvine says, "Sorry that you have to be the bearer of this bad news, friend. Hopefully I can listen in on another good show some time soon. : Wyrdguard Mithrilvine reluctantly produces an unused ticket and hands it to you. You receive [[Mithrilvine's Ticket]] from Wyrdguard Mithrilvine.
You receive your items back from Wyrdguard Mithrivine.
You say, "Hail, Listener Maplebloom." : Listener Maplebloom seems to snap out of a reverie as you offer her the voucher. : Listener Maplebloom tucks the voucher away and returns the ticket with a sad smile. : Listener Maplebloom nods in acceptance, then takes a deep breath and resumes her meditation. You receive [[Maplebloom's Ticket]] from Listener Maplebloom.
You receive your items back from Listener Maplebloom.
: Sersil Tangleroot says, "Listen to the wisdom of the fae! Heed the call of those who truly watch over us!" : Sersil Tangleroot sighs whimsically at the news, meeting your offer with a slow smile. He accepts the voucher, but seems to withhold his ticket for now. : Sersil Tangleroot says, "That is truly a shame. Naerith has a mesmerizing tone that elicits sensations bordering on faerie fascination. I suppose I will return this ticket to you, but in exchange, will you hear a simple message?" You receive your items back from Sersil Tangleroot.
You say, "I will hear a simple message" : Sersil Tangleroot spreads his arms in a gesture that encompasses everything around him. : Sersil Tangleroot says, "All of Evershade Weald would not be as it is without the benevolence of our fae benefactors. It was not through the grace of any gods that our forest has thrived over the course of many cataclysms." : Sersil Tangleroot says, "It is only through the intervention of the Fae Realms that we survive here at all, so why should we imprison ourselves in a world which has so often sought to cast us out?" : Sersil Tangleroot says, "We Faelewyn should disassociate ourselves with the other races of this land, and embrace the teachings and comforts of the Seven Courts. Only then can our people finally be at peace." : Sersil Tangleroot says, Spread this message to any kin who would hear it, so that they too can revel in the wisdom of the fae." : Sersil Tangleroot says, "Thank you for listening, young bard, and please keep my words in mind. Here is my ticket. I do hope that Naerith is able to reschedule soon." You receive [[Tangleroot's Ticket]] from Sersil Tangleroot.
You say, "Hail, Lorinthal Skybranch." : Lorinthal Skybranch says, "What do you mean she had to cancel?! I waited until dawn for this ticket, and now you're telling me it's useless?! Blasted ash... root-rot... fel-fae... giant droppings!" : Lorinthal Skybranch continues his tirade of accusatory curses and slang as he flings his ticket at your chest, then shifts his focus to an imprisoned poacher, berating him without end. You receive [[Skybranch's Ticket]] from Lorinthal Skybranch.
You receive your items back from Lorinthal Skybranch.
(Combine all the Tickets in the [[Ticket Satchel]]).
You receive [[Full Ticket Satchel]].
==== Part 1b (Performance) ==== '''Give [[Full Ticket Satchel]] to Pine Brightreed.''' {{exp}} : Your faction standing with Lambent Wanderers got better. : Your faction standing with Fellstone Orcs got worse. : Pine Brightreed says, "Hey, great, you're back! I hope no one was too disappointed with the news." : Pine Brightreed says, "On the bright side, while you were off running around, I managed to land you a chance to show your stuff right here on stage! : Pine Brightreed says, "You'll want this basket for any donations you get. What do you say? Would you be willing show us your talents by means of a small performance?" You receive [[Donation Basket]] from Pine Brightreed.
: Pine Brightreed gestures toward a nearby shelf of used instruments, shooting you a playful grin. : Pine Brightreed says, "Take a look at our assortment of public instruments on the shelf next to Ilyra, then pick out one that you like! A lot of them have seen better days, but I'm sure you can find something that's at least playable." : Pine Brightreed says, "Once you have something suitable, all you need to go is go out and take the stage to start your performance! Then return to me once you have a basket full of donations along with the instrument that you borrowed." : Pine Brightreed says, "And I really do mean ''take'' the stage, ! Look for the rug on stage and stand there. This will be your first appearance at the Whisper, so you'll want to make it memorable."
Type ''"/look"'' : Worn and well-used instruments are stored here, many of which are in need of repair or replacement. A casual glance leaves much to be desired in the selection, but there may be something salvageable buried here should one choose to give the shelf a more thorough inspection. Type ''"/inspect shelf"'' : Unsurprisingly, there is little of good quality found among the public instruments; however, you spot a wooden recorder behind some of the more worn pieces that looks to be in good shape. It may be worth taking. Type ''"/take recorder"'' : You shift the used instruments aside and reach out to take the recorder. You receive [[Odd Recorder]].
: It seems to be in respectable shape, and by taking the stage with such a piece, you are sure you can deliver a memorable performance, Equip the recorder
Type ''"/take stage"'' (Throughout your "performance", a [[Generous Donation]] will be thrown onto the stage. You will need 4 of them).
(Dialog varies, so just follow the prompts).
 : You take the stage for the first time and offer a bow to the patrons of the Willows Whisper. Pine shouts out a brief introduction as you ready the odd recorder in your grip. For a brief moment, it feels as though it wants to slide out of your hands, but you shrug it off as mere nerves. : You bring the recorder to your lips. All you need to do now is take a breath. Type ''"/take breath"'' : You take a deep breath and blow into the recorder. A sudden slip of a finger across one of the tone holes causes a sharp, ear-piercing whistle to ring out across the stage! : That was some rotten luck, as you know you can do better. Before carrying on with your performance, you should take a moment, just enough to calm your nerves. Type ''"/take breath"'' or maybe ''"/take moment"'' : You take a moment to center yourself, fingers now poised with precision. You blow, but no sound escapes, as though the instrument were blocked or silenced by an unseen force! : a citizen looks shocked. : a tipsy citizen says, "Ugh... Where did they find this so-called talent? Surely not in Faelindral." : Someone from the crowd throws a donation onto the stage, which thunks wetly near your feet. : You peer down the body of the recorder but see no blockage. What is going on here? If you wish to continue your performance, you may need to give the odd recorder a thorough inspection. Type ''"/inspect recorder"'' : You give the recorder a quick inspection, but nothing about it appears overtly broken or out of place. Determined, you grip it with frustration and force a note through! : Notes flow from the recorder at last; however, they are all reversed! This leads to a cacophony of untrained sounds that billow among the patrons, prompting yet another donation of fruit to be tossed onto the stage, : Reversed tones? This must be some fae prank, Is there a pixie hiding inside the recorder? You should open it and find out. Type ''"/open recorder"'' : You open the recorder and remove the mouthpiece, peering inside. There does not appear to be a pixie inside, and the act draws a chuckle from the crowd. : After replacing the mouthpiece, you decide to take a calm and delicate approach, blowing faintly into the instrument in hopes of eliciting a soft note. What follows is a horrendous, ear-piercing screech that nearly deafens the crowd! This results in yet another donation splattering across the stage. : This cannot be how your first performance goes. Determined to show your actual talent, you must try to push forward! Type ''"/push forward"'' : Fed up with the instrument, you inhale deeply and blow into it with all your might... but the recorder wrenches free from your hands and clatters to the stage floor! You fumble to snatch it back, heart racing. : Suddenly, a generous donation splats against you, coating you in a fruity residue. Things are getting out of hand, quite literally. You could take a breath to center yourself and continue, or simply end this farce by taking a bow. Type ''"/take bow"'' : You decide you have had enough of this mockery, having received plenty of so-called donations from the patrons of the Willows Whisper, Despite the crushing performance, you take an awkward bow. : Pine Brightreed seems to be beside himself with joy as be beckons you over. Combine the Donations in the Donation Basket. : You begin crafting Full Donation Basket. : Donation Basket is consumed while crafting {{exp}} : You have leveled up! You are now level 2! : You can now engage in combat against other players. ==== Part 1c (Finish) ==== '''Give [[Full Donation Basket]] and [[Odd Recorder]] to [[Pine Brightreed]]''' {{exp}} : Your faction standing with Lambent Wanderers got better. : Your faction standing with Fellstone Orcs got worse. : Pine Brightreed laughs heartily as you turn over your basket full of donations. Wiping a tear from his eye, he claps you on the shoulder while struggling to regain his breath. : Pine Brightreed says, "You should have seen your face, you looked positively baffled! That playing could have awoken the Sleepers themselves! Oh stars above, let me help you clean all this up." : Pine Brightreed continues to chuckle as he pulls out a small washcloth and wipes away the remnants of the generous donations you received from the crowd, before stuffing it into your pocket. You receive [[Fruit-Stained Washcloth]] from Pine Brightreed.
: Pine Brightreed says, "I must confess, I was just having a bit of fun. I have no doubt that you're talented, seeing as you did manage to pick out the one instrument in the pile that remained intact." : Pine Brightreed says, "What you didn't know, however, was the only viable instrument in that lot was afflicted with a terrible curse!" You say, "A curse?" : Pine Brightreed says, "The worst curse an instrument could have, of course... a curse of cacophonia! Anything played on that recorder sounds terrible, no matter your skill!" : Pine Brightreed says, "On the bright side, you forced many patrons to buy another round of drinks. Not to mention, we won't be going hungry anytime soon." : Pine Brightreed trails off as he tests the weight of your donation basket, shooting you a playful grin. : Pine Brightreed says, "Just some innocent fun for an introduction, right? Do you forgive me?" You say, "I forgive you" : Pine Brightreed beams a bright smile as he claps you on the shoulder once more. You can smell the sweet scent of wine on his breath. : Pine Brightreed says, "Wonderful! I can already see the beginnings of a beautiful friendship. Though, I feel it's about time that you get acquainted with the rest of our little troupe here." : Pine Brightreed says, "Go show Laenyth that washcloth and she'll know exactly who sent you. She's our resident Tale Keeper, so she might even record this event as the harrowing beginning to your own legendary adventures!" : Pine Brightreed says, "She should be just up the ascent to the Lambent Lantern, which you can spot from the front of the stage." Head to [[Laenyth Windharp]] in the Lambent Lantern on the first floor. '''Give [[Fruit-Stained Washcloth]] to [[Laenyth Windharp]]''' {{exp}} : Your faction standing with Lambent Wanderers got better. : Your faction standing with Fellstone Orcs got worse. : Laenyth Windharp takes the washcloth and exhales a short sigh, offering you a politely apologetic smile. : Laenyth Windharp says, "You really don't need to introduce yourself after that performance you had to put on. I do apologize for Pine. He's often as whimsical as the fae if he's not drowning in his cups." : Laenyth Windharp says, "I'm Laenyth Windharp, the Tale Keeper for the Lambent Wanderers. I'm gladdened by your arrival today, despite the... unfortunate introduction." : Laenyth Windharp says, "Many of Aêthoril's greatest tales are manifested through trial and tribulation. Perhaps this is simply the beginning of your own great epic." : Laenyth Windharp says, "You should take this note to Sylphrena Starfall next. She's our lead envoy and may have a task for you that, hopefully, doesn't involve fruit." You receive [[Note for Sylphrena]].
Sylphrena,

Pine has made yet another introduction using the cursed recorder.

Can you please see to it that he keeps it locked up this time, while also compensating the performer in some way? This is not how anyone wishes to begin their tale.

- Laenyth
You receive [[Note for Sylphrena]].
'''Give [[Note for Sylphrena]] to [[Sylphrena Starfall]], who is just upstairs from [[Laenyth Windharp]].''' {{exp}} : Your faction standing with Lambent Wanderers got better. : Sylphrena Starfall says, "Ah, I see! So you're the one Pine was just hazing out on the stage? Goodness, that oaf... and now, of all times?" : Sylphrena Starfall says, "Listen, I hope he didn't put a sour taste in your mouth, because we really could use the help of performers such as yourself!" : Sylphrena Starfall says, "Please, take this ring as a means of recompense. Also... would you be willing to hear me out?" You receive [[Ring of Introduction]] from Sylphrena Starfall. You say, "I am willing to hear you out." : Sylphrena Starfall says, "I'll just need a little time to sort out a plan, then we'll make sure you don't regret your decision to join us! In the meantime, I'm sure you can find a way to make a, erm... more positive name for yourself here in Faelindral." : Sylphrena Starfall says, "Once you're more familiar with Evershade, show me your Ring of Introduction. By then, I should have something fun for you!" === Part 2 - Req. Lvl 4 === '''Give [[Ring of Introduction]] to Sylphrena Starfall.''' : Sylphrena Startall claps her hands together and beams you a bright smile before handing you the ring along with a small bag. : Sylphrena Starfall says, "Ah, it seems you've already started making a name for yourself! Pine really ought to be more forgiving toward those with such promising talent." : Sylphrena Starfall says, "He actually has his own show coming up shortly. How would you feel about turning his own performance into a bit of a comedy routine?" You receive [[Ring of Introduction]] from Sylphrena Starfall.
You receive [[Ingredient Bag]] from Sylphrena Starfall.
==== Part 2a (Gather) ==== You need to collect and then combine:
  • 2 [[Royal Jelly]]
  • 2 [[Pixie glitter]]
  • 2 [[Wasp Worker Wax]]
: You begin crafting Full Ingredient Bag. : Ingredient Bag is consumed while crafting. : You craft Full Ingredient Bag. '''Give [[Full Ingredient Bag]] to Sylphrena Starfall.''' {{exp}} : Your faction standing with Lambent Wanderers got better. ==== Part 2b (Trickster) ==== : Sylphrena Starfall says, "Oh, how devious! I hope gathering these ingredients wasn't too difficult a task. I promise that the show will be worth it, though!" : Sylphrena Starfall proceeds to combine the ingredients into a syrupy mixture, then slowly pours it into the bottom of a wineglass laced with the mysterious concoction. She offers the glass to you with a smirk. You receive [[Laced Wineglass]] from Sylphrena Starfall.
: Sylphrena Starfall says, "All that's left is to offer Pine a free glass of Cilindrine Red. Trust me, he won't be able to resist." : Sylphrena Starfall says, "I'll signal the bartender to allow you behind the bar. You'll be free to look around for the barrel of wine back there." : Sylphrena Starfall says, "Then, all you have to do is pour enough wine into the glass so that Pine doesn't notice or taste the little addition we made when you offer it to him." : Sylphrena Starfall says, "Well? Go on, get to it! Pine's act is coming up shortly, so he's bound to parched! Bring me back the empty glass when you're done." Head over to barrels at the back of the bar. Type ''"/pour wine"'' : You tilt the barrel just enough to coax a stream of Cilindrine red into your keeping. The act feels like simple theft, yet it carries a playful thrill without real consequence. : You fill the laced wineglass nearly to the rim, the syrupy mixture Sylphrena added blending seamlessly with the rich crimson color of the wine. As you glance over your shoulder, you catch the bartender's knowing wink, and a quick smirk passes between you. You receive [[Laced Wine]].
'''Give [[Laced Wine]] to Pine Brightreed.''' {{exp}} : Your faction standing with Lambent Wanderers got better. ==== Part 2c (ha ha) ==== : Pine Brightreed blinks in surprise as you offer him the wineglass, though his hesitation is short lived as he accepts it with a wide grin. : Pine Brightreed says, "Hey, now this is a surprise! Who told you this was my favorite drink? Ahh, no matter. I'm glad that there aren't any hard feelings between us!" : Pine Brightreed says, "Great timing, too, as I'm just about to put on one of my great acts! Stick around and maybe you'll learn a thing or two from a master bard!" : Pine Brightreed proceeds to down the entire glass of wine in a rather uncouth display. He hands you back the empty glass and shoots you a wink before making his way to the stage. You receive [[Empty Wineglass]] from Pine Brightreed.
: Pine Brightreed says, "*Hic*" : Pine Brightreed stumbles out onto the stage, looking as though he is about to lose his balance. : Pine Brightreed says, "Hellooo, everyone! Let's give a big round of applause to our next performer! You all know and love them! It's Pine! That's me!" : a citizen says, "When I hear Naerith sing, I know it's just for me. She's so enchanting..." : Pine Brightreed says, "I have to warn you, my head is really throbbing today. It's getting to be a little Pine-ful!" : Pine Brightreed says, "Maybe it has something to do with this altitude. We're so far up in the sky, it's a wonder we aren't called High Elves!" : Pine Brightreed looks out expectantly at the crowd, who regard him with unimpressed skepticism. : Pine Brightreed says, "I've been wondering if we've spent enough time up in the elderspires. Maybe it's about time we branched out a little more!" : Pine Brightreed says, "Ahh, who am I kidding? I love this community/ We're all rooted in culture and history!" : Pine Brightreed beckons to the crowd for a reaction, but all he receives in response is a series of disturbed groans. : Pine Brightreed says, "Oh come on, that was a good one! If you think you can outdo me, I dare you to come up here and be a better treant-ertainer!" : Pine Brightreed says, "Anyway... did any of you catch that thick fog that rolled in the other night? I tried to, but I mist!" : Pine Brightreed sways so far to one side that he nearly topples over, struggling to catch his footing and right himself. : Pine Brightreed says, "Enough groaning! I might as well go join the Circle of Spores... since I'm a real fun-guy!" : Pine Brightreed outstretches his arms, expecting applause. Instead, he receives a torrent of generous, fruity donations that knock him off his unsteady feet. : Pine Brightreed says, "Alright, alright! I'm going! You'll hate to see me go, but you'll love to watch me leaf!" ==== Part 2d (Finish) ==== '''Give [[Empty Wineglass]] to Sylphrena Starfall.''' {{exp}} : Your faction standing with Lambent Wanderers got better. : Sylphrena Starfall doubles over in laughter as the boos and jeers of the crowd fill the air from the nearby stage. : Sylphrena Starfall says, "Oh Pine, that'll teach you to treat our new members with a little more respect!" : Sylphrena Starfall says, "He can normally handle a glass of wine without issue, but those extra ingredients are more than likely making him feel as though he's performing for the fae courts themselves." : Sylphrena Starfall says, "Here, you deserve a little something for going out and doing all that work." : Sylphrena Starfall unstraps a lute from her back and holds it out for you. You receive [[Lambent Lute]] from Sylphrena Starfall.
: Sylphrena Starfall says, "I promise that this one doesn't have a curse! You should go out and practice with it, then come show it to me after you earn some callouses on your fingertips." : Sylphrena Starfall says, "I'm sure that by then we'll have some actual work for someone as talented as you." : Sylphrena Starfall says, "Here, you deserve a little something for going out and doing all that work." : Sylphrena Starfall unstraps a lute from her back and holds it out for you. You receive [[Lambent Lute]] from Sylphrena Starfall.
=== Part 3 - Req. Lvl 8 === ==== Part 3a (Intro) ==== '''Give [[Lambent Lute]] to Sylphrena Starfall.''' : Sylphrena Starfall says, "Ah, look at that! Calloused fingertips and a voice that could compel someone off the edge of Faelindral. I think you're ready to do some real Lambent Wanderer work!" : Sylphrena Starfall strums her fingers across your lute before turning it around and offering it back to you with a smile. : Sylphrena Starfall says, "Here, you'll need your lute as well as this letter. Tell me, , have you ever done much in the way of diplomacy?" You receive [[Lambent Lute]] from Sylphrena Starfall.
You receive [[Sylphrena's Note]].
Laenyth,

This performer may have the talent we need to determine why and how the naiads have become so confrontational of late.

You have the most experience of us all in dealing with the water nymphs, but I still respect your decision to retire as a tale keeper.
