Instead, please impart your wisdom upon this young bard and see that they are prepared for the mission ahead.


Sylphrena
You say, "I can do diplomacy." : Sylphrena Starfall says, "It's what the Wanderers excel at, I must say! Who better to spread the arts and words of our people than performers such as ourselves? Even if a little magic tends to get mixed into our lyrics from time to time." : Sylphrena Starfall says, "The job I have for you involves a dispute with the residents of the Whispering Pools. Do you know the place?" : Sylphrena Starfall says, "They're the caves behind the eastern waterfall where the naiads dwell. Supposedly they're led by a powerful water nymph who they refer to as Mistress Naelira." : Sylphrena Starfall says, "I've heard from reliable sources that the naiads are trying to spread their influence outside the pools, which goes against their pact with Queen Sylneira." : Sylphrena Starfall says, "This is obviously upsetting to a number of Faelindral's groups, one in particular being the Ardent Keepers." : Sylphrena Starfall says, "So, we're going to go in there as a happy neutral party and see if we can determine what's got them so eager to get out, and what we might be able to do to appease them." : Sylphrena Starfall says, "Are you interested?" You say, "I am interested." : Sylphrena Starfall claps her hands together excitedly! : Sylphrena Starfall says, "Oh, how lovely! Now, before you go diving head first into their caves, you should be warned... the naiads are notoriously ruthless to their guests!" : Sylphrena Starfall says, "There's a good chance that even dipping a toe into one of their pools will have a hoard of angry faeries trying to tear your mind apart from the inside out." : Sylphrena Starfall says, "That's why we're going to have to put together a little disguise before you can wander safely through the Whispering Pools and negotiate with their leader." : Sylphrena Starfall says, "Bring the letter I gave you downstairs to Laenyth. She has the most experience with those water faeries, and also knows a trick or two about illusions. She'll get you sorted for the job!" ==== Part 3b (Potion) ==== '''Give [[Sylphrena's Note]] to Laenyth Windharp.''' {{exp}} : Your faction standing with Lambent Wanderers got better. : Your faction standing with Fellstone Ores got worse. : Laenyth Windharp offers you a pleasant smile as she dips her gaze to read over the letter, her brow aising a touch. : Laenyth Windharp says, "Sleeper's dream! You're heading into the Whispering Pools? You have quite the task ahead of you, my friend. The naiads can be a terrifying foe if you're on their bad side." : Laenyth Windharp says,".. Which I suppose is why Sylphrena has sent you to me. I have, in the past, managed to spend time among the naiads by appealing to their connection to water." : Laenyth Windharp says, "I learned much while I mingled with the water nymphs, though I dared not approach their Mistress Naelira." : Laenyth Windharp says, "She's quite powerful, and I had a suspicion that she saw straight through my magics... yet she did not raise an alarm simply for her own amusement." : Laenyth Windharp says, "That's neither here nor there, however! I'm to help you create a potion that allows you to take on an aspect of water, so that you may safely traverse the Whispering Pools." : Laenyth Windharp says, "Here's a recipe that you can follow, along with a special tear that you'll need for this particular potion. If you see anything that you don't recognize, you need only ask me." : Laenyth Windharp says, "Show me your completed potion once you've finished assembling it. Don't worry if you haven't worked with alchemy before, Simply combine these materials in a cauldron and I'll handle the rest." You receive [[Laenyth's Potion Recipe]] from Laenyth Windharp.
You receive [[Siren's Tear]] from Laenyth Windharp,
To craft a potion of River's Allure, you must gather the following reagents and mix them within an alchemist's cauldron:
A dyad of Selstie kelp,
A pentad of river essence,
A dyad of fish oil-crude, not fine,
A single Siren's Tear,
A Tempered Vial.
:Dyad = Two :Pentad = Five You say "Where can I find [[Selstie kelp]]?" : Laenyth Windharp says, "Selstie kelp is typically found at the bottom of rivers. There should be some located here in the Weald, though you may need strong lungs in order to harvest it." You say "What is [[river essence]]?" : Laenyth Windharp says, "You'll need to collect some of the river's essence from the manifested elementals that live in the river itself." : Laenyth Windharp says, "Though do be careful, as some of them seem rather... confused of late. It may be related to a plot of the naiads." You say "What about [[Crude Fish Oil]]?" : Laenyth Windharp says, "Fish oil comes from, well, fish! If you cannot find any for sale, you could always take up a bit of fishing." : Laenyth Windharp says, "You'll need to find at least four fish to get any meaningful amount of oil, then extract it into a makeshift vial using an alchemist's cauldron. Do this enough to fill two vials and you should have what's needed for the potion." You say, "Where can I get the [[Tempered Vial|vial]]?" : Laenyth Windharp says, "Tempered vials should be sold directly from the alchemists shop. The Well of Order is where you'd find them here in Faelindral; it's just across from the bank. {{Spoiler | Note: Cauldron recipe only takes [[Whitefish]] }} '''Give [[Completed Mixture]] to Laenyth Windharp.''' {{exp}} : Your faction standing with Lambent Wanderers got better. : Your faction standing with Fellstone Ores got worse. : Laenyth Windharp says, "Ah, well done! You've made plenty here, enough for more than one potion. Let me just apply the finishing touches..." : Laenyth Windharp pours a small amount of the mixture into a separate flask as she sings an enthralling melody, her voice causing the mixture to glow with a magical blue aura. Once finished, she offers the potion to you. : Laenyth Windharp says, "You'll need to drink this potion while you're under the waterfall concealing the naiad's home. It should temper any of their immediate hostility toward you. If you run out and require any more, bring me the empty potion and I'll refill it for you." : Laenyth Windharp says, "Hopefully this helps you in your task, . The Whispering Pools are beautiful, but dangerous. Do take care, especially around Mistress Naelira. ==== Part 3c (Tragedy) ==== You receive [[Potion of River's Allure]] from Laenyth Windharp,
Drink potion
You say, "Hail, Mistress Naelira." : Mistress Naelira regards you with an icy gaze that could freeze the very blood in your veins. : Despite her cold demeanor, her words sing upon your ears like the gentle lapping of waves agai a shore. : Mistress Naelira says, "Quite rare and even bold for one such as yourself to seek an audience with me. I see through that feeble magic of yours, though I admit it's rather entertaining." Mistress Naelira dips her gaze to the lute you bought, her eyes briefly lighting up with interest. : Mistress Naelira says, "Are you a performer?" You say, "Yes, I am a performer" : Mistress Naelira says, "Is that so? Then show me that instrument of yours if you believe you're worthy to perform for the Lady of Sirens." '''Give [[Lambent Lute]] to Mistress Naelira.''' : Mistress Naelira inspects the lute with a enchanting, sapphire gaze. Icy fingers trace down the neck of the lute and across the strings, causing them to tighten and contract due to the chill of her touch. : Mistress Naelira strums her fingers across the chilled chords. The lute offers a final, feeble note before the pressure becomes too much to bear and a string suddenly snaps. It coils up against itself after an abrupt twang. : Mistress Naelira sighs in disappointment and tosses the broken lute back to you. : Mistress Naelira says, "I'm not impressed with your instrument, bard. Certainly not now with a missing string. I'll only accept entertainment from the finest of amusements. I can't be appeased by such a meager lute that's so obviously in need of.. improvement." You receive [[Broken Lambent Lute]] from Mistress Naelira.
You sniffle, tears in your eye.
You say, "My.. my lute!"
You glare at Mistress Naelira.
 You say, "What improvement?" : Mistress Naelira says, "Eager to be my plaything, aren't you? If you're that determined to repair your so-called instrument and play for me, then perhaps you can seek out someone capable of weaving better strings." : Mistress Naelira says, "Your Faelindral is filled with artisans of all kinds, is it not? I'm sure one of them could fashion some new, stronger lute strings for you." : Mistress Naelira says, "Use that precious voice of yours and ask around for lute strings that aren't so delicate or flimsy." : Mistress Naelira says, "Now begone, lest I choose to feed you to my other pets." To replenish the potion: Give [[Potion of River's Allure]] to Laenyth Windharp. :Laenyth Windharp says, "Do you require more of the potion? I understand, Petanj. Diplomacy oft takes far longer than one thinks." :Laenyth Windharp proceeds to infuse another potion with an enthralling melody. :Laenyth Windharp says, "Here you are. I'l be here should you need me to refill it for you again." You receive [[Potion of River's Allure]] from Laenyth Windharp. ==== Part 3d (Remedy) ==== You say, "Hail, Flerri Dawntender the Tailor." : Flerri Dawntender the Tailor says, "We've got the finest silks and weaves around! Take a look and let me know if anything interests you!" You say, "Do you have any lute strings?" : Flerri Dawntender the Tailor says, "Lute strings? Well that's an interesting request... very interesting. You know, I've been meaning to try my hand at making something that is both fine and durable." : Flerri Dawntender the Tailor says, "This would be a good test of that, I imagine. I'd be more than happy to string something together for you!" : Flerri Dawntender the Tailor chuckles softly at her own little joke before letting out a sigh. : Flerri Dawntender the Tailor says, "Sorry, I just got back from one of Pine's performances." : Flerri Dawntender the Tailor says, "The thing is, I don't really have the materials in stock to make something requiring that much tension. I do have one idea, but that's... no, it's far too dangerous." You say, "Ohh, I like it dangerous!" : Flerri Dawntender the Tailor says, "Well, I'm sure you know that the spiders in Evershade have some fairly common and useful silk. But I've heard there are larger brown recluse spiders that hide out in Keepers Bight!" : Flerri Dawntender the Tailor says, "Supposedly they're as large as a horse with silk of steel! That's not all, though. There's tales of a rare one.. an even larger recluse that must have silk like mithril!" : Flerri Dawntender the Tailor says, "If you could somehow get me some of that silk, I'd surely be able to weave a set of strings that would last you a lifetime! Just... be careful if you do go out there." ==== Part 3e (Spiders) ==== (Head to Keeper's Bight and find the spiders.) {{spoiler|They can be found inside a large hollow log north of the mill. [[A deadwood matriarch]] will drop [[Bundle of Strong Silk]].}} Once you have the silk, give the [[Broken Lambent Lute]] and [[Bundle of Strong Silk]] to Flerri Dawntender the Tailor : Flerri Dawntender the Tailor sets to work pulling and shaping the impressively durable silk into long, glimmering threads. : Flerri Dawntender the Tailor uses her shears to cut the rare thread into suitable lengths, then guides them through the bridge of the broken lute. : She pulls the strings taut up along the neck and wraps them securely around each peg. : Flerri Dawntender the Tailor says, "There, that should do it! What do you think? It may need a little tuning, but I'm sure these strings will last longer than the lute body will!" : Flerri Dawntender the Tailor says, "I hope you don't mind if I keep some of the spare silk here; I'd love to work on some new projects with it. Of course, I'll also swing by the Willow at some point to hear you play!" You receive [[Silk-Strung Lute]] from Flerri Dawntender the Tailor. ==== Part 3f (Mistress) ==== (Make sure you have a refilled potion and go back to the cave under the waterfall.) You say, "Hail Mistress Naelira" : Mistress Naelira says, "Ah, the prospective entertainment returns. Have you procured an instrument worthy of performing for me, bard? Let me see it." Hand the [[Silk-Strung Lute]] to Mistress Naelira : Mistress Naelira purses her lips as she regards the newly strung lute, subjecting it to the same test she performed previously. : Mistress Naelira strums her icy digits along the rare strings, eliciting a beautiful and harmonious note from the instrument. : Mistress Naelira says, "I suppose this will have to do. Very well, bard. I shall permit you to enthrall us with a dazzling performance. Here's your lute along with a token of my favor." : Mistress Naelira says, "Enter the line of my ensemble and look out from your next stage, dear bard. When you're ready to begin, be sure to take a bow." Just stand amongst the mobs lined up in near her and type 
/take bow
This will start the performance. During the performance, when given the prompts, you will use mud commands such as: 
/push forward
/break rhythm
/take pause
It seems like a few different options will work and then you end it with another: 
/take bow
 : You end your overwhelming performance with a sweeping, flourished bow. Sweat runs down your brow as you pant for some much-needed breath. : The naiads all stare incredulously at you, before looking back to their Mistress to gauge her reaction. : You also turn your gaze up to witness an overly flustered nymph, now sporting cheeks that are far deeper in hue than they once were. : Naelira's gaze leaps from you to her servants, then back to you again. : She places a hand on her hip and lets out a petulant huff, casting her gaze to the side. Her other hand extends out toward you expectantly. : Mistress Naelira says, "Your lute and my favor, bard. Return them to me. You should be rewarded for a... suitably entertaining performance." Hand her the [[Silk-Strung Lute]] and [[Naelira's Favor]] : Mistress Naelira snatches both the favor and lute from your grasp, offering and indignant huff. The crowd of onlooking naiads softly giggle among themselves following the reaction of their mistress, which earns them a dagger-like stare from the flustered water nymph. : Mistress Naelira proceeds to turn her attention back to your lute and sings a gentle, melodious harmony upon it that infuses it with siren magic. She then offers the instrument back to you, along with an upturned nose. : Mistress Naelira says,"You performed admirably, bard, and I am...impressed. You've shown me that there's reason yet to linger in these pools, but don't think you're the only reason I'm encouraged to stay!" : Mistress Naelira says,"Now begone from my sight until I'm in need of further entertainment. You receive [[Enchanted Lute]] from Mistress Naelira. ==== Part 3g (Finally!) ==== Return to Sylphrena Starfall at the bard guildhall in Faelindral and hand her the [[Enchanted Lute]] : Sylphrena Starfall blinks in surprise as you hand her the enchanted lute. :Her hand runs down along the neck as she inspects the strings, seeming to notice the magic that has been woven into the instrument. : Sylphrena Starfall says, "Insertname, this is magnificent! An instrument blessed by the water nymphs of the Whispering Pools? You must be an incredible negotiatior!" : Sylphrena Starfall says, "I'm thrilled you managed to appease them, at least for a time. Fae can be terribly fickle and prone to whimsy that can sometimes turn violent." : Sylphrena Starfall says, "I had my full trust in you, though, and this outcome only reinforces that decision!" : Sylphrena Starfall says, "This lute belongs to you, without a doubt. Perhaps you'll try your hand at another show on the Willow's stage...No curses this time, promise!" : Sylphrena Starfall says, "Well, I'll let you make that choice. I don't have anything more for you, but check back in from time to time. I'm sure I could think of some ways to put that enchanted lute of your to good use for the Lambent Wanderers." You receive [[Lute of the Charmed]] from Sylphrena Starfall. Reward: [[Lute of the Charmed]] [[Category:Quests]] [[Category:Faelindral Quests]] [[Category:Bard Quests]]

Fariha's Shawl Quest.title: Fariha's Shawl Quest

Fighter Starter Quest (Night Harbor).title: Fighter Starter Quest (Night Harbor)
Fighter Starter Quest (Night Harbor).content:
{{Quest | imagefilename = phicon.png | width = 100px | caption = Placeholder Image |Start Zone = [[Night Harbor]] |Quest Giver = - |Minimum Level = 1 |Classes = [[Fighter]] |Related NPCs = [[Fedamius Steele III]], [[Lurinda Steele]], [[Elrind Steele]] }} __TOC__ == Reward == * Experience
  • [[Steel Talon Trainee Tunic (Fighter)]]
  • [[Steel Talons Recruit Breastplate|Steel Talon's Recruit Breastplate]]
== Walkthrough == === Part 1 - Req. Lvl 1=== Read [[Notice of Recruitment]] you start with as a new Fighter Character: 
Recruit:

You are to deliver this note to Fedamius Steele III
in the Steel Talons Garrison to begin your training.

He can be found observing the courtyard from his 
post on the wall above.

If you get lost, ask a guard. Any guard worth their
salt will know his name.

And be quick about it.

-Steel Talons Recruitment
'''Head to the Steel Talons Martial Academy on the Southwest side of Night Harbor and hand in your [[Notice of Recruitment]] to [[Fedamius Steel III]]'''
{{exp}}
: Fedamius Steele III says, "Speak quickly, and don't mince your words." :Fedamius Steele III glares at you before reading the note. : Fedamius Steele III says, "So, you want to join the Fighter Corps of the Steel Talons? Hmph... you and a few hundred others. What makes you special?" :Fedamius Steele III considers you again. : Fedamius Steele III says, "We'll see if you have what it takes soon enough... Go speak to my sister, Lurinda. Give her your note." : Fedamius Steele III says, "Now get moving." '''Head down to the courtyard and hand in your [[Notice of Recruitment]] to [[Lurinda Steele]]'''
{{exp}}
: Lurinda Steele says, "By Porbor's shriveled organ, we've got another one! You would-be recruits are stumbling in faster than copper coin falling from a drunkard's pouch!" :Lurinda Steele sizes you up. : Lurinda Steele says, "But you might not be a complete waste of time. Speaking of a waste of time, take your note to my son Elrind to file. He'll complete your registration at the academy so you can start your training." : Lurinda Steele says, "While you're at it, tell him to give you the research he's supposed to have finished for me." : Lurinda Steele says, "You'll find him in the academy's library - if he's not skulking about the entrance to the garrison's tavern again." : Lurinda Steele says, "MOVE!" :Lurinda Steele motions you away. '''Head into southern entrance to the academy and hand in your [[Notice of Recruitment]] to [[Elrind Steele]]'''
{{exp}}
:Elrind Steele widens his eyes in awe. : Elrind Steele says, "My, don't you look mighty." :Elrind Steele quickly dons a serious expression as he scans the note deliberately. : Elrind Steele says, "You're wanting to complete your registration at the academy, then. I'm sure you're eager to start your training." : Elrind Steele says, "Unfortunately, it might be weeks before I can file your application. Mother has tasked me with important research, so I'm very busy. Unless..." : Elrind Steele says, "Maybe we can help each other. If you gather the items for my research, I can expedite your registration. How does that sound? Truth be told, I'd rather stay in the library anyway." : Elrind Steele says, "Here's the list of items, as well as some charcoal and parchment for the frottage." You receive [[Elrind's List]] from [[Elrind Steele]].
You receive [[Charcoal]] from [[Elrind Steele]].
You receive [[Parchment]] from [[Elrind Steele]].

'''Head out the west gate to kill [[a rotting skeleton]]s, [[a snake]]s, and [[a fire beetle]]s'''
: Keep killing until you receive a [[Skeleton Jawbone]], a [[Snake Fang]], and a [[Fire Beetle Eye]]. Alternatively you can buy them. : Then head towards the stone pillar outside of the cave to Wyrmsbane. : /rub inscription when you are standing next to the pillar to receive [[Frottage of Inscriptions]] '''Return to [[Elrind Steele]] and hand him the [[Frottage of Inscriptions]], [[Skeleton Jawbone]], [[Snake Fang]], and [[Fire Beetle Eye]]'''
{{exp}}
:Elrind Steele accepts the items with reverence. : Elrind Steele says, "Welcome to the Steel Talons. I'll file your papers with the others under Status - Currently Alive" : Elrind Steele says, "Here is the research that my mother requested. You're also more than welcome to discard the list I previously gave you, as you'll no longer need it." : Elrind Steele says, "Come back some time, maybe we'll find a way to help each other again... unless your status changes, of course" You receive [[Elrind's Research]] from [[Elrind Steele]].

'''Return to [[Lurinda Steele]] and hand her [[Elrind's Research]]'''
{{exp}}
: Lurinda Steele says, "What took yo uso long? Did Elrind send you on one of his scavenger hunts? Never mind. Don't keep me waiting again." : Lurinda Steele says, "Take this tunic. It will identify you as one of our trainees." : Lurinda Steele says, "We practice in the garrison, but true training occurs in the field. And this is where the Steel Talons excel." : Lurinda Steele says, "That's why our most promising members are sought after by the Night Harbor Guard or the Red Mantles." : Lurinda Steele says, "The Ashira have been harassing the city's borders and this is as good as an opportunity as ever to support the efforts of the Night Harbor Guard and the Red Mantles, and to distinguish yourself as a competent member of the Steel Talons." : Lurinda Steele says, "Fill this pack with proof of your assistance in culling the Ashira menace. Their warriors' bracers will do. Let our archers tend to their scouts." You receive [[Steel Talon Trainee Tunic (Fighter)|Steel Talon Trainee Tunic]] from [[Lurinda Steele]].
You receive [[Lurinda's Pack]] from [[Lurinda Steele]].

=== Part 2 === '''Return to [[Lurinda Steele]] and hand her [[Combined 6 Ashira Warrior Bracers]]'''
{{exp}}
: Lurinda Steele says, "Things have been moving quickly in Night Harbor lately. Both the City Watch and the Red Mantles are taking recruits all recruits we can muster." : Lurinda Steele says, "You're not quite there yet, but clearly you have potential. Keep up the good work." : Lurinda Steele says, "Take this note and your tunic to Fedamius. You're getting a promotion." Receive Lurinda's Note
'''Return to [[Fedamius Steel III]] and hand him [[Tunic and Lurinda's Note]]'''
{{exp}}
: Fedamius Steel III says, "Hmph... if Lurinda thinks you're worth promoting, then maybe there's more to you than I initially thought." Fedamius Steel III looks genuinely pleased.
: Fedamius Steel III says, "Take this and wear it with pride. You've earned it, recruit." : Fedamius Steel III says, "Now, while you've got some downtime, visit the towers along the city's western wall and make yourself known to a captain. It's good for our candidates to get to know their future leadership." You receive [[Steel Talons Recruit Breastplate|Steel Talon's Recruit Breastplate]] from [[Fedamius Steel III]].
It is safe to discard Elrind's List. [[Category:Quests]] [[Category:Night Harbor Quests]] [[Category:Fighter Quests]]

Enchanter Starter Quest (Night Harbor).title: Enchanter Starter Quest (Night Harbor)
Enchanter Starter Quest (Night Harbor).content:
{{Quest | imagefilename = phicon.png | width = 100px | caption = Placeholder Image |Start Zone = [[Night Harbor]] |Quest Giver = |Minimum Level = 1 |Classes = [[Enchanter]] |Related NPCs = [[Master Wincog]], [[Bieito Brightsmile]], [[Mirembe Tiifu]], [[Malory Moreland]], [[Sexton Harding]], [[Vaclav]],
[[Jaakima]], [[Piia]], [[Jamee Langris]] }}
__TOC__ == Reward ==
  • [[Dusty Violet Robe]]
  • [[Braided Crystal Ring]]
  • [[Rough Cut Robe]]
  • [[Scroll: Invisibility Versus Undead]]
  • *Experience
== Walkthrough == === Part 1 - Req. Lvl 1 (both paths)=== '''Read [[Torn Note (Enchanter)|Torn Note]] you start with as a new Enchanter character:''' 
Do not be startled, , but you have a choice to make, and time is of the essence.

Do you register as a practitioner of mind magic, as the law requires, and then face a lifetime of scrutiny and obedience to some faceless bureaucracy?

Or do you maintain your anonymity, seek out the aid of like-minded beguilers, and chart your own course?

The choice is yours, though we advise you to pursue the latter.

Deliver this note to Master Wincog at his curious goods shop. You'll find it along the long flight of stairs that connects Sageside to Saltbreeze Park. Look for the sign.

And a word of caution: he may not look like much, but as all enchanters know - never trust your eyes.
'''Give [[Torn Note (Enchanter)|Torn Note]] to [[Master Wincog]].''' {{exp}} :Master Wincog adjusts his spectacles and reads the note. : Master Wincog says, "Well, it's good to meet you. Or at least I think it is." : Master Wincog says, "As a novice enchanter, you're required by law to register with the city...though, you could always choose to set your own course. You have a big decision to make." : Master Wincog says, "If you want to be a good, law-abiding citizen, seek out Registrar Vauquelin inside the Spellbinders Spire. He keeps a watchful eye on all registered enchanters." : Master Wincog says, "His office is on the ground level of the Spire, near the entrance. So, if you happen to use the wizards' teleporter, head downstairs." : Master Wincog says, "Give him his registration form. With it, you'll be properly registered." You receive [[Sealed Registration Form]] from [[Master Wincog]]. : Master Wincog says, "Or...should you choose otherwise, you can just return it to me. The choice is yours." === Part 2a - Req. Lvl 1 (Wincog path)=== : Master Wincog says, "Since you're handing me this, I take it you're not looking for work as an entertainer." : Master Wincog says, "You'll likely come to know that being an unregistered enchanter isn't exactly an easy life... but as long as they think you're only capable of party tricks, they tend to leave you alone." : Master Wincog says, "Now, how about you run some errands for me so that my dear friend Nerlbus can take a break? When you're done, I might let you in on a great secret!" : Master Wincog says, "Take this robe, bag, and the items to be delivered." You receive [[Dusty Violet Robe]] from [[Master Wincog]]. You receive [[Wincog's Delivery Bag]] from [[Master Wincog]]. You receive [[Ivory Inlaid Box]] from [[Master Wincog]]. You receive [[Smoky Glass Vial]] from [[Master Wincog]]. You receive [[Ornately Locked Book]] from [[Master Wincog]]. You receive [[Small Golden Cage]] from [[Master Wincog]]. : Master Wincog says, "Once you've got the robe and bag on and adjusted, let me know that you're ready to get started." : You say, "I'm ready for my instructions" :Master Wincog laughs deviously. You think you hear Nerlbus's laughter echoing in the distance as well. : Master Wincog says, "Oh... I'm not sure you're ready for this." :Master Wincog smiles at you with a sparkle in this eyes. : Master Wincog says, "We enchanters are feared by the authorities for a reason. We can appear as anything, or disappear altogether... and, we have the power to get inside the heads of others." :Master Wincog appears to grow slightly, his voice booming inside your head! : Master Wincog says, "IF YOU WISH TO ENTER THE HOUSE OF CANDOR, YOU MUST KNOW THE CONSEQUENCES OF BETRAYAL!" : Master Wincog says, "Well... enough of that." : Master Wincog says, "The deliveries are labeled. Take the first item to Bieito Brightsmile in the Travelers Ward." : Master Wincog says, "Don't worry I'll help you find it." :Master Wincog smiles again as your vision begin to blur... :You are mesmerized. :You are no longer mesmerized. [[Master Wincog]] has teleported you to the Soujourner's Camp near to [[Bieito Brightsmile]]. Give [[Bieito Brightsmile]] the [[Ivory Inlaid Box]]. {{exp}} :Bieito Brightsmile laughs and tucks away the box. : Bieito Brightsmile says, "Here's what he requested in exchange." You receive [[Large Black Stone Egg]] from [[Bieito Brightsmile]]. : Bieito Brightsmile says, "Tell ol' Wincog that I appre..." :Bieito Brightsmile suddenly begins to nod off and lean to one side. : Bieito Brightsmile says, "You can find Mirembe in the harbor district. She supervises a warehouse on the waterfront. Go to her at once." :Bieito Brightsmile jolts upright, looking alert. : Bieito Brightsmile says, "...ciate him finding this for us. We've been all over and inquired to no avail. Thankfully, Wincog's reputation as a procurer precedes him." : Bieito Brightsmile says, "Well, take care, and thanks again." [[Mirembe Tiifu]] can be found South and slightly East of the Monk/Elementalist guild (Just East of the Customs Office). She can be visible on the second floor on a balcony above some arches when running down the seafront. Use the entrance on the West side to reach her. Give her the [[Smoky Glass Vial]]. {{exp}} : Mirembe Tiifu says, "Thanks the gods! I've been waiting for this." : Mirembe Tiifu says, "Here's what I found for the trade. I'm happy to get rid of this creepy thing." You receive [[Writhing Leather Bag]] from [[Mirembe Tiifu]]. :Mirembe Tiifu makes a disgusted face. : Mirembe Tiifu says, "They said they found it on one of the islands off the coast, like he said they would." : Mirembe Tiifu says, "I don't know what those little ones want with such a thing..." :Mirembe Tiifu squeezes her eyes shut and shivers at the thought. : Mirembe Tiifu says, "Okay, now head north to the Concourse of Souls. It's built into the mountains that border the city. You'll find Malory in the library there." :Mirembe Tiifu shifts her eyes around for a moment, then looks at your suspiciously. : Mirembe Tiifu says, "I forget what I was saying... but thank you for the delivery, and for taking that creepy thing away from here." [[Malory Moreland]] can be found on the second floor of the Concourse of Souls, in the same room as the Necromancer and Shadow Knight Spell Merchants. Give her the [[Ornately Locked Book]]. {{exp}} : Malory Moreland says, "Ah yes... I was expecting you, ." :Malory Moreland sets down the book down without opening it. : Malory Moreland says, "I look forward to reading this. It's very rare, but Master Wincog has an impeccable ability to acquire peculiar things... take you, for example." :Malory Moreland pauses to consider you for a moment. : Malory Moreland says, "Well, I'm sure you'll turn out fine." :Malory Moreland tilts her head slightly, then laughs as she straightens it. : Malory Moreland says, "Your master should know better than to try entering my mind. It's a fine parlor trick, but we're quite heavily warded here." You receive [[Locked 6-fold Notebook]] from [[Malory Moreland]]. : Malory Moreland says, "Here's the gift I promised the gnome. After that little stunt he just pulled, I should keep it, but then you'd be unable to finish your task." : Malory Moreland says, "Oh, and he wants you to give the last package to Sexton Harding. You can find him in the old cemetery outside of the Northern Gate. There's a shortcut to it through the Black Feather Bazaar." : Malory Moreland says, "Since you're heading there, you may need this." You receive a NODROP version of [[Scroll: Invisibility versus Undead]] from [[Malory Moreland]]. : Malory Moreland says, "Best of luck!" Note: It's not strictly necessary to scribe, memorize and cast Invisibilty versus Undead on yourself for the next step, but for safety it's probably advised, especially when doing his at low level. [[Sexton Harding]] can be found by turning left immediately after exiting the Night Harbour via the North Gate. He can be found in the corner by a camp fire. You will need to go round the ruins to get to him. Give him the [[Small Golden Cage]]. {{exp}} : Sexton Harding says, "Oh! Oh dear... this is a surprise. I'd entirely forgotten about it!" :Sexton Harding quickly hands you a skull that was sitting nearby. You receive [[Engraved Human Skull]] from [[Sexton Harding]]. : Sexton Harding says, "Don't worry, don't worry... the skull isn't from here. I wouldn't dare defile this sacred garden. It was brought onto the grounds by some ne'er-do-wells who didn't belong here." : Sexton Harding says, "Well, they're occupying their own spaces here now. Buried proper-like. Got 'em both with my pickaxe and shovel, whilst they were neck-deep in someone else's grave." :Sexton Harding nods proudly and smiles with a toothless grin. : Sexton Harding says, "Master Wincog said that if I were ever to come across a skull with these markings, we'd have a trade to make. Sure enough, the robbers had one in their bag." :Sexton Harding rubs his chin. : Sexton Harding says, "But, I'd completely forgotten about it until now! It's lucky that you came by!" : Sexton Harding says, "Take 'im that skull, and my thanks. No idea how he knew it'd be here, but there it is... and here's my moth cage!" Combine the [[Large Black Stone Egg]], [[Writhing Leather Bag]], [[Locked 6-fold Notebook]] and [[Engraved Human Skull]] in [[Wincog's Delivery Bag]]. Give [[Wincog's Delivery Bag]] to [[Master Wincog]]. {{exp}} :Master Wincog places the bag under the counter. : Master Wincog says, "I appreciate the help. I hope you enjoyed yourself and made some new friends." : Master Wincog says, "You're going to meet a few more people, or at least, mostly people, as part of your next journey." : (If you registered with the enchanter guild, the above line is replaced with:)Master Wincog says," We've decided to trust you. You're going to meet a few more people, or at least, You receive [[Silver Key of Candor]] from [[Master Wincog]].
: Master Wincog says, "If you're clever, you'll find a secret lair in which your new allies reside!" : Master Wincog says, "If you're not so clever, you'll be surrounded by books for hours and hours, so maybe you'll eventually become clever enough to figure it out." : Master Wincog says, "Now, go to the library and show that key to Vaclav. He'll take care of you from here." Go to the floating caster tower and take the portal marked Library. Take the portal in front of you to be teleported down one floor. Walk straight ahead and through a bookcase into an empty room, which should teleport you to another room with windows with [[Vaclav]]. This room is within the Enchanter guild which can be found in the harbor district. Give [[Vaclav]] the [[Silver Key of Candor]]. {{exp}} : Vaclav says, "Welcome to the House of Candor! We've been expecting your arrival, Master Wincog was quite eager for us to meet." :Vaclav motions to the room around him. : Vaclav says, "Night Harbor is still growing, so you may find that we'll occupy a different location in the future. For now, please enjoy our facility here." :Vaclav looks distracted for a moment. : Vaclav says, "...Oh! You gave me your key, you'll need that back." You receive [[Silver Key of Candor]] from [[Vaclav]]. : Vaclav says, "Now... where was I? Ah, yes! The House of Candor is a distributed collective, which means you can find us throughout the realms of Aêthoril." : Vaclav says, "To preserve our order and, thereby, our personal safety, we excel at acquiring knowledge, making deals, and generally being indispensable." : You say, "What knowledge?" : Vaclav says, "We can be quite persuasive, so the House has often been called upon to assist with important negotiations... or to gather information to gain the upper hand in such matters." : Vaclav says, "Do not worry! If you have more of a taste for flash and danger, there's ample opportunity to assist bold adventurers heading into the hither or dither. Personally, though, I'll have none of that. I'd prefer to simply sit here and read." : Vaclav says, While we're on this topic. You should speak with Jaakima. He needs assistance with something or other. Just show him the key." Head downstairs from [[Vaclav]]. Exit the tower and turn left, [[Jaakima]] is inside the first door on the right. Give him the [[Silver Key of Candor]]. : Jaakima says, "Welcome! It's nice to see a new face." :Jaakima laughs heartily. : Jaakima says, "That's a joke. We're enchanters, we constantly see new faces... even on the same people." : Jaakima says, "If Vaclav just sent you, then you probably need more practice before you can assist us. Once you're ready, speak with the twins, Pau and Piia. They'll likely have a job for you." : Jaakima says, "Oh, and be sure to keep the key with you at all times. You never know when you'll need it." You receive your items back from Jaakima. Head down one flight of stairs and you will find [[Piia]] and Pau in a room on this floor. Give [[Piia]] the [[Silver Key of Candor]]. :Piia rolls the key in her palm. : Piia says, "Very well, if you're ready to assist us, let's get to it." : Piia says, "First of all, here's your key back." : Piia says, "We've learned of a shipment arriving via some smugglers who operate from a cove west of the city." : Piia says, "Pay them a visit. Look inside their tents to see if you can find a small, ironbound crate. However, if you do find it, don't open it. It's very dangerous." : Piia says, "It's bound for a person of great importance here in the city, so it's likely to be well-hidden until they're ready to smuggle it in. Be sure to inspect anything that seems out of the ordinary within those tents." : Piia says, "Once you've retrieved it, bring it to Jamee Langris. You'll find him where the bards meet to perform in the Night Market." : Piia says, "Good luck." You receive your items back from Piia. This next part can be done during the day and night. It can be done while invisible, although a smuggler may come and investigate - you can easily run out whilst still invisible. Head to the Smuggler's Camp in Shaded Dunes and enter the second tent from the East. Use /look to receive the following message: :Old fishing nets lie inconspicuously piled in the corner of the tent. Use /inspect nets to receive the following message: :As you push the nets aside, you discover an ironbound wooden box hidden beneath. You receive [[Ironbound Wooden Box]]. Head back to Night Harbor and go to the stage in The Night Market. [[Jamee Langris]] can be found behind the stage. Give him the [[Ironbound Wooden Box]]. (Note you must have your [[Silver Key of Candor]] on you or he will ask for identification) :Jamee Langris looks both startled and impressed by the box you have given him. : Jamee Langris says, "Oh dear, this is quite a surprise! The twins must have sent you." : Jamee Langris says, "I wasn't certain whether the rumors of its existence were true, but we'll find out soon enough." :Jamee Langris bows slightly. : Jamee Langris says, "My client will be very, very pleased. In return, please accept this gift to take to Piia." You receive [[Finely Wrapped Gift]] from [[Jamee Langris]]. Head back to the Enchanter guild and give [[Finely Wrapped Gift]] to [[Piia]]. :Piia claps her hands with joy. :Piia tears open the wrapping to reveal a leatherbound book. : Piia says, "Well done! Jamee said he'd be able to find this for me. It's a study of human behaviour under stress, written by the physicians of Lymian. Pau and I are quite eager to learn." : Piia says, "In exchange, I offer you this." You receive [[Braided Crystal Ring]] from [[Piia]]. : Piia says, "Please accept it as a token of my appreciation." : Piia says, "Take care now, though do visit later. I may have another favor to ask of you." {{ItemBox | item_name = Braided Crystal Ring | link_name = | icon_id = Itemicon0098AA | item_link_id = dcc7f7015af582851a1923a8 | magic = Yes | unique = Yes | nodrop = Yes | slot = NECK FINGER | int = 2 | cha = 1 | hp = 5 | weight = 0.1 | size = TINY | class = ENC | race = ALL | item_stats = A ring fashioned from delicate strands of crystal woven together. }} === Part 2b - Req. Lvl 1 (Vauquelin path)=== If you hand in to [[Registrar Vauquelin]] '''instead of''' back to [[Master Wincog]]: {{exp}} : Your faction standing with House of Candor got worse. You receive [[Rough Cut Robe]] from [[Registrar Vauquelin]]. : Registrar Vauquelin says, “Ah, I see…”
:Registrar Vauquelin clears his throat.
: Registrar Vauquelin says, “You have made the lawful choice to register as an enchanter of Night Harbor.
:Registrar Vauquelin dutifully writes your name in the large book before him.
: Registrar Vauquelin says, “There, now you are properly registered.” : Registrar Vauquelin says, “You are required by law to wear this robe, as it signifies your registration status with the authorities. Do not dispose of it.” : Registrar Vauquelin says, “Futhermore, you are only permitted to scribe a selection of approved spells. Should you encounter any unsanctioned spell usage, please report it to the Spellbinders at once. :(At this point you can either take the robe to Master Wincog, or keep the [[Rough Cut Robe]] robe.) :*Upon handing the Rough Cut Robe to Master Wincog: : Master Wincog says, "Smart choice. As you likely know, being an unregistered enchanter isn't exactly an easy life... But as long as they think you're only capable of party tricks, they tend to leave you alone." :Master Wincog says, "Now, since you went and registered, you'll need to make an effort to regain the trust of House Candor." : Master Wincog says, "How about you run some errands for me so that my dear friend Nerlbus can take a break? When you're done, I'll put in a good word for you." :Master Wincog inspects your old robe and lets out a chuckle.
:Master Wincog says, "They're still using that same old scrying spell to track registrants. It's highly inaccurate and easy to remove." :Master Wincog quietly mutters an incantation.
:Master Wincog says, "Here, put on this bag along with your disenchanted robe. Also, take these items for delivery." :Master Wincog says, "Once you've got them on, let me know that you're ready to go. When you're done, return the filled bag and your robe to me." :(At this point, refer to Part 2a where you reply to Master Wincog.) === Part 3 - Req. Lvl ?=== NEED INFO [[Category:Quests]] [[Category:Night Harbor Quests]] [[Category:Enchanter Quests]]

Elementalist Starter Quest (Night Harbor.title: Elementalist Starter Quest (Night Harbor)
Elementalist Starter Quest (Night Harbor.content:
{{Quest | imagefilename = phicon.png | width = 100px | caption = Placeholder Image |Start Zone = [[Night Harbor]] |Quest Giver = [[Tenebrim Tam]] |Minimum Level = 1 |Classes = [[Elementalist]] |Related NPCs = | Related Items = A Pinwheel | Quest Rewards = (exp) [[First Degree Fourfold Sash]] [[Simple Brass Coin]] }} The Pinwheel quest is the beginner quest for elementalists, obtained after turning in their starter note to their guild master. The quest takes the player throughout Night Harbor. ==Reward== * Faction standing with School of the Fourfold Path * Experience == Introduction == Upon turning in [[a humble note]] to [[Tenebrim Tam]] inside [[The School of the Fourfold Path]]: : Tenebrim Tam turns to you gruffly, assessing your[sic] a moment, before his expression cracks into a broad smile. : Your faction standing with School of the Fourfold Path got better. : Tenebrim Tam says, "Welcome to the School of the Fourfold Path! I take it you are here because you wish to train as an Elementalist with our school, no?" : Tenebrim Tam claps his broad hand across your shoulders as a boisterous laugh escapes his lips. : Tenebrim Tam says, "Here at the school, we learn not just about how to use the magic of the elementals, but also to find harmony in our relations with them. As a new member to our school, I would like to present you with our belt!" : You receive [[Fourfold Sash]] from Tenebrim Tam. : Tenebrim Tam says, "That belt marks you as a member of our school, and as you increase in rank, we will add emblems to it. Do our guild proud. With that out of the way, I have a task for you, as part of your training." : Tenebrim Tam claps his hands together, and suddenly, several items appear in them with a flash! : Tenebrim Tam says, "You are to go about the city and provide offerings to some of our invisible helps. Take this pinwheel, it will spin when you are in the presence of a hungry Djinn, in places of proper elemental resonance. You need not do anything with it, it will spin all on its own. Djinn are often housed inside of objects of art, such as statues, because they do not have a physical form. When you find them, place some incense for them from this box. They will offer you a token of their appreciation in the form of a pearl. Place the pearls in this bag, and return it alongside the pinwheel, your belt, and the box. There are four pearls in all to find - one for earth, water, wind, and fire." : You receive [[A Pinwheel]] from Tenebrim Tam. : You receive [[A Box of Elemental Incense]] from Tenebrim Tam. : You receive [[small velvet bag|Small Velvet Bag]] from Tenebrim Tam. == Part 1 == As you approach the objects of interest you'll receive these messages in order of proximity: : Your pinwheel beings to spin... : Your pinwheel spins faster... You must be getting closer. : Your pinwheel spins very quickly. There must be something nearby. After the third message you can use /look to get a description of the object. Then open your inventory and left-click on the box of elemental incense (it will appear on your cursor). Lastly, place the incense on the object by typing: /place incense === Earthen Pearl === After turning in the humble note, turn 180° from Tenebrim Tan and make your way downstairs to the wall parallel to where he stands. Get close to the small scarab idol hanging on the wall. Pinwheel_Scarab.png|Scarab idol far-way Ele2.png|Scarab idol close-up Upon /looking around you notice: : This cave provides a protected aera for the elementals. Along the wall, you notice a small stone idol of a scarab. Click on your box of incense and /place scarab: : The sweet scent of incense fills the air. : As you place and light the incense in front of the idol, the ethereal being grows in size, seemingly pleased from your offering. Suddenly, it reaches into itself, pulling out a small pearl, which it unceremoniously drops into your hands. : You receive [[An Earthern Pearl]]. Place the Earthen Pearl, and all subsequent pearls, inside your small velvet bag. ===Aqua Pearl=== Leave the School of the Fourfold Path through the doorway directly to the right of the scarab idol. Follow the path down the ramp and turn sharp right going west, you will pass a set of stairs on your right and find a doorway on your left heading south. Your pinwheel should begin to spin again now. You will see white columned portico covering a well with the statue of a jackal at the southern end. [[File:Pinwheel_Jackal.png|300px]] Following the same procedures as before: : This covered well provides a much-needed respite for the labors of the day. Along the southern wall, an alabaster pillar displaying a small wooden idol of a jackal stands watch over the square.
Click on your box of incense and /place statue : You receive [[An Aqua Pearl]]. ===Fiery Pearl=== Now head to the blacksmithing forge at [[the Night Market]] by going north back through the doorway you came through and head northwest until you come to the market area.
[[File:Ele3.png|300px]] Another scarab idol is attached to the wall near the forge.
Click on your box of incense and /place scarab. After offering incense: : Ringing hammers announce the Smithy's Guild as you make your way towards it, as apprentices stoke coals in forges, quench hammered plates in water, and hone freshly forged blades on sharpening wheels. Meanwhile, masters demonstrate more advanced techniques to their students as the fires of the forges dance across the shadowed walls. on the wall, a stone fire beetle statue stands in silent vigil. : Swirling smoke rises from the offered incense, which seems to collect within the ethereal being, strengthening it. A small, fiery pearl drops from the beetle statue's pincers, which youj pocket hastily. : The smell of sweet incense wafts through the air, mingling with the scent of coal and molten metal. : You receive [[A Fiery Pearl]]. ===Airy Pearl=== Now venture northeast to the area with the North Gate. Once you find the North Gate, make your way east to the huge glowing mage tower and, taking the ramps and magic platforms, go to the very top of the tower. At the top, find the bird statue on one of the ledges. [[File:Pinwheel_Avian.png|300px]]
Click on your box of incense and /place statue
After offering incense: : The tower stands tall above the city. A small avian statue perched along the wall, standing watch. : You light the incense, and the siwrling winds around the tower coalesce around the statue, a swirling vortex of sweet incense and sea air mingling together. After a moment, the incorporeal figure is gone, but a small, egg-like pearl remains in its place. The scent of jasmine and sandalwood permeate the area as the incense is lit. : You receive [[An Airy Pearl]]. ===Turn In=== Open the small velvet bag and ensure all pearls are placed within. Press combine to transform the small velvet bag into a [[Velvet Bag of Pearls]]. Return to Tenebrim Tam and give him the incense, the pinwheel, the bag of pearls, and the training belt all at once. He responds: : Tenebrim Tam takes the items from you, counting out the pearls. : Tenebrim Tam says, "Ah, wonderful! You've completed your tasks. I am very proud of you for this, . As a reward, I will be affixing the first seal to your belt, marking you as a First Degree Elementalist in the School of the Fourfold Path! Congratulations!" : You receive [[First Degree Fourfold Sash]] from Tenebrim Tam. : Your faction standing with School of the Fourfold Path got better. : Tenebrim Tam says, "Now, I urge you to go out and train with your fellow adventurers. once you have grown a bit in skill, I have another task for you. bring this imbued coin to me when you feel you are ready to being your next task." : You receive [[A Simple Brass Coin]] from Tenebrim Tam. == Part 2 - Preparing for the Test == {{Quest | imagefilename = phicon.png | width = 100px | caption = Placeholder Image |Start Zone = [[Night Harbor]] |Quest Giver = [[Tenebrim Tam]] |Minimum Level = 3 |Classes = [[Elementalist]] |Related NPCs = None }} ===Return to Tenebrim Tam=== Turn in [[A Simple Brass Coin]] to Tenebrim Tam. : Tenebrim Tam says, "Please go through the Night Harbor gates, into the yards, and grab two fire beetle glands, two bone chips, two bat wings, and a water flask." Turn the items in to Tenebrim Tam along with your [[First Degree Fourfold Sash]]. : Tenebrim Tam says, "Excellent!" : Tenebrim Tam says, "I've reinforced your trainee belt and we're now ready to start your elemental affinity tests." : Tenebrim Tam says, "Go speak to Pedram in the back, tell him you're there for the tests, he'll ready your elemental crystals for them." You receive
  • [[Reinforced First Degree Fourfold Sash]]
    • == Part 3 == {{Quest | imagefilename = phicon.png | width = 100px | caption = Placeholder Image |Start Zone = [[Night Harbor]] |Quest Giver = [[Tenebrim Tam]] |Minimum Level = 3 |Classes = [[Elementalist]] |Related NPCs = None }} ===Speak with Pedram=== : You say, "Hail, Pedram." : Pedram says, "Hail, adventurer. I'm Pedram, assistant to the Tams." : You say, "I'm here for the tests." : Pedram says, "You're a trainee here for the elemental tests?" : Pedram says, "Good. I've extracted the elemental affinities from the ingredients you provided and prepared the crystals." : : Pedram beams at you. : Pedram says, "Are you ready for the first one?" : You say, "I'm ready." : Pedram hands you a small crystal. You receive [[Red Crystral]]. : Pedram says, "First comes fire." : Pedram says, "Use this crystal in the training grounds, but be prepared! Once you've overcome the challenge, come back to me with the elemental essence." : Pedram says, "If you fail the challenge, return to me with the empty crystal and I'll replenish it for you." Go downstairs to the training grounds. Use the crystal in your inventory. A Level 5 [[an angry fire elemental]] will spawn and attack you. Kill it and loot [[Fiery Essence]]. Give the Fiery Essence to Pedram. : Pedram says, "You've bested it. Well done!" : Pedram says, "Are you ready for the next challenge? It's earth! Once you've overcome it, return to me with the elemental essence." Repeat the process using the [[Brown Crystal]] to summon a Level 5 [[an angry earth elemental]] and loot the [[Earthen Essence]]. Give the Earthen Essence to Pedram. : Pedram says, "You're starting to get the hang of this. Splendid!" : Pedram says, "Are you ready for the water challenge? Once you overcome it, return to me with the elemental essence." Repeat the process using the [[Blue Crystal]] to summon a Level 5 [[an angry water elemental]] and loot the [[Watery Essence]]. Give the Watery Essence to Pedram. : Pedram says, "Seems you're quite capable. Great work!" : Pedram says, "Are you ready for the final challenge, air? Once you overcome it, return to me with the elemental essence." Repeat the process using the [[Translucent Crystal]] to summon a Level 5 [[an angry air elemental]] and loot the [[Airy Essence]]. Give the Airy Essence to Pedram. : Pedram says, "You've succeeded in your elemental affinity tests. Congratulations!" : Pedram claps his hands. : Pedram says, "Take this note back to Master Tenebrim, he'll be thrilled to hear of your success!" : You receive [[Note for Tenebrim]]. Hand the note to Tenebrim. : Tenebrim Tam picks up the note, reads through and smiles at you. : Tenebrim Tam says, "You managed to tame the elements! I knew you'd overcome this challenge, well done." : Tenebrim Tam says, "We have a gift for you, student. Choose your eleemental affinity by handing me the corresponding essence with your trainee belt. Hand your
  • [[Reinforced First Degree Fourfold Sash]]
    • and an Elemental Essence to Tenebrim Tam. : Tenebrim Tam fiddles with your belt and adds a second seal to it. You will receive a Level 4 spell scroll of the element you choose. You also receive a
  • [[Second Degree Fourfold Sash]]
    • . : Tenebrim Tam says, "You are now a second degree student of the Fourfold Path, congratulations!" : Tenebrim Tam says, "Come back to me after spending some time honing your skills, I will have other things to teach you." : Tenebrim Tam salutes you. : Tenebrim Tam says, "Oh, if you have any crystals or essences left, give them to Pedram, he'll give you some crushed malachites for your summonings!" Give your remaining essences and crystals to Pedram. He will give you one [[Crushed Malachite]] per turn in. : Pedram says, "Thank you. We'll make good use of it!" : Pedram says, "Here's my end of the bargain." : Pedram presses a crushed malachite into your palm with a smile. Archer Starter Quest (Night Harbor).title: Archer Starter Quest (Night Harbor)
Archer Starter Quest (Night Harbor).content:
{{Quest | imagefilename = phicon.png | width = 100px | caption = Placeholder Image |Start Zone = [[Night Harbor]] |Quest Giver = - |Minimum Level = 1 |Classes = [[Archer]] |Related NPCs = [[Fedamius Steele III]], [[Jacobin Yeats]], [[Garrison Quartermaster]] }} == Reward == * Experience
  • [[Steel Talon Trainee Tunic (Archer)]]
  • [[Steel Talons Bowman Tunic]]
== Walkthrough == === Part 1 - Req. Lvl 1=== Read the [[Notice of Recruitment]] you start with as a new Archer character: 
Recruit:

You are to deliver this note to Fedamius Steele III
in the Steel Talons Garrison to begin your training.

He can be found observing the courtyard from his 
post on the wall above.

If you get lost, ask a guard. Any guard worth their
salt will know his name.

And be quick about it.

-Steel Talons Recruitment
'''Head to the Steel Talons Martial Academy on the Southwest side of Night Harbor and hand in your [[Notice of Recruitment]] to [[Fedamius Steel III]]'''
{{exp}}
: Fedamius Steele III squints and looks at you. : Fedamius Steele III says "What do we have here?" : Fedamius Steele III takes the note from you and reads it. : Fedamius Steele III says "Ahh... another one for Jacobin to train. Well, Archer, scuttle back down the stairs and deliver this to that ridiculous brother-in-law of mine." : Fedamius Steele III says Let’s hope his aim rubs off on you more than his sense of humor. You receive [[Notice of Recruitment]] from [[Fedamius Steel III]].

'''Head down into the courtyard and hand your [[Notice of Recruitment]] to [[Jacobin Yeats]]'''
{{exp}}
: Jacobin Yeats quickly skewers the note with an arrow. : Jacobin Yeats says "Oh! Another one of these. Where do all of you keep wandering in from?" : Jacobin Yeats shakes his head. : Jacobin Yeats says "Well alright then, how about a wager?I'll give you one arrow. If you can hit the bullseye on your first shot, you get to stay deal?" : Jacobin Yeats laughs. : Jacobin Yeats says "Oh, stop looking at me that way. I'm just kidding. Take this and get ready to head back out." : Jacobin Yeats says "We’ll work on refining your skills later, but for now, the cost of entry involves you, your bow, and scouts." : Jacobin Yeats says "The Ashira have scouts roaming outside the gates. Fill this bag with the scouts' necklaces as proof that you can hit a large, slow moving, somewhat smelly target, and then we’ll get you started." : Jacobin Yeats says "And… don’t go bartering with the Ashira for them." You receive [[Steel Talon Trainee Tunic (Archer)]] from [[Jacobin Yeats]].
You receive [[Jacobin's Bag]] from [[Jacobin Yeats]].

=== Part 2 - Req. Lvl 1=== '''Head out to the west gate noob yard and kill [[An ashira scout]] until you get 4 [[Ashira Scout Necklace]]s'''
: Combine the 4 [[Ashira Scout Necklace]]s in [[Jacobin's Bag]] to receive [[Bag of Ashira Scout Necklaces]] '''Hand the [[Bag of Ashira Scout Necklaces]] to [[Jacobin Yeats]]'''
{{exp}}
: Jacobin Yeats examines the necklaces. : Jacobin Yeats says "These are the ones, well done! What did you end up paying for them?" : Jacobin Yeats laughs. : Jacobin Yeats says "I jest, I jest. The Ashira are a constant threat to our northern and western trade routes. Though, in a way, part of me is sympathetic to any creature that's trying to survive in such a harsh environment." : Jacobin Yeats says "But we're obligated to do our part in keeping Night Harbor safe, and unfortunately, this puts us in a bit of conflict with our furry, feral friends." : Jacobin Yeats says "Let's up the stakes a little bit and move you onto bigger game. Fill this pack with Ashira warrior necklaces, and we'll officially get you onto our roster." : Jacobin Yeats says "Their warriors are no joke, so keep your guard up. You'll find them further out in the desert..' : Jacobin Yeats says "Again... no cheating!" You receive [[Jacobin's Pack]] from [[Jacobin Yeats]].

'''Head out to the west gate noob yard and kill [[An ashira warrior]] until you get 6 [[Ashira Warrior Necklace]]s'''
: Alternatively you can head into [[Shaded Dunes]] to find small camps of [[An ashira lookout]]s and [[An ashira warrior]]s : After attaining 6 [[Ashira Warrior Necklace]]s, combine them in [[Jacobin's Pack]] to receive [[Pack of Ashira Warrior Necklaces]] : Then return back to [[Jacobin Yates]] '''Hand the [[Pack of Ashira Warrior Necklaces]] to [[Jacobin Yeats]]'''
{{exp}}
: Jacobin Yeats shakes the pack. : Jacobin Yeats says "Yeah, that sounds about right. Great work! Your efforts probably saved a couple of the plump and juicy merchants who'll be fleecing you in the market later. Be sure to let them know, that way they'll have mercy on your coin pouch." : Jacobin Yeats rolls his eyes and laughs. : Jacobin Yeats says "Now that you've risked your life repeatedly for us, maybe it's about time I give you a little information on the Steel Talons' archers. That, or you can just take this note and your tunic to the quartermaster and keep plinking away, no questions asked." You receive [[Jacobin's Note]] from [[Jacobin Yeats]].

'''Head to the north side of the courtyard and hand in your [[Steel Talon Trainee Tunic (Archer)|Steel Talon Trainee Tunic]] and [[Jacobin's Note]] to the [[Garrison Quartermaster]]'''
{{exp}}
Your faction standing with Night Harbor Garrison got better. : Garrison Quartermaster furrows his brow as he looks at the note, his expression turning into a broad smile. : Garrison Quartermaster claps his hand against your back and lets out a hearty chuckle. : Garrison Quartermaster says "Welcome aboard! Go ahead, try it on! I've got your size." You receive [[Steel Talons Bowman Tunic]] from [[Garrison Quartermaster]]. [[Category:Quests]] [[Category:Night Harbor Quests]] [[Category:Archer Quests]]

Cleric Starter Quest (Night Harbor).title: Cleric Starter Quest (Night Harbor)
Cleric Starter Quest (Night Harbor).content:
{{Quest | imagefilename = phicon.png | width = 100px | caption = Placeholder Image |Start Zone = [[Night Harbor]] |Quest Giver = - |Minimum Level = 1 |Classes = [[Cleric]] |Related NPCs = [[Thibald Burlond]], [[Jiselle Heyley]], [[Dalinder Grammanoot]], [[Millicent Domaire]] }} == Reward == * Experience
  • [[Dalinder's Tunic]]
  • [[Penitent Knight's Tunic]]
== Walkthrough == === Part 1 === Read [[Formal Note]] you start with as a new Cleric Character: 
To whom it may concern,

The Wayfarers Hospice is in need of charitable souls who are gifted with a healing touch.

Please bring this note and your interest to Thibald
Burlond at the Hospice, located in the Travelers
Ward to the north of the city's Western Gate.

Should you find yourself lost, ask one of the guards.
They have likely received our treatment before.

May your journey be blessed.

-The Penitent Knights of the Hospice
'''Hand [[Formal Note]] to [[Thibald Burlond]] in the Wayfarer's Hospice north of the West Gate'''
{{exp}} :Thibald Burlond reads the note, then gives you a welcoming nod. :Thibald Burlond suddenly stands upright, puffing his chest slightly. : Thibald Burlond says, "Welcome to the Wayfarers Hospice. I am Grand Master Thibald Burlond of the Penitent Knights of the Hospice." : Thibald Burlond says, "We accept the assistance of all who aid the less fortunate and suffering, regardless of tehir background or beliefs." :Thibald Burlond pauses for a moment, meeting your eyes with his. : Thibald Burlond says, "We have an impeccable reputation within this city and with its leadership. All we ask is that you do not sully it." : Thibald Burlond says, "Now, take the note you've given me upstairs to Jiselle Heyley. She will guide you from here." You receive [[Formal Note]] from [[Thibald Burlond]].

'''Hand [[Formal Note]] to [[Jiselle Heyley]] upstairs.'''
{{exp}} :Jiselle Heyley takes the note and carelessly discards it. : Jiselle Heyley says, "I heard the Grand Master from here, no need for this!" :Jiselle Heyley reaches into a pouch on her belt and retrieves a coin, then hands it to you. : Jiselle Heyley says, "As Thibald said, welcome to the Hospice. It's a kindness you pay us in being here. Thank you." :Jiselle Heyley makes a sweeping gesture with an open hand. : Jiselle Heyley says, "As you look around, you'll find that we spend most of our time comforting those at their journey's end, particularly those without better means, families, or friends." : Jiselle Heyley says, "Clerics can alleviate most ailments, but there's no cure for age... at least, none that my conscience will allow me to pursue, lest we find ourselves consorting with the likes of necromancers!" : Jiselle Heyley says, "Well... let's focus on what we can do. Take this and show it to Dalinder. He's in his laboratory." You receive [[Penitent Knight's Coin (Cleric)|Penitent Knight's Coin]] from [[Jiselle Heyley]].

'''Hand [[Penitent Knight's Coin (Cleric)|Penitent Knight's Coin]] to [[Dalinder Grammanoot]] downstairs.'''
:Dalinder Grammanoot briefly inspects the coin before leaning forward and sniffing you. : Dalinder Grammanoot says, "Just getting into town? We do have bathhouses here, you know. Use them if you're going to be coming in here regularly." :Dalinder Grammanoot grabs a bag from a neatly organized pile. : Dalinder Grammanoot says, "Let's get started. Take this bag. Take your coin. Do not put the coin in the bag. Put the coin in your pocket. Fasten the bag firmly. Do not lose it." : Dalinder Grammanoot says, "Jiselle is a wonderful human, but they call her gentle for a reason. She has a soft heart... especially for critters. Unfortunately, the work that Milli and I do can occasionally call for hearts, glands, bile ducts, venom sacs, and the like. So, spare her the details, eh?" : Dalinder Grammanoot says, "For now I'm running low on snake venom sacs... but not the fully developed ones, just the immature kind. Fill the bag for me, and I'll go see if Millicent needs anything." : Dalinder Grammanoot says, "Be careful out there. I hope to see you again soon." You receive [[Penitent Knight's Coin (Cleric)|Penitent Knight's Coin]] from [[Dalinder Grammanoot]].
You receive [[Dalinder's Bag]] from [[Dalinder Grammanoot]].

'''Head to the West Gate Noob Yard and kill [[a snake]]s until you receive 6 [[Immature Snake Venom Sac]]s. Alternatively you can buy them.''' : Combine the 6 [[Immature Snake Venom Sac]]s in [[Dalinder's Bag]] to receive a [[Bag of Venom Sacs]] '''Return to [[Dalinder Grammanoot]] and hand in your [[Bag of Venom Sacs]]'''
{{exp}} : Dalinder Grammanoot says, "Splendid, thank you!" :Dalinder Grammanoot sniffs the air. : Dalinder Grammanoot says, "Hmm... clearly that was hard work, given the heat and all." :Dalinder Grammanoot sizes you up, then pulls a finely folded tunic off one of the stacks. : Dalinder Grammanoot says, "You can change into this, though maybe wait until after you've bathed." : Dalinder Grammanoot says, "Millicent said she needs a few items as well. Here's her list." :Dalinder Grammanoot returns to his work. You receive [[Dalinder's Tunic]] from [[Dalinder Grammanoot]].
You receive [[Millicent's List]] from [[Dalinder Grammanoot]].

=== Part 2 Millicent's List === Read [[Millicent's List]] Items Needed - [[Moondew Moss]] (Often grows in or around wells and is visible at night) * Hint: Investigate the Well outside of the West gate, use the "/inspect well" command,then "/take moss" command which allows you to acquire the moss. - Cantharadin (Just bring me 2 [[Blister Beetle Gland]] and I'll process them) * Hint: Blister Beetles only spawn during the day time hours. - Bat Bile from a diseased bat ( [[Intact Diseased Bat Bile Duct]] ) * Hint: Investigate the area behind the gate through the Red Mantle Keep. Also may be found in the ruins outside of the West Gate, before the entrance to the Tomb of the Last Wyurmsbane. Once all items have been gathered, return to [[Millicent Domaire]] in the Wayfarer's Hospice north of the West Gate.
'''Hand [[Millicent's List]], [[Dalinder's Tunic]], 2 [[Blister Beetle Gland]], the [[Intact Diseased Bat Bile Duct]], and the [[Moondew Moss]] to [[Millicent Domaire]] '''
{{exp}} :Millicent Domaire gathers everything and hands you a fresh tunic. :Millicent Domaire says, "There we go. I appreciate the assistance."
:Millicent Domaire appears distracted for a moment, her eyes fixated on empty space. :Millicent Domaire says, "I'm... I'm sorry, where are we? Ah, yes... the tunic. Don it, and keep the coin Jiselle gave you on your person. We have a lot of new people arriving these days, so you can use it to indicate your association with the Hospice."
:Millicent Domaire says, "I'm sure I'll need your assistance again soon. In the meantime, please take the opportunity to get to know everyone here."
:Millicent Domaire smiles at you and returns her work, though seemingly distracted.. You receive [[Penitent Knight's Tunic]] from [[Millicent Domaire]].

Fizzle Screwtape's Critical Research.title: Fizzle Screwtape's Critical Research
Fizzle Screwtape's Critical Research.content: {{Quest |imagefilename = |width = 233px |Start Zone = [[Shallow Shoals]] |Quest Giver = [[Fizzle Screwtape]] |Minimum Level = 40 |Classes = ARC BRD BST CLR DRU FTR INQ MNK PAL RNG ROG SHD SHM SPB |Related NPCs = [[Tariq the Revealer]], [[Ngakepoto]] }} == Rewards == * [[Horn of the Sea]] or * [[Sea Giant's Handkerchief]] == Walkthrough == You say, "Hail, Fizzle Screwtape." : Fizzle Screwtape says, "Who are you, now? Did Tariq send you? I can complete this assignment without oversight, thank you very much." : Fizzle Screwtape says, "My research is critical to the future of the Silver Ledger, Dwarf. I must find... well, never you mind that." : Fizzle Screwtape says, "I do have a task that needs doing, however... if you wish to make yourself useful." You say, "task" : Fizzle Screwtape says, "There's an island across from the harbor that's infested with basilisks. Vile creatures, and much too large. Scour the island and bring back and objects that may aid my research." : *proceed to swim to the island directly across from the docks - in the centre of the island is a giant skeleton" : *type /look at the skull" : The sun-bleached bones of a giant lie scattered in the sand. : *type /take skull" : Sand falls away from the skull's empty cavity as you lift it from the sand. It is heavy and awkward to hold. : *proceed to swim back to Fizzle Screwtape and '''Give Fizzle Screwtape 1x [[Giant Skull]].''' : Fizzle Screwtape barely lifts the skull in his dainty hands. : Fizzle Screwtape says, "What am I to do with this? A giant's skull... adolescent, by the looks of it. You can keep it, Dwarf." : Fizzle Screwtape says, "You're still alive, at least. My previous assistants didn't fare quite as well. Now, get back out there and find something of real worth. I don't care if you have to exterminate every single basilisk to do it. In fact, that might be for the best." : *proceed to swim back to the island with the basilisks and kill until you find a rare drop artifact off of a basilisk" '''*Note that basiliks cannot be slowed, stunned, charmed.*''' : *swim back to Fizzle Screwtape and '''Give Fizzle Screwtape 1x [[Bile-Drenched Artifact]].'''" : Fizzle Screwtape mumbles to himself as he examines the much-encrusted object. : Fizzle Screwtape says, "This might be something, Dwarf, but we can't determine its worth while it's in this condition. I need to clean it with the right implement." : Fizzle Screwtape says, "Perhaps a sea sponge will do a trick. Hold on to this for now. Find a suitable sponge so that we may continue." '''Give Fizzle Screwtape 1x [[Pristine Sea Sponge]] and 1x [[Bile-Drenched Artifact]].''' : Fizzle Screwtape says, "Aha! So you found one. Nevermind how you got it." : Cheikho says, "Look around friend! How did you make it this far without dying?" : Fizzle Screwtape scrubs the artifact furiously with the sea sponge. As the much and grime slough off, you begin to see strange markings upon the object. : Fizzle Screwtape says, "See these markings, Dwarf? Like whirlpools. I've seen them before, but I can't recall..." : Fizzle Screwtape says, "Please, fetch me Luum's Giant Glossary from the shelf." : *climb up the ladder to the top book shelf" You say, "/look" : These shelves are dedicated to history books. You say, "/take book" : You carefully retrieve the book from the shelf. '''receive 1x [[Luum's Giant Glossary]].''' '''give Fizzle Screwtape 1x [[Luum's Giant Glossary]].''' : Fizzle Screwtape mutters as he flips through the pages of the old tome. : Fizzle Screwtape sighs. : Fizzle Screwtape says, "It's as I thought. Worthless." : Fizzle Screwtape says, "I'm afraid your time has been wasted, Dwarf. This artifact is of no use to me." : Fizzle Screwtape says, "Take the artifact and this report to Tariq. Should you ever find anything of real value, you know where to find me." '''receive 1x [[Fizzle Screwtape's Report]].''' '''receive 1x [[Horn of the Sea]].''' : *go outside and upstairs to Tariq the Revealer" '''Give Tariq the Revealer 1x [[Fizzle Screwtape's Report]] and 1x [[Horn of the Sea]].''' : Tariq the Revealer says, "A valuable object, no doubt, but I'm afraid my underling is correct. We have no use for it. You may keep it for yourself, or return it to its rightful owner." You say, "rightful owner" : Tariq the Revealer says, "These markings indicate that the horn belongs to those whose kingdoms once rose from the depths of the ocean... the Sealords." : Tariq the Revealer says, "Upon the island where you found this artifact stands a ruined pedestal. Place the horn upon it. If one of the Sealords wishes to claim it, you may be rewarded for your trouble." : Tariq the Revealer says, "Do keep in mind that the Sealords are creatures of the depths. They're likely to spurn the light of Eth." : *Swim back to the far side of the island where there is a ruined pedestal in the sand." You say, "/look" : A simple pedestal emerges from the sandy shore. : This must be done at night. You say, "/place pedestal" : The waters begin to stir... : This spawns a giant named [[Ngakepoto]] from the water. '''give Ngakepoto 1x [[Horn of the Sea]].''' '''receive 1x [[Sea Giant's Handkerchief]].''' [[Category:Quests]] [[Category:Shallow Shoals Quests]]
