Fighter Starter Quest (Faelindral).title: Fighter Starter Quest (Faelindral)
Fighter Starter Quest (Faelindral).content:
{{Quest | imagefilename = Captain_Vaelric_Ironbark.png | width = 300px | caption = Starting quest NPC |Start Zone = [[Faelindral]] |Quest Giver = [[Commander Elydris Stormbough]] |Minimum Level = 1 |Classes = [[Fighter]] |Related NPCs = [[Thibald Burlond]], [[Jiselle Heyley]], [[Dalinder Grammanoot]], [[Millicent Domaire]] }} __TOC__ == Reward == * Experience
  • [[Tarnished Elven Blade]]
  • [[Novice Chain of the Wyrdguard]]
  • [[Striker's Chain of the Wyrdguard]]
  • [[Tempered Blade of the Fae-Bound]]
== Walkthrough == == Part 1 == Read [[Rolled Leafscroll]] you start with as a new Fighter Character: 
To whom it may concern,

Your martial skill has been noted by the Wyrdguard, and we would be honored to have your strength added to our own.

New protectors are needed now more than ever in this turbulent age, when corruption abounds and shadows threaten the Weald from all sides.

We invite your to bear this letter to [[Captain Vaelric Ironbark]], who resides within the Sentinels Gaze garrison. 

To reach the garrison, follow the signage past the inn and toward the stage ar the Willows Whisper. Climb the main ascent behind the stage to reach the Traders Terrace, then continue up the central ramp and cross the span opposite the tanner.

The local guard can direct you further should you inquire with hem.

                                         Fair shades to you,
                                -Commander Elydris Stormbough
'''Step by step way :''' To reach the garrison, take the lift. You can double click on the bell and it will come down. Double click again for it to go up. Go left to the the inn, go up right, right (in a right angle), when you see [[Pine Brightreed]] go up left. You'll be on the Traders Terrace, go toward the weapons armor sign and take the ramp on the left of Taelin Goldstem. Take the bridge on your left, go left in the Sentinels Gaze and [[Captain Vaelric Ironbark]] will be inside. '''Hand [[Rolled Leafscroll]] to [[Captain Vaelric Ironbark]] in the Sentinels Gaze'''
{{exp}} Your faction standing with Wyrdguard got better. Your faction standing with Fellstone Orcs got worse. :Captain Vaelric Ironbark accepts the scroll and offers you a curt nod. His gaze is stern and piercing as he seems to immediately size up your worth in a heartbeat. : Captain Vaelric Ironbark says, "Good. The Wyrdguard are in need of strong arms. I'm glad that you've answered the call." : Captain Vaelric Ironbark says, "I would induct you immediately if I could, but first, we must make sure you're capable of arming yourself before I can entrust you to the field." :Captain Vaelric Ironbark turns your note around and scrawls something on the back before handing it back to you. : Captain Vaelric Ironbark says, "Take this note to Craftguard Vinebrow at the garrison forge. He'll instruct you further. Dismissed.." You receive [[Scrawled Leafscroll]] from [[Captain Vaelric Ironbark]].

'''Hand [[Scrawled Leafscroll]] to [[Craftguard Vinebrow]] a few meters away.'''
{{exp}} Your faction standing with Wyrdguard got better. Your faction standing with Fellstone Orcs got worse. :Craftguard Vinebrow snatches the note and scans the contents quickly. Nodding, he trusts a small kit into your hand while gesturing toward the nearby weapon racks. : Craftguard Vinebrow says, "Take this kit and grab yourself a used blade from the rack, recruit. The Wyrdguard don't carry rusted filth onthe the field." : Craftguard Vinebrow says, "Once you've chosen a blade, place it in the kit along with the bar of wax to bring out the blade's luster. Show it to me once you've finished." : Craftguard Vinebrow says, "I'll be here if you have any questions." You receive [[Sharpening Kit]] from [[Craftguard Vinebrow]].
You receive [[Wasp Wax Bar]] from [[Craftguard Vinebrow]].

'''Come closer to the racks and use /look /inspect rack /take weapon
''' You receive [[Patinated Elven Blade]].

Put together the [[Patinated Elven Blade]] and the [[Wasp Wax Bar]] in the [[Sharpening Kit]].
You receive [[Tarnished Elven Blade]].

Give the blade to [[Craftguard Vinebrow]] for the next step.

:Craftguard Vinebrow holds the blade aloft and gazes down its length, inspecting your work. After a short moment, he offers a grunt of satisfaction and returns the blade to you. : Craftguard Vinebrow says, "Your bevel could use some work, but that will comme with practice. You've managed to deburr the edge, and that's the most important part." : Craftguard Vinebrow says, "A burr folding over the edge of a blade can easily form a chip. A chip can lead to a fragile blade, and a fragile blade can lead to death." : Craftguard Vinebrow says, "Now, take your weapon and show it to Captain Ironbark. Inform him that you're ready to set out... and don't forget to maintain your equipement!." You receive [[Tarnished Elven Blade]] from [[Craftguard Vinebrow]].

Give the blade to [[Captain Vaelric Ironbark]] for the next step.

:Captain Vaelric Ironbark accepts the offered blade and gives it one crisp, precise strike through the air. The blade almost hums after being handled by the veteran captain. He then offers it back to you. You receive [[Tarnished Elven Blade]] from [[Captain Vaelric Ironbark]].
: Captain Vaelric Ironbark says, "Well done. You've chosen yourself a suitable weapon. I'm confident now that I can send you to the forest floor." : Captain Vaelric Ironbark says, "Are you ready for your first assignment ?" : You says, "I am ready." You receive [[Pouch for Skulls]] from [[Captain Vaelric Ironbark]].
: Captain Vaelric Ironbark says, "Take this pouch. Descend to the forest floor and rid it of the undead that have recently made a presence there." : Captain Vaelric Ironbark says, "If you can fill the bag with their shattered skulls, you'll have taken your first step toward becoming a true Wyrdguard and protecting the Weald from unnatural threats." :Captain Vaelric Ironbark briskly salutes you before offering one last piece of advice. : Captain Vaelric Ironbark says, "...And don't venture into the ruins, young one. Too many have tried." From here on, you have two choices. Go back to the starting lift (do not take the lift close to the quest npc) and drop 4 [[Shattered Skull]] from Rottings Skeletons roaming in the zone. Or buy them and fuse them in the bundle. Then, give it back to [[Captain Vaelric Ironbark]].
:Captain Vaelric sighs in relief as you return with the filled pouch of skulls. He sets it aside with a nod. : Captain Vaelric Ironbark says, "I was dreading that I may have sent a young warrior to their doom, but you've shown that you can look after yourself out in the Weald." : Captain Vaelric Ironbark says, "I can now confidently issue you this emblazoned chain as a sign of your induction as a novice of the Wyrdguard." You receive [[Novice Chain of the Wyrdguard]] from [[Captain Vaelric Ironbark]].
: Captain Vaelric Ironbark says, "When you have a little more experience in the field, report yourself to Commander Elydris Stormbough and display your chain shirt to her." : Captain Vaelric Ironbark says, "She'll proceed with your induction and likely assign you a new task. Shades protect you. Dismissed, novice!" == Part 2 == (Level 4 is needed) Give your [[Novice Chain of the Wyrdguard]] to [[Commander Elydris Stormbough]] :Commander Elydris Stormbough inspects the state of your chainmail and nods approvingly. She returns it to you, alongside a rolled note. : Commander Elydris Stormbough says, "Allow me to introduce myself. I am Elydris Stormbough, Commander of the Wyrdguard, and I humbly thank you for adding your strength to our own." : Commander Elydris Stormbough says, "As you have no doubt noticed out on the field, the presence of undead and orcs has become egregious. They must be contended with." : Commander Elydris Stormbough says, "Our scouts are already looking into their source, while the druids counter their foul magic. I am assigning all available fighters to combat this presence through force of arms." : Commander Elydris Stormbough says, "Are you willing to participate on the front lines?" /say yes :Commander Elydris Stormbough offers a satisfactory nod. [[Commander Elydris Stormbough]] hands you a note. : Commander Elydris Stormbough says, "Take the note I have given you to Craftguard Vinebrow. I believe you have already been acquainted, yes? He is to help you improve the weapon that you found in the armoury." : Commander Elydris Stormbough says, "Once you have had your weapon worked on, return to me for further instruction. If you misplaced your weapon, you will have to inform Vinebrow. Though I pray you do not have to." Give the note to [[Craftguard Vinebrow]]. :Craftguard Vinebrow accepts the note and gives it a quick glance, acknowledging the message with a firm nod. : Craftguard Vinebrow says, "I hope you've learned by now how important it is to have a proper weapon! Though it appears the commander would like to see you wielding something that isn't just a polished edge." : Craftguard Vinebrow says, "I think I know what your blade needs, but we're currently running low on ore for smelting. Would you be able to help get me some supplies?" /say I will get supplies. : Craftguard Vinebrow says, "I'll need about four copper bars and two cloth scraps for what I have in mind. Mine it, buy it, smelt it... I don't care how you get it." : Craftguard Vinebrow says, "Just get everything into that satchel and pack it up neatly before returning to me, along with your blade." Combine four [[Copper Bar]] and two [[Cloth Scraps]] in the satchel and hand it back to [[Craftguard Vinebrow]] with the [[Tarnished Elven Blade]]. : Craftguard Vinebrow says, "Hmm, good. This should be enough. Give me one moment while I stoke the forge." :Craftguard Vinebrow separates your blade from the hilt and begins heating the worn steel until it becomes molten. He inspects the metal curiously, then gives it a few strikes with his hammer and lets out a grunt of satisfaction. :Craftguard Vinebrow proceeds to similarly heat the copper and incorporate it into your blade, folding the two metals together into an alloy. He then quenches the revitalized blade and reassembles the hilt, wrapping it in the cloth. : Craftguard Vinebrow says, "Very interesting. You found this in the weapon racks, did you? That steel doesn't normally fuse so well with copper." : Craftguard Vinebrow says, "I'd love to experiment further with it, but I'm not about to leave one of our young fighters without a blade. Here, you can bring this back to the Commander to show her your equipped." : Craftguard Vinebrow says, "And don't lose this one! I feel like we can do more with it when the time is right." [[Craftguard Vinebrow]] hands you the [[Bronzed Elven Blade]].
Hand the [[Bronzed Elven Blade]] to [[Commander Elydris Stormbough]]. :Commander Elydris Stormbough examines your blade and offers a satisfied nod. : Commander Elydris Stormbough says, "A curious alloy, but that is a discussion for another time. What matters now that it is able to strike at the enemy force quickly and efficiently." : Commander Elydris Stormbough says, "Here, take your weapon back, along with this satchel." : Commander Elydris Stormbough says, "You will be part of this strike, fighter. Our fighters have been tasked with engaging the orcish encampments that have sprung up along the southeastern cliffs. Are you ready to participate in the assault?" /say yes : Commander Elydris Stormbough says, "Fellstone forces have hidden themselves amongst the cliffs and ruins, so we have not been able to determine their precise location from the heights of Faelindral." : Commander Elydris Stormbough says, "We suspect they have a talented scout leader who is helping keep their emplacements concealed. You are to locate these camps and assault them until you have drawn out this leader of theirs." [[Commander Elydris Stormbough]] hands you a satchel. : Commander Elydris Stormbough says, "Fill the satchel with the belts of their warriors, then return it to me along with the scout leader's head and your novice chain." Combine four [[Fellstone Warrior's Belt]]s in the satchel to form [[Full Satchel of Orc Belts]] and hand it to [[Commander Elydris Stormbough]] along with [[Scout Leader's Head]] and [[Novice Chain of the Wyrdguard]]. :Commander Elydris Stormbough checks the satchel's contents and confirms the orcish equipment, alongside the trophy head. She nods. : Commander Elydris Stormbough says, "An impressive feat for a novice, well done. The orcs will dare not forget this strike when they attempt to match themselves against the might of the Wyrdguard." : Commander Elydris Stormbough says, "I had this prepared for you, fighter, as the news of your victory was forseen. Wear it with pride." You receive [[Striker's Chain of the Wyrdguard]] from [[Commander Elydris Stormbough]].
: Commander Elydris Stormbough says, "You are dismissed for now; however, you should take this opportunity to practice your dance with that weapon. I am certain that Vinebrow would be interested in seeing it once it has endured a few more deployments." == Part 3 == (Level 8 might be needed, untested.) Give your [[Bronzed Elven Blade]] to [[Craftguard Vinebrow]] :Craftguard Vinebrow raises the blade to inspect the edge by aligning it to his eye. : Craftguard Vinebrow says, "Fascinating. A normal bronze would've seen significantly more scoring than this. Yours carries hardly a notch." : Craftguard Vinebrow says, "This makes me want to experiment with some other metals. I wonder if it'll take to iron as well as it did to copper." [[Craftguard Vinebrow]] returns the blade to you, alongside a rod of iron. : Craftguard Vinebrow says, "What do you say, striker? Want to try reforging this blade with me?" /say Reforge : Craftguard Vinebrow says, "Now don't you worry, I'll do all the forging. But you may as well lend a hand by heating up the blade and iron rod in the forge while i prepare some flux." : Craftguard Vinebrow says, "All you need to do is take the blade and place it in the forge until it's red hot. Once it's burning brightly as a faefly, you can take it out and set it aside." : Craftguard Vinebrow says, "Do the same with the iron rod, heating up until it's also glowing. Show them both to me when they're hot and ready for forging." : Craftguard Vinebrow says, "Oh, and make sure to use a pair of smithing pliers with both items! You don't want to be touching metal directly when it gets hot at Eth." Combine the [[Bronzed Elven Blade]] with a pair of [[Smithing Pliers]] at a Forge to Recieve [[Red Hot Elven Blade]] Combine the [[Iron Rod]] with a pair of [[Smithing Pliers]] at a Forge to Recieve [[Red Hot Iron Rod]] Hand the [[Red Hot Elven Blade]] and [[Red Hot Iron Rod]] to [[Craftguard Vinebrow]] : Craftguard Vinebrow says, "Good, that's looking plenty hot! Now stand back as i try to incorporate this iron..." :Craftguard Vinebrow uses his own pliers to handle the searing metals, bringing them over to the anvil. He sets the blade and rod together and prepares to deliver his first strike. :Craftguard Vinebrow brings his hammer down in a resounding clang; a shower of sparks cascades outwards from the anvil and explodes as though an angry dragon had just released a belch of flame! : Craftguard Vinebrow says, "Gah!" :Craftguard Vinebrow coughs and sputters, his face peppered with pieces of soot. The iron rod lies twisted and warped across the anvil while the blade cools into an awkward bend. : Craftguard Vinebrow says, "Shalla take me, what was that!?" : Craftguard Vinebrow says, "The blade felt ''angry'' in my hands when I tried to incorporate the iron. Almost as if it were..." :Craftguard Vinebrow trails off as he carefully picks up the slowly cooling blade, furrowing his brow in thought as he offers the crooked weapon back to you. : Craftguard Vinebrow says, "[NAME], I don't want to alarm you, but... I believe that you may have a faerie spirit residing within this blade." You recieve [[Bent Elven Blade]] from [[Craftguard Vinebrow]] /say spirit? : Craftguard Vinebrow says, "Just as i said, I'm certain there must be a spirit inside that weapon of yours." : Craftguard Vinebrow says, "My first guess would be some sort of faerie spirit if it responded this way toward iron. They have an aversion to the metal, from what I understand." : Craftguard Vinebrow says, "I'm afraid it's going to be of no use to you bent like that. But I'll straighten it out for you. But before then, you should go to the Preservers to confirm this suspicion of mine." /say preservers : Craftguard Vinebrow says, "The Preservers are the foremost experts on things unseen within nature. Their Elder Whisperer, [[Eraeldor Lowmist]], would be the best person to seek out." : Craftguard Vinebrow says, "Offer him the blade and find out if it's truly inhabited by some sort of spirit. I want to know what I'm dealing with before I start hammering away at it and angering it further." Hand the [[Bent Elven Blade]] to [[Eraeldor Lowmist]] in the Shaman Guild :Eraeldor Lowmist has his hands extended out toward you before the bent blade is even offered to him. :Eraeldor Lowmist says, "I can feel the anger seething out from this old weapon, warrior of the Wyrdguard. I heard its cursed song across Faelindral before your arrival." :Eraeldor Lowmist says, "A sorrowful wail of contempt, a cry for life extinguished, a dirge of vengeance." :Eraeldor Lowmist says, "You have a bloodthirsty blade here, young one, which looks to have been recently scorned by the touch of iron." :Eraeldor Lowmist offers the bent blade back to you. The metal still feels warm to the touch despite hearing no such song yourself. :Eraeldor Lowmist says, "Are you looking to temper its woes?" /say temper :Eraeldor Lowmist says, "A faerie spirit is, by nature, a chaotic entity." :Eraeldor Lowmist says, "To temper this particular tantrum, you will first have to embellish it within its very element." :Eraeldor Lowmist says, "Just as a forge master must stoke the flames to heat steel, your blade must be annealed in the chaos that it inflicts." :Eraeldor Lowmist says, "Return the weapon to your Craftguard so that he may correct his err, then discover a means of order for the spirit to unravel." :Eraeldor Lowmist says, "That is all the wisdom I can share in this moment, young Wyrdguard." Hand the [[Bent Elven Blade]] to [[Craftguard Vinebrow]] : Craftguard Vinebrow says, "So it's true? Incredible!" : Craftguard Vinebrow says, "To think that you just happened to pull this blade off one of the racks. Well, that's all shade under the leaf. Allow me to do as the Elder Whisperer suggested and straighten out this weapon for you." :Craftguard Vinebrow takes the bent blade and fires it within the forge until it is red hot once more. He then takes it onto the anvil and, with a series of expertly delivered strikes of his hammer, reshapes the blade back into it's normal honed edge. :Craftguard Vinebrow quenches the blade with a sizzling hiss into a barrel of spring water, then offers the weapon back to you, handle first. : Craftguard Vinebrow says, "I suppose it's not as explosive when I'm not trying to fuse it with iron. It still has a hot edge to it, but it should be straightened enough for causing a little chaos. That's the next step, right? It gives me an idea." You receive [[Angry Elven Blade]] from [[Craftguard Vinebrow]] /say idea? : Craftguard Vinebrow says, "We're still under threat from the orcish incursion, so why not take this opportunity to sow a little discord among their ranks?" : Craftguard Vinebrow says, "Despite being unnatural beasts, orc warlords can be horrifyingly strategic and organized. From what I've heard from our scouts, the leader of this particular raid is a necromancer of some renown." : Craftguard Vinebrow says, "If you can manage to lop off the head of the orcs' raid leader, it would cause untold chaos among their forces... certainly enough to whet the appetite of that blade." : Craftguard Vinebrow says, "Go show the invaders the strength of the Wyrdguard, striker. Return with the head of their leader and we'll see if that awakens the spirit of your weapon." Loot [[Orc Necromancer's Head]] from [[Taeresh Deathcharmer]] and hand it to [[Craftguard Vinebrow]] Along with the [[Angry Elven Blade]] : Craftguard Vinebrow says, "Hmm, it's still rather warm to the touch." :Craftguard Vinebrow glances back to you. : Craftguard Vinebrow says, "I'm referring to the blade, not the head." : Craftguard Vinebrow says, "Elydris will be please to hear that you've managed to stall the orcs' efforts. Just as I'm pleased to try my best at reforging this weapon for you." : Craftguard Vinebrow says, "Though, it'd be best if we requested the wisdom of [[Eraeldor Lowmist]] once more. Even I can feel the temperament of this weapon seething at me." : Craftguard Vinebrow says, "Our blade is hot and fired, but there may be a more... spiritual method to quench it's bloodlust so that it doesn't lash out as I reshape it." : Craftguard Vinebrow says, "Take the angry blade back to the Elder Whisperer and seek his council. I'll prepare the forge for your return." Hand the [[Angry Elven Blade]] to [[Eraeldor Lowmist]] :Eraeldor Lowmist regards the offered blade with a calm demeanor. :Eraeldor Lowmist says, "You have certainly roused the spirit with your actions, young Wyrdguard." :Eraeldor Lowmist says, "Chaos and violence have stoked it to life. much as the Craftguard brings his metals to blaze." :Eraeldor Lowmist says, "And just as water or oil is used to subdue the fires of a smith's art, so too must you seek what opposes chaos and bloodlust to quench the spirit within." :Eraeldor Lowmist says, "Show this spirit-bound blade to our alchemist, Sylwine. She will be able to guide you toward what you need to tame the flames within. You can find her in the Well of Order above the Wayward Branch Inn." Hand the [[Angry Elven Blade]] to [[Sylwine Brightspirit]] :Sylwine Brightspirit says, "Leapers in a lily pond, what in the boughs in this?!" :Sylwine Brightspirit says, "This blade has a sharper tongue on it than Myrielle after her fourth glass of Calafrey Red! If only you could hear the depravities coming out of this thing! :Sylwine Brightspirit says, "If I were you, I'd douse this nasty bugger in a [[Tincture of Tranquility (Quest)]]." /say tincture :Sylwine Brightspirit says, "Yes indeed, a [[Tincture of Tranquility (Quest)]] would surely reel in one who's leapt over the edge of madness. Seems to me like that blade of yours could use it." :Sylwine Brightspirit says, "Speaking of, you look as though you just returned from a battlefield. Perhaps you could use a little peace and tranquility yourself?" :Sylwine Brightspirit says, "If that's the case, I have a proposition for you." /say proposition :Sylwine Brightspirit says, "Aye, what better way the nerves and soul than by surrounding yourself in nature ands collecting wild herbs?" :Sylwine Brightspirit says, "If you can fetch me sic bundles of [[Sylvine]] and two stalks of [[Whispering Sage]], I'll go ahead and craft a tincture for you free of charge." :Sylwine Brightspirit says, "You'll need some modest skill if you want to properly harvest [[Whispering Sage]], or you could always check to see if anyone has sold some spare stalks to the herbalist." :Sylwine Brightspirit says, "I personally recommend taking the time to familiarize yourself with herbs if you haven't already. I may be biased, but potions are incredibly versatile and useful." Hand 6 [[Sylvine]] and 2 [[Whispering Sage]] to [[Sylwine Brightspirit]] :Sylwine Brightspirit says, "Ah, you're back! Did you buy these or take the time to get your hands nice and dirty in the cool earth?" :Sylwine Brightspirit says, "Never you mind. I'll get a tincture mixed up for you regardless." :Sylwine Brightspirit chuckles softly as she begins to expertly process the herbs within a mortar, crushing them down and diluting the solution with spring water. :Sylwine Brightspirit swirls the mixture while humming a pleasant tune to herself, then filters it through a small sieve as she drains the contents into a glass vial. She presses a small topper into it and happily offers it to you. There you are, one [[Tincture of Tranquility (Quest)]]! Hand [[Tincture of Tranquility (Quest)]] and [[Angry Elven Blade]] to [[Craftguard Vinebrow]] : Craftguard Vinebrow says, "Excellent. I believe I have everything I need to reforge the blade properly this time." : Craftguard Vinebrow says, "I also wasn't just standing idly by while you were out picking weeds. I manages to scrounge together some silver bars to use this time, a metal that even the fae appreciate. : Craftguard Vinebrow says, "Now let's get to work!" :Craftguard Vinebrow returns the spirit-bound blade to the heat of the forge once more. The sword sizzles and sparks angrily amidst the flames as he mutters out curses, doing his best to get the heat under control. :Craftguard Vinebrow begins to partake in a battlefield of his own design as he brings the blade to the anvil, shaping the furious steel with repeated strikes from his trusty hammer. Impressive sparks dance into the sky with the faeflies, as he incorporates the silver into the faerie blade with elaborate folds of super-heated metal. :Craftguard Vinebrow spits one last curse at the shimmering weapon as he at last douses it with the contents of the tincture. One need not be a shaman to hear the wailing that ensues, as the chaotic nature of the faerie spirit is quickly aand abruptly quenched by the tranquil potion. :Craftguard Vinebrow Examines the results of his work with a keen eye as the spiritual screeching dulls to a gentle sigh. Satisfies, he turns to present the blade to you. : Craftguard Vinebrow says, "You've given me quite the challenge with this weapon. Yet the battlefield is not the only place where the Wyrdguard triumpoh!" : Craftguard Vinebrow says, "Take a look and tell me what you think. Isn't she beautiful? A tempered spirit, a silvered edge, and a strong arm to wield her. : Craftguard Vinebrow says, "You deserve it [NAME]. Well done." You recieve [[Tempered Blade of the Fae-Bound]] from [[Craftguard Vinebrow]] [[Category:Quests]] [[Category:Faelindral Quests]] [[Category:Fighter Quests]]

Burning Bones.content:
{{Quest

|Related NPCs       =

After completing the [[Necrolyte's Pouch Quest]] say "take the list of charred procurements" to bones. He will give you a new letter describing the items needed, [[Bones' List of Uncommon Necrotic Procurement]].

# 20 [[Scorched Skeletal Remains]] (Talking to Cordellius is optional)
## Hail [[Cordellius Hollmion]] in [[Spellbinders of the Spire]]
## He will tell you that they are from skeletons killed via the [[Flameburst]] spell.
# 15 [[Burnt Bone Chips]] (Talking to Pedram is optional)
## Hail [[Pedram]] at the [[School of the Fourfold Path]]
## Pedram says, "Hail, Adventurer. I'm Pedram, assistant to the Tams."
## You say, "burnt bone chips"
## "Pedram lifts his head from a swirl of dancing cinders, his expression serene."
## Pedram says, "Ah...not mere ash.Not what you find in a hearth or the pit of pyre. You seek a flame that remembers."
## Pedram says, "Campfire, torchlight, forge heat...these flames are bereft of soul, fed by the spent remnants of life. But elemental fire...it's fire that lives, fire that hungers. It's not kind."
## You say, "where can I find elemental fire?"
## Pedram smiles faintly, more reverant than pleased.
## Pedram says, "Yes. Elemental fire is not tool. It's a presence...a spirit, if you will. It speaks in crackles and sizzles, and devours without pause."
## Pedram says, "Many will call upon spirits for light, war, or spectacle. Few truly understand what they bind, and fewer still survive when the bond breaks...when reverence is forgotten, and fire takes back what it's owed."
## Pedram leans closer
## Pedram says, "The bone chips you seek must be seared by such a fire. Not summoned, but enraged...by a fire spirit untethered."
## You say, "where can i find an untethered fire spirit?"
## Pedram lowers his voice, eyes reflecting a flicker of emotion.
## Pedram says, "There is one. Bound long ago within an ancient crypt by rites of the dead. It was enslaved through force, not honor, and it burns still with fury unspent."
## Pedram says, "Now it's surrounded by it's necromantic keepers, once masters of their craft, now minions to the very spirit they sought to command."
## Pedram says, "It's flames do not simply consume, they rage...they scar. They mark bones with the burn you require."
## Pedram straightens and gestures towards the school's tall shelves.
## Pedram says, "Before you go stumbling through ash and wrath, learn the tale. Seek the book titled Deference to the Flame; a Tale of Ash and Sorrow. It rests amongst the southern stacks, with our other teachings."
## Pedram says, "May you find what you seek...and survive the meeting."

Presumably the elemental being referred to is either a flame elemental or the Skyseer in Ancient Crypt. To be confirmed. The book is in the bookcase to the left of the door to Pedram's room as you enter.

# 5 [[Blackened Fish Bones]]
## Hail [[A Fishwife]] in [[Saltbreeze Park]]
## Eventually she will tell you to talk to [[Jasmerin]]
## [[Jasmerin]] will tell you to go and see [[Chef Violyn]] at the Crimson Oasis (Inn with red drapes) near the north gate. Violyn will tell you that to make blackened fish bones you need either 1x [[Flux]] (alchemy) and 1x [[Fish Bones]], or 8x [[Fish Bones]]. Blackened Fish Bones recipe trivials at 5 Cooking.
# 1 [[Singed Skull]]
## hail [[Rallin Wizentrop]] at the [[Academy of Arcane Inquiry]]
## eventually he will mention [[Drazllin]]
## Enter [[Sungreet Strand]] and make your way to the Beetle Caves near the Quarry.  Enter the caves by going up from the ground floor of the quarry, until you arrive at a room with stalagmites and several cinder drones. On a small ledge near the bottom is a pile of gnome bones. '/look' then '/take skull'. Fight [[Blazed Revenant]], a level 18-19 undead. Loot [[Singed Skull]].

Return all items to [[Bones]], including the [[Bones' List of Uncommon Necrotic Procurement]]

Druid Starter Quest (Underdocks).title: Druid Starter Quest (Underdocks)
Druid Starter Quest (Underdocks).content:
{{Quest | imagefilename = phicon.png | width = 100px | caption = Placeholder Image |Start Zone = [[Underdocks]] |Quest Giver = - |Minimum Level = 1 |Classes = [[Druid]] |Related NPCs = [[Luskmit]] }} == Reward == * Experience
  • [[Shredded Cloak]]
  • [[Rotting Rootstaff]]
== Walkthrough == === Part 1 - Req. Lvl 1=== Read the [[Musky Note]] you start with as a new Druid character: 
Celebrate, young one, for you will be a messenger of the Rotfather.

It is our gift to spread his joy across the wilds and the deeps.

Come to the Rotten Hollow to begin you lessons.
Seek the Rot of Gorm in the cavern west of the palace.

Luskmit
'''Head east to the Dry Docks. Go right once you reach the water. Run a long way, looking for a tunnel that has hanging vines. Go through there and keep veering right until you see a camp up a hill. You will find [[Luskmit]] there. Hand him your [[Musky Note]].''' : You say, "Hail, Luskmit." : Luskmit says "Are you ready to spread the Rotfather's joy?" : {{exp}} : Your faction standing with Rot of Gorm got better. : Luskmit says, "Rotfather's blessing! We are in great need of a new messenger. Will you spread his joy?" : You receive [[Shredded Cloak]] from Luskmit. : You say, "I will spread his joy!" : Luskmit says, "All creatures serve his purpose, young Druid. He is inevitable. Find plagued rats within the Underdocks and use this club to subdue them. Collect four rats within this satchel and deliver it to the halfling, Jumbe. You should find him lurking somewhere around the citadel." : You receive [[Beat Stick]] from Luskmit. : You receive [[Plaguerat Satchel]] from Luskmit. : Luskmit says, "Try not to mangle them too badly." '''Use the [[Beat Stick]] on rats in the newbie area and around town until you get 4x [[Lightly Bashed Plaguerat]] corpses, Fill the bag, combine and turn into [[Jumbe]] (Odol).''' The dusky rats do not drop the corpses. "a diseased rat", which spawns rarely in the north gate area will but the best spots to look are in the tunnels connecting the citadel to an outer district, or to take a lift up then back down to the rafters and there all of the rafter rats will also drop the [[Lightly Bashed Plaguerat]] corpses. : {{exp}} : Your faction standing with Rot of Gorm got better. : Jumbe Odol says, "Well done! I hope you didn't beat the rats too badly. I'll do my best to revive them, if I can. But they will find their way into the palace kitchens one way or another. Eheh! You may return to the one who sent you. Go with the Rotfather's blessing." '''Go back to Luskmit and hail them.''' : {{exp}} : Your faction standing with Rot of Gorm got better. : Luskim says, "So it is done. Even the smallest creatures have a part to play. Keep this walking staff to ease your travels. May it serve as a living reminder of your calling." : You receive [[Rotting Rootstaff]] from Luskmit. '''If you hail Luskmit again she tells you to come back later.''' : You say, "Hail, Luskmit." : Luskmit says, "You have much to learn, Druid. Return to me when you are more seasoned in the ways of the Rotfather." === Part 2 - Req. Lvl 5 - The Deep teems with life. === '''Head back to Luskmit in the Rotten Hollow''' : You say, "Hail, Luskmit" : Luskmit says, "The Deep teems with life. It is the greatest joy of the Rotfather, how we creatures writhe and squirm in our feeble attempts to survive his great, inexorable decay. We must tend to this garden." : Luskmit says, " I need an assistant to collect samples of the rot festering in the Deep." : You say, "Samples? or What Samples?" : Luskmit says, "Hunt the fauna roaming the Deep who have lived long while their ailments well from within. Many species inhabit the Deep. Bring me rotten organ smples from a shadewing bat, a myconid, a slitherscale, and a deepweb spider." : You receive [[Organ Sample Bag]] from Luskmit. : Luskmit says, "Healthy specimens may suffer in your search, but this is part of the natural order." '''Combine [[Blind Deepweb Eye]], [[Rotten Deepscale Gland]], [[Rotting Shadewing Heart]], and [[Decomposed Myconid Cap]] in the Organ Sample Bag to make a [[Bag of Rotting Organs]]. Return this to Luskmit.''' : {{exp}} : Your faction standing with Rot of Gorm got better. : Luskmit says, "Proof of his presence is everywhere we look, . I will put these to good use." : Luskmit says, "Give me your rootstaff, young Druid. The Rotfather blesses those who carry out his will." '''Give Luskmit a [[Rotting Rootstaff]].''' : Luskmit says, "Go with the Rotfather's blessing, ." : You receive [[Mossy Rootstaff]] from Luskmit. Extra - While you search for these items by killing the above mobs give. If you speak with Luskmit before turning in the items: : Luskmit says, "Do not dither among the rocks and the weeds, Druid. The Rotfather gives us only a short time to spread his gifts." === Part 3 - Req. Lvl 5 - A strange rot brews in The Deep. === '''Return to Luskmit in the Rotten Hollow.''' :You say, “Hail, Luskmit.” :Luskmit says, “The shamans of Gorm investigate a rot growing among the fungi of the deep. They are in need of a messenger of Bulibyre. Will you aid them, young druid?” :You say, “I will aid them.” :Luskmit says, “There is a shaman called Brugg at the mushroom farm in a cavern not far from here. Find him and offer your services. '''Go to [[Brugg Mulcher]] in the nearby mushroom cave.''' :You say, “Hail, Brugg Mulcher.” :Brugg Mulcher says, “Are you the messenger?” :You say, “I am the messenger.” :Brugg Mulcher says, “Rejoice when decay finds you, Druid, for you are in the domain of Bulibyre. Our brothers and sisters cultivate his garden, and we must destroy any threats from without.” BBrugg Mulcher says, “There is a rotten mushroom in yonder garden bed. Fetch it.” '''Go to the nearby red mushroom. /take mushroom''' : You receive [[Rotten Mushroom]]. '''Give the mushroom to Brugg.''' :Brugg Mulcher says, “Long have we cultivated Bulibyre’s rot in the deep, yet I cannot say if this is the Rotfather’s doing.” :Brugg Mulcher says, “Take this basket, young Druid. Scour the great cavern beyond the gates for others like it. Return to me only when the basket is filled.” : You receive Mushroom Basket from Brugg Mulcher. : You receive your items back from Brugg Mulcher. : He will give you a [[Mushroom Basket]] fill the basket with other red mushrooms you can find around the zone. These are the same small red mushroom as the first one. : The [[Malignant Mushroom]] is in the poison spore cave on the east side out the NE gate. The cave entrance is a small tunnel entrance on the left wall with 2 Myconid standing nearby. The mushroom is on the opposite side of a boulder near the back of the room, growing on the shoulder of a seated corpse. Nothing will see invis, but the /take mushroom command will remove your invis so get ready to run. : To find the [[Tainted Mushroom]], go out the NW gate and into a small Myconid cave tunnel on this side. The entrance is about halfway up the wall on the left. Follow the tunnel all the way to the top where you'll exit out into a higher plateau area. If you hug the right wall around to the plateau ledge you'll see the mushroom in a small bed. : The final [[Virulent Mushroom]] is a bit harder to find and get to. To help see it, from the top plateau go to the western edge and look NW and you'll see it down below you across the way. Go back across the plateau and drop off to the east to the next level down. On your left, you'll see some larger mushrooms that let you jump puzzle across to the next plateau where there are some wererat tents set up (maybe there's an easier way up here?). Once on that next area, turn left and run west to the end. There will be a small drop off to a little ledge/boulder area below you where the mushroom is tucked in around the corner. : Combine the 4 mushrooms, [[Rotten Mushroom]], [[Malignant Mushroom]], [[Virulent Mushroom]], [[Tainted Mushroom]] within the [[Mushroom Basket]] to create the [[Full Mushroom Basket]] '''Give the [[Full Mushroom Basket]] to [[Brugg Mulcher]].''' : {{exp}} : Your faction standing with Rot of Gorm got better. :Brugg Mulcher says, "You have served the Rotfather well today, Druid. We must remain vigilant if we are to learn the source of this new corruption. I fear I have more questions than answers." :Brugg Mulcher says, "Bring this report to the head of your order, the druid Letharia." : You receive Brugg's Report from Brugg Mulcher. '''Take [[Brugg's Report]] to to the Druid leader [[Letharia Hollowgrove]].''' : Letharia Hollowgrove says, "I am not pleased to receive this news, but Bulibyre has prepared us to endure such trials. We will need druids like you, ." : Letharia Hollowgrove says, "Hand me your walking staff and receive new gifts from Bulibyre." '''Give Letharia your [[Mossy Rootstaff]].''' : {{exp}} : Your faction standing with Rot of Gorm got better. : Letharia Hollowgrove says, "We must fortify ourselves against corruption even as we must inevitably succumb to it, lest we fail to spread his gifts across Eth-ur. Remember this as you grow in the ways of the Rotfather." : You receive [[Fungal Rootstaff]] from Letharia Hollowgrave. '''More to come''' [[Category:Quests]] [[Category:Underdocks Quests]] [[Category:Druid Quests]]

Cleric Starter Quest (Underdocks).title: Cleric Starter Quest (Underdocks)
Cleric Starter Quest (Underdocks).content:
{{Quest | imagefilename = phicon.png | width = 100px | caption = Placeholder Image |Start Zone = [[Underdocks]] |Quest Giver = [[Soren Akedd]] |Minimum Level = 1 |Classes = [[Cleric]] |Related NPCs = [[Sister Marwen]]; [[Lady Tabitha]] |Quest Rewards = [[Tattered Ephod]] [[Splintered Servant's Buckler]] [[Worn Servant Buckler]] }} __TOC__ == Walkthrough == === Part 1 - The Offering === This part is the same for [[Cleric]], [[Necromancer]], and [[Shadow Knight]]. Starting note in inventory: 
Wake, dreamer. The Master has called you into his service. Salvage your meager ambitions and seek the Temple of Ygorath. Deliver this note to Soren Akedd and make the offering.
'''Hand in the note to [[Soren Akedd]].''' : Soren Akedd says, "You have done well to come when called NAME. This is the House of Ygorath, which you may call home, if you are deemed worthy to carry out his work." : {{exp}} : Your faction standing with The Trembling Hand got better. '''If you didn't hand him the note, you can still start this quest as so:''' : You say, "Hail, Soren Akedd." : Soren Akedd says, "You appear before me as you were in my nightmare, NAME." : You say, "Nightmare?" : Soren Akedd says, "Nightmares are visits from Ygorath, gifted upon all the fearful of this land. It was my nightmare that called you here to begin his work." '''Either way, you can ask about the work.''' : You say, "What work?" : Soren Akedd says, "It is the work of trembling hands to raise both the living and the dead upon his altar. It is for their salvation as much as our own." : Soren Akedd says, "Many souls walk Eth-up practicing feints of valor, but Ygorath's wisdom knows bravery to be a thin sheen upon a bottomless terror. We must usher them into his kingdom with right fear in their hearts." : Soren Akedd says, "This you must do, Cleric, whether by sign or by sword. If you pass the test." : You say, "What is the test?" : Soren Akedd says, "The rabble carry fear in their blood and their bones. Ours are bourne by Ygorath. This is your test: take this effigy to the chapel and make of it an offering. Place your effigy upon the altar and receive Ygorath's blessing. Return with what remains. : You receive Strange Effigy from Soren Akedd. : Soren Akedd says, "But I must warn you... cast your gaze downward and look not upon the visage of Ygorath." '''Go out the front of the building and take a left. The chapel is very close and has a red glow inside. Go inside, walk all the way up to the altar in front of the statue and /look.''' : A simple clay bowl rests upon the altar. You dare not raise your gaze any higher, lest you behold the statue looking over the chapel. '''Pick up the [[Strange Effigy]] in your inventory so that it's on your cursor, then /place altar.''' : As the effigy leaves your fingers, it turns to ash without flame. : You receive Offering Bowl. '''Take the Offering Bowl back to Soren and hand it in to him.''' : Soren Akedd says, "Your eyes are open. Take this drape and rise a new servant of Ygorath." : {{exp}} : Your faction standing with The Trembling Hand got better. : Your faction standing with The Dreaming Dawn got worse. : You receive [[Tattered Ephod]] from Soren Akedd. : Soren Akedd says, "Now go, and do his work. Should you need guidance look for Sister Marwen attending her duties at the chapel. === Part 2 - The Unworthy === '''[[Sister Marwen]] is on the porch of the chapel. She is a cleric trainer.''' : You say, "Hail, Sister Marwen." : Sister Marwen says, "Well met. Spreading the word of Ygorath is not for the faint of heart. Will you accept the duties required of you?" : You say, "I accept." : Sister Marwen says, "We shall see. There are those who shirk their duties." : Sister Marwen stares at you with wide, unblinking eyes. : Sister Marwen says, "Sometimes the unworthy linger, hoping to regain entry to the temple. Go to the mortuary that overlooks the water and look for those who have abandoned their calling. many still wear the drape of the temple. Reclaim no fewer than four robes and return them to me in this box." : You receive Robe Box from Sister Marwen. '''If you head out the tunnel that leads to the city, the unworthy you are looking for are both high and low on the waterfront where the tunnels come out: [[a craven neophyte]], [[a failed knight]], [[an unworthy aspirant]].''' '''Kill them until you get [[Stained Servant's Robe]] x4.''' '''Combine them in the Robe Box to get the Full Robe Box.''' '''Hand the Full Robe Box in to Sister Marwen.''' : {{exp}} : Your faction standing with The Trembling Hand got better. : Sister Marwen says, "Our duty is to give and to take as Ygorath commands. Take this shield and bear it proudly, no matter what you are called upon to do." : You receive [[Splintered Servant's Buckler]] from Sister Marwen. '''If you hail her again she says to come back later.''' : You say, "Hail, Sister Marwen." : Sister Marwen says, "Attend to your duties, young one. Return when you are stronger." === Part 3 === '''At level 8 Sister Marwen has the next step for you.''' : You say, "Hail, Sister Marwen." : Sister Marwen says, "Your faith in Ygorath strengthens your resolve, Cleric. Look for Lady Tabitha in the temple and offer her your services. She is an alchemist of some repute." '''[[Lady Tabitha]] is in the morgue (same building as Soren).''' : You say, "Hail, Lady Tabitha." : Lady Tabitha hums to herself. : Lady Tabitha says, "Oh, here's a new on. Who sent you to me? Or have you become a nuisance of your own volition?" : You say, "Sister Marwen sent me." : Lady Tabitha says, "Indeed! Each somehow less promising than the last, it seems. No matter. If you can furnish the ingredients I require, I will endorse your aspiration. : You say, "What ingredients?" : Lady Tabitha says, "Poison and antidote are cut from the same cloth, Cleric. Go and collect as many snake venom glands as this will carry." : You receive [[Snake Gland Pouch]] from Lady Tabitha. : Lady Tabitha says, "Undamaged, if you please." '''Need to fufill the [[Snake Gland Pouch]] with 8 [[Deepscale Venom Gland]] drop from [[Deepscale Slitherer]]''' '''Hand [[Full Snake Gland Pouch]] you get after the combine''' : {{exp}} : Your faction standing with The Trembling Hand got better. : Lady Tabitha says I thank you, Cleric. The work continues. Give this letter to Sister Marwen as a sign of your progress. : You receive [[Alchemist's Reference Letter]] from Lady Tabitha. ''' Hand [[Alchemist's Reference Letter]] to Sister Marwen''' : {{exp}} : Your faction standing with The Trembling Hand got better. : You receive [[Alchemist's Reference Letter]] from Sister Marwen : Sister Marwen says Splendidly done. Give me the alchemist's letter along with the shield of our order to receive a blessing. ''' Give both : [[Alchemist's Reference Letter]] and your [[Splintered Servant's Buckler]]''' : {{exp}} : Your faction standing with The Trembling Hand got better. :Sister Marwen says Walk in fear, Cleric. : You receive [[Worn Servant Buckler]] from Sister Morwen

Ancient Wurmsbane Armor - Cloth.title: Ancient Wurmsbane Armor - Cloth
Ancient Wurmsbane Armor - Cloth.content:
== Ancient Wurmsbane Armor - Cloth == This quest involves restoring pieces of Ancient Wurmsbane cloth armor with the assistance of '''Tailor Thaddeus'''. Before he can begin repairing the armor, players must recover his stolen sewing needle. == Armor Locations == * '''Cloth Shoulders:''' Dropped by Animist Wafi in Tel Ekir. * '''Cloth Boots:''' Dropped by Sivah Arjun in the Smuggler Cave, Fallen Pass. == Quest Walkthrough == === Step 1: Speak with Tailor Thaddeus === Obtain a piece of Ancient Wurmsbane cloth armor and bring it to '''Tailor Thaddeus'''. Thaddeus recognizes the armor and offers to repair it, but explains that he needs help recovering a special sewing needle originally given to him by the Wurmsbane. The following dialogue prompts were confirmed in-game: * '''what is your idea''' * '''how can i help?''' These prompts advance the conversation and reveal the missing needle. === Step 2: Recover the Stolen Needle === Thaddeus explains that vermin stole his unique sewing needle. He provides the following clue:
"I feel it far to the north, just beyond Szuur, and deep underground in the paw of some rogue."
'''Needle location:''' * '''Zone:''' Black Tide Bay * '''NPC:''' Assassin Relk * '''Item:''' Sewing needle (exact item name not yet documented) The needle is reported to be obtained from '''Assassin Relk''' in Black Tide Bay. ''Note: This location is documented on this wiki, but the drop has not yet been independently verified during this walkthrough.'' === Step 3: Return to Tailor Thaddeus === Return the recovered needle to '''Tailor Thaddeus'''. According to the existing quest information, after returning the needle, players can turn in their Ancient Wurmsbane armor piece to receive dialogue explaining the materials required to repair it. === Step 4: Gather the Repair Materials === Different armor pieces may require different materials. The following requirements have been documented for the cloth shoulders. == Cloth Shoulders - Repair Requirements == * '''Eth-Silk Thread consecrated with a Blessing of Remembrance''' * '''2 Enchanted Bolts of Cotton''' * '''2 Light Thread''' * '''2 Iron Fasteners''' === Eth-Silk Thread and the Blessing of Remembrance === The thread must be consecrated with a '''Blessing of Remembrance'''. The original quest notes suggest finding a historian or scholar who can explain the blessing process. '''Potential NPC: Ethweaver Farania''' * '''Zone:''' Vale of Zintar * '''Location:''' Sojourner camp * '''Availability:''' Dialogue reported during daytime hours Farania has dialogue concerning the thread and appears to have a vendor inventory, although no items were available when previously investigated. '''Recorded dialogue:'''
Farania says, "Mother Eth bears us strands of light. Sometimes you see them, no? I can pull them from the sky and put them in your hand. For a price, of course!"
'''Current status:''' Further progression with Farania has not yet been documented. == Cloth Boots - Repair Requirements == The required materials for repairing the cloth boots have not yet been documented. Players should recover Thaddeus's needle and then present the boots to him to discover the required components. == Research Notes == * The dialogue prompts '''what is your idea''' and '''how can i help?''' were confirmed in-game while investigating the Ancient Tattered Wyrmsbane Boots. * Assassin Relk in Black Tide Bay is identified by existing wiki documentation as the source of the stolen needle. * The exact needle item name, drop conditions, and spawn location of Assassin Relk remain to be verified. * The complete cloth shoulder repair process and final rewards are not yet documented. * Additional player discoveries are welcome. Instrument of Hospitality.title: Instrument of Hospitality
Instrument of Hospitality.content:
{{Quest | imagefilename = Phicon.png | width = 200px | caption = Rais Alyssum |Start Zone = [[Night Harbor]] |Quest Giver = [[Rais Alyssum]] |Minimum Level = 6 |Classes = [[Bard]] |Related NPCs = }} == Reward ==
  • {{:Restored Mandolin}}
* Experience == Walkthrough == '''This quest starts with hailing [[Rais Alyssum]].''' You say, 'Hail, Rais Alyssum.' Rais Alyssum says 'Hello, may I interest you in one of my fine handcrafted instruments? I carry everything that a young instrumentalist might need to enhance his beginnings as a performer.' You say, 'Performer?' Rais Alyssum clears his throat and puffs out his chest. Rais Alyssum says 'Everything in life is a performance. Eth-ur is our stage. Now you have to ask yourself, will you play the lead? Or are you content to continue as supporting cast? You say, 'I will play the lead." Rais Alyssum says 'Excellent! A vibrant storyteller needs purpose, humility, and of course; experience. Why don't we start with something a little.. philanthropic? First you can start by bringing light to those in the dark of Night Harbor. Return to me when you feel you've brightened the spirits of the less fortunate.' '''Scattered across Night Harbor are [[A beggar]]. Purchase 3 [[Weak Beer]] from [[A barkeep]] and trade one individually to each a beggar and /Play Lute to brighten the spirits of the less fortunate.''' '''***You must have an instrument equipped to use the /Play feature***''' You say, 'Hail, a beggar.' a beggar says, 'Alms for the poor?' '''Hand a beggar 1 [[Weak Beer]] and use the /Play lute command.''' a_beggar_1 says, 'Thank you for the drink, but can you keep it down you're scaring the tourists away!' a_beggar_2 says, 'Ahhh my ears! I've heard better music coming from the stables at the Sojourner camp!' a_beggar_3 says, 'Wow, I cannot tell you how long it has been since I have felt kindness and compassion. What a beautiful melody, bless you kind stranger. I found this while rummaging through the Night Market and something compelled me to hold onto it, just give me a moment to find it. a_beggar_3 pats his pockets and then anxiously searches through his bags. A_beggar_3 says 'Now where did I put that, oh here it is!' ''You receive a [[Broken Mandolin]] from a_beggar_3.'' a_beggar_3 says, 'Now it may not be in the best condition, but please take this as a token of my gratitude. I'm sure a bright young Bard like yourself can find a way to restore it back to a working condition.' '''Return to [[Rais Alyssum]] and hand him the [[Broken Mandolin]].''' Upon turning in the Broken Mandolin: Rais Alyssum holds the broken mandolin in his hands and studies it intently. Rais Alyssum says, 'Well would you look at that! Sometimes kindness really does pay off! Let's see what we have here.. Ah yes, a polished mahogany body, with beautiful trim work on the headstock. A shame the condition that it's in. I could repair it for you, but I would need some additional materials and of course a fee.' You say, 'What additional materials?' Rais Alyssum looks you up and down with a mischievous gleam in his eye. Rais Alyssum says, 'Come closer and take a look at these three strings. They are salvageable, but I will need five more. The silk of a large spider should do the trick. Now for the tailpiece.. we could use stone, but lets try for something a little more elegant and special. I've heard the performers outside talk of a translucent beetle roaming the dunes to the west. A piece of his carapace will work perfectly. Rais Alyssum says, 'Oh and don't forget about the fee. After all, this is a lesson in helping the less fortunate. Ten silver pieces sounds fair, don't you think?' '''Head to the Shaded Dunes and kill [[Large Spiders]] until you have 5 [[Large Spider Silk]]. Obtain a [[Piece of Translucent Beetle Shell]] from [[a giant translucent beetle]]. Return with them to Rais Alyssum.''' Upon turning in 5 {{:Large Spider Silk}} and {{:Piece of Translucent Beetle Shell}} and 10 silver pieces: {{YouGainExperience}} Rais Alyssum excitedly fashions together the tailpiece and tightens the strings. ''You receive a [[Restored Mandolin]] from Rais Alyssum.'' Rais Alyssum says, 'I knew you had the heart of a performer in you. As promised here is the restored mandolin. Now go and set the stage for your adventure! Oh and before I forget.. when another Bard becomes envious of my artwork, send him my way. Just don't mention the fee. Rais Alyssum winks at you. Find a skeleton named [[Bones]] in the [[Night Harbor]] Necropolis (Concourse of Souls).  He is in the same room as [[Sekhmet]] who gives the initial [[Necromancer]] quest.  The room is through the middle path when you enter from the courtyard.

# Hail Bones.  He is unable to talk, but will hand you Bones' Note of Tidings.  The note mentions a list of necrotic procurement.
# Say "list of necrotic procurement" to Bones.
# Return 20 [[Bone Chips]], 1 [[Skeleton Jawbone]], and the list of necrotic procurement
# Receive [[Necrolyte's Pouch]] (4 slot small belt pouch), Note of Gratitude.

# 2nd list. Say "take the list of charred procurements.

Platinum Badge of the Living City Quest.content:
{{Quest | imagefilename = phicon.png | width = 100px | caption = Placeholder Image |Start Zone = [[Night Harbor]] |Quest Giver = [[Lieutenant Jarovik Holt|Lieutenant Jarovik Holt]] |Minimum Level = 15 |Classes = |Related NPCs = [[Lieutenant Jarovik Holt|Lieutenant Jarovik Holt]] Corporal Theodora [[Vikar Brask|Vikar Brask]] [[Darius Brask|Darius Brask]] [[Cormac Renshaw|Cormac Renshaw]] Eamon Kassir | Related Items = [[Head of Vikar Brask]] Head of Darius Brask Head of Cormac Head of Eamon Kassir | Quest Rewards = Iron Badge of the City [[Platinum Badge of the Living City]] (money: 0,0,30,0) (exp) }} Bends_Spawn_Locations.png == Walkthrough == === Preparation === To receive the quest from [[Lieutenant Jarovik Holt|Lieutenant Jarovik Holt]] you'll need Kindly + 1 yellows (20%) [[Bends Garrison]] faction. You can raise the [[Bends Garrison]] faction via the quest: [[Riverbend Gang Wars Quest]] which requires turning in: [[Bloodied_Allegiance_Cuffs]] You can also raise [[Bends Garrison]] faction though killing within the bends. === Part 1 - Getting Ahead of the Problem === You say, "Hail, Lieutenant Jarovik Holt" Lieutenant Jarovik Holt says, "You have gained my attention, Elementalist, I have a task that must be done, if you have the courage to see it through." You say "What task?" Lieutenant Jarovik Holt says, "The Ten Hooks and the Waterdogs have been a thorn in my side for far too long. Bring me the heads of the Brask brothers and Cormac Renshaw." [[Lieutenant Jarovik Holt|Lieutenant Jarovik Holt]] gives you a small bag with 3 slots, put the three heads in the bag then combine and hand over the bag.
* Kill [[Vikar Brask|Vikar Brask]] and get the [[Head of Vikar Brask]]
Location 1 in the image above. He spawns in a small hut on top of the building. * Kill [[Darius Brask|Darius Brask]] and get the [[Head of Darius Brask]]
Location 2 in the image above. He spawns in the top most building in the area above the book-cases. * Kill [[Cormac Renshaw|Cormac Renshaw]] and get the [[Head of Cormac]]
Location 3 in the image above. He spawns inside the boat. Combine into [[Sack of Heads]]
Lieutenant Jarovik Holt reaches into the bloodstained satch and examines it's contents. You receive 20 silver from Lieutenant Jarovik Holt. Lieutenant Jarovik Holt says, "You have done hte people of Night Harbor a great service on this, Maev, and you have earned my respect. Take this badge as proof of your bravery. You receive [[Iron Badge of the City]]
=== Part 2 - The one that got away === You say, "Hail, Lieutenant Jarovik Holt." Lieutenant Jarovik Holt nods at you. Lieutenant Jarovik Holt says, "You have proven yourself, Name. Are you prepared for one final mission?" You say, "What mission?" Lieutenant Jarovik Holt says, "I do not ask this lightly, but it must be done. Bring me the viper's head, Name. Bring me the head of [[Eamon Kassir]]." * Kill [[Eamon Kassir]] and loot [[Head of Eamon Kassir]].
Location 4 in the image above. He spawns in a room at the very top of the structure near a table that has potions on it. Deceptive Trickster is PH Return the head to [[Lieutenant Jarovik Holt|Lieutenant Jarovik Holt]] Lieutenant Jarovik Holt takes the head of Eamon Kassir and holds it aloft in the light. Lieutenant Jarovik Holt drops the head on the ground. Lieutenant Jarovik Holt says, "So it is done. I will have that thing piked on the gate for all to see. On my honor Name, we will finally purge Riverbend of these scum." Lieutenant Jarovik Holt says, "You have my thanks. Present this commendation and your badge to Theodora." You receive [[Jarovik's Commendation]] from Lieutenant Jarovik Holt. Take your [[Iron Badge of the City]] and the [[Jarovik's Commendation]] to [[Corporal Theodora]]. Corporal Theodora says, "You're one of us now, soldier. I know we'll do great things together." You receive 10 silver from Corporal Theodora. You receive [[Platinum Badge of the Living City]] from Corporal Theodora. ==Video Overview== {{#ev:youtube|https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=wSm9taxaaSA|dimensions=640x360}} [[Category:Quests]] [[Category:Night Harbor Quests]]

Paladin Starter Quest (Night Harbor).content:
{{Quest | imagefilename = phicon.png | width = 100px | caption = Placeholder Image |Start Zone = [[Night Harbor]] |Quest Giver = - |Minimum Level = 1 |Classes = [[Paladin]] |Related NPCs = [[Thibald Burlond]], [[Trey Fulton]], [[Halrinn Grimsul]] }} == Reward == * Experience
  • [[Simple Penitent Knight's Tunic]]
  • [[Penitent Knight's Tunic (Paladin)|Penitent Knight's Tunic]]
== Walkthrough == === Part 1 === Read [[Formal Note]] you start with as a new Paladin Character: 
To whom it may concern,

The Wayfarers Hospice is in need of charitable souls who are gifted with a healing touch.

Please bring this note and your interest to Thibald
Burlond at the Hospice, located in the Travelers
Ward to the north of the city's Western Gate.

Should you find yourself lost, ask one of the guards.
They have likely received our treatment before.

May your journey be blessed.

-The Penitent Knights of the Hospice
'''Hand [[Formal Note]] to [[Thibald Burlond]] in the Wayfarer's Hospice north of the West Gate'''
{{exp}} :Thibald Burlond reads the note, then gives you a generous nod. :Thibald Burlond suddenly stands upright and straightens his tunic. : Thibald Burlond says, "Welcome to the Wayfarers Hospice. I am Grand Master Thibald Burdlond of the Penitent Knights of the Hospice." : Thibald Burlond says, "We accept all paladins who come to aid and maintain our order, no matter their background or faith." :Thibald Burlond pauses for a moment to assess you. : Thibald Burlond says, "This hospice is known to Night Harbor's citizens and authorities alike as a place of order and charity. Your faith and your history are of no concern, but do not besmirch our good name." : Thibald Burlond says, "Now, please deliver the note you just gave me to Master Fulton. You will serve his needs." You receive [[Formal Note]] from [[Thibald Burlond]].

'''Hand [[Formal Note]] to [[Trey Fulton]]'''
{{exp}} :Trey Fulton takes the note without reading it and wave you closer. : Trey Fulton says, "Our Grand Master is a loud enough fella, isn't he?" : Trey Fulton says, "It's a pleasure to meet you and all that, but let's cut right to it, eh? We've got a lot of work ahead of us." : Trey Fulton says, "An increasing number of travelers are coming through our city gates having been wounded or worse. Most tell tales of Ashira ambushes or hordes of undead appearing in the night." :Trey Fulton leans closer to you and places something in your hand. : Trey Fulton says, "But before we send you to take on the night, I need you to show this coin to Ol' Grimsul at the inn just across the street. This will be your first big mission." :Trey Fulton winks at you. You receive [[Penitent Knight's Coin (Paladin)|Penitent Knight's Coin]] from [[Trey Fulton]].

'''Head to the Inn near the West Gate and hand your [[Penitent Knight's Coin (Paladin)|Penitent Knight's Coin]] to [[Halrinn Grimsul]]'''
{{exp}} :Halrinn Grimsul looks at the coin, then returns it. : Halrinn Grimsul says, "Well, it's good to see that the old cuss finally found his appetite." : Halrinn Grimsul says, "It looks like you've become his courier, brave knight." : Halrinn Grimsul says, "But first, you'll need to do the other thing he sent you here for." :Halrinn Grimsul smiles at you and places a filthy bag on the bar. : Halrinn Grimsul says, "As a brave defender of whatever faith you claim to follow, I'm sure my task is a trivial endeavor. I'll need you to kill two birds with one stone, so to speak." : Halrinn Grimsul says, "We're short on staff, so I'm stuck up here for a bit while grain beetles gnaw away at our supplies in the cellar. Also, our cook is running low on ingredients for the stew..." : Halrinn Grimsul says, "You get it, right? Fill the bag with their legs and return it to me. Then you can go back to whatever brave deeds you thought you'd be doing. Just make sure those legs are intact and juicy looking." :Halrinn Grimsul laughs to himself as he wipes down the bar. You receive [[Halrinn's Bag]] from [[Halrinn Grimsul]].

'''Head behind the bar and head to the basement and kill [[a grain beetle]]s until you receive 6 of them. Alternatively you can buy them.''' : Combine 6 of them in [[Halrinn's Bag]] ensuring they are not stacked. You will receive [[Bag of Intact Beetle Legs]] '''Hand [[Bag of Intact Beetle Legs]] to [[Halrinn Grimsul]]'''
{{exp}} :Halrinn Grimsul whistles appreciatively and mock bows. : Halrinn Grimsul says, "Everyone, my brave defender has returned!" : Halrinn Grimsul says, "I may jest, but... I do truly appreciate the assistance. Master Fulton's food is wrapped up and ready to go. Deliver it to my dear sir, before it gets cold." : Halrinn Grimsul says, "And no, don't worry, it's not the stew." :Halrinn Grimsul winks at you. :Halrinn Grimsul leans towards you, taking on a more serious disposition. : Halrinn Grimsul says, "Do see that he gets this and eats it. I'm glad he finally sent for something. I'll not have him waste away from worry." : Halrinn Grimsul says, "The situation with his son is unfortunate, and he's a good man. There's no telling what happened to his son. He was a paladin, like yourself." : Halrinn Grimsul says, "I'll not have him starve while waiting on word in the meantime." You receive [[Food for Trey Fulton]] from [[Halrinn Grimsul]].

'''Hand [[Food for Trey Fulton]] to [[Trey Fulton]]'''
{{exp}} :Trey Fulton takes the bundled food and sets it aside. : Trey Fulton says, "Thank you for this. I assume Halrinn put you to work for it." :Trey Fulton hands you a simple tunic bearing the guild's insignia. : Trey Fulton says, "Take this for your efforts." : Trey Fulton says, "It was good for you to meet, Halrinn. He may tend bar now, but he was formidable in his day. As were many of the people you'll serve here in the hospice and as part of our guild." : Trey Fulton says, "This place and our duty, is a constant reminder that time moves swiftly, eluding even the most fastidious grasp." :Trey Fulton shakes his head and looks up to meet your gaze. : Trey Fulton says, "Ah, look at me getting all morose. Don your tunic and explore the city. I have nothing for you now, but come back soon and we'll put you to work." You receive [[Simple Penitent Knight's Tunic]] from [[Trey Fulton]].

=== Part 2 === '''Return to the Shaded Bloom Inn near West Gate and ask [[Halrinn Grimsul]] about Trey's son''' :Halrinn Grimsul says, "Master Fulton's son, Troy, went on an expedition to investigate the origins of the undead in our area and has yet to return. His son is an experienced paladin, but he's been missing for weeks." :Halrinn Grimsul sighs. :Halrinn Grimsul says, "Given all the kindness they showed my brother during his last days in the hospice, I'm compelled to assist however I can... But here I am, my adventuring days behind me." :Halrinn Grimsul pauses for a moment, then smacks the bar. :Halrinn Grimsul says, "I overheard a conversation last week between a few inebriated archaeologists from the Wyrmsbane site." :Halrinn Grimsul says, "They've been unable to explore the site too deeply due to increased undead activity, but they mentioned seeing what looked like signs of a recent and significant skirmish." :Halrinn Grimsul says, "It's not much to go on, so I haven't passed it along. I'd hate to worry Master Fulton without real cause. Please keep this between us, and deliver that food before it gets cold." '''Head to the [[Tomb of the Last Wyrmsbane]] to search for clues regarding the whereabouts of [[Trey Fulton|Trey Fulton's]] son.''' To complete this quest, you will need to gather three items and combine them: * Obtain the [[Tattered Field Pack]] from [[Dario Numas]]. (Note: This is a 2-slot container). * Obtain the [[Torn Cloak]], a rare drop from [[a skeletal archer]] or [[a skeletal marksman]]. * Obtain the [[Engraved Coin]] located upstairs in the Tomb. Stand between the two blue-flamed braziers in the "Skull Wall" room until you see the message: "You notice a glimmer from a crack in the floor." Use the command '''/take coin''' to retrieve it. '''Combine the [[Torn Cloak]] and [[Engraved Coin]] inside the [[Tattered Field Pack]] to create [[Troy's Field Pack]].''' '''Hand [[Troy's Field Pack]] to [[Trey Fulton]]''' {{exp}} :Trey Fulton abruptly straightens his posture, looking shocked. :Trey Fulton says, "By the Gods! This is my son's field pack. These items belong to Troy!" :Trey Fulton says, "I'd heard rumors that he and his men entered the tomb, but now we have confirmation!" :Trey Fulton says, "The initiative you've shown is only outdone by your heroism. Remove that trainee tunic and take this with my gratitude. You're clearly deserving of a more permanent role here." :Trey Fulton looks at his son's field pack. :Trey Fulton says, "He may have lost his gear, but he's still alive. I can feel it." :Trey Fulton says, "I'm going to speak with Grand Master Burlond about the appropriate course of action. In the meantime, please let me know if you see any signs of my son while you're beyond the gates." You receive [[Penitent Knight's Tunic (Paladin)|Penitent Knight's Tunic]] from [[Trey Fulton]]. === Part 3 === ??? [[Category:Quests]] [[Category:Night Harbor Quests]] [[Category:Paladin Quests]]
