== Walkthrough ==

=== Part 1 ===
Read [[Rune-Etched Note]] you start with as a new Inquisitor character:

''Hail, apprentice.''

''Master Jaffar Jhaym awaits your arrival at the Spellbinders Spire in Sageside. You'll know you're close when you see the wizard tower looming overhead.''

''Use the translocation devices beneath the tower to reach the academy grounds. Once there, you'll likely find Jaffar atop the Spire.''

''Your desire for advancement is well-served by Jaffar's tutelage. The academy he has built is highly regarded within Night Harbor, and he employs only the finest instructors.''

''If you lose your way, consult the nearest guard and inquire about the Spire's location.''

''Godspeed!''

Head to the wizard tower east of the North Gate. Take the teleporter to the first floor and go through the portal labeled "Spellbinders Spire". Head to the top of the tower with spellbinder guards around it to find [[Jaffar Jhaym]]. He is at the very top of the Spellbinders Spire.

Hand [[Rune-Etched Note]] to [[Jaffar Jhaym]].

{{exp}}
''Jaffar Jhaym examines your note and then smiles broadly at you.''
:Jaffar Jhaym says, "Very well met! You have arrived safely, and I am indeed who you seek. Welcome to the Spellbinders Spire!"
:Jaffar Jhaym says, "The desert grows more dangerous by the day, so you have arrived none too soon."
:Jaffar Jhaym says, "I am sure we will get better acquainted in the days to come, but you must be tired, so I’ll delay your introduction to your trainer no longer."
:Jaffar Jhaym says, "As an aspiring inquisitor, you will be under the tutelage of Petra Gyle."
:Jaffar Jhaym says, "Deliver your note to her, and she will get you started."
''Jaffar Jhaym bows slightly and smiles at you.''
{{ReceiveItem|You receive [[Rune-Etched Note]] from [[Jaffar Jhaym]].}}

Head down the spire and hand your [[Rune-Etched Note]] to [[Petra Gyle]].

{{exp}}
''Petra Gyle takes the note.''
:Petra Gyle says, "Hmm..."
''Petra Gyle snatches the note form your hands and skims it briefly, her fierce gaze peering over top of the parchment as she appraises you.''
:Petra Gyle says, "So you wish to be an inquisitor of the spire, do you? You'll have to prove to me you have the mettle to take on such a responsibility."
:Petra Gyle says, "Magic is a powerful, yet extremely dangerous talent. Especially when used by those who collude with, or seek to benefit from, corrupted forces."
:Petra Gyle says, "Our role as inquisitors is to protect our colleagues from such forces, while also routing out corruption before it has a chance to take hold."
''Petra Gyle pulls out a small key and offers it to you, while also posing a simple question.''
{{ReceiveItem|You receive [[Spellbinder's Cell Key]] from [[Petra Gyle]].}}
:Petra Gyle says, "Are you prepared to take on this role?"
You say, 'Yes I am.'
:Petra Gyle says, "We shall see if there's truth to your words, or if they ring hollow."
:Petra Gyle says, "Descend to the bottom floor of the Spire and use the key I've given you to enter the confinement cells. We've captured a number of cultists that have yet to reveal to us their intentions."
''Petra Gyle scowls and practically spits at the word cultists.''
:Petra Gyle says, "Even a novice like yourself should have the aptitude to force them to talk."
:Petra Gyle says, "Speak to the Inquisitor Selpha outside the cells should you have any questions regarding interrogation, then return to me with anything you uncover, along with the key to the cells."

Head down to the confinement cells, hold your [[Spellbinder's Cell Key]], and click the cell door next to [[Inquisitor Selpha]].

Cast Torment on one of the prisoners three times; they will then tell you about a secret pocket in their cloaks.

There will be a table with some knives on it in the room outside. Use ''/look'' at the table, then ''/inspect cloak'', then ''/inspect seam'', then ''/take note''. Give it to [[Inquisitor Selpha]].

:Inquisitor Selpha says, "What's this? You found this hidden within one of their cloaks? Hmm..."
:Inquisitor Selpha says, "You'd best show these to Petra right away. The spike carries a malevolent aura that she may be able to unravel, along with the meaning behind that blank note."

Return to [[Petra Gyle]], and give her the [[Mysterious Rolled Note]], the [[Mysterious Iron Spike]], and the [[Spellbinder's Cell Key]].

''Petra Gyle pockets the key and gives the spike an intense stare. She then retrieves a strangely glowing stone from her possession and runs it across the spike's surface, causing the image of the object to shift and waver like a mirage.''
''Petra Gyle mutters a curse under her breath as she shifts the stone across the surface of the parchment next. She clicks her tongue before returning her attention to you.''
:Petra Gyle says, "You did well to bring these finds to me, [Player], while also proving that you have the resolve to be a true inquisitor."
:Petra Gyle says, "Take this, it will serve as a symbol that you're now a member of our order. You'll need it, along with this seer stone, if you're to look further into these matters."
:Petra Gyle says, "Tell me, [Player], are you familiar with the Tarellian Seer Stones?"
You say, 'What Seer Stones?'
:Petra Gyle says, "The seer stone that I've given you is magically imbued. It enables us to see through minor illusions and masking spells, which is how you'll use it to thwart the cultists."
:Petra Gyle says, "These so-called spikes have been revealed to scrying anchors. They would allow anyone attuned to them to view, and potentially overhear, anything in their vicinity."
:Petra Gyle says, "I've also used the power of the Tarellian Seer Stone to dispel the illusion concealing what information the note contained."
:Petra Gyle says, "It appears that out Easthymnite guests have been directed to discreetly affix these spikes at various locations throughout Night Harbor, likely in an effort to spy and sow discord."
:Petra Gyle says, "So now, [Player], to continue your investigations you must make a choice."
You say, 'What choice?'
:Petra Gyle says, "Your first option is to pursue the cultists that have been sent to plant these spikes, either by following them or discerning the clues revealed in the note about their intended locations. For this, you'll need the note."
:Petra Gyle says, "The second option is to track down and eliminate the individual who is attuned to the spikes, so that even if they're planted, they'll remain nothing more than a potential snag on someone's clothing. To do this, you'll require the spike."
:Petra Gyle says, "As this is your first investigation, I leave the choice to you, [Player]."
:Petra Gyle says, "Note or spike?"

* [[#Note Path|Choose the Note Path]]
* [[#Spike Path|Choose the Spike Path]]

==== Note Path ====
You say, 'Give me the note.'
:Petra Gyle says, "Very well, the note is yours."
{{ReceiveItem|You receive [[Revealed Cultist Note]].}}
:Petra Gyle says, "There are three travelers from Easthymn who've caught our eye at the Shaded Bloom Inn. You'll recognize them by their black garb and the thin silver chains they wear around their waists. Identify them and follow them."
:Petra Gyle says, "Two of them have been reported to wander the streets, making brief stops at nondescript locations. With the seer stone, look closely at the areas where they stop. You're to pull out any spikes they affix to these locations."
:Petra Gyle says, "You may be able to use the note to discern the locations yourself without having to following them, if you're keen enough."
:Petra Gyle says, "The third traveler never leaves the inn, but we're not sure why. Follow him as well, but if he doesn't affix the spikes anywhere... take them from him. The spire authorizes the use of force, once he is out of sight of the locals."
:Petra Gyle says, "Fill the bag with each unique spike, combine it, and then return it to me, along with the seer stone."
{{ReceiveItem|You receive [[Tarellian Seer Stone]] from [[Petra Gyle]].}}
{{ReceiveItem|You receive [[Small Leather Bag]] from [[Petra Gyle]].}}

Head to the Shaded Bloom Inn near the west gate.
* Make sure you equip the [[Tarellian Seer Stone]] before you begin these steps.
* The three [[an Easthymnite traveler]]s that you are meant to follow/assassinate spawn near the side street entrance door of the inn.
** One of them will walk to the basement behind the bar. Follow him to the basement and kill him for 2 unique Ornately Carved Iron Spikes. Keep in mind that you need all 6 unique spikes so you cannot pick up more than one of the same type.
* You DO NOT need to follow the remaining two Easthymnites—go to each of the four locations shown below and type ''/pull spike''. You can use ''/look'' to make sure you're in the right location first if you desire.
** An [[an Easthymnite traveler]] will walk towards the Blacksmith in Night Market.
*** Follow this one to an alley.
*** When he inspects the wall, ''/look''.
*** ''A small iron spike is embedded in the wall. It looks like you could pull it free.''
*** ''/pull spike''
*** ''You pull the iron spike from the wall.''
*** This map indicates all three locations with red circles:
[[File:NightHarborMapInquisitorSpikes.jpg|thumb|none|alt=Location of Spikes for Inquisitor Class Quest|Location of Spikes for Inquisitor Class Quest]]
** The second [[an Easthymnite traveler]] will head towards the Night Market and stop at two of the locations:
*** In Night Market Between Baker and Butcher 1: [[File:Easthymnite traveler two spike location one.png|thumb|none|alt=Easthymnite traveler two spike one alleyway location]]
*** In Night Market Between Baker and Butcher 2 (Spike Location): [[File:Screenshot 9.png|thumb|none|alt=Easthymnite traveler two spike location one]]
*** Night Market Gilded Claw Brazier: [[File:Easthymnite traveler two spike location two.png|thumb|none|alt=Easthymnite traveler two spike location two]]
** Like the second, a third [[an Easthymnite traveler]] will walk out the main entrance of the inn. They will once again visit two of the spike locations:
*** Brazier at crossroads behind western bank: [[File:Screenshot 5.png|thumb|none|alt=Easthymnite traveler three spike location one]]
*** Brazier at right side of entrance to Saltbreeze Park: [[File:Easthymnite Traveler Three spike location 2.png|thumb|none|alt=Easthymnite traveler three spike location two]]
* Combine the 6 Ornately Carved Iron Spikes in your [[Small Leather Bag]] to receive a [[Small Bag of Spikes]].
* Head back to [[Petra Gyle]].

Hand the [[Tarellian Seer Stone]] and [[Small Bag of Spikes]] to [[Petra Gyle]].

{{exp}}
:Petra Gyle says, "Well done. You've returned, so I must assume you were able to trail them safely."
''Petra Gyle pauses for a moment and squints at you.''
:Petra Gyle says, "Oh, did you get into a tussle?."
''Petra Gyle laughs.''
:Petra Gyle says, "Seems you can handle a more direct challenge then."
''Petra Gyle hands you two small bags.''
:Petra Gyle says, "We're tasked with tracking down and dealing with mages, wizards, and other arcane filth. However, we are also charged, at times, to deal with adversaries of a more spiritual nature."
:Petra Gyle says, "Seek out two camps in the desert to the west. There are shamans amongst the Ashira. Gather medicinal herbs from them to replenish the first pouch."
:Petra Gyle says, "You'll find a group of smugglers along the coast. They work for Jens Vermahn, so take care to engage them during the day. Gather whatever leafy filth they're using to heal themselves in the second bag."
:Petra Gyle says, "Now go."
{{ReceiveItem|You receive [[Ashira Herb Pouch]] from [[Petra Gyle]].}}
{{ReceiveItem|You receive [[Filthy Leather Herb Pouch]] from [[Petra Gyle]].}}
{{ReceiveItem|You receive [[Tarnished Spellbinder Cuirass]] from [[Petra Gyle]].}}

==== Spike Path ====
You say, 'Spike'
''Petra Gyle nods, handing you the spike.''
:Petra Gyle says, "The spike is yours, then."
:Petra Gyle says, "If you're going to find out who has attuned themselves to the spike, you'll need the assistance of another member of our order."
:Petra Gyle says, "Bring the spike to Spellbinder Kharash. I imagine he'll be in the archives on the bottom floor, opposite the hallway where you found the containment cells."
:Petra Gyle says, "He's an expert at unraveling divination magics and will be able to help you trace its origin."
:Petra Gyle says, "Good hunting, [Player]."

{{ReceiveItem|You receive [[Cultist's Iron Spike]] from [[Petra Gyle]].}}
{{ReceiveItem|You receive [[Tarellian Seer Stone]] from [[Petra Gyle]].}}

Give the [[Cultist's Iron Spike]] to [[Spellbinder Kharash]].

''Spellbinder Kharash inspects the spike and quickly frowns.''
:Spellbinder Kharash says, "You bring me a cursed object, inquisitor. I sense foul magics tied to it... divine in origin. Likely a dark gift granted by a malevolent benefactor."
:Spellbinder Kharash says, "Let us not waste time with further details. I will retain the spike here and prevent those who are attuned to it from scrying its location, or potentially, overhearing our plans."
:Spellbinder Kharash says, "In the meanwhile, take this bag. You must fill it With the components I need to trace the magic of the spike back to its source."
{{ReceiveItem|You receive [[Spellbinder's Bag]] from [[Spellbinder Kharash]].}}

{{exp}}

You say, 'What components?'
:Spellbinder Kharash says, "Good of you to ask."
:Spellbinder Kharash says, "The components I need to seek this foe rely on the vision of those who scour the sands. You must acquire the eye of a bat, a fire beetle, a dune scarab, a spiderling, and a crypt scarab."
:Spellbinder Kharash says, "I will also need a mirror to reflect the gaze back to its source. I believe Haredi sells such trinkets to other students of the academy in the Grand Library."
:Spellbinder Kharash says, "Once you have an of the eyes and the mirror, combine them in the bag and return it to me. I Will then conduct the ritual to reverse the attunement Of the spike."

[[Haredi]] is in the library. Once in the library, take the teleportation platform in front of you. You'll see [[Haredi]] to the left. Buy a [[Pocket Mirror]] from him.

Combine a [[Fire Beetle Eye]], [[Bat Eye]], [[Spiderling Eye]], [[Scarab Eye]], [[Crypt Scarab Eye]], and [[Pocket Mirror]] in the [[Spellbinder's Bag]] to craft [[Full Spellbinder's Bag]].

Give the [[Full Spellbinder's Bag]] to [[Spellbinder Kharash]].

{{exp}}
{{Faction|Spellbinders of the Spire|+}}
:Spellbinder Kharash says, "Well done, recruit With this, I can refocus the vision of the desert creatures and reflect the sinister gaze on this scrying device back to its source. Allow me a moment to redirect this foul magic."
''Spellbinder Kharash withdraws the spike he had been safeguarding and begins his ritual.''
''Spellbinder Kharash takes the spike and pierces it through one of the eyes, then another, and another, until an four are speared upon the nail like a grotesque form of street''
''Spellbinder Kharash then murmurs out a low, guttural chant as he points the skewered set of eyes toward the mirror, invoking his magic upon them. A bright flash fills the corner of the archives and temporarily blinds you!''
''Spellbinder Kharash stands before you as your vision readjusts, offering you the spike.''
:Spellbinder Kharash says, "Take it, [Player]. I have reversed the attunement of the object and directed the eyes to assist you in locating the cultist leader."
:Spellbinder Kharash says, "There is now one final thing you must do."
{{ReceiveItem|You receive [[Revealing Iron Spike]] from [[Spellbinder Kharash]].}}

You say, 'What must I do?'
:Spellbinder Kharash says, "Before you depart, you must be sure to bring your Tarellian Seer Stone with you."
:Spellbinder Kharash says, "It is capable Of removing illusions and can be used to unmask those attempting to hide their true selves. They must simply touch the stone."
:Spellbinder Kharash says, "When you are ready, proceed down to the Northern Gate. While standing beneath it, focus your will into the spike and it shall conjure an eye that will lead you to the cultist scryer."
:Spellbinder Kharash says, "If an eye does not immediately appear, the villain may be momentarily out of sight. Simply wait a short moment before trying once again."
:Spellbinder Kharash says, "When an eye appears, follow it. After that, you must use your own judgment on how best to deliver the Spellbinder's justice to your foe."
:Spellbinder Kharash says, "Bring anything you find from you investigation back to Petra, as my part here has concluded. May Tilustra illuminate path, inquisitor."

While standing just outside the Northern Gate, right-click your [[Revealing Iron Spike]] to summon an [[Eye of Kharash]].

The [[Eye of Kharash]] will spawn and run towards [[Farmer Lubern]]. Be prepared to fight a level 5 encounter.

Follow the eye or just make your way to [[Farmer Lubern]]. He is in the second enclosed area of farms on the right as you leave the north gate.

Give [[Tarellian Seer Stone]] to [[Farmer Lubern]] and he will transform into [[Lubern the Heretic]].

:Lubern the Heretic says, "No! How did you...?"
{{ReceiveItem|You receive [[Tarellian Seer Stone]] from [[Farmer Lubern]].}}
:Lubern the Heretic says, "Your blood will serve as a sacrifice for Kravvin!"

Kill [[Lubern the Heretic]] and loot [[Lubern's Scrying Orb]].

Return to [[Petra Gyle]].

Give [[Petra Gyle]] [[Lubern's Scrying Orb]], [[Tarellian Seer Stone]], and [[Revealing Iron Spike]].

{{Faction|Spellbinders of the Spire|+}}
:Petra Gyle says, "Well done. It seems you may have what it takes to be a real inquisitor after all."
''Petra Gyle pauses for a moment and squints at you.''
:Petra Gyle says, "Oh, did you get into a tussle?."
''Petra Gyle laughs.''
:Petra Gyle says, "Seems you can handle a more direct challenge then."
''Petra Gyle hands you two small bags.''
:Petra Gyle says, "We're tasked with tracking down and dealing with mages, wizards, and other arcane filth. However, we are also charged, at times, to deal with adversaries of a more spiritual nature."
:Petra Gyle says, "Seek out two camps in the desert to the west. There are shamans amongst the Ashira. Gather medicinal herbs from them to replenish the first pouch."
:Petra Gyle says, "You'll find a group of smugglers along the coast. They work for Jens Vermahn, so take care to engage them during the day. Gather whatever leafy filth they're using to heal themselves in the second bag."
:Petra Gyle says, "Now go."
{{ReceiveItem|You receive [[Ashira Herb Pouch]] from [[Petra Gyle]].}}
{{ReceiveItem|You receive [[Filthy Leather Herb Pouch]] from [[Petra Gyle]].}}
{{ReceiveItem|You receive [[Tarnished Spellbinder Cuirass]] from [[Petra Gyle]].}}

=== Part 2 ===
Combine six [[Ashira Medicinal Herbs]] in the [[Ashira Herb Pouch]]. Ashira Medicinal Herbs do not stack, but they can be traded.

Combine six [[Pungent Healing Herbs]] in the [[Filthy Leather Herb Pouch]]. Pungent Healing Herbs do not stack, but they can be traded.

Hand the filled [[Ashira Herb Pouch]] and [[Filthy Leather Herb Pouch]] to [[Petra Gyle]].

{{exp}}
:Petra Gyle says, "Fantastic Work. We've been using these herbs to formulate a better understanding of how to disrupt the enemy's healing magics."
:Petra Gyle says, "The spiritual nature of Ashira magic is more challenging to understand, but Jens' rats appear to be using simple alchemy. We'll know soon enough."
:Petra Gyle says, "Well, young recruit, you're proving to be quite the find. I've got one last task, then we'll let you get some rest."
:Petra Gyle says, "I've just been made aware of a powerful, yet still up-in-coming wizard, in league with Jens. He can occasionally be found in a small house in the Bends."
:Petra Gyle says, "You're to kill him and bring me his head. Pack it in this bag so you don't draw any unwanted attention."
{{ReceiveItem|You receive [[Rune Covered Black Silk Bag]] from [[Petra Gyle]].}}

=== Part 3 ===
Head to the Bends part of [[Night Harbor]]. There is a teleporter just before the north bank that will take you to the shipyard area. Take the teleporter and go left to get to the Bends.

Look for [[Sahir Muzalal]] (level 16); a possible spawn location is the ground floor of the first building cluster on the left. A [[a mercenary magus|mercenary magus]] is the placeholder.

Kill [[Sahir Muzalal]] and loot his [[Bloodied Wizard Head]].

Place his [[Bloodied Wizard Head]] into [[Rune Covered Black Silk Bag]] and click on combine.

Head back to [[Petra Gyle]] and hand her the filled [[Rune Covered Black Silk Bag]].

{{exp}}
''Petra Gyle takes the bag from you, looking at it with disgust.''
:Petra Gyle says, "Good work. He was on his way to becoming a powerful adversary, so it benefits us to be rid of him."
:Petra Gyle says, "For now, consider yourself well on your way down the proper path. Continue to explore the city and familiarize yourself with the people here. If you run into anything suspicious, come back to me. Otherwise, get some rest."
''Petra Gyle plucks a small talisman from her waistband and hands it to you.''
:Petra Gyle says, "And keep this with you."
{{ReceiveItem|You receive [[Spellbinder's Inquisitor Talisman]] from [[Petra Gyle]].}}

Monk Starter Quest (Night Harbor).title: Monk Starter Quest (Night Harbor)
Monk Starter Quest (Night Harbor).content:
{{Quest | imagefilename = phicon.png | width = 100px | caption = Placeholder Image |Start Zone = [[Night Harbor]] |Quest Giver = - |Minimum Level = 1 |Classes = [[Monk]] |Related NPCs = [[Chahaya Tam]] }} __TOC__ == Reward == * Experience
  • [[First Degree Fourfold Sash (Monk)]]
== Walkthrough == === Part 1: First Degree === Read [[Humble Note]] you start with as a new Monk Character: 
Dear ,

You are invited to come train at the School of the
Fourfold Path.

If you're not afraid to push your body to the brink
and test the limits of your endurance, deliver this
note to Chahaya Tam, one of the masters of our
school.

Bring nothing more than the clothes on your back
and your bare fists. The more calloused, the better.

The school is located in Twilight Harbor, directly
south of Saltbreeze Park. If you see elementals
floating about, you'll know you're close.

Train and Fight! Seek discipline! Always pursue
your highest self!
'''Hand [[Humble Note|Humble Note]] to [[Chahaya Tam|Chahaya Tam]]'''
{{exp}} :Chahaya Tam takes the note from you, furrowing her brow. : Chahaya Tam says, "You wish to train with our order?" :Chahaya Tam bows deeply. : Chahaya Tam says, "Welcome to the School of the Fourfold Path, where one can refine their body and mind, and seek a connection with the four elements. I am Master Chahaya Tam, I lead this order, alongside my husband, Tenebrim. You have done well to seek us out, as there are no greater adepts of the pugilist arts within this city than us." :Chahaya Tam reaches out, and clasps your shoulder, her grip tight, yet you can tell she is holding back some of her strength within her corded muscles. : Chahaya Tam says, "Let's get started. For your initial training, I would like you to approach and challenge some of our students to a sparring match. They will not hold back, and I do not expect you to, either. If they know you down, the match will be over, but you can return to spar later when you have honed your skill. If you have further questions about the matches, just ask about them. All of us in the order have had to pass through this trial by fire, so to speak." : Chahaya Tam says, "Wear your belt, so they know you as a fellow student, and speak to them to start sparring. Recover a training emblem from them. When you have bested three of our students, return to me, along with your belt. Train and fight!" :Chahaya Tam bows to you once again, clasping her fist in her open hand. You receive [[Fourfold Sash (Monk)|Fourfold Sash]] from [[Chahaya Tam]].

'''Hail [[a strong sparring monk]] and say "let's spar", then proceed to defeat 3 of them.'''
: Loot [[Training Emblem]] from each corpse.

'''Hand all 3 [[Training Emblem]] and your [[Fourfold Sash (Monk)|Fourfold Sash]] to [[Chahaya Tam]]'''
{{exp}}
Your faction standing with School of the Fourfold Path got better. : Chahaya Tam says, "Wonderful! Wasn't it an exhilarating experience? Do not worry, your bruises will heal in time." :Chahaya Tam clasps her hand against your back. : Chahaya Tam says, "Your first victories! I am proud of you and present you with your new belt, marking you as a member of the First Degree." :Chahaya Tam ties the sash around your waist, affixing a single seal to it. : Chahaya Tam says, "Wear it with pride, " : Chahaya Tam says, "Now, go and get some training. Once you have a few more matches under your belt, and have spent time with your fellow adventurers, come to me for your next task." You receive [[First Degree Fourfold Sash (Monk)|First Degree Fourfold Sash]] from [[Chahaya Tam]].

=== Part 2 : Second Degree - Req. Lvl 3 === [[Category:Quests]] [[Category:Night Harbor Quests]] [[Category:Monk Quests]] '''Hail Chahaya Tam once you've completed part 1''' : Chahaya Tam says, "Ah, excellent, ! You've returned for training." : Chahaya Tam says, "Your journey has just started. It'll be a long time before you gain full control of your mind and body." : Chahaya Tam says, "For your next challenge, I have something different in mind. Less safe... but more thrilling!" : Chahaya Tam says, "Are you excited?" '''Reply with Yes.''' : Chahaya Tam says, "I expected no less of you, !" :Chahaya Tam cheers you on. : Chahaya Tam says, "I want you to head out to the desert and face off against ashira scouts. They're formidable masters of physicality, so there's much you can learn from defeating them." : Chahaya Tam says, "Or if you truly wish to test yourself, you can engage the ashira lookouts just beyond the city borders." : Chayaha Tam says, "Bring me back three of their necklaces to prove you've beaten them in martial combat."
'''Hand in 3 [[Ashira Scout Necklace|Ashira Scout Necklaces]] and your [[Fourfold Sash (Monk)|Fourfold Sash]] to [[Chahaya Tam]]'''
: Chahaya Tam says, "Well done, . You're an inspiration to other students already." Chahaya Tam smiles at you warmly. : Chahaya Tam says, "This belt marks you as a second-degree monk of the Fourfold Path! But don't neglect your training. It has only just begun!"
You receive [[Second Degree Fourfold Sash (Monk)|Second Degree Fourfold Sash]] from Chahaya Tam.
{{exp}}
Your faction standing with School of the Fourfold Path got better. === Part 3 : Third Degree - Req. Lvl 5 === [[Category:Quests]] [[Category:Night Harbor Quests]] [[Category:Monk Quests]] : Chahaya Tam says, "! There you are." : Chahaya Tam says, "I see a few additional scars... you must have been out training. Good!" : Chahaya Tam says, "We've been honing your physical prowess, but today, you're going to work on another side of yourself. Your mind needs to be one with your body." : Chahaya Tam says, "We need you to head into the sweltering heat of the Shaded Dunes and find the refreshing Waterfall of Serenity." : Chahaya Tam says, "Do you feel up to the task? Hand me your belt if so. I'll check it for wear and tear." '''Hand your belt to Chahaya Tam.''' :Chahaya Tam smiles at you. : Chahaya Tam says, "I can see you've taken good care of it." :Chahaya Tam pats you on the shoulder and hands it back to you. : You receive Second Degree Fourfold Sash from Chahaya Tam. : Chahaya Tam says, "Take this elixir and be on your way. Remember, this is a test of the mind, not the body." : You receive [[Elixir of Mental Focus]] from Chahaya Tam. Where to go: {{spoiler | Shaded Dunes is the next zone west of Night Harbor.
The waterfall is in an oasis-looking area on the western side of the zone.
The easiest way to find it is to follow the road from the zone almost to the next zone (Fallen Pass). | You'll see the oasis on your left.

When you get to the right place alongside the water: | :The serene waterfall gently flows down the dune into the oasis below. It seems to match Chahaya's description. }} '''Note: You must stand on solid ground; if you are swimming, the attacks will kill you.''' '''Drink the [[Elixir of Mental Focus]].''' : a familiar shadow says, "Come on, hit me. You know you want to."
'''Do not attack! Simply stand there. All damage will be "absorbed" and not hurt you.'''
:a familiar shadow offers a vague smile as it coalesces into the shape of a medallion, resting into the hand of the monk who passed their trial. Note: You will now find a [[Worn Medallion]] in your inventory. Go back and hand the medallion together with your belt to Chahaya Tam.

: Chahaya Tam beams with pride. : Chahaya Tam says, "Wonderful, trainee. You've manage to overcome your fears and focus your mind to the limit of its current capabilities!" : Chahaya Tam says, "I'm truly delighted to award yo with the rank of third-degree monk!" : {{exp}} : You receive [[Third Degree Fourfold Sash (Monk)|Third Degree Fourfold Sash]] from Chahaya Tam. : Your faction standing with School of the Fourfold Path got better. : Chahaya Tam says, "It's no small feat for a trainee to have such control, you should be proud of yourself." : Chahaya Tam says, "Now, be on your way... and keep training! ==Video Overview== {{#ev:youtube|https://youtu.be/TmGHaGug4xQ?list=PLutdYUPa-Xeei2T70-n0NfSTUjji3fHDB}}

Necromancer Starter Quest (Night Harbor).title: Necromancer Starter Quest (Night Harbor)
Necromancer Starter Quest (Night Harbor).content:
{{Quest | imagefilename = phicon.png | width = 100px | caption = Placeholder Image |Start Zone = [[Night Harbor]] |Quest Giver = - |Minimum Level = 1 |Classes = [[Necromancer]] |Related NPCs = [[Marvion Hallows]], [[Sekhmet]], [[Buckmarr Gorstagg]] }} == Reward ==
  • [[Black and Gold Robe]]
  • [[Symbol of the Concourse of Souls]]
== Walkthrough == === Part 1 === Read [[Weathered Note]] you start with as a new Necromancer character: '''You have been summoned to the Concourse of Souls.''' 
Show this note to Marvion Hallows in the Concourse's library to begin your training.

The Concourse is carved into the mountainside of the necropolis. It is accessible through Sageside; simply head north before you enter Saltbreeze Park.

Or, if you're feeling daring, take the shortcut through the old cemetery outside the Black Feather Bazaar.

You may speak with a guard if you get lost; however, exercise caution, as some do not agree with our practices.

And try not to die. We have enough undead in the desert already.
'''Give Weathered Note to [[Marvion Hallows]].''' : Marvion Hallows says, "Oh, a new student! This is worth the interruption, well, as long as you don't make a habit of it. I assume you'll be dealing primarily with Buckmarr, Sekhmet, or one of Exavius's people, as I am quite busy." : Marvion Hallows says, "Given the influx of new students, Sekhmet should be prepared for your arrival. Take your note to him. You'll find him below in the morgue." '''Receive [[Weathered Note]] from Marvion Hallows.''' {{exp}} === Part 2 === '''Give [[Weathered Note]] to [[Sekhmet]] who is also in the Concourse of Souls.''' :Sekhmet smiles at you awkwardly, yet seems genuinely happy to meet you. : Sekhmet says, "Welcome to the Concourse of Souls! As the professor may have mentioned, I am Sekhmet. I will assist you in your studies." : Sekhmet says, "As you can see, we try to keep the morgues well-stocked to accommodate a broad varied range of study. Fortunately, Night Harbor is generous in its donations to our cause... the city produces a lot of dead." :Sekhmet sighs, and then perks up again. : Sekhmet says, "Buckmarr, our alchemist, asked me to gather some materials for him. I genuinely do not enjoy the outdoors, so perhaps you could assist with this? Take this jar and fill it with [[Incarnal Residue]]. Eight should do. Then bring it to Buckmarr." :Sekhmet squints and leans forward, as if expecting a question from you. : Sekhmet says, "You do know what incarnal residue is, do you not?" '''Receive [[Small Clay Jar]] from Sekhmet.''' {{exp}} You say, "No. What is incarnal residue?" : Sekhmet says, "Excellent question! Incarnal residue is the name that Buckmarr has given a fascinating substance he is researching. He is very fond of giving things new names." : Sekhmet says, "The residue can be found on the bones of reanimated skeletons. Though Buckt disagrees, I believe it manifests most commonly when the skeleton's life, or more accurately, animating energy is drained from its corporeal form through necromantic magic." : Sekhmet says, "Keep that in mind." : Sekhmet says, "Good hunting, and do not forget to give the jar to Buckmarr once it has been filled!" === Part 3 === '''Combine 8 [[Incarnal Residue]] in [[Small Clay Jar]] to get a filled Small Clay Jar. Hand it to [[Buckmarr Gorstagg]] in the Concourse of Souls.''' *Newbie Note: if the jar is missing after hitting combine, check your tradeskill containers :Buckmarr Gorstagg stares at you with a puzzled expression. : Buckmarr Gorstagg says, "Ahh, you're new. I bet Sekhmet sent you out so he could continue to hide inside. Did he tell you that this was my discovery?" :Buckmarr Gorstagg holds up the jar proudly. : Buckmarr Gorstagg says, "Well, it was. It's just one of many. I have a knack for alchemical advancement. One day, our modest college will be quite renowned at the rate I'm going." :Buckmarr Gorstagg fetches a simple robe with the guild's cred embroidered on its collar. : Buckmarr Gorstagg says, "Speaking of renown, you may wear this to formalize your association with our fine school." '''Receive [[Black and Gold Robe]] from Buckmarr Gorstagg''' : Buckmarr Gorstagg says, "Now, if you'd like to assist me with another matter, read this list and return it to me along with the materials it describes. These items are vital to my research." '''Receive [[Buckmarr's List]] from Buckmarr Gorstagg''' :Buckmarr Gorstagg pauses to stare at you in a more serious manner. : Buckmarr Gorstagg says, "Except for the pelt, that's a personal matter. I loathe wererats." {{exp}} === Part 4 === ''' Turn in [[Buckmarr's List]] along with [[Wererat Pelt]], [[Corrupted Heart]], [[Ghostly Cloth Scrap]], [[Vibroplasmic Residue]] ''' :Buckmarr Gorstagg examines the pelt for a moment before throwing it over a collection of wererat heads. : Buckmarr Gorstagg says, "Well, I hope that one suffered." :Buckmarr Gorstagg returns his attention to you. : Buckmarr Gorstagg says, "Thank you for the materials. I'll likely need more assistance in the future, but in the meantime, familiarize yourself with the others you'll find here." '''Receive [[Symbol of the Concourse of Souls]] from Buckmarr Gorstagg''' {{exp}} [[Category:Quests]] [[Category:Night Harbor Quests]] [[Category:Necromancer Quests]]

The [[Tel Ekir Warrior Pelt]]s can be obtained in [[Tel Ekir]]. Known sources include [[Ashir the Protector]] and [[an ashira warchief]]. == Notes == * The turn-in only works during the day. * The reward appears to be random. * Do not confuse [[Tel Ekir Warrior Pelt]]s with [[Ashira Warrior Pelt]]s. Ghost Haul.title: Ghost Haul
Ghost Haul.content:
{{Quest | imagefilename = Barkeep Glior.png | width = 300px | caption = Barkeep Glior |Start Zone = [[Shallow Shoals]] |Quest Giver = [[Barkeep Glior]] |Minimum Level = 1 |Classes = All |Related NPCs = N/A }} == Reward == Your faction standing with Cossa Pirates got better. ''Looks to be a large faction gain.''
Your faction standing with Cossa's Crew got better. ''Looks to be a large faction gain.'' == Walkthrough == Barkeep Glior says,"Blast and bother, another shipment's gone missing!" Barkeep Glior says, "Twas supposed to be a regular run from here to the Wreck of the Wanderer. Word is, it just vanished outta thin air..." Barkeep Glior says, "Duval's got his cutlasses out over it. If you can find out what happened, he'll owe you a favor. Just Tell him I sent you and ask about the Ghost Haul."
Go speak to Crowne Duval, up in Captain Jonas Cossa's tent.

Crowne Duval says, "Hand over your finest treasures and the Cossa pirates will let you sail under our protection." You say, "Glinor told me to ask you about the Ghost Haul." Crowne Duval says, "Ah, so you know that damn haul disappeared?! Captain will have my skin if I don't find out what happened quickly." Crowne Duval says, "Care to lend a hand?" You say, "I'll lend a hand." Crowne Duval Says, "I can't leave my post right now, so please travel to the Wreck of the Wanderer, straight north of here beyond the Landing. You can't miss the shipwreck, it has a very high mast still rising from the waters. It's where the deal was to take place." Crowne Duval says, "Find what's happened there!"

Head out to Zaedin's Landing. Head north and there will be a shipwreck near a cluster of rocks.

/Look reveals - This shipwreck appears quite recent. The area is littered with broken crates and bottles, telltale signs of a struggle. ''Could not figure out a prompt that worked to give more information.''

Nearby is Castaway Island. [[Enforcer Gritjaw]] spawns within the bungalow on the island. Kill him and loot [[Crate of Stolen Spices]].

Take [[Crate of Stolen Spices]] back to Crowne Duval.

Crowne Duval says, "Excellent, it still smells fresh!" Crown Duval says, "So some new guys are out there thinkin' they can steal our stuff? Captain needs to hear about it."

''Work in progress'' 6/21/26 - no follow-up noted with any prompts used. Appears to be a faction reward only. [[Category:Quests]] [[Category:Shallow Shoals Quests]]

Landing Loop Quest.content:
{{Quest

== Walkthrough ==

=== Part 1 - Raging Elements Investigation ===

Go to the top of the lighthouse of Zaedin's Landing in Shallow Shoals to find [[Nadim Al-Saraf|Nadim Al-Saraf]]. 

* To get to him you need to get past the locked gate. Go to the inn and say [I am here to help] to [[Barkeep Zahra|Barkeep Zahra]] to get [[Zaedin's Landing Fort Key|Zaedin's Landing Fort Key]] when you have enough faction of Zaedin's Corsairs. 

* If you can't  get the key, there are several rooms beside the locked gate along the ramp, go up the ramp and jump through the window to bypass the gate. You need to be a small-sized race to do that, or you need to find someone to shrink you twice.

* If Nadim is not up, kill [[A Syndicate channeler|A Syndicate channeler]] that roams on the top of the lighthouse to spawn him.

Ask Nadim about the [lighthouse], then tell him [I can help]. He will ask you to find out why elements around this island are growing unstable.

Go to the back of the island and kill [[A raging elemental|A raging elemental]] until you get 4 [[Tainted Elemental Core|Tainted Elemental Core]],  turn in those to Nadim, he will give you Note from Nadim and tell you to go find [[Captain Harkan Saafir|Captain Harkan Saafir]].

=== Part 2 - Goblin Raids ===

Captain Harkan Saafir is halfway to the lighthouse where you reach the first iron gate. Turn left and go upstairs to find him in the room. 

* [[A landing lieutenant|A landing lieutenant]] is his PH and also accepts quest items. 

Turn in the note and he mentions that there are goblins raiding Zaedin's Landing. 

Every 9 pm, several goblins spawn on a small island which lies south of Zaedin's Landing and will head to attack the islanders. And if rain falls at the time, [[Skizzak Darkrain|Skizzak Darkrain]] also spawns. 

* Kill Skizzak and loot [[Command Scroll|Command Scroll]]. 

Turn in the scroll to Captain Harkan Saafir / a Landing lieutenant, he'll instruct you to take the scroll to [[Tariq the Revealer|Tariq the Revealer]] who roams in south side of the buildings on the 2nd floor. 

Give him both the Command Scroll and Note from Nadim, then go back to Nadim with the Command scroll. 

To turn in the scroll to Nadim you'll receive a new Note from Nadim. Take it to Captain Harkan Saafir /  a Landing lieutenant , and you are tasked to scout the goblin island for clues.

=== Part 3 - Goblins in the Ruins ===

Now go to the goblin island, it's to the northeast of Zaedin's Landing. 

You will spot a river inside the island once you get there. 

Take left to the tunnel, find an entrance underwater on your left . It leads you to a cave with two houses. 

Enter the house that with no door by climbing up or jumping through the window (if small-sized race) and get to the room stacked with crates. 

There is a book behind them. Get close and use /take paper to get Hidden Note.

=== Part 4 - Ritual of the Orcs ===

Hand the Hidden Note to Captain Harkan Saafir /  a Landing lieutenant, he then wants you to decrypt the note with Tariq's help. 

Go to Tariq and give him the Hidden Note to receive the Decrypted Note. 

Give Decrypted Note to Captain Harkan Saafir /  a Landing lieutenant, then give it to Nadim. 

Nadim will refresh [[Note from Nadim|Note from Nadim]] in your inventory and task you with killing [[Witchlord Kruurgal|Witchlord Kruurgal]] to disrupt the rituals. 

* Kruurgal spawns in a tower within Black Shoals Fortress,  north of Zaedin's Landing. [[A Witchguard corruptor|A Witchguard corruptor]] is PH

Kill Kruurgal and bring [[Head of Kruurgal the Witchlord|Head of Kruurgal the Witchlord]] to Nadim along with [[Note from Nadim|Note from Nadim]].

* You receive 10 gold from Nadim Al-Saraf.

* You receive [[Landing Loop]] from Nadim Al-Saraf.

Gnomes Next Door.title: Gnomes Next Door
Gnomes Next Door.content: {{Quest | imagefilename = | width = | caption = | Start Zone = [[Underdocks]] | Quest Giver = [[Innkeeper Farda]] | Minimum Level = 1 | Classes = All | Related NPCs = [[Chef Brigit]], [[Barkeeper Tull]] }} == Notes == 2026-09-11 - Possible unfinished or breadcrumb quest. More information is required. [[Innkeeper Farda]] has recently expanded her business by acquiring the building next door from some Deep Gnomes. Farda's employees mention these gnomes may have met an unfortunate demise attempting to sell Mushroom Wood to denizens in [[Night Harbor]]. == Walkthrough == '''This quest begins in the [[Underdocks]] western district inside an inn on the southern rise by speaking with [[Innkeeper Farda]].''' You say, "Hail, Innkeeper Farda." : Innkeeper Farda says, "I have good food and safe rooms. Coins are paid up front for a stay or a meal. And keep your animals outside." : Innkeeper Farda says, "That includes Goblins." You say, "Why do you dislike Goblins?" : Innkeeper Farda says, "They make a mess and only cause trouble. I don't work to lose money." You say, "I want some food" : Innkeeper Farda says, "The dining room is on the second floor. Just head up those stairs behind me and you will smell the food at the top." You say, "I want a room" : Innkeeper Farda says, "Take a look for yourself. Downstairs rooms if you have fewer coin and upstairs if you have more." : Innkeeper Farda says, "And do not mind the current layout. The building next door was a... recent acquisition" You say, "Tell me about your recent acquisition" : Innkeeper Farda says, "The tenants next door fell on hard times. I took on their debt and now this entire building is mine." '''Innkeeper Farda doesn't have much else to share. Head upstairs and chat with [[Barkeeper Tull]].''' You say, "Hail, Barkeeper Tull." : Barkeeper Tull says, "Yes, hail to you too. I haven't much time since I'm ferrying plates up and down these stairs all day." You say, "Why are you ferrying plates up and down these stairs all day?" : Barkeeper Tull says, "It wasn't so bad before Farda kicked those gnomes out of the unit next door. The kitchen used to be so close, but more rooms to sleep means more coins to keep, so now I'm burning my legs going up and down all day." You say, "Who were the gnomes?" : Barkeeper Tull says, "Bad business that. But Farda had her eye on that unit for a while." : Barkeeper Tull says, "They always thought they could make it big bringing shroom wood above ground but... well, we see how that went." '''Tull does not provide much more information, but he does respond to inquiries about his colleagues.''' You say, "Who is Farda?" : Barkeeper Tull says, "She owns this inn. Not much humor in her, but she keeps me well employed." '''Head outside into the adjacent building and speak with [[Chef Brigit]]''' You say, "Hail, Chef Brigit." : Chef Brigit says, "Are you lost? You don't look like a new server. This is my kitchen and I don't need you sneaking a taste of my meals." You say, "I am a new server" : Chef Brigit looks you up and down, unimpressed. : Chef Brigit says, "Why don't you go in the other entrance and talk to Farda. She can help you." : Chef Brigit says, "She runs this place. If you need a room, go speak with her. And don't try to bargain with her or she'll raise the prices on you." : Chef Brigit waves her hands at you in an impatient gesture. : Chef Brigit says, "Off with you now, shoo!" You say, "Tell me about Barkeeper Tull" : Chef Brigit says, "Where is that rascal? I have three meals waiting to go upstairs." '''You can return to [[Barkeeper Tull]] and he responds to an inquiry about Brigit, but doesn't share anything else.''' You say, "Who is Brigit?" : Barkeeper Tull says, "You'll find her in the kitchen. I try not to spend much time there. It gets too hot for me." More information is required == Reward == ??

Munk Family Recipe.title: Munk Family Recipe
Munk Family Recipe.content: {{Quest | imagefilename = | width = | caption = | Start Zone = [[Underdocks]] | Quest Giver = [[Munk]] | Minimum Level = 1 | Classes = ALL | Related NPCs = }} == Notes == 2026-09-11 - Possible flavor dialogue only, or an unfinished or breadcrumb quest. More information is required. == Walkthrough == '''This quest begins in the [[Underdocks]] citadel district by talking with a meat vendor, [[Munk]].''' You say, "Hail, Munk." : Munk says, "Welcome to Munk's Meats! Big food for big appetites!" : Munk looks around and raises his voice to a boom. : Munk says, "Small butchers won't cut you portions to fill, only portions to sit on a scale!" : Munk slaps his belly with both hands. : Munk says, "If you're hungry, I'll cook you a slab you can feed your whole family with! And no brick-sitting butcher can tell you otherwise!" You say, "What is in your meat?" : Munk says, "It's good meat! Tasty with spices and enough to fill you up for your adventures. The contents are my... secret family recipe." You say, "How can I learn your secret family recipe?" : Munk says, "Buy something or step aside for other customers. I have meat to sell!" '''Munk sells [[Munk's Meat]] for 5 copper each.''' '''Around the corner is another meat shop staffed by [[Apprentice Millen]] and [[Ebba Dungor]].''' You say, "Hail, Apprentice Millen." : Apprentice Millen says, "Welcome to my master's shop. She trained for two decades in Darra Nor, learning the cut, handling, and presentation of delicate meats. The nobility and common folk alike come to her for her skills." : Apprentice Millen frowns slightly. : Apprentice Millen says, "Well, not as many common folk anymore..." You say, "What is Darra Nor?" : Apprentice Millen says, "It's rather far off. I've never been there myself but the stories my Master told me make it sound like a welcoming place." You say, "What nobility?" : Apprentice Millen says, "Oh yes, most of our orders come from the nobility. They, at least, have a discerning taste for quality." : Apprentice Millen frowns slightly. : Apprentice Millen says, "Well, not as many common folk anymore..." You say, "Who is your master?" : Apprentice Millen points towards [[Ebba Dungor]]. : Apprentice Millen says, "She's right over there. She can help you if you need anything more." '''Speak with [[Ebba Dungor]].''' You say, "Hail, Ebba Dungor." : Ebba Dungor says, "You'll find no cleaner cuts in the Underdocks! And I don't pad my wares with... dubious meats like other butchers." Handing Ebba or Millen a piece of [[Munk's Meat]] does not yield any further text. This may just be flavor conversations between two rival butchers. More information is required == Reward == ??

Mining Picks for Hull.title: Mining Picks for Hull
Mining Picks for Hull.content: {{Quest | imagefilename = | width = | caption = | Start Zone = [[Underdocks]] | Quest Giver = [[Hull Orbel]] | Minimum Level = | Classes = ALL | Related NPCs = }} == Notes == This quest is repeatable. == Rewards == * Experience * 2 Silver, 18 Copper * Random piece of [[Patched Rawhide]] armor or [[Patched Cloth]] * Faction with [[Delvestone Mining Company]], [[The Underwatch]], [[Citizens of Underdocks]] == Walkthrough == '''This quest begins in the [[Underdocks]] upper city district by talking with [[Hull Orbel]]. Hull is located near the Delvestone miners on the northeast side of the upper city.''' You say, "Hail, Hull Orbel." : Hull Orbel says, "Bandits! Blaggards! Mold-eating malefactors!" You say, "What bandits?" : Hull Orbel says, "Aye! The Deepcut are murderers and thieves. Indeed!" You say, "Who are the deepcut?" : Hull Orbel says, "Reptiles! Ruffians! Every last one of 'em. Darrowdwell is ours to mine by right." : Hull Orbel shakes his head. : Hull Orbel says, "Say, whip the rascals and I'll pay you handsomely for four reclaimed mining picks!" You say, "Where is Darrowdwell?" : Hull Orbel says, "Aye, the mine is just beneath yer feet. Full of precious gems and ores, if it weren't for those profiteers. Parasites!" '''[[Hull Orbel]] is looking for [[Delvestone Mining Pick]] from the Deepcut miners, which can be found in the mines on the rafters level. Take the elevator directly across from Hull Orbel on the southeast side of the wooden bridge.''' '''Note that [[Broken Mining Pick]] will NOT work for this quest.''' '''Upon handing in 4 [[Delvestone Mining Pick]] to Hull Orbel...''' {{exp}} : Hull Orbel laughs heartily. : Hull Orbel says, "Ye've done it! Curse the assassins! Earthworms! Take this as a token of our appreciation." Your faction standing with [[Delvestone Mining Company]] got better. Your faction standing with [[The Underwatch]] got better. Your faction standing with [[Citizens of Underdocks]] got better. Your faction standing with [[Deepcut Bandits]] got worse. You receive [[Patched Rawhide]] or [[Patched Cloth]] from Hull Orbel. You receive 3 silver, 18 copper from Hull Orbel.

== Overview ==
The introductory class quest line for Necromancers starting in the Underdocks under the banner of Ygorath.

== Walkthrough ==

=== Part 1 ===

Read the [[Folded Note]] you start with as a new Necromancer Character.


You can find [[Soren Akedd]]... {{spoiler| in the tunnel in the southeast corner of [[Underdocks]]. Soren is in the first room inside the temple.}}


Hand [[Folded Note]] to [[Soren Akedd]].

:Soren Akedd says, "You have done well to come when called, [Player]. This is the House of Ygorath, which you may call home, if you are deemed worthy to carry out his work."

{{exp}}
{{Faction|The Trembling Hand|+}}


You say, 'Hail, Soren Akedd'

:Soren Akedd says, "You appear before me as you were in my nightmare, [Player]."

You say, 'What nightmare?'

:Soren Akedd says, "Nightmares are visits from Ygorath, gifted upon the fearful of this land. It was my nightmare that called you here to begin his work."

You say, 'Ygorath'

:Soren Akedd says, "He is the fear and the terror that opens our eyes."

''A black bat screeches as it swoops in to attack Soren Akedd!''

You say, 'What work?'

:Soren Akedd says, "It is the work of trembling hands to raise both the living and the dead upon his altar. It is for their salvation as much as our own."
:Soren Akedd says, "Many souls walk Eth-ur practicing feints of valor, but Ygorath's wisdom knows bravery to be a thin sheen upon a bottomless terror. We must usher them into his kingdom with right fear in their hearts."
:Soren Akedd says, "This you must do, Necromancer, whether by sign or by sword. If you pass the test."

You say, 'What test?'

:Soren Akedd says, "The rabble fear in their blood and their bones. Ours are borne by Ygorath. This is your test: take this Effigy to the chapel and make of it an offering. Place your effigy upon the altar and receive Ygorath's blessing. Return with what remains."
{{ReceiveItem|You receive [[Strange Effigy]].}}
:Soren Akedd says, "But I must warn you... cast your gaze downward and look not upon the visage of Ygorath."


Go to the chapel and (while holding the [[Strange Effigy]] on your cursor) type "/place effigy" near the altar.

''As the effigy leaves your fingers, it turns to ash without flame.''
{{ReceiveItem|You receive [[Offering Bowl]].}}


Return to [[Soren Akedd]] and turn in the [[Offering Bowl]].

:Soren Akedd says, "Your eyes are open. Take this drape and rise a new servant of Ygorath."

{{exp}}
{{Faction|The Trembling Hand|+}}
{{Faction|The Dreaming Dawn|-}}
{{ReceiveItem|You receive [[Ragged Robe]] from Soren Akedd.}}


:Soren Akedd says, "Now go, and do his work. I believe Abbot Harrow has tasks suited to an aspirant such as yourself. You may find him below."

=== Part 2 ===
Head to the lower level of the building and locate [[Abbot Harrow]].

You say, 'Hail, Abbot Harrow'

''Abbot Harrow rifles through a stack of manuscripts.''
:Abbot Harrow says, "Are you the new aspirant?"

You say, 'I am the new aspirant'

:Abbot Harrow says, "Yes, you have that look about you. Like a beaten dog. You might even be commended for tucking tail in the master's temple, but you must learn to stand upright if you are to walk the path."
:Abbot Harrow says, "Fortunate for you, I have a task suitable for a pup."

You say, 'What task?'

:Abbot Harrow says, "Our work requires material. Test yourself against the risen dead outside the temple."
:Abbot Harrow says, "Take this satchel and collect four femurs. Combine and deliver them to my pupil, Vryar."
{{ReceiveItem|You receive [[Femur Satchel]] from Abbot Harrow.}}

You say, 'Where is Vryar?'

:Abbot Harrow says, "He should be in the cemetery, where he communes with the dead."

=== Part 3 ===
Kill [[A Risen Skeleton|risen skeletons]] outside the temple to collect 4 [[Brittle Femur|femurs]]. Place all four inside the [[Femur Satchel]] and combine them to create a [[Full Femur Satchel]].

Find [[Acolyte Vryar]] in the cemetery and hand him the [[Full Femur Satchel]].

{{exp}}
{{Faction|The Trembling Hand|+}}
:Acolyte Vryar says, "Ah, a delivery. Sister Morvea and I will put these to good use."
''Acolyte Vryar scrawls a note in his journal and tears out the page.''
:Acolyte Vryar says, "Take this receipt and thank the Abbot for giving you this opportunity. Our paths will cross again."
{{ReceiveItem|You receive [[Delivery Receipt]].}}

Return to [[Abbot Harrow]] and give him the [[Delivery Receipt]].

{{exp}}
{{Faction|The Trembling Hand|+}}
:Abbot Harrow says, "I am glad to see you did not embarrass yourself today. There will be future opportunities."
:Abbot Harrow says, "Until that day comes, heed the word of Ygorath."
''Abbot Harrow sighs and hands you a book.''
{{ReceiveItem|You receive [[Beaten Tome]].}}

=== Part 4 ===
*Level 5 Required*
You say, 'Hail, Abbot Harrow'

:Abbot Harrow says, "If you wish to make yourself useful, seek an audience with Lady Tabitha. You will find her in the laboratory upstairs."

Go upstairs to the laboratory and locate [[Lady Tabitha]].

You say, 'Hail, Lady Tabitha'

''Lady Tabitha hums to herself.''
:Lady Tabitha says, "Oh, here's a new one. Who sent you to me? Or have you become a nuisance of your own volition?"

You say, 'Abbot'

:Lady Tabitha says, "Indeed! Each somehow less promising than the last, it seems. No matter. If you can furnish the ingredients I require, I will endorse your aspiration."

You say, 'What ingredients?'

:Lady Tabitha says, "The embalmers keep me busy. Venture into the caverns beyond the Underdocks and fetch me as many spider eyes as this will carry."
{{ReceiveItem|You receive [[Deepweb Eye Bag]].}}
:Lady Tabitha says, "Undamaged, if you please."

Hunt spiders in the nearby caverns, place their eyes in the [[Deepweb Eye Bag]], and combine to form a full bag. Turn the bag in to [[Lady Tabitha]].

{{exp}}
{{Faction|The Trembling Hand|+}}
:Lady Tabitha says, "I thank you, Necromancer. The work continues. Give this letter to Abbot Harrow as a sign of your progress."
{{ReceiveItem|You receive [[Alchemist's Reference Letter]].}}

Return to [[Abbot Harrow]] and give him the [[Alchemist's Reference Letter]] along with your [[Beaten Tome]].

{{exp}}
{{Faction|The Trembling Hand|+}}
''Abbot Harrow unfolds the letter.''
:Abbot Harrow says, "You continue to make yourself useful. Hand me the alchemist's letter along with your tome of Ygorath, and I will augment its power."
:Abbot Harrow says, "May the word of Ygorath guide you on the path."
{{ReceiveItem|You receive [[Well-Thumbed Tome]].}}

=== Part 5 ===
''Requirement: Level 13''

You say, 'Hail, Abbot Harrow'

:Abbot Harrow says, "Embalmer Tyriel has need of your services. Find him below."

Head downstairs to find [[Embalmer Tyriel]].

You say, 'Hail, Embalmer Tyriel'

:Embalmer Tyriel says, "I have a task suitable for an aspirant who has mastered the gifts of Ygorath."

You say, 'What task?'

:Embalmer Tyriel says, "Use your gifts to spread Ygorath's fear in the Deep."
:Embalmer Tyriel says, "Take this and fill it with [[Elder Shadowbone Marrow]] and the blood of Deepcut bandits. Three samples of each will suffice. And remember, they must die in [[fear]]."

(You must cast [[Terrify the Dead]] to get [[Elder Shadowbone Marrow]], other effects such as [[Fear]] does not work)

{{ReceiveItem|You receive [[Collection Box]].}}

Elder shadowbones spawn on the west side of the northern gate.

Deepcut bandits spawn on the east side of the northern gate.

Collect 3 Elder Shadowbone Marrows and 3 Deepcut Bandit Bloods, place them inside the [[Collection Box]], and combine to obtain the [[Full Collection Box]].

Return and give the [[Full Collection Box]] to [[Embalmer Tyriel]].

{{exp}}
{{Faction|The Trembling Hand|+}}
:Embalmer Tyriel says, "Ygorath's gifts sustain us. Deliver these to Lady Tabitha upstairs to aid her work and our salvation."
{{ReceiveItem|You receive [[Full Collection Box]].}}

Bring the [[Full Collection Box]] upstairs to [[Lady Tabitha]].

:Lady Tabitha says, "A delivery! Let's see."
''Lady Tabitha opens the box and inhales deeply.''
:Lady Tabitha says, "How delightful. With this material I can distill the humors needed to brew our strongest potions. But I require another ingredient, still."
{{ReceiveItem|You receive [[Fearful Humors]].}}

You say, 'What ingredient?'

:Lady Tabitha says, "An abomination has been sighted roaming beyond the Underdocks. Few aspirants who have tried to hunt the creature have returned, and they say it cannot know fear."
:Lady Tabitha says, "Bring me the shriveled heart of this ghoul, as well as the fearful humors. See that you do not join your fallen brothers and sisters. My work must continue."

Hunt [[An Abominable Ghoul]], which wanders near the elder shadowbones.
''Note: He is immune to Fear, but can be Snared. Exercise caution as roaming around elder shadowbones can trigger additional adds; bring a group if necessary.''

Loot the [[Shriveled Ghoul Heart]] and hand both it and the [[Fearful Humors]] to [[Lady Tabitha]].

{{exp}}
{{Faction|The Trembling Hand|+}}
:Lady Tabitha says, "How unnatural."
:Lady Tabitha says, "Thank Ygorath for your gifts. Present this letter to Tyriel, along with your tome of Ygorath."
{{ReceiveItem|You receive [[Tabitha's Letter]].}}

Return to [[Embalmer Tyriel]] in the crypt. Hand him [[Tabitha's Letter]] along with your [[Well-Thumbed Tome]].

{{exp}}
{{Faction|The Trembling Hand|+}}
:Embalmer Tyriel says, "You have earned the privilege to carry these sacred words. Perhaps the day will come when you can seek the lost manuscripts of Sakrel with the rest of your ilk."
{{ReceiveItem|You receive [[Oblate's Tome]].}}

{{Quest | imagefilename = Sinastin Aspenleaf.png | width = 300px | caption = Sinastin Aspenleaf |Start Zone = [[Night Harbor]] |Quest Giver = [[Sinastin Aspenleaf]] |Minimum Level = 1 |Classes = [[Rogue]] |Related NPCs = [[Sinastin Aspenleaf]], [[Albrecht]], [[Customs Inspector Bakari]], [[Captain Eilionoir]], [[Nerida Thinblade]], [[Dilshad Abolfazl]], [[Guard Andreu]], [[Maheed the Butcher]], [[Irfan Raz]], [[Stumpy the Whistler]], [[Sproggets Bedsprings]], [[Selyst Surecoin]] }} == Reward == * ''Experience''

  • [[Mark of the Lamplighters]]
