== Walkthrough == Read Torn Note you start with as a new Rogue character: 
Deliver this note to Sinastin Aspinleaf in Night
Harbor to begin your association with the
Lamplighters.

You will find him in the City Illuminators' Guild,
which is located on the edge of the Night Market.
The City Illuminators' Guild serves as a front fro
his operation there.

To find the market, enter the city and then keep
an eye out for a large archway containing what
appears to be a massive red gemstone.

If you can't spot what looks like the largest ruby
in the world, odds are you're not going to make a
good rogue.

If you get lost, ask a guard for directions to the
City Illuminators' Guild. But, it's prolly not wise
to ask where all the rogues are hiding. And it's
time for you to be wise. Otherwise Irfan will
leave you floating in the harbor.

Good luck with Sinastin's Crew.

You're going to need it.
'''Give Torn Note to [[Sinastin Aspenleaf]].''' {{exp}} :Sinastin Aspenleaf examines the note. : Sinastin Aspenleaf says, "Ah yes... welcome to my humble organization. The Lamplighters are honored to add such a..." :Sinastin Aspenleaf looks at you for a moment and appears to think. : Sinastin Aspenleaf says, "...wonderful find, such as yourself, to our roster." : Sinastin Aspenleaf says, "The note you just handed me means that, while you may be new, you're already trusted enough to start earning your keep." :Sinastin Aspenleaf snickered to himself when he said the word trusted. : Sinastin Aspenleaf says, "The courier I was going to send out today is no longer with us. So, please take list and read the names written therein. Let me know if you have any questions about these people." :Sinastin Aspenleaf smiles at you with a perfect, but unpleasant smile. ''You receive [[Sinastin's List of Names]] Sinastin Aspenleaf.'' : Sinastin Aspenleaf says, "Now, show that note to Albrecht on the way out. He'll give you what you need." : Sinastin Aspenleaf says, "Once you have gathered all of our gifts, take the bag to Albrecht to inventory and bring the receipt to me when he's finished."

'''You are tasked with retrieving items from six NPCs across Night Harbor. Read [[Sinastin's List of Names]] and then give it to [[Albrecht]] in the next room.''' :Albrecht looks at the note and hands over a bag and several seal notes. ''You receive [[Small Courier Bag (Rogue)|Small Courier Bag]] from Albrecht.'' ''You receive [[Sealed Note for Bakari]] from Albrecht.'' ''You receive [[Sealed Note for Mafeed]] from Albrecht.'' ''You receive [[Sealed Note for Dilshad]] from Albrecht.'' ''You receive [[Sealed Note for Nerida]] from Albrecht.'' ''You receive [[Sealed Note for Eilionoir]] from Albrecht.'' ''You receive [[Sealed Note for Andreu]] from Albrecht.'' : Albrecht says, "Toss those sealed notes into the bag I gave you and don't try to open them. Nor should you open the packages you get in return. Nosey people don't fare well here." : Albrecht says, "Well, my new friend. I wish you the best of luck." : Albrecht says, "I hope you last longer than the last guy." : Albrecht says, "Oh, and here's your list of names back." ''You receive [[Sinastin's List of Names]] from Albrecht.''

'''Go and locate the following NPCs and retrieve the requested items.''' * [[Customs Inspector Bakari]] Located in the Harbor by the [[Harbormaster Daoud]]. * [[Captain Eilionoir]] Located in "The Changing of the Guard". A bar on the ramp down when leaving Sageside heading towards west gate. An off duty guard is outside. {{exp}}
:Captain Eilionoir takes the note and quickly places it out of sight under the bar. :Captain Eilionoir sighs with a frown. :Captain Eilionoir glances around before speaking. : Captain Eilionoir says, "There are a lot of new faces since my time in the City Watch. Some of them are taking a little longer to warm up to me, but soon I'll have another roster ready to go." ''You receive Sealed Scroll from Captain Eilionoir'' : Captain Eilionoir says, "Now drink this and get out of here before anyone gets suspicious." ''You receive Twilight Bay Rum from Captain Eilionoir''

* [[Nerida Thinblade]] Located in the "Spirit Tap," a bar in the Black Feather Bazaar (in the Necropolis area). '''Hand [[Nerida Thinblade]] the [[Sealed Note for Nerida]].
{{exp}}
:Nerida Thinblade reads through the note, then tosses it under the bar. :Nerida Thinblade smiles at you wickedly, her eyes briefly wide with amusement. : Nerida Thinblade says, "Well, that contained an interesting enough proposition." : Nerida Thinblade says, "Give this to your master, he'll be happy I got it back in one piece. Make sure it arrives that way." ''You receive Small Wrapped Box from Nerida Thinblade'' : Nerida Thinblade says, "And, my new friend, here's a drunk for the walk back." ''You receive Black Feather Whiskey from Nerida Thinblade''

* [[Dilshad Abolfazl]] Located in the Tannery.

* [[Guard Andreu]] Overlooking the Naval Shipyard (near the garrison) during the day. '''Hand [[Guard Andreu]] the [[Sealed Note for Andreu]].
{{exp}}
:Guard Andreu glances around and quickly tucks the note into his tunic. :Guard Andreu motions for you to lean closer. :Guard Andreu stubly slips you a key. ''You receive Small Iron Key from Guard Andreu'' : Guard Andreu says, "Now piss off."

* [[Mafeed the Butcher]] Located in the Night Market.

'''When you have collected all six items combine them inside the [[Small Courier Bag (Rogue)|Small Courier Bag]]. Turn in the combined [[Small Courier Bag (Rogue Combined)|Small Courier Bag]] to [[Albrecht]].''' {{exp}} :Albrecht dumps the bag's contents on the table and opens the packages. : Albrecht says, "One hand. Check. Wait.. is the tattoo.." :Albrecht turns the hand over. : Albrecht says, "Oh! There it is. Check." : Albrecht says, "A bar of gold..." :Albrecht weighs the gold. : Albrecht says, "Check." :Albrecht examines Nerida's package. : Albrecht says, "Umbral transducer. Good to see you again. Check." :Albrecht scans Eilionoir's scroll. : Albrecht says, "Well that means a change of plans, but... guard schedule. Check." :Albrecht dumps the contents of Bakari's pouch. : Albrecht says, "Oh my!" :Albrecht holds a red gem up to the light. : Albrecht says, "Rubies, Check." :Albrecht reaches for the key, but appears to swap it with a key he had hidden in his palm. :Albrecht shifts his eyes to you for a moment, before looking back to his ledger. : Albrecht says, "The tower key. Check." : Albrecht says, "Well, it looks like everything is accounted for. Take the receipt to Sinastin... and keep your mouth shut." ''You receive [[Albrecht's Receipt]] from Albrecht.''

'''Give the receipt to Sinastin''' :Sinastin takes the receipt and reads it carefully. : Sinastin Aspenleaf says, "Well it looks like we've received everything we expected. I trust that everything went smoothly." : Sinastin Aspenleaf says, "I'd like for you to deliver the list to Irfan. You probably saw him on the way in." ''You receive [[Sinastan's Note]] from Sinastin Aspenleaf'' : Sinastin Aspenleaf says, "If you're unfamiliar with our formidable friend... well, to put it simply, he's an avatar of violence. He may not be as sneaky as some of the others, but he is absolute in his loyalty." : Sinastin Aspenleaf says, "Irfan is not 'sneaky peaky' like you and many others within our organization. Irfan is an avatar of violence. But, he is absolute in his loyalty." : Sinastin Aspenleaf says, "...And loyalty is a good trait to have around here. I'd advise against crossing me." :Sinastin Aspenleaf stares at you coldly for a moment, then suddenly smiles. : Sinastin Aspenleaf says, "Off with you, then! You don't want to keep Irfan waiting... he isn't known for his patience."

'''Give the note to [[Irfan Raz]], located right outside the Illuminators' Guild.''' :Irfan Raz glances at the list and then tucks it away. : Irfan Raz says, "You'll need this, so hang on to it." ''You receive [[Irfan's Dagger]] from Irfan Raz'' : Irfan Raz says, "Sinastin needs you to do three things for him." : Irfan Raz says, "If you are caught by the guards, you'll not speak of this work. If you do, we will know. Understand?" :Irfan Raz looks at you with a vaguely threatening expression. : Irfan Raz says, "I'll take that as a yes. Bring this parchment to Stumpy at one of his posts in the market. He has the first job for you." ''You receive [[Irfan's Parchment]] from Irfan Raz.'' : Irfan Raz says, "When you're done, return to me my dagger to me, along with proof you have completed the task."

'''Give Irfan's Parchment to [[Stumpy the Whistler]], standing by the cobbler in the Night Market. He can also be in the left stall when entering Night Market from the west bank. Rumor is he roams at times. Be sure to look around the bridge to Twilight Harbor as you leave the South East corner of Night Market.''' [[File:Stumpy area.png|thumb|stumpy by night market]] :Stumpy the Whistler looks at the writing on the parchment, then shakes his head with a sigh. :Stumpy the Whistler pulls out his quill and begins to sketch something. :Stumpy the Whistler shows you a crude drawing of the god Haradrel and a dagger prying a gem from its face. :Stumpy the Whistler points at the drawing, then to you. :Stumpy the Whistler scribbles a new image of a small tower on top of what looks like the Steel Talons Garrison. :Stumpy the Whistler continues drawing, this time of a building with the words Sproggets' Adventuring Goods. :Stumpy the Whistler finally jots down a picture of a grappling hook on the parchment's corner, then tears it off. :Stumpy the Whistler hands it to you and motions for you to give it to Sproggets. ''You receive a [[Piece of Parchment (Rogue)|Piece of Parchment]] from Stumpy the Whistler.''


'''Give the Piece of Parchment to [[Sproggets Bedsprings]], located in the shop next to the northwest entrance to the Night Market.''' :Sproggets Bedsprings glances over the illustration of the piece of parchment. :Sproggets Bedsprings purses his lips, then sighs deeply. ''You receive [[Worn Grappling Hook]] from Sproggets Bedsprings.'' : Sproggets Bedsprings says, "Okay, I'll give you the goods. But you didn't get it from me." : Sproggets Bedsprings says, "I'm neutral in all of this... just an innocent gnome trying to earn some coin." : Sproggets Bedsprings says, "Do you even know how to use this thing? Look for a good place to climb, throw the grappling hook, then climb. That's all there is to it. Look, throw, and away you go." : Sproggets Bedsprings says, "Now, out with ya! ...But maybe bring it back when you're done with it."

'''Go to the Steel Talons Garrison onto the roof of the southern structure overlooking the west gate newbie yard. There is a small tower-like section with no roof.''' [[File:SteelTalonsRoof.png|300px|right|thumb|Steel Talons Garrison roof tower, where you use the grappling hook.]] : /Look at the base of the tower for the message, :You feel you could climb this wall with the proper equipment. : While holding the grappling hook "/throw wall" :You begin to ascend the wall... :After a few brief seconds you will see :You reached the top of the wall. : Drop down into the tower.(DONT drop into room below until you /pry eye) You will see a statue below you. While holding your [[Irfan's Dagger] type "/pry eye" :You pry the bloodstone free from the statue. ''You receive [[Haradrel's Bloodstone Eye]]'' : Your faction standing with the Priests of Haradrel got worse.

'''Give the [[Haradrel's Bloodstone Eye]] and [[Irfan's Dagger]] to [[Irfan Raz]].''' :Irfan Raz rolls the gem around in his hand and almost appears to smirk. : Irfan Raz says, "Let's hope you didn't just catch notice of the God of War." : Irfan Raz says, "For your next job, pay a visit to Whispering Wallace at the Shaded Bloom Inn. He'll be drinking there at night. Show him my dagger so he knows I sent you." ''You receive [[Irfan's Dagger]] from Irfan Raz.'' : Irfan Raz says, "And like before, return with my dagger and proof of your deed."

'''Give [[Irfan's Dagger]] to [[Whispering Wallace]].''' :Whispering Wallace looks around quickly and motions for you to speak softly. : Whispering Wallace says, "I've gathered word that Pasha Patrice has a special guest at her compound. The guest is an emissary from Tarellon who's travelling through Night Harbor under Patrice's protection." : Whispering Wallace says, "Let's just say it would be very embarrassing to her and her operation if this guest winds up dead." : Whispering Wallace says, "They've given the emissary a room for the night on the second floor of the compound, just past the room where our fake 'Pasha' likes to hold court toward the end of the day." :Whispering Wallace pauses for a moment and looks at you, as though realizing something. : Whispering Wallace says, "You're new, so you may not know about the compound. It's in the eastern corner of the market. On the right as you're leaving, just before the bridge. Sometimes Stumpy posts up across from it." : Whispering Wallace says, "The boss is pissed that she set up shop so close to us, so he'll be happy when you pull this off." : Whispering Wallace says, "You'll probably want this dagger back. When the job's done, return it to Irfan with proof of the deed." : Whispering Wallace says, "Good hunting." ''You receive [[Irfan's Dagger]] from [[Whispering Wallace]]''

'''Go to the compound described to survey the area and plan your attack. On the west side of the building, you will see a fountain. The attack must happen at night ( between 3a.m. and 6a.m.) when the emissary is in her room. You will need to jump across from a nearby 2nd floor building to get access. You can get on top of the city wall from behind the bathhouse. Run on the wall towards Night Market. When you see the fountain on your left, the building you're looking for will be next. Jump down from the wall on to the closest building. Jump the gap over to the 2nd floor of the Claw Compound. Find the emissary's room behind a closed door. Kill [[an emissary]] and loot her [[Fine Leather Courier Bag]] and return it along with the dagger to [[Irfan Raz]].''' : Irfan Raz takes the bag and almost seems to chuckle. : Irfan Raz says, "The last job is from me. There's a camp of smugglers along the coast to the west of here." : Irfan Raz says, "You'll find a man named Toma there. He's in charge. He needs to die. I want the ring he wears as proof." :Irfan Raz deftly flips his dagger back to you. : Irfan Raz says, "You might find this handy once again." ''You receive [[Irfan's Dagger]] from [[Irfan Raz]].''

''' Recommended level: 7-8 - Go to Shaded Dunes along the coast to the smuggler/wererat camp and kill [[Toma the Two-Faced]] and loot [[Toma's Signet Ring]]. Turn ring and Irfan's Dagger into [[Irfan Raz]]. : Irfan Raz says, "You got the rat man's ring! His death will show the rest of Vermahn's crew whose territory they're in... not that his thrall has much choice in the matter." : Irfan Raz spits. : Irfan Raz says, "Take these to our little bookkeeper upstairs." : Irfan Raz says, "Don't neglect to slide him my dagger... point first." : Irfan Raz laughs. : Irfan Raz says, "So he knows I sent you." ''You receive [[Haradrel's Bloodstone Eye]], [[Toma's Signet Ring]], and [[Fine Leather Courier Bag]] from Irfan Raz..'' '''Take these to Albrecht who is just upstairs from Irfan Raz.

'''Turn in [[Haradrel's Bloodstone Eye]], [[Toma's Signet Ring]], [[Irfan's Dagger]], and [[Fine Leather Courier Bag]] to [[Albrecht]]. {{Exp}} : Albrecht looks over the items as you set them on the table. : Albrecht says, "You can have this one back. I don't know where he finds all of them..." ''You receive Irfan's Dagger from Albrecht. : Albrecht picks up the bloodstone with a pair of jeweler's tongs. : Albrecht says, "You can never be too careful with defiling the likeness of a god." : Albrecht drops the bloodstone into a black box and tucks it away. : Albrecht unlocks the emissary's bag with a small key, then looks inside. : Albrecht says, "Well, several people will be upset to see the emissary dead... including our little pretend Pasha. But that's her problem to deal with now." : Albrecht says, "Good work. She's almost as hideous as some other people I know." : Albrecht stiffens up, realizing what he just said out loud. : Albrecht quickly glances over toward Sinastin's room. : Albrecht shakes his head, refocusing on his task, then picks up the ring. : Albrecht says, "Filthy business, this lot. Like a nest of vipers and rats, constantly biting each other." : Albrecht says, "Well, here you are. Take this receipt to Sinastin." ''You receive Ring Receipt from Albrecht.'' : Albrecht motions for you to lean close. : Albrecht says, "You seem decent enough. Take this note to Elmswood at the Spirit Tap. If I'm not wrong about you, you might want to hear what he's got to say. If I'm wrong, we never spoke." ''You receive Albrecht's Note from Albrecht.'' : Albrecht says, "Wrap things up with Sinastin first, then go to the Spirit Tasp before you do anything more for him. You'll understand more when you speak to Elmswood."

'''First, take the [[Ring Receipt]] to [[Sinastin Aspenleaf]] in the next room. It gets you experience and [[Lamplighter's Ring]].
'''Second, take the [[Albrecht's Note]] to [[Elmswood]] at the Spirit Tap in the Dark Bazaar.

{{exp}} :Sinastin Aspenleaf scans the receipt, then looks at you. : Sinastin Aspenleaf says, "Very well done. I see you brought back one of the rat's rings, too." : Sinastin Aspenleaf says, "Did you keep the finger you found it on? ...Actually, never mind that. Here's a nicer ring for your troubles. It would seem that you're a Lamplighter after all." ''You receive [[Lamplighter's Ring]] from Sinastin Aspenleaf.'' : Sinastin Aspenleaf says, "Which means... I've got another job for you. Take this bag. There are a few things I'd like you to retrieve for me." ''You receive a [[Black Leather Courier Bag]].''

: You say, "What things?" : Sinastin Aspenleaf says, "The tomb just outside of town is said to contain a wealth of interesting artifacts. I've learned that one of our rivals, Jamee Langris, is attempting to recover an amulet for a client of his. It supposedly allows the wearer to commune with spirits." : Sinastin Aspenleaf says, "The previous amulet bearer entered the tomb to speak with a certain female spirit... but she put a quick end to him. Find her, and I bet you'll find the amulet." : Sinastin Aspenleaf says, "The other thing I need can be found at the archaeological site in Shaded Dunes. I'm very curious about the activities of the head researcher there... a fellow named Aashir." : Sinastin Aspenleaf says, "Sneak into the site after dark and see if you can find his documentation. He's bound to have a journal or something similar to log their findings." : Sinastin Aspenleaf says, "On that note, I've heard that a group of cultists has been poking around there lately. Don't let them get to it first." : Sinastin Aspenleaf says, "Place both items in the bag and bring it directly to me. Don't involve Albrecht this time."

'''[[Elmswood]] can be found at the Spirit Tap in the Dark Bazaar just to the left of Nerida.

:Elmswood rubs his thumb across the surface of the note and smiles. : Elmswood says, "Well then... the dwarf has finally gathered some courage." : Elmswood says, "He sent you to me... to betray his master. How do you feel about that? :Elmswood squints at you for a moment. : Elmswood says, "If you don't like it, you'd be wise to keep your mouth shut. Sure, you could rat the dwarf out to Sinastin, but you'd be a food to think he won't suspect you too. : Elmswood says, "But... if you're interested in running with a less 'despicable' crew, then take this note to the fishing camp just outside the city. Someone will meet you there at midnight." ''You receive [[Albrecht's Note]] from Elmswood.''

'''Take [[Albrecht's Note]] to the fishing village inside the Shaded Dunes near the young crocodiles. The village is south of Night Harbor, along the waters edge. Give the note to [[Selyst Surecoin]] when she spawns exactly at 12am game time.

:Selyst Surecoin rubs the tips of her fingers across the note. : Selyst Surecoin says, "Elmswood said he was sending someone... and the note is real enough." : Selyst Surecoin says, "We run with Tinka Roofstrider's crew. She despises Sinastin, so the bag he gave you and the items he wanted in it... we want them." : Selyst Surecoin says, "That pointy dung pile of an elf won't be too pleased if you do this for us, so you'd better think carefully about it." : Selyst Surecoin says, "If you choose to run with us, you'll have a bounty on your head as well... and I'm sure you've seen what Irfan and the other Lamplighters are capable of. Hells, you've likely had to do some of it yourself." : Selyst Surecoin says, "So, ask your questions now. If you decide to move forward with us, fetch the items and bring me the bag." : Selyst Surecoin says, "You know when and where to find me." '''Need more information. Split factions and possibly KoS to Rogue's guild if this path is followed? ''' Recommended level: 15 - Enter [[Tomb of the Last Wyrmsbane]] and head down to [[High Marshal Fionna]]. Fionna is the spirit that [[Sinastin Aspenleaf]] references. Kill Fionna and obtain the [[Engraved Amulet]]. The amulet is an occasional dropped item and it is the first item needed. For the second item, you will need to kill [[a cultist]] and collect a 6-slot [[Aashir's Journal]], and 6 Aashir journal pages: * [[Aashir's Journal Page 4]] * [[Aashir's Journal Page 17]] * [[Aashir's Journal Page 37]] * [[Aashir's Journal Page 42]] * [[Aashir's Journal Page 70]] * [[Aashir's Journal Page 76]] The cultist can be found at night near the Ancient Crypt entrance or under a hidden tunnel beyond the farm just outside of North Gate Night's Harbor.

''' Combine the 6 Aashir Journal pages in the [[Aashir's Journal]]. It will turn into a completed [[Aashir's Journal completed|Aashir's Journal]].

''' Combine both the completed [[Aashir's Journal completed|Aashir's Journal]] and the [[Engraved Amulet]] into the [[Black Leather Courier Bag]] and it'll turn into a completed [[Black Leather Courier Bag completed|Black Leather Courier Bag]].'''

Turn in combined [[Black Leather Courier Bag completed|Black Leather Courier Bag]] to [[Sinastin Aspenleaf]] : Sinastin Aspenleaf says, "Fantastic Work." :Sinastin Aspenleaf smiles broadly while looking at the amulet. : Sinastin Aspenleaf says, "This will certanly leave Langris in a bind. It's not often that he fails to fulfill a request... pity." : Sinastin Aspenleaf says, "As for the journal, I look forward to seeing what opportunities it has for us." : Sinastin Aspenleaf says, "For now, take some time off. You've earned it, and... you've pleased me." ''You receive [[Mark of the Lamplighters]] from Sinastin Aspenleaf. ''


'''Alternate Hand combined black leather bag to [[Selyst Surecoin]].''' : Selyst Surecoin says, "Well, well... for better or worse, it looks like you've got a new crew to meet! We've got a couple of safehouses in the Bends." :Selyst Surecoin shrugs. : Selyst Surecoin says, "Sure, it's a little dangerous there for outsiders, but it's fun once you know your way around." : Selyst Surecoin says, "Take the bag to Tinka. She'll be expecting you. You'll find her observing the courtyard, just inside the main gate to Riverbend." ''You receive [[Black Leather Courier Bag completed|Black Leather Courier Bag]] from Selyst Surecoin.'' : Selyst Surecoin says, "Oh, and just so you know, you made the right choice." '''Take Black Leather Courier Bag to [[Tinka Roofstrider]].''' : Tinka Roofstrider says, "We were hoping you'd make the right choice. Welcome to the crew!" : Tinka Roofstrider says, "I'll have something you can help with soon. In the meantime, if Sinastin gave you one of his gaudy rings, hand it over and we'll give you something classy." : Tinka Roofstrider says, "Otherwise, feel free to poke around and meet the crew." '''Hand [[Tinka Roofstrider]] [[Lamplighter's Ring]]''' : Tinka Roofstrider says, "Yep, that's the one. Trashy, isn't it?" :Tinka Roofstrider pockets the ring. : Tinka Roofstrider says, "Here, this is much better." ''You receive [[Roofstrider's Ring]] from Tinka Roofstrider.'' ==Video Overview== {{#ev:youtube|https://youtu.be/qh3NnrMIIeY}} [[Category:Quests]] [[Category:Night Harbor Quests]] [[Category:Rogue Quests]]

Scarab Armor Quests.title: Scarab Armor Quests

Wyrmsbane Armor Quest.title: Wyrmsbane Armor Quest
Wyrmsbane Armor Quest.content:
{{MessageBox | class = warning | img = Itemicon0001AA.png | header = This content is changing | message = The quest has changed since the last update of this page and the information is largely unknown. If you see details that don't make sense and want to help us, please update it! }} {{Quest | imagefilename = Crafter Ghost Buildings.png | width = 500px | caption = Ghostly Crafter Buildings in Fallen Pass |Start Zone = [[Fallen Pass]] |Quest Giver = |Minimum Level = 1 |Classes = All |Related NPCs = [[Forge Master Durthir]]; [[Tailor Thaddeus]]; [[Leathersmith Visali]] }} Quest Givers are in Fallen Pass, up the ramp and stay left. There are 2 buildings with banners that have a white dragon head on them. Within the right one there are 2 mobs, [[Forge Master Durthir]] and [[Tailor Thaddeus]]. The left building has [[Leathersmith Visali]] in it. To get the text to proceed with the quest, you need to hand in one of the Ancient Wyrmsbane pieces. They then give the proper text to continue with the quest. == '''Drop Locations''' == ==== Cloth ==== * [[Ancient Tattered Wyrmsbane Cap]] - [[Leila al-Bahri]] in [[Grain Cellar]] * [[Ancient Tattered Wyrmsbane Mantle]] - unknown * [[Ancient Tattered Wyrmsbane Robe]] - unknown * [[Ancient Tattered Wyrmsbane Bracer]] - Blackscale Snake in [[Shaded Dunes]] * [[Ancient Tattered Wyrmsbane Pantaloons]] - Bandits in [[Fallen Pass]] on the Shore * [[Ancient Tattered Wyrmsbane Belt]] - [[Nerguk]] in [[Sungreet Strand]] * [[Ancient Tattered Wyrmsbane Gloves]] - unknown * [[Ancient Tattered Wyrmsbane Boots]] - [[Sivah Arun]] in [[Fallen Pass]] ==== Plate ==== * [[Ancient Corroded Wyrmsbane Helm]] - unknown * [[Ancient Corroded Wyrmsbane Pauldrons]] - unknown * [[Ancient Corroded Wyrmsbane Breastplate]] - unknown * [[Ancient Corroded Wyrmsbane Bracer]] - [[Ashir the Protector]] in [[Tel Ekir]] * [[Ancient Corroded Wyrmsbane Greaves]] - [[Eamon Kassir]] in The Bends, [[Night Harbor]] * [[Ancient Corroded Wyrmsbane Girdle]] - [[First Mate Baird]] in [[Sungreet Strand]] * [[Ancient Corroded Wyrmsbane Gauntlets]] - a crusader's remains or Undead in [[Fallen Pass]] pit * [[Ancient Corroded Wyrmsbane Boots]] - [[Duneshell]] in [[Glass Flats]] ==== Chain ==== * [[Ancient Eroded Wyrmsbane Coif]] - unknown * [[Ancient Eroded Wyrmsbane Shoulderguards]] - [[Qassem Brolt]] in [[Fallen Pass]] * [[Ancient Eroded Wyrmsbane Tunic]] - [[Nimasu]] in [[Shaded Dunes]] * [[Ancient Eroded Wyrmsbane Wristguard]] - [[Ember]] in [[Sungreet Strand]] * [[Ancient Eroded Wyrmsbane Leggings]] - [[Shattershriek]] in [[Glass Flats]] * [[Ancient Eroded Wyrmsbane Waistguard]] - unknown * [[Ancient Eroded Wyrmsbane Gloves]] - Ashira in [[Vale of Zintar]] (possibly Seshena) * [[Ancient Eroded Wyrmsbane Boots]] - unknown ==== Leather ==== * [[Ancient Rotting Wyrmsbane Cap]] - unknown * [[Ancient Rotting Wyrmsbane Shoulders]] - [[Seeress Hamana]] in [[Tel Ekir]] * [[Ancient Rotting Wyrmsbane Tunic]] - unknown * [[Ancient Rotting Wyrmsbane Bracelet]] - unknown * [[Ancient Rotting Wyrmsbane Leggings]] - unknown * [[Ancient Rotting Wyrmsbane Belt]] - unknown * [[Ancient Rotting Wyrmsbane Gloves]] - [[A shimmering shadow]] in [[Shaded Dunes]] * [[Ancient Rotting Wyrmsbane Boots]] - unknown == ''' Plate Quest Text ''' == : Forge Master Durthir says, "Gods be damned! Why, this is my work! See there, my insignia, still barely legible. Where did you find this friend? Ah, it matters not." : Forge Master Durthir says, "I tell you, this armor was the pride of Saman. Specially commissioned by the Wyrmsbane! I'm sad to see it in such a state. Though I wonder if I could repair it?" You say, "repair?" : Forge Master Durthir says, "Aye, my friend. See here, how it still holds up? Why, with the right materials and..." : Forge Master Durthir says, "Ah, blast, I'm getting carried away. This is a folly, traveler. It's for naught without my smithing hammer." You say, "what hammer?" : Forge Master Durthir says, "A special tool, and necessary for any work on this armor I'm afraid. `Twas forged in the heat of a slain dragon's heart. Its dragonfire imbuement is what gives it its potency at the forge, and what makes the Wyrmsbane armor so sturdy." : Forge Master Durthir says, "But those bloody ratmen... They swarmed the village and made off with it ages ago." : Forge Master Durthir says, "I still hear it calling to me faintly across the umbra, in some forlorn hollow deep beneath the Shaded Dunes. As I said, a folly, to be sure. But you've brought back a sweet memory of my work, traveler. For that I thank you." : Forge Master Durthir returns to his forge, his shoulders slumped in resignation. The hammer in question is the [[Dragonforged Smithing Hammer]] that drops from [[Grukk`Tal the Ravener]] in [[Caves of Irem]]. Hand the hammer to the Forge Master : Forge Master Durthir Solemnly takes the hammer, looking it up and down. His ghostly hands tremble ever so slightly. : Forge Master Durthir says, "It can't be... It is! I never thought I'd lay my eyes on this again!" : Forge Master Durthir says, "I'm in your debt, dearest friend. Now we can get to work fixing up that armor, but you'll need to acquire some materials first." : Forge Master Durthir says, "Show me the piece you'd like to repair, and I'll tell you what's needed." : Forge Master Durthir returns to examining the hammer, a smile stretched wide across his face. Turning in the Pants results in: : Forge Master Durthir says, "This piece will require Ritual Oil consecrated with a Blessing of Courage, along with three Enchanted Iron Plates and three Leather Straps." Turning in the Belt results in: : Forge Master Durthir says, "This piece will require Ritual Oil consecrated with a Blessing of Courage, along with an Enchanted Iron Plates and two Leather Straps." ==== Information on the Ritual Oil ==== You say, "What Ritual Oil?" : Forge Master Durthir says, "Yes, the Wyrmsbane were quite a pious order. I suppose a great deal of faith is needed if you're slaying dragons!" : Forge Master Durthir says, "A Wyrmsbane initiate would need to perform a pilgrimage, blessing oil with a priest at various sacred sites around Szuur. It instilled in them the order's values to prepare them for knighthood, you see." : Forge Master Durthir says, "And of Course, I was tasked with forging this armor once the pilgrimage was complete." : Forge Master Durthir says, "Now, as to where they acquired the oil, you're wondering? That was the priest's business. Same with the rites too, I suppose." : Forge Master Durthir says, "Not sure who can help you out these days, Maybe a scholar would have record of the rites. And the oil surely could be found in some temple, I'd bet." [[Ritual Oil]] is sold by [[Sacristan Lorik]] in [[Keeper's Bight]] for 1g 22s. == '''Outdated Quest Information:''' == The Wyrmsbane Armor sets are obtained through a quest offered by [[Matheus Griswald]] of the [[Easthymn Freebooters]], who is found near the entrance of the tomb. You must have a minimum of '''KINDLY''' faction to turn in your components.

Each piece requires an armor token for one of the available sets which can be found from bosses in the dungeon: * [[Ancient Tattered Wyrmsbane Cloth]] * [[Ancient Rotting Wyrmsbane Leather]] * [[Ancient Eroded Wyrmsbane Chain]] * [[Ancient Corroded Wyrmsbane Plate]] == Reward == * [[Wyrmsbane Cloth|Wyrmsbane Cloth Set]] * [[Wyrmsbane Leather|Wyrmsbane Leather Set]] * [[Wyrmsbane Chain|Wyrmsbane Chain Set]] * [[Wyrmsbane Plate|Wyrmsbane Plate Set]] == Walkthrough == This quest involves talking to [[Matheus Griswald]] found within the cave that the [[Tomb of the Last Wyrmsbane]] resides in. Matheus Griswald when shown armor tokens, which the player can receive from named mobs within the tomb, will inform the player on how he can restore them. These armor tokens are turned in for their respective armor types & slots alongside [[Chipped Star Rose Quartz]] for cloth armor, [[Chipped Jasper]] for leather armor, [[Chipped Amber]] for chain armor, and [[Chipped Fire Opal]] for plate armor. It is unknown if faction with the [[Easthymn Freebooters]] influences your ability to turn in the tokens, however, this faction raises while killing most mobs found within the tomb.

Hail, Matheus Griswald : Matheus Griswald says, "Hail, adventurer. The name's Matheus Griswald, of the Easthymnite Freebooters. I head up this dig site. My crew was searching for long lost relics, but our excavation has fallen into peril." You say, "What lost relics?" : Matheus Griswald says, "There are many ancient relics within the tomb. Some of which may even be of value to you. If you help us destroy the monstrosities inside, you will earn the favor of the Freebooters. And with that, can come many benefits." You say, "What benefits?" : Matheus Griswald says, "We know that the ancient armor of the fallen Wyrmsbane still lies within. If you bring it to us, along with certain gems, we can help you restore it." You say, "What gems?" : Matheus Griswald says, "Are you looking to restore cloth, leather, chain or plate?" You say, "Cloth." : Matheus Griswald says, "Bring me pieces of the old ancient cloth armor, along with the corresponding amount of [[Chipped Star Rose Quartz]]. I'll restore waist and wrist armor with one [[Chipped Star Rose Quartz]], feet and hands with two, shoulders and head with three, legs with four, and chest with five." You say, "Leather." : Matheus Griswald says, "Bring me pieces of the old ancient leather armor, along with the corresponding amount of [[Chipped Jasper]]. I'll restore waist and wrist armor with one [[Chipped Jasper]], feet and hands with two, shoulders and head with three, legs with four, and chest with five." You say, "Chain." : Matheus Griswald says, "Bring me pieces of the old ancient chain armor, along with the corresponding amount of [[Chipped Amber]]. I'll restore waist and wrist armor with one [[Chipped Amber]], feet and hands with two, shoulders and head with three, legs with four, and chest with five." You say, "Plate." : Matheus Griswald says, "Bring me pieces of the old ancient plate armor, along with the corresponding amount of [[Chipped Fire Opal]]. I'll restore waist and wrist armor with one [[Chipped Fire Opal]], feet and hands with two, shoulders and head with three, legs with four, and chest with five." You say, "Where can I get [[Chipped Star Rose Quartz]]" : Matheus Griswald says, "You can find from miners, or mine it yourself from [[Copper Vein]]s." == Changes == 11 Aug 24 - It seems as though the dialogue options below are no longer active, as the quest now specifies type of armor and there's no mention of/ need for [[Flawless Malachite]]s ''Matheus Griswald says, "Bring me pieces of the old, ancient armor, along with the corresponding amount of [[Flawless Malachite]]s. I'll restore waist and wrist armor with one Flawless Malachite, feet and hands with two, shoulders and head with three, legs with four, and chest with five." Matheus Griswald says, "You must first prove your worth to our cause. Enter the tomb and help us to slay the Undead inside. Then you may ask me again about how we can restore the armor."'' '''Give armor and gems to Matheus''' Matheus Griswald says, "I have restored the armor for you. May it protect you well."

Wanted: Ayip & Yapala.title: Wanted: Ayip & Yapala
Wanted: Ayip & Yapala.content:
{{Quest | imagefilename = Guard Atep New.jpg | width = 300px | caption = |Start Zone = [[Night Harbor]] |Quest Giver = [[Guard Atep]] |Minimum Level = ? |Classes = ALL |Related NPCs = [[Ayip]], [[Yapala]] }} == Reward ==
  • [[The Impaler]]
* Experience == Walkthrough == '''This quest starts with hailing [[Guard Atep]].''' You say, 'Hail, Guard Atep.' :Guard Atep says, "Citizen, I am offering bounties for various targets of opportunity. Are you interested in hearing about them?" You say, "Interested" :Guard Atep says, "I currently have a bounty for Ashira." You say, "What Ashira?" :Guard Atep hands you a wanted poster. ''You receive [[Wanted: Ayip and Yapala]] from Guard Atep'' 
WANTED: Dead or Alive


Ayip and Yapala of the Ashira


These two mongrel Ashira have raided our lands

and killed innocent civilians long enough. Their

last known location was near the hidden entrance

to Tel Ekir, found in the Shaded Dunes.


Bring their heads to Guard Atep.


-The Red Mantles
Upon turning in the [[Bloodied Ashira Head (Ayip)]] and [[Bloodied Ashira Head (Yapala)]] Guard Atep responds: :Guard Atep says, "Ha! The only good Ashira is a dead Ashira. You bagged two of their worst. Take this as a token of the League's appreciation." ''You receive [[The Impaler]]'' {{exp}} [[Category:Quests]] [[Category:Night Harbor Quests]]

Spectral Armor Quest.title: Spectral Armor Quest
Spectral Armor Quest.content:
{{Quest |Start Zone = [[Night Harbor]] |Quest Giver = [[a master blacksmith]] |Minimum Level = 1 |Classes = All |Related Items = [[Alunite Ore]]; [[Alum]]; [[Alum Solution]]; [[Spectral Essence]]; [[Spectral Bar]], [[Chomper's Hide]]; [[Dreadweave Silk]] |Related NPCs = }} == Intro == Speak to [[a master blacksmith]] in [[Night Harbor]], who only appears at night (despawns at 6 AM in-game time). You say, "Hail, a master blacksmith." : a master blacksmith says, "Good evening to you, . I can tell by those shoulders that you've swung y our fair share of smithing hammers. Perhaps you'd like to help me with an experiment?" You say, "What experiment?" : a master blacksmith says, "During the day, I've been studying the origins of magically reinforced metals, meeting with the local enchanters, and perusing the library in Sageside." : a master blacksmith says, "Well, perusing as much as I'm allowed to, seeing as I'm not enrolled there." : a master blacksmith says, "Based on what I've managed to learn, it seems that most enchantments can be strengthened if the caster imbues a portion of their own essence into the metal itself." : a master blacksmith says, "That got me thinking of those recently discovered ruins..." You say, "What recently discovered ruins?" : a master blacksmith says, "Wormsfood? Wurmsbite? Something like that. Either way, I've heard there are some powerful spirits within those ruins!" : a master blacksmith says, "Seeing as they must have been there for hundreds of years, I often wonder what I could do with the spiritual essence of such timeless foes." : a master blacksmith says, "If you find yourself within that tomb of... Wordsthane, I'd be grateful if you'd let me borrow a small portion of any spiritual essence you come across." Go to the [[Tomb of the Last Wyrmsbane]] and retrieve [[Spectral Essence]] == Part 1: Spectral Bar == Hand in the [[Spectral Essence]] to [[a master blacksmith]]. :a master blacksmith says, "You actually found some! You've my gratitude, . Now, let's see what we're able to accomplish with this lingering soul..." :a master blacksmith says, "Oh, now that is a surprise! The copper has hardened considerably. This essence is truly potent, . I feel like you could make some powerful equipment using this method." :a master blacksmith says, "Here, take the remaining essence. Why don't you give it a try yourself?" :a master blacksmith says, "See if you can fashion a bar using the essence, some enchanted copper, and flux. Show me the results of your handicraft." Go to a [[smelter]], and use one [[Enchanted Copper Bar]]s, one [[Spectral Essence]], and one [[Flux]] to craft the [[Spectral Bar]]s. Hand in the [[Spectral Bar]] :a master blacksmith says, "I'd call that a resounding success, wouldn't you, ?" :a master blacksmith says, "Something like this is quite special, and I'd be remiss to let you fashion something out of it using crude leathers or cheap padding." :a master blacksmith says, "You should speak to some of the other master artisans in the city and see if they have any ideas for high-grade components that would complement this new alloy." :a master blacksmith says, "You'd do well to inquire about particularly sturdy leather for the straps, and some high-quality cloth for any interior padding." :a master blacksmith says, "Once you've found suitable components, see about fashioning a breastplate from this special alloy. Only the most protective of pieces should be used for something so rare, don't you agree?" :a master blacksmith says, "Take care now, , and may Sorophal's spark illuminate your craft." == Part 2: Sturdy Leather Straps == Speak to [[Leatherworker Haiat]]. You say, "I'm looking for sturdy leather." :Leatherworker Haiat says, "You're looking for particularly sturdy leather? Hmm... Well, of all Szuur's beasts, I'd say the crocodiles have the sturdiest hides in the area." you say, "nasty brute?" :Leatherworker Haiat says, "Though, there's one especially nasty brute with a hide ten times as thick as the others!" :Leatherworking Trainer says, "Ol' Chompers, they call it. Last I heard, it wanders the beaches of the Shaded Dunes, taking a bite out of anything it sees. Though, I'd hate to work a hide like that without the proper treatment." You say, "What proper treatment?" :Leatherworker Haiat says, "That's a question for the tanner. Chompers' hide is sure to make some quality leather, but I'd show it to them first before you try and trim it down to size." :Leatherworker Haiat says, "...That is, assuming you actually manage to bring down the beast!" Go hunt [[Chompers]] in [[Shaded Dunes]]. Loot [[Chomper's Hide]]. Hand in [[Chomper's Hide]] to [[Tanner Burhan]]. :Tanner Burhan says, "Chompers' hide! You actually managed to bring it down? I'm impressed, !" :Tanner Burhan says, "Look at this hue! The thickness of the scales is unlike anything I've seen. You would need a very potent solution in order to treat a hide like this properly." You say, "What potent solution?" :Tanner Burhan says, "Hmm, something of this size and quality would need to use alum. It's derived from alunite ore, so you would need to find an alchemist capable of breaking it down for you." :Tanner Burhan says, "Or you could always do so yourself, if you've the skill. Some alum combined with resin would yield a powerful enough solution to treat something this exquisite." In a [[Mortar and Pestle]], combine two [[Alunite Ore]] to make [[Alum]].
In a cauldron, combine 5 [[Alum]] and 5 [[Resin]] to make [[Alum Solution]] (Alchemy, Trivial: 25)
Combine [[Chomper's Hide]] and [[Alum Solution]] in a tanner to create [[Hardened Crocodile Leather]] (Tanning, Trivial: < 55) Hand [[Hardened Crocodile Leather]] to [[Tanning Trainer]] :Tanning Trainer says, "By the grace of Sorophal, what an impressive piece of leather you've managed to get hold of!" :Tanning Trainer says, "A skilled leatherworker could use this to create components of very high quality. They'd be highly sought after by the smiths in the market, that's for certain!" Put the [[Hardened Crocodile Leather]] in a [[Leatherworking Kit]] crafting 3 [[Hardened Crocodile Leather Straps]](Leatherworking, Trivial: < 80) == Part 3: High Quality Padding == Go speak to [[Master Tailor Sansha]] near the North Gate. Master Tailor Sansha says, "Greetings, friend. Have you come to practice your weaves?" You say, "Yes" :Master Tailor Sansha says, "A coarse plant-based thread would clash terribly with this fine silk, so it would be ideal to find a material of similar origin for the stitching." :Master Tailor Sansha says, "I have heard that the farmers in the Strand use lesser spider silks for many of their fabrics. Perhaps a suitable thread could be made from common silks found in that area. You will have to determine that for yourself, however." :Master Tailor Sansha says, "At the very least, I would be sure to have confidence in your skills before attempting such a project. Butchering such fine fabric would be simply heartbreaking, after all!" You say, "I am looking for high quality cloth." :Master Tailor Sansha says, "I have received a number of high-quality silks from adventurers in the past. If I recall, they said that they found them in a Tel Saman crypt, out in the Shaded Dunes." :Master Tailor Sansha says, "What they brought me was clearly from the smaller arachnids, but I cannot help but wonder what the matriarch of such a brood is capable of weaving." :Master Tailor Sansha says, "Typically, the largest of the spiders produce the finest and sturdiest threads. I would love to see an example one day." Go to [[Infested Crypt]] in [[Shaded Dunes]] and kill [[a crypt broodmother]] to loot [[Dreadweave Silk]].
Hand in [[Dreadweave Silk]] to Master Tailor Sansha.
:Master Tailor Sansha says, "Oh, what a wonderfully robust weave! One could certainly use such silk to create a most comfortable material, resistant to wear and stains." :Master Tailor Sansha says, "To speak nothing of its breathability and moisture-wicking properties! These are highly sought-after traits for clothing hear in Szuur." :Master Tailor Sansha says, "Even the blacksmiths would adore such silk for padding their heavy armor. Though, it may require something different to hold a proper weave." (Part 3 to be continued) == Part 4: (to be continued) == (Part 4 to be continued) [[Category:Quests]] [[Category:Night Harbor Quests]]
