Ranger Starter Quest (Faelindral).title: Ranger Starter Quest (Faelindral)
Ranger Starter Quest (Faelindral).content:
{{Quest | imagefilename = Ranger Calafrey Request for Aid.png | width = 100px | caption = Request for Aid |Start Zone = [[Faelindral]] |Quest Giver = [[Captain Relgen Greenblade]] |Minimum Level = 1 |Classes = [[Ranger]] |Related NPCs = [[Ranger Valegazer]] | Related Items = Ranger's Logbook; Unintelligible Report | Quest Rewards = Reach of the Ardent Keeper;Initiate Keepers Cloak;(exp) }} __TOC__ == Walkthrough == === Part 1 - Req. Lvl 1=== Read [[Request for Aid]] you start with as a new Ranger Character: 
The balance of the Weald is threatened and the natural
order disturbed.

Those with a connection to the lands and its creatures
are summoned to Rangers Rest upon Keepers Terrace.

To reach us, set out from the top of the Travelers Lift 
and venture past the inn, toward the Willows Whisper.
Ascend the ramp on the left to Traders Terrace, where
you will find the Rangers Rest across the span.

Any of the Defenders of Faelindral can offer directions if
asked.

When you arrive, deliver this pamphlet to Captain
Relgen Greenblade.

From there, your talents shall benefit the preservation of
all who call the Weald their home.

- High Keeper Caelen Stillbranch
You say, "Hail, Captain Relgen Greenblade." Captain Relgen Greenblade waves you off with a dismissive gesture. : Captain Relgen Greenblade says, "I have no mind for idle talk, unless you've something important to share." '''Hand in 1 x [[Request for Aid]] to Captain Relgen Greenblade.''' {{exp}} Your faction standing with [[Ardent Keepers]] got better. Your faction standing with [[Fellstone Orcs]] got worse. : Captain Relgen Greenblade says, "Ah, a new volunteer? Let me get a look at you, then." Captain Relgen Greenblade regards you with the emerald gaze of a veteran ranger, his rugged features stern and sharp. He nods after a quick appraisal and produces a small book for you to take. You receive [[Ranger's Logbook]] from Captain Relgen Greenblade. : Captain Relgen Greenblade says, "You look like you'll do. I am Relgen Greenblade, Regional Captain of the Ardent Keepers, and it's my duty to safeguard our borders from all threats within and without." : Captain Relgen Greenblade says, "As the request mentioned, we're in need of fresh rangers who are willing to maintain a presence in Evershade Weald, and to that end, I would see that you're put to work immediately." : Captain Relgen Greenblade says, "Are you prepared, ranger?" You say, "I am prepared." Captain Relgen Greenblade nods curtly. : Captain Relgen Greenblade says, "Good. Being as fresh as you are, I'll not yet have you engage priority threats. Your first mission will be one of reconnaissance and familiarizing yourself with the forest's layout. Our rangers need to know their way around, after all." : Captain Relgen Greenblade says, "You'll investigate three locations within the Weald, then report your findings and any evidence you find in the logbook." : Captain Relgen Greenblade says, "If you can return with a full logbook of useful information, you'll have proven that you're worthy of being inducted into the Ardent Keepers as a formal initiate." : Captain Relgen Greenblade says, "As for the locations, you'll be reporting on the '''Whispering Pools''', '''Sporehaven Karst''', and a '''ruined archway that spans the border of Keepers Bight'''. You need only ask if you require further details on each of these locations." : Captain Relgen Greenblade says, "I'll remind you that you are to look closely at each site and report your findings. You are not there to take action. These places are still dangerous for a prospective ranger." You say, "What are the Whispering Pools?" Captain Relgen Greenblade grimaces in disgust at the name, as though merely describing it is enough to revolt him. : Captain Relgen Greenblade says, "Devious naiads make the Whispering Pools their home. They reside behind the great falls of the river that splits the Weald in two." : Captain Relgen Greenblade says, "Be warned, the Fossergrim you'll encounter may be peaceful enough, but the nymphs who dwell further inside are known to possess travelers and keep them as playthings." : Captain Relgen Greenblade says, "Don't venture too deep inside. In fact, make your report from inside the cave's mouth, just past the threshold of the falls. I must know if there are any signs that they're attempting to breach their pact and leave the caves." You say, "Their pact?" : Captain Relgen Greenblade says, "It's my opinion that the fae in general cannot be trusted, even if bound to a pact. The naiads are no exception. Their mistress, Naelira, is bound to the pools of that cave, but I fear she wishes to expand her influence." You say, "Who is Naelira?" : Captain Relgen Greenblade says, "Enough of the fae! Just speaking of them makes my ears burn. If you want to learn more about them, you should consult the Heartwood Archives." You say, "Where are the Heartwood Archives?" : Captain Relgen Greenblade says, "The Heartwood Archives is Faelindral's great library, kept by the Preservers. It's located just above the city bank. There's plenty to learn there for those who are so inclined." You say, "What is Sporehaven Karst?" : Captain Relgen Greenblade says, "Sporehaven Karst is home to the Circle of Spores. They're a group of reclusive druids who dedicate themselves to the research and proliferation of fungi." : Captain Relgen Greenblade says, "Though normally quite harmless, their fungal research has a history of spreading infestations up into Faelindral, which we are then forced to cleanse." : Captain Relgen Greenblade says, "Venture beneath the city to the caves that have been carved out by the river's passage, and pray that there's no sign of their latest experiments growing out of control." : Captain Relgen Greenblade says, "If you do come across dangerous fungus, avoid it to the best of your ability while you search for evidence of the Circle's actions from the entrance of their domain." You say, "And the ruined archway?" : Captain Relgen Greenblade says, "Disturbing rumors of the risen dead have made their way to Faelindral, particularly from the caravan route to the neighboring Keepers Bight." : Captain Relgen Greenblade says, "Venture south, away from the river, and follow the main road toward the Bight. Just before you reach the border, you should see the ancient archway of Calafrey beneath a foot bridge." : Captain Relgen Greenblade says, "See if you can find any evidence of an undead presence in the ruins, but don't engage them if the rumors prove true. Remember, you're only there to look this time around." ==== Evidence of Orcs ==== Look around the road near the ruined archway right before the zone-line for Keepers Bight using the MUD action "/look". 
These great and ruined arches belonged to an ancient empire and served as a form of boundary that has long since fallen.
There are signs of caravans having crossed this threshold many times over, however a peculiar set of footprints catch your eye and warrant inspection.
Inspect the peculiar set of footprints using the MUD action "/inspect footprints". 
These footprints bear no resemblance to any hoof nor animal you’ve seen before, and follow an unorthodox step pattern that you cannot place.
They appear to lead back toward Faelindral before veering to the right, following a small path toward another set of ruins up the hill.
There is a large elderspire tree only a few steps away, between this location and the ruins, where you might get a safe view of what could be occupying the ancient, toppled structure.
Head to the elderspire tree to get a safe view using the MUD action "/look". 
You hunker down near the roots of the elderspire and begin searching for the source of the footprints...
The trail leads to indications of undead infesting the ruins, their bone chips littering the ruin floor alongside numerous signs of adult wolves in the area.
Yet what draws your eye most is a second series of strange, alien footprints. These heavy prints stand out in stark contrast to the others.
Inspect the alien footprints using the MUD action "/inspect footprints". 
This second set of footprints was clearly made by a creature with significant bulk who stands on two feet. 
They do not appear to be wearing any sort of fashioned footwear, though you observe that they are supported by a set of only three toes. 
You know of only one creature that strides on two three-toed feet and could have made these impressions... orcs.
'''You receive [[Evidence of Orcs]].''' ==== Evidence of the Nymphs ==== : /look Behind the waterfall, at the entrance of the Fossergrim cave. 
The continuous, thundering roar of the waterfall overwhelms all other sounds as it echoes back from deep within the cave that the naiads have claimed as their home.

Your eye catches sight of a series of wet, childlike footprints along the dampened stone... footprints that seem to beckon further inspection.
: /inspect footprints 
The footprints were freshly made, and nowhere near large enough to belong to one of the Fossergrim guarding the entrance.

It seems at least one nymph has recently been wandering out past the waterfall barrier, defying their bond. You decide to take this as evidence for your logbook.
'''You receive [[Evidence of Nymphs]].''' ==== Evidence of Sporehaven ==== : /look On the banks of the river that flows into the myconid cave 
This damp and humid cave system proves to be the perfect breeding ground for fungus as made evident by its thriving myconid population. 
Along the banks of the gently flowing river you spy an odd, multicolored foam accumulating against the stone.
: /inspect foam 
Closer examination of the foam reveals that it flows from further upstream before clinging to the edges of the rocky embankment. This could be a clue as to what's causing the local myconids to be acting so aggressively.
Touching the foam directly would not be wise, but perhaps you could rub a sample onto a page of your logbook.
: /rub foam 
You carefully rub a blank page of your logbook against the foam, smearing a small sample along it.The strange foam leaves a scintillating, multihued pattern across one of the blank pages.

It is so beautifully mesmerizing, and you find your gaze to be transfixed for a short time upon that single page...

Such an exquisite pattern...

You suddenly blink and snap back to your senses, tearing your gaze away from the page and quickly closing your logbook.
'''You receive [[Evidence of Sporehaven]].''' '''You receive [[Scintillating Page]].''' Combine [[Evidence of Orcs]] [[Evidence of Nymphs]] [[Evidence of Sporehaven]] [[Scintillating Page]] : Captain Relgen Greenblade accepts the logbook with a nod of gratitude. He flips through your reports, his brow arching slightly at the mesmerizing pattern splayed across one of the pages, though it seems to have no effect on him. : Captain Relgen Greenblade says, "An interesting method of procuring evidence, but I'll not scorn success. It seems my fears were not unfounded. I was right to send you to scout these locations." : Captain Relgen Greenblade says, "You've shown that you can traverse the Weald and return with useful information, and that's what we need in our rangers. Here, you've earned this." : Captain Relgen Greenblade unfurls a cloak fashioned from an enormous leaf and swoops it over your shoulders. : Captain Relgen Greenblade says, "A good cloak on your shoulders is one of the basic tenants of wilderness survival. As an initiate of the Ardent Keepers, you'll be outdoors rather often." ''You receive [[Initiate Keepers Cloak]].'' : Captain Relgen Greenblade says, "Which leads us to your next assignment, initiate. You've seen the state of things in the Weald. Are you ready to help clean it up?" You say, "i am ready" : Captain Relgen Greenblade says, "I'm glad to hear it. Take some time to familiarize yourself more with the forest, then check back and I'll have something for you." === Part 2 - Req. Lvl 3 === : Captain Greenblade says, "Greetings initiate, how fares the state of your cloak?" You should hand Captain Greenblade your cloak here. : Captain Greenblade says, "Im glad to hear it. You look as though you're familiar with the forest's trails by now. Allow me to see your initiate cloak one last time to make sure it's donned properly." : Captain Greenblade regards the state of the cloak and gives a satisfied nod before draping it back over your shoulders. : Captain Greenblade says, "Excellent. Your next task begins immediately, initiate. Take this satchel." : Captain Greenblade procures a small bag and tosses it into your hands. : Captain Greenblade says, "Carry yourself down to the forest floor and eliminate some of the threats that you witnessed, particularly the undead, the roaming fae, and the orcish threat." : "Gather two shattered skulls of the undead, two samples of dryad sap, and two belts from the Fellstone warriors. That should be sufficient evidence." : "Importantly, once you've gathered these items and combined them in the satchel, you will not bring them back to me." : "There is another captain that I want you to meet." You receive [[a ranger's satchel]]. You say, "What Captain?" : Captain Greenblade says " You're to venture south to Keepers Bight with your full satchel, and head toward the village of Penshaw. Follow the edge of the forest and cross the river, you should come upon one of our camps." : "Once there, I want you to show the evidence of your encounters to the Keepers Bight regional captain, Syllisian Shadedglade." : "If he happens to be out on patrol when you arrive, perhaps one of the other rangers there can provide more information, should you present evidence to them." : "We need to know if there has been any sign of these threats spreading into, or coming out of, the Bight. Report back to me with any of your findings, and safe travels, initiate. Make sure to wear your initiate cloak so they know you're with the Ardent Keepers." Collect, place in bag, combine, and turn in:
  • 2x [[Shattered Skull]]
  • 2x [[Fellstone Warrior's Belt]]
  • 2x [[Dryad Sap]]
Go to Keeper's Bight, keep down the road until you cross a wooden bridge. Shortly past the bridge is a small ranger camp. Give Full Ranger's Satchel to [[Ranger Valegazer]]. : Ranger Valegazer regards your cloak with a nod and a smile. : Ranger Valegazer says, "Ah, what brings you to Keepers Bight, initiate? Do you carry news from the Weald?" Give Full Ranger's Satchel to [[Ranger Valegazer]]. a Trunk Key Ranger Valegazer inspects the evidence of your encounters and frowns, her long and thin ears drooping in response. : Ranger Valegazer says, "Undead of our ancestors in the Weald, as well as fae venturing out of their domain? This is disheartening news, but I can assure you they're not crossing the boundary from Keepers Bight, at least." "In fact, the captain patrolled there recently. There should be some paperwork about it in his trunk. I imagine that's what Captain Relgen is looking for."
{{Spoiler | Behind him there is another tent with a "trunk" (it's like a crate)
Pick up the key and type ''/insert key''
Type ''/inspect paper''
Type ''/inspect report''
Type ''/take report'' }} You receive [[Lone Point Report]]. {{Spoiler | Hand the key back to Ranger Valegazer }} You receive [[Keepers Bight Report]]. Return to Captain Relgen Greenblade in the Ranger's Rest Give [[Lone Point Report]] and [[Keepers Bight Report]]. to [[Captain Relgen Greenblade]]. You receive a [[Verdant Waistguard]] from [[Captain Relgen Greenblade]].(belt). : Captain Greenblade says, "Return the belt to me after you've worked it in and I've had a time to speak with Caelen. Until then, you're free to explore the Weald and cull any threats. Be sure to keep that cloak as well, so others will recognize you as a Keeper." === Part 3 - Req. Lvl 5 === : Captain Greenblade says, "Good. It seems you're looking more comfortable in the garb of a Keeper." : Captain Greenblade says, "You'll require something with more protection than what an initiate cloak and a mere waistguard can afford you, if I'm to send you on your next task." You say, "What task are you sending me on next?" : Captain Greenblade says, "The first thing you're required to do is reinforce the initiate cloak you were given. An initiate keeps their cloak for life, but the standard variation will only serve you for so long." : Captain Greenblade says, "Bring your cloak to one of our senior trackers, Gareth Ashenpath. He should be outside the Rangers Rest and can guide you maintaining and improving your own equipment." Step outside the Ranger's Rest and go to [[Gaereth Ashenpath]]. Hand your cloak to Gaereth Ashenpath. : Gaereth Ashenpath says, "Let me guess, Relgen is delegating his responsibilities again? Doesn't surprise me." : Gaereth Ashenpath says, "The old man needs to spend more time down in the actual forest and less time berating potential rangers from the safety of the city, of you ask me." : Gaereth Ashenpath says, "Still, that doesn't mean I'm going to runaway an initiate like yourself. You're going to need to know how to enhance your cloak one way or another." : Gaereth Ashenpath says, "Yours in particular is in need of some real improvement." You say, "Oh jeepers, what improvement can we do?" : Gaereth Ashenpath says, "The flora of the Weald have been infused with magic over the course of many years. The preserved leaves we used aren't just protective, they're capable of adaption under the right circumstances." : Gaereth Ashenpath says, "The best way to improve your cloak, at least initially is to purposefully expose it to the same environmental effects that you wish it to protect you from. Make sense, right?" : Gaereth Ashenpath says, "While you'll have to find ways of subverting every element at some point, for now, we'll focus on venom and poisons. The mountain snakes in the Bight and the vipers of Szuur can be deadly foes if they manage to inject you with some of their lethal venom." : Gaereth Ashenpath says, "You probably don't want to march all the way to the desert, though. Lucky for you, we have a critter on the forest floor than can you the proper... exposure." You say, "By golly, what critter is that?" : Gaereth Ashenpath says, "You've probably noticed out issue with the local drakeling population." : Gaereth Ashenpath says, "If left unchecked, they can overwhelm most of the Weald's younger fauna using their magical poison breath." : Gaereth Ashenpath says, "So what better way to expose you to poison than by having it breathe all over you, eh?" : Gaereth Ashenpath grins. : Gaereth Ashenpath says, "Go cull some of the drakelings and expose that cloak of yours to their poisonous breath." : Gaereth Ashenpath says, "Bring me back at least two of their hides and four drakeling scales as proof that you've been out there fighting the good fight. Oh, and your initiate cloak of course. We'll see then if you've exposed it to enough poison for it to adapt." You will need to collect 2 [[Green Drakeling Hide]] and 4 [[Green Drakeling Scale]] then return to Gaereth Ashenpath. Hand to Gaereth your cloak, and the Drakeling parts. : Gaereth Ashenpath takes the drakeling parts and gauges the state of your cloak. : Gaereth Ashenpath says, "Granted the poison of a young drakeling is only so strong, but you also don't want to expose the cloak to too much and overwhelm it. You have to nurture it, just as you would an other plant of the forest." : Gaereth Ashenpath says, "I'll provide you with a salve that you can use to speed up the recovery process and lock in the magic of the drakeling's breath." : Gaereth Ashenpath says, "You can bring your cloak to a tanning vat to apply the salve. Make sure it's coated fully before returning it to me for inspection. You don't need to have any actual tanning skill, so don't worry about ruining your cloak." He will give to you a [[Cultivating Salve]] and return your cloak. Head to the tannery above the Blacksmith : Place the salve and your cloak in the tanning vat and press craft. Return your cloak to Gaereth. : Gaereth Ashenpath checks over the cloak and offers a nod. : Gaereth Ashenpath says, "Good, see here? The fivers of your cloak are starrting to weave together stronger than they once were. It should be more resilient to poison in general." : Gaereth Ashenpath says, "This is just one of the many gifts that we've been given by the forests of Evershade, and why its so important that we protect our home. We help the land and it helps us in turn." : Gaereth Ashenpath returns the cloak to you, which looks to be developing a series of reinforced vines. : Gaereth Ashenpath says, "I'll teach you more about creating you own salve at a later time. For now, you should return to Captain Relgen and show him the cloak so he knows you're prepared for the next assignment. The salve should be set fully by the time you show him. : Gaereth Ashenpath says, "Oh, and here. Take this as a gift from me. A lot of rangers like yourself might find it useful out in the Weald." : Gaereth Ashenpath tosses you a small, glowing orb. :He gives you a [[Fire Beetle Eye]] (useful for [[Burning Embers]] spell if you don't have one already). :He gives you a [[Coated Keeper's Cloak]]. === Part 4 - Req. Lvl 8=== Return your cloak to Captain Relgan Greenblade. : Captain Relgan Greenblade says, "With this you may be capable of an important assignment, initiate." You say, "What assignment?" : Captain Relgan Greenblade says, "We've recently received reports from the Wyrdguard scouts that orcs have encroached further into our territory than previously expected. As the protectors of our borders, this is an offense that we cannot ignore." : Captain Relgan Greenblade says, "The Wyrdguard have already involved themselves in the effort to cull the orcish presence, and the Keepers will not be far behind. We know they have trackers which they employ to hunt innocent caravans on the route to Faelindral." : Captain Relgan Greenblade says, "You're to hunt down their orc trackers before they manage to lay a finger upon an innocents. Eliminate as many as it takes to uncover who or what they might be reporting to, then bring back any evidence you find to me." Kill [[Fellstone Tracker]]s and bring him any [[Unintelligible Report]]s you find. You need bring only one. : Captain Relgan Greenblade frowns as he tries to make sense of the brutish orc script. : Captain Relgan Greenblade says, "This is utter nonsense to my eyes. Thankfully, there's a researcher who's currently attempting to decipher the orcish language." : Captain Relgan Greenblade says, "Bring the report to Researcher Fairgrove, who's likely poring over texts at the Heartwood Archives." : Captain Relgan Greenblade says, "Find out if she can glean any meaning from these accursed scribbles." [[Researcher Fairgrove]] is found above the bank. Give her the report. : Researcher Fairgrove says, "O-oh, what's this? From an... o-orc tracker? Let me s-see what I can make out for you, K-Keeper." : Researcher Fairgrove produces a blank parchment and begins to cross-reference the orc report with a number of symbols she has mapped out across a series of leafscrolls. : Researcher Fairgrove murmurs softly to herself, her stutter seeming to vanish when caught in a moment of heavy concentration. : Researcher Fairgrove says, "Time... attack... orders. Foot-no, toes? Four. Four feet? Hmm... this is quite curious." : Researcher Fairgrove turns her attention back to you, blinking owlishly as her stutter resumes from where it left off. : Researcher Fairgrove says, "I, u-umm... I b-believe the report mentions something about an... an a-attack , and orders coming from s-someone names Fourth Feet? Or Four Toes." : Researcher Fairgrove says, "I think that F-four Toes makes the most sense, but then again... w-we're talking about orcs. : Researcher Fairgrove says, "Unfortunately that's a-all I can manage to decipher for now, but I... I hope that I was at least able to help in some regard, Keeper!" You receive [[Partially Translated Report]] from Researcher Fairgrove. Return to Captain Relgan Greenblade and give him the [[Partially Translated Report]]. : Captain Relgan Greenblade says, "Hmm, four toes, you say? It's not much, but it does give me an idea." : Captain Relgan Greenblade says, "If they're taking orders from someone named Four Toes, that might be all the information we need to track them down." : Captain Relgan Greenblade says, "This would also serve a s good test of your abilities, Keeper. There can't be too many orcs within Evershade who have four toes, after all. Let's hope their naming conventions are as literal as they sound." : Captain Relgan Greenblade says, "You'll need this for your important mission, Keeper." : Captain Relgan Greenblade retrieves a small pouch and tosses it to you. You receive [[Pouch of Scintillating Dust]] from Captain Relgan Greenblade. You say, "What important mission?" : Captain Relgan Greenblade says, "While eliminating orc leaders is always warranted, there are times when capturing an enemy alive is more beneficial in a prolonged battle." : Captain Relgan Greenblade says, "That powder I've given you was made from the mysterious foam you brought me during your initiation. You did well to bring me a sample. It has powerful hypnotic properties that we should be able to use to subdue the orc leader." : Captain Relgan Greenblade says, "The only snag will be searching for the right... opportunity." You say, "What opportunity?" : Captain Relgan Greenblade says, "Even orcs must sleep, so I propose you uncover the location of this leader's camp and wait until nightfall to subdue the four-toed beast while it slumbers." : Captain Relgan Greenblade says, "Once within their territory, use your tracking skills to search for signs of an orc that has four toes. If you locate any such tracks, follow them to their source and inspect the region for any evidence of where they've made camp. : Captain Relgan Greenblade says, "It'd be wise to shroud yourself if you're to infiltrate the orc-controlled regions, though you'll have to avoid the undead presence if that the route you choose. They have sight for the soul rather than what's truly visible." : Captain Relgan Greenblade says, "Approach the camp during the night to catch the leader while they sleep. Pour the dust onto them, and with any luck, you should be able to silently haul them back here for questioning." : Captain Relgan Greenblade says, "If you lose or misplace the dust, you can ask me for more. If the orc proves to be resistant to the effects of the foam... you have my leave to eliminate them. Your life before theirs, Keeper." Take the lift down to the middle of the map. Go past the ruins, across the bridge, across the Elder Spire tree platform, down another bridge. Finally, turn right and go down until you encounter orcs. Once there, use Track to follow [[a trial of curious footprints]] to its end point. Once there, /inspect footprints. These footprints differ from those of a typical orc, appearing to have four distinct toes instead of the usual three. Now that you are able to distinguish them from the others, you see that they lead toward the base of the nearby ramp, ascending the cliffside. Continue up the cliff side, turning to the right, and find an empty tent eventually. /Look around. This simple campsite appears deserted, bearing remnants of a crude fire long since extinguished. Wait until nighttime, then /look around again. Though well concealed atop the cliffs, you have managed to locate this crude campsite under cover of darkness. You notice a slight stirring from beneath the a heavy pile of furs. It seems to be a slumbering orc who is not yet aware of your presence. The wretched creature twitches beneath the furs as you examine it closer. It does not awaken, though you see it begin to grimace through clenched tusks. One of its feet emerges from beneath the furs, revealing a detail of great interest... four-toes. Put the [[Pouch of Scintillating Dust]] on your cursor and /pour it on the /orc. You carefully sprinkle the contents of the scintillating pouch over the orc's face. It recoils its snout as it unconsciously inhales the hypnotic dust. ''[[Bewildered Gorakk Four-Toes]] seethes at you, ready to strike -- Would you like to die? You would almost certainly be defeated in battle. '' The orc's eyes open groggily as it battles the effects of the dust, letting out a garbled groan as it gets to its feet and begins blindly swinging its arms! Cons red to a level 8 ranger, unknown level, estimated at level 11 by others. Immune to snare. Kill it anyway. Collect the [[Orc Commander's Head]] and return it to [[Captain Relgen Greenblade]]. : Captain Relgan Greenblade says, "It's unfortunate that you were unable to capture the commander alive, but this is still a great victory all the same." : Captain Relgan Greenblade says, "We'll have more opportunities to question the orc leadership and discover their true intentions in the future. For now, I award with this spear as a sign of your accomplishment." : Captain Relgan Greenblade says, "Carry it well, Almond, for you are an initiate no longer." : Captain Relgan Greenblade says, "You are a full and true Ardent Keeper!" You receive [[Reach of the Ardent Keeper]] from Captain Relgen Greenblade. === Part 5 === === Part 6 === [[Category:Quests]] [[Category:Faelindral Quests]] [[Category:Ranger Quests]]

Riverbend Gang Wars Quest.title: Riverbend Gang Wars Quest
Riverbend Gang Wars Quest.content: {{Quest |Start Zone = [[Night Harbor]] |Quest Giver = [[Corporal Theodora]] |Minimum Level = 10 |Classes = All |Related NPCs = [[Lieutenant Jarovik Holt]] }} == Notes == '''This quest appears to be a precursor to the [[Platinum Badge of the Living City Quest]].''' == Walkthrough == '''Before entering the Bends portion of Night Harbor, climb the nearby gate stairs to find [[Lieutenant Jarovik Holt]] and [[Corporal Theodora]]. Holt is visibly distressed and requests you speak with Theodora.''' You say, "Hail, Lieutenant Jarovik Holt." : Lieutenant Jarovik Holt frowns at you. : Lieutenant Jarovik Holt says, "Leave me be, citizen. Speak to my corporal, Theodora, if you want to make yourself useful." You say, "Who is Theodora?" : Lieutenant Jarovik Holt says, "You will find the corporal in yonder hall. Move along now." You say, "Hail, Corporal Theodora." : Corporal Theodora says, "Mind how you go, citizen. I cannot guarantee your safety if you enter the Bends." You say, "What are the Bends?" : Corporal Theodora says, "Riverbend is one of Night Harbor's oldest districts. It was once a vibrant fishing village and port of commerce, before the gangs took over." You say, "What gangs?" : Corporal Theodora says, "There are three rival gangs in the Bends... the [[Ten Hooks]], the [[Waterdogs]], and the [[Serpent Sashes]]. We've contained the worst of them within these walls, but I'm afraid Night Harbor won't know peace until we've exterminated their kind." : Corporal Theodora sighs. : Corporal Theodora says, "Now leave me to my work, citizen, unless you wish to aid our great city." You say, "I wish to aid our great city." : Corporal Theodora says, "Know this, citizen, should you enter the Bends, you'll be met with violence. Meet with the Ten Hooks and Waterdogs in the dirty hovels they inhabit, and bring me proof of your valor. You'll be well rewarded." '''Enter the Bends and begin killing the gang members residing there. These mobs will start non-KOS but will quickly become aggressive due to negative faction hits when killed.''' ''' Eventually, you will loot a [[Bloodied Allegiance Cuffs]]. Return to [[Corporal Theodora]] and hand her the cuffs.''' * Your faction standing with [[Bends Garrison]] got better. * Your faction standing with [[Cult of the Living City]] got better. " 1 full blue " * Your faction standing with [[Ten Hooks]] got worse. " 1 full blue " * Your faction standing with [[Waterdogs]] got worse. " 1 full blue " : Corporal Theodora says, "The streets are safer for your efforts, citizen." {{exp}} You receive 3 silver. '''This can also be done with''' [[Dirty Pirate Earring]] '''which also drops from the local mobs and gives a small faction boost and 2 silver.''' === Sub-Quests === '''There are other notable named gang members directly inside the first area of the Bends, [[Karif Jamah]], [[Tinka Roofstrider]], [[Vikar Brask]] and [[Ratan]]. It is unclear if they have dialogue to continue this quest...''' WATERDOGS You say, "Hail, Ratan." : Ratan says, "Hail yerself, mate. Standin' around... have you not got a job to do?" You say, "What job?" : Ratan says, "Ten Hooks are takin' liberties lately and we've given 'em enough chances. People don't learn if you don't explain it to 'em." You say "Who are the Ten Hooks?" : Ratan says, "Honest fishermen, so they say! As likely hook a fish as hook yer eyes out." : Ratan smirks. : Ratan says, "Those uppity thugs wear fancy cuffs like they're in a gentlemen's club or something. Bring me a pair and I'll give you a pretty penny." Give Ratan two [[Bloodied Allegiance Cuffs]] : Ratan says, "It ain't pretty, but it does the job. Here you go, mate." : You gain experience! : You receive 45 silver from Ratan. : Your faction standing with Waterdogs got better. : Your faction standing with Ten Hooks got worse. : Your faction with Cult of the Living City got worse. TEN HOOKS You say, "Hail, Karif Jamah." : Karif Jamah grins. : Karif Jamah says, "Speak up, Human. These streets belong to the Ten Hooks. What's your business?" You say, "Business?" : Karif Jamah says, "If your hands are idle, there's work that needs doing." You say, "Work?" : Karif Jamah says, "The Waterdogs have been useful to us, but they've become too bold." : Karif Jamah says, "Those pirates are fond of their jewelry. Collect four of their earrings and return them to me. Go now, remind them of their place." Give Karif Jamah 4 [[Dirty Pirate Earring]] : Karif Jamah counts out each earring in the palm of his hand. : Karif Jamah says, "Four coins for four souls. Our family thanks you." : You gain experience! : You receive 50 silver from Karif Jamah. (Bugged? This is not "four coins" and very much not worth doing 50/4=12.5 silver per ring, whereas turning into the watch grants 35 silver each...) : Your faction standing with Ten Hooks got better. : Your faction standing with Waterdogs got worse. : Your faction standing with Cult of the Living City got worse. '''((more information is required))''' == Video Overview == {{#ev:youtube|https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=-ospVGYoYIA|dimensions=640x360}} [[Category:Quests]] [[Category:Night Harbor Quests]]

Soul Binding.title: Soul Binding
Soul Binding.content:
{{Quest
| imagefilename     = A_priest_of_the_Matswar.png
| width             = 100px
| caption           = 
|Start Zone         = [[Night Harbor]]
|Quest Giver        = [[A priest of The Matswar|a priest of the Matswar]]
|Minimum Level      = 1
|Classes            = All
|Related NPCs       = [[A rotting skeleton|a rotting skeleton]]
}}
== Reward ==
* [[Icon of the Matswar]]

== Walkthrough ==
[[A priest of The Matswar|A priest of the Matswar]] is located at the Temple of the Matswar, which is in The Necropolis of Night Harbor.

You say, "Hail, a priest of the Matswar."

: a priest of the Matswar says, "Hail, friend. I am but a humble priest of the Matswar, offering service in his name."

: a priest of the Matswar says, "With the Matswar's blessing, I am able to retrieve long-lost corporeal forms from his realm."

: a priest of the Matswar says, "Shall I call forth your expired corpse, or do you require some other assistance?"

You say, "What other assistance can you provide?"

: a priest of the Matswar says, "I am able to bind your soul to this location and honor the exchange of icons from other temples."

You say, "Icons?"

: a priest of the Matswar says, "Many priests will trade icons of their gods in exchange for offerings. These icons may be exchanged for various services." 

: a priest of the Matswar says, "For example, if you were to take an icon of the Matswar to the Temple of Relle, the priest there would bind your soul to their temple in exchange."

You say, "Bind my soul?"

: a priest of the Matswar says, "Once bound to a location, the Matswar will safely guide your soul there should it depart from your body."

: a priest of the Matswar says, "If you would like me to bind your soul, I must first ask that you bring me an offering. A stack of bone chips will suffice."

: a priest of the Matswar says, "In return, I will exchange the offering for an icon of the Matswar. The icon can be exchanged at any temple to bind your soul there."

Collect 20 [[Bone Chips|bone chips]] from [[A rotting skeleton|rotting skeletons]] found throughout Night Harbor, then return to [[A priest of The Matswar|a priest of the Matswar]] and hand them in.

: a priest of the Matswar says, "Your gift honors our temple and pleases the Matswar. Take this icon in exchange for your service."

You receive [[Icon of the Matswar]] from a priest of the Matswar.

This quest is repeatable.

Ranger Starter Quest (Night Harbor).title: Ranger Starter Quest (Night Harbor)
Ranger Starter Quest (Night Harbor).content:
{{Quest | imagefilename = phicon.png | width = 100px | caption = Placeholder Image |Start Zone = [[Night Harbor]] |Quest Giver = - |Minimum Level = 1 |Classes = [[Ranger]] |Related NPCs = [[Fedamius Steele III]], [[Foss Dunestrider]] }} == Reward == * Experience
  • [[Steel Talon Trainee Tunic]]
== Walkthrough == Video Walk-Through: {{#ev:youtube|https://youtu.be/_jNzJzl-WBQ}}}} === Part 1 - Req. Lvl 1=== Read [[Notice of Recruitment]] you start with as a new Ranger Character: 
Recruit:

You are to deliver this note to Fedamius Steele III
in the Steel Talons Garrison to begin your training.

He can be found observing the courtyard from his 
post on the wall above.

If you get lost, ask a guard. Any guard worth their
salt will know his name.

And be quick about it.

-Steel Talons Recruitment
'''Head to the Steel Talons Martial Academy on the Southwest side of Night Harbor and hand in your [[Notice of Recruitment]] to [[Fedamius Steel III]]'''
{{exp}}
: Fedamius Steele III says, "What is it?" :Fedamius Steele III stares at you for a moment before reading the note. :Fedamius Steele III chuckles. : Fedamius Steele III says, "Well, well... Foss has another aspiring Ranger on his hands. I wonder how long it'll be before he's out pulling you out of the sand?" : Fedamius Steele III says, "The Rangers trained by the Steel Talons are the finest in the land, so you'll either become one of them or the next of your lot will use your corpse as a tracking exercise." : Fedamius Steele III says, "Now, take your note to Mister Dunestrider." : Fedamius Steele III says, "A skilled ranger needs no directions, so... you'll find him in one of the towers along the wall." :Fedamius Steele III gives you a smug look. '''Bold text'''You receive [[Notice of Recruitment]] from [[Fedamius Steel III]].

'''Head to the top of the Wayfarer's Hospice north of the west gate and follow the top of the wall south until you find [[Foss Dunestrider]] above the west gate.'''
: Hand him the [[Notice of Recruitment]]
{{exp}}
:Foss Dunstrider takes the note without breaking his gaze on some figure in the distance. : Foss Dunstrider says, "A new recruit, splendid. I know you're new to Night Harbor, but I'm sure you'll come to love this city as I do." : Foss Dunstrider says, "I've got some time, and I know you have at least a little skill from your experience outside these walls. So, let's see you in action. Take this tunic and head back down there." :Foss Dunstrider picks up a dusty tunic from a small pile at his feet. : Foss Dunstrider says, "As a test of your fieldcraft, I want you to collect the following..." : Foss Dunstrider says, "a natural light source, butchered from a proximal creature..." : Foss Dunstrider says, "a reagent harvested from a bat that might help you avoid a fall..." : Foss Dunstrider says, "a venom gland, carefully removed from one of the younger snakes below..." : Foss Dunstrider says, "and a Multhele Root." : Foss Dunstrider says, "You'll find all of these just outside our gates, with the exception of the root." You receive [[Steel Talon Trainee Tunic]] from [[Foss Dunestrider]].

=== Part 2 === '''Head down to the noob yard below and kill [[a snake]]s, [[a fire beetle]]s, and [[a desert bat]]s'''
: Keep killing until you receive an [[Immature Snake Venom Sac]], a [[Fire Beetle Eye]], and a [[Bat Wing]]. Alternatively you can buy these. : Then, head to the docks just east of the garrison and pick up a bag of [[Multhele Root]] under one of the docks. : Then, return to [[Foss Dunestrider]] '''Hand [[Foss Dunestrider]] the [[Multhele Root]], [[Immature Snake Venom Sac]], [[Fire Beetle Eye]], and [[Bat Wing]]'''
{{exp}}
: Foss Dunstrider says, "You looked good out there. And don't look surprised. Given that tunic, you weren't hard to track." :Foss Dunstrider looks at you and smiles. :Foss Dunstrider he looks at the items you handed him. : Foss Dunstrider says, "Excellent fieldcraft. A ranger's tricks of the trade mean the difference between life and death down range." : Foss Dunstrider says, "After watching you move around out there, you seem experienced or at least capable enough to assist me with a matter of personal interest." : Foss Dunstrider says, "The consensus in the garrison is that the Ashira are bothersome, but I think there's more to them than most assume. I think there's a sickness in them, but we've been unable to gather specifics. Maybe we can learn more by gathering information from other afflicted c reatures in the area." : Foss Dunstrider says, "I'd like you to carefully gather the blood of a diseased bat, rat, snake, and jackl. Seal the vials in this pack and return it to me when you're done." You receive [[Small Test Kit]] from [[Foss Dunestrider]].

'''Head to the cave entrance towards Wyrmsbane and kill [[a diseased bat]], [[a diseased rat]], [[a diseased snake]], and [[a diseased jackal]].'''
: Keep killing until you receive: [[Diseased Bat Blood]], [[Diseased Rat Blood]], [[Diseased Snake Blood]], and [[Diseased Jackal Blood]] Combine the four bloods in the small test kit you will get a sealed pouch, take the sealed pouch to [[Foss Dunestrider]] and you will receive a note. Take that note and your Steel Talon Trainee Tunic to [[Quartermaster Obaid]] to hand in and receive Steel Talons Scout Tunic (3ac/5hp/1dex) as well as some exp. === Part 3 - Req. Level ?? (Got it at 8, could be earlier) === '''Go to Oakes Wakim in the Circle of Scarce Rains Building''' : You say, "Hail, Oakes Wakim." : Oakes Wakim says, "Ah, another one of Dunestrider's rangers. Good. He said one of you might come asking about these samples." : You say, "Please tell me more about the samples." : Oakes Wakim says, "We've examined the blood your people gathered. Whatever afflicts these creatures is no common desert sickness." : Oakes Wakim picks up one of the vials and holds it toward the light. : Oakes Wakim says, "I've seen something similar before, many years ago. Creatures in the Howling Hills, west of Easthymn, suffered from an affliction with many of the same characteristics." : Oakes Wakim says, "But the Howling Hills are a very long way from Night Harbor. How the same sickness came to afflict creatures here, I cannot say." : Oakes Wakim carefully returns the vial to its place. : Oakes Wakim says, "These samples have told me all they can. If there are answers to be uncovered, I suspect they will be found where the creatures became sick, not in their blood." : Oakes Wakim says, "Speak with Foss Dunestrider. Give him back his pack. Ask him how to read the language of the land. Then perhaps the desert will tell you what these samples cannot." : You receive [[Sealed Test Kit]] from Oakes Wakim. '''Go back to [[Foss Dunestrider]]''' : Hand [[Sealed Test Kit]] to Foss. : Foss Dunestrider listens quietly as you explain what Oakes Wakim discovered. He carefully removes the diseased vials and hands you back the kit. : Foss Dunestrider says, "Hold onto this for the time being. Did Oakes give you any more instructions?" : You say, "Language of the land." : Foss Dunestrider says, "The language of the land... It's true, sharp eyes and a good intuition serve a ranger well in the desert." : Foss Dunestrider looks out across the Shaded Dunes. : Foss Dunestrider says, "Every creature leaves something behind. Tracks, blood, fur, droppings, a disturbed stone, a broken branch. Most folks walk pas a thousand stories every day because they don't know they're looking at words." : Foss Dunestrider says, "A ranger learns to read them." : Foss Dunestrider says, "You've alre4ady hunted the afflicted creatures. You know where they're being found. Go back to those places, but this time, don't go looking for something to kill." : Foss Dunestrider says, "Slow down. Look at the ground. Look at what doesn't belong. Ask yourself what happened there before you arrived. Be observant. See what others miss." : Foss Dunestrider says, "Find what is left behind so we may see where this mystery leads. Good hunting!" *At this point, you need to find four items to fill the test kit: a sun-bleached note, a stone, shards of a broken bottle, and a sample from a diseased jackal corpse. *All items outside of Wyrmsbane and you have to use MUD commands to interact with them. You can track the jackal corpse. *Note is in the sand of the ruins under an arch, the stone is on dead human that is hidden in ruins, the broken bottle is in the sand up the hill from the jackals, and the jackal corpse is on the hill up to the Wyrmsbane entrance. *Once you have all four of these items, combine them in the test kit and return to Foss. : Foss Dunestrider lays the objects out before him. : Foss Dunestrider says, "Now you're learning to see." : Foss Dunestrider picks up the broken bottle. : Foss Dunestrider says, "This didn't grow in the desert. Someone carried it there." : Foss Dunestrider examines the diseased jackal skin. : Foss Dunestrider says, "And you found the same sickness on the dead man?" : Foss Dunestrider listens to you recount what you discovered near the jackal and the condition of the corpse. : Foss Dunestrider says, "A sick man... a sick jackal. The jackal saw an opportune meal and became sick in turn. We can assume this has happened to many of the scavenger animals there. That's worth remembering." : Foss Dunestrider reads the weathered note. : Foss Dunestrider says, "Vespyra, Goddess of Magic..." : Foss Dunestrider says, "Plenty seek her wisdom. Doesn't mean she has anything to do with this." : Foss Dunestrider takes the purple fluorite prism and turns it slowly between his fingers. : Foss Dunestrider says, "A Vespyra's Stone..." : Foss Dunestrider says, "Not exactly the sort of thing I'd expect to find on a man wandering the desert without food or water." *At this point, Foss doesn't say anything more - you can check back with [[Assistant Researcher Nimvari]] near the entrance to Wyrmsbane for more clues. : You say, "A Vespyra Stone" : Assistant Researcher Nimvari rolls her eyes. : Assistant Researcher Nimvari says, "Oh, not you too." : Assistant Researcher Nimvari says, "That's what they kept asking about. Vespyra." : Assistant Researcher Nimvari says, "Had we found evidence of her presence? Had we discovered her grace? Was there some place here where the worthy could speak with her?" : Assistant Researcher Nimvari scoffs. : Assistant Researcher Nimvari says, "Vespyra is the Goddess of Magic. That doesn't make every pile of old stones a doorway to her." : You say, "Ancient magical obelisk." [phrase on the Sand Scoured Note] : Assistant Researcher Nimvari says, "That explains why they were so interested in Wyrmsbane." : Assistant Researcher Nimvari says, "They kept asking whether this was some ancient place of magic." : Assistant Researcher Nimvari says, "It isn't. At least, we've found nothing to suggest that it is." : Assistant Researcher Nimvari says, "Eventually I told them there are two old crypts further into the Shaded Dunes. There are stories of strange magical presences surrounding both." : Assistant Researcher Nimvari gives you a sheepish smile. : Assistant Researcher Nimvari says, "I may have suggested they continue their search out that way." : Assistant Researcher Nimvari says, "Mostly because I wanted them away from our excavation." Shadow Knight Starter Quest (Night Harbo.title: Shadow Knight Starter Quest (Night Harbor)
Shadow Knight Starter Quest (Night Harbo.content:
{{Quest | imagefilename = phicon.png | width = 100px | caption = Placeholder Image |Start Zone = [[Night Harbor]] |Quest Giver = [[Exavius Deathwhisper]] |Minimum Level = 1 |Classes = SHD |Related NPCs = [[Brazzic Durraim]] [[Noel Klares]] }} == Reward == * Experience * [[Gold Trimmed Black Tunic]] == Walkthrough == === Part 1 - Req. Lvl 1=== Read Weathered Note you start with as a new Shadow Knight character: 
Take this note to Exavius Deathwhisper in the
Concourse of Souls to begin your training.

The guild hall can be found within the Necropolis
District.

You'll find it if you proceed through the Sageside
District towards Saltbreeze Park. If you get to the
Tannery, you've gone too far.

Or if you are very daring, there's a shortcut 
through the old cemetery outside of the Black
Feather Bazaar. This will lead into the Necropolis
District.

If you get lost, ask a guard. They are often helpful
with directions.

And try not to die. We have enough undead in the
desert already.
'''Give Weathered Note to Exavius Deathwhisper.''' : Exavius Deathwhisper says, "Welcome. We are looking to expand our ranks, but expect to be vetted." : Exavius Deathwhisper says, "You'll need to prove to be a value beyond just your capability to survive the desert and deliver notes. Your loyalty will be tested." : Exavius Deathwhisper says, "Night Harbor is far more than what shows on her surface. You'll see in due time and we'll learn the durability of your resolve." : Exavius Deathwhisper says, "Take your note to Brazzic, downstairs in the sleeping quarters. He'll get you started." {{exp}} '''You receive Weathered Note from Exavius Deathwhisper.''' : Brazzic Durraim says, "Well? Out with it." : Brazzic Durraim says, "... and if you think I mean your tongue, my response will be painful." '''Give Weathered Note Note to [[Brazzic Durraim]] who is also in the Concourse of Souls.''' : Brazzic Durraim says, "Well, you made it. Our people have been watching you. Appears you're more "knight" than "shadow" for the time being. And to be fair, friend, you don't look like much of a knight." : Brazzic Durraim says, "But at least you arrived, and I guess that counts for something." : Brazzic Durraim says, "We're going to get straight to business. Let's see how you operate." : Brazzic Durraim says, "Deliver the note to a gentleman named Noel Klares. Bring back whatever he gives you." : Brazzic Durraim says, "The bag is to be filled with shattered femurs from the bone piles you saw stumbling around out in the desert. Do you have questions?" {{exp}} ''You receive Sealed Scroll from Brazzic Durraim.'' ''You receive Black Leather Bag from Brazzic Durraim.'' '''Go out into the yard in front of the Concourse of Souls and hunt [[a rotting skeleton]] until you have 6 [[Shattered Skeleton Femur]]. Combine them inside the Black Leather Bag from Brazzic and receive a [[Bag of Femurs]].''' '''Locate [[Noel Klares]] in the Wayfarers Hospice in [[Night Harbor]] and give him the Sealed Scroll. (find guard tower, go up, back inside 2nd floor, find ramp, go up, he's on the roof). *** Warning. The guards will assist him if they are nearby. It is recommended to pull him to a safer area where guards will not patrol.''' : Noel Klares says, "Who sent you?! What do you know of us? No matter, I'll deal with you myself!" He Will attack, Kill him. : Noel Klares says, "You've come to confront me? Don't you know who I work for?" : Noel Klares says, "... they ... they will ... find you." ''Loot [[Noel Klares' Ring]] from [[Noel Klares]].'' '''Return to [[Brazzic Durraim]] and give him [[Bag of Femurs]] and [[Noel Klares' Ring]].''' : Brazzic Durraim says, "Bravo! Our people say you performed well. And the fact that you're here now and not locked in prison, means that you've got a bit of a shadow to your knight after all." : Brazzic Durraim says, "Feels good to do bad things to bad people sometimes, eh?" : Brazzic Durraim says, "As master Hallows was kind enough to establish this wonderful college from which we now operate, we in return, provide services to his necromancers and faculty." : Brazzic Durraim says, "Please take the bag over to Buckmarr Gorstagg, the head alchemist. He'll make use of it's contents." : Brazzic Durraim says, "Your next task will involve his favorite abomination. Return to me after you've assisted him with it. Then, maybe you can take a little break and peruse some of this fair city's night life." ''You receive [[Bag of Femurs]] from Brazzic Durraim.'' === Part 2 - Req. Lvl 8 or 5 if you have a group for Wererats=== : You say, "Hail [[Buckmarr Gorstagg]]." : Buckmarr Gorstagg looks up from his work. : Buckmarrgorstagg says, "It's extremely important that my work not be disturbed. What is it?" '''Hand him the [[Bag of Femurs]] {{exp}} : Buckmarr Gorstagg opens the bag and examines the contents. : Buckmarr Gorstagg says, "Yes, this will do. Thank you." : Buckmarr Gorstagg removes a bladed weapon from a black silk bag. : Buckmarr Gorstagg says, "Please take this weapon. I'm experimenting with coating in an attempt to see if it will cauterize certain wounds in a manner suitable for my needs." : Buckmarr Gorstagg says, "There's rumored to be a camp deep along the coast of Shaded Dunes that's utilized by wererats posing as smugglers. Or wererat smugglers. Or some such nonsense." : Buckmarr Gorstagg says, "Use the blade to sever their whiskered heads and return them to me. Bring me at least four.: : Buckmarr Gorstagg pauses for a moment. '''You receive [[Silver Edged Blade]] from Buckmarr Gorstagg. : Buckmarr Gorstagg says, "If you feel like they should be made to suffer, please by all means, but do take care not to mention this to Master Hallows. He worries about the attention your people draw to our work here." : Buckmarr Gorstagg returns to his work. === Part 3 - Req. Lvl none(?) just a turn in for part 2 above=== '''Hand [[Buckmarr Gorstagg]] 4 [[Wererat Head]] and the [[Silver Edged Blade]]. {{exp}} : Buckmarr Gorstagg lines the heads up and stares at them. : Buckmarr Gorstagg says, "Well, I do hope they suffered. I would have taken my time with them." : Buckmarr Gorstagg pokes one of the heads. : Buckmarr Gorstagg says, "The wounds look promising. I'll need to examine them more in detail, but I'm sure my blade performed as planned." : Buckmarr Gorstagg hands you a concoction filled vial. : Buckmarr Gorstagg says, "Please give this to Brazzic for me. I'm sure Master Deathwhisper is awaiting its delivery." ''You receive [[Small Brown Vial]] from Buckmarr Gorstagg.'' : Buckmarr Gorstagg says, "I may have other work for you later. But for now, that is all" : Buckmarr Gorstagg returns to poking at one of the heads. === Part 4 - Req. Lvl none(?) just a turn in for the tunic reward=== '''Hand [[Brazzic Durraim]] the [[Small Brown Vial]] {{exp}} : Brazzic Durraim looks at the vial and frowns for a moment. : Brazzic Durraim says, "Buckmarr should know better than to give this to just anyone, but you seem to be ingratiating yourself well enough. I assume he refrained from describing its contents, yes?" : Brazzic Durraim appears to scan your face for clues. : Brazzic Durraim says, "I'll take that as a "no." Good." : Brazzic Durraim says, "You're doing good work so far. I think you'll fit in just fine here. Take this and then take some time to go explore the city. It's more of a hunting ground than it looks." : Brazzic Durraim says, "Just be careful of some of the darker corners. You've still got some learning to do yet, "shadow knight."" : Brazzic Durraim hands you a tunic. ''You receive [[Gold Trimmed Black Tunic]] from Brazzic Durraim.'' : Brazzic Durraim winks at you. : Brazzic Durraim says, "Come back later and I'll likely have some new work for you."

Shaman Starter Quest (Night Harbor).title: Shaman Starter Quest (Night Harbor)
Shaman Starter Quest (Night Harbor).content:
{{Quest | imagefilename = Seeker of the Lost Eye Icon.jpeg | width = 250px | caption = Night Harbor Shaman Quest |Start Zone = [[Night Harbor]] |Quest Giver = [[Errol Shrewtender]] |Minimum Level = 1 |Classes = [[Shaman]] |Related NPCs = | Related Items = Bone Chips }} == Reward ==
  • [[Awakened Spirit Pouch]]
  • [[Dusty Spiritist Tunic]]
  • Experience
== Walkthrough == == Part 1 - First steps of being a Shaman == Read Hastily Scrawled Note you start with as a new Shaman Character: 
On a sheet of parchment, you hastily wrote down the fading vestiges of a disturbing dream, as follows:

I found myself standing in a vast, open field, the sky as golden as the endless wheat around me. The setting sun gave way to an unblinking eye, which blinded me, yet allowed me to see more than I could before. What could it all mean?

Make haste to the Seekers of the Lost Eye, there, they will help you make sense of this unusual dream.

The Seekers are located within Saltbreeze Park, central to the city and right below the Great Guild Hall.

If you're feeling lost out there, remember this:
our sun, Eth, rises in the East and sets to the West, and the Twilight Bay is always to the South. Need help beyond that? Just ask a guard. They'll often be able to assist with directions.
'''Give 'Hastily Scrawled Note' to [[Errol Shrewtender]].''' Errol Shrewtender pauses, taking the note into his hands. : " A strange dream you've had and you've been sent here? Hmmm." Errol Shrewtender studies the note carefully, before looking up to you. : "Yes, this is quite an unusual dream. However, it is not something to be afraid of." : "You have a gift, ." : "You possess the ability to peer into the looming darkness, a power not known by many, and fewer still learn to harness it. Do you wish to harness your power, ? It is a grueling path, but one which will bring you insight into the true nature of Eth-ur." Errol Shrewtender produces a small pouch and tunic, before handing them to you. : "It's not much, but here is your guild tunic, marking you as an Initiate in the Seekers of the Lost Eye. And here is a spirit pouch. I was given one as an initiate myself, many years ago. Bring it to Masoumeh, and she will give you your first task." ''You receive Uncured Spirit Pouch from Errol Shrewtender.'' ''You receive Seekers of the Lost Eye Tunic from Errol Shrewtender.'' Errol Shrewtender smiles, before turning away, ignoring you. **Stop here to keep the Pouch as a free four slot bag. Once you do the next step it becomes unusable as a bag. '''Give the Uncured Spirt Pouch to [[Masoumeh Akhtar]].''' Masoumeh Akhtar looks down at the pouch in your hands, before gasping. : "Oh! You must be , the one with the strange dreams. Yes, welcome to our order!" Masoumeh Akhtar gives you a warm smile, though something is clearly on the young woman's mind. : "It is custom for all shamans inducted into the order to begin preparations for their Becoming Ritual." : "That pouch of yours contains some very special magic, and with the proper reagents, you can begin to prepare for your ritual." : "You will need to collect some moondew moss, a fire beetle gland, and two chips of bone from an animated undead. Place them inside your pouch and crush them together to combine them, and then bring it back to me." : "If you have any trouble finding any of the items, don't hesitate to ask. Good luck, ." Masoumeh Akhtar smiles at you, bidding farewell. Collect 2 [[Bone Chips]] from skeletons, 1 [[Fire Beetle Gland]] from fire beetles, and 1 [[Moondew Moss]]. The Moondew Moss is found at a well outside the West gate of Night Harbor (during the night cycle). Finding the Well: : Leave Night Harbor from the West Gate. : Continue walking forward and slightly to the left. : Once you locate the small ruins with the Shifty Gnome, continue further West (towards the green tower in the distance.) : The well is behind a ruined wall nearby to the Shifty Gnome. Once near the well, type "/look" the well will respond: "You see an old well. Its crumbling exterior betrays its age, and it appears to be as old as the rest of the ruins nearby." Type "/take moss" and you will receive Moondew Moss. '''Single stack those four items into the Uncured Spirit Pouch, it will turn into Shaman's Fiery Base. Turn into Masoumeh Akhtar.''' : "Oh! Wonderful, it looks like you've successfully made the base for your ritual." Masoumeh Akhtar smiles at you fondly. : "I remember when I was preparing for my ritual... anyhow, there's a little something else that needs to be done before the base is ready." Masoumeh Akhtar takes out a small bottle, uncorking it and letting out a few drops of a strange, crimson liquid. Upon contact with the acidic base, it begins to foam, and she hands your pouch back to you. You notice the leather is somehow sturdier because of the trial it has just endured. ''You receive Cured Spirit Pouch from Masoumeh Akhtar.'' : "Take this pouch over to my father, Eskander. He will tell you what to do next. Good luck, initiate. May the spirits bless you. Masoumeh Akhtar bows towards you respectfully. == Part 2 - Craft the Potion == '''Requires Level 4''' Go two levels upstairs and find [[Eskander Akhtar]]. At level 4 you can hand him the Cured Spirit Pouch and continue the quest. : Eskander Ahktar says, "...Ah, a new initiate, I see. You need a task from me?" Eskander Akhtar frowns, before suddenly letting out an exasperated sigh. : Eskander Akhtar says, "Very well. Harvallen Root, gather one and bring it back to me." Eskander Akhtar waves his hand dismissively turning his gaze back to the city. [[Harvallen Root]] drops off [[An ashira shaman]] in [[Shaded Dunes]]. They do not drop in [[Sungreet Strand]], but can also be obtained from [[A shady peddler]] in the Night Market at night or by saying "root" to [[Herbmonger Nabiah]] and completing her task. Hand him the Harvallen Root and he responds (this step may not be necessary): : Eskander Akhtar says, "You have the root? Good, now hand me your pouch as well." ''You receive your items back from Eskander Akhtar.'' Hand the Harvallen Root and Cured Spirit Pouch to him together and you receive Purified Entheogenic Powder and he responds: : Eskander Ahktar says, "Hm, you've done well initiate. It has been ground to a powder and purified. You are now almost ready for your Becoming Ritual. There are a few more components needed." : Eskander Akhtar says, "I'll keep your pouch for now and prepare it for the Becoming Ritual." : Eskander Akhtar says, "The ritual is a harrowing experience, and I am ill to suggest it to an unseasoned shaman such as yourself." : Eskander Akhtar says, "If you believe yourself ready, bring your powder back to me and we'll discuss next steps." '''Requires Level 8''' At level 8 hand him the Purified Entheogenic Powder and he responds; : Eskander Akhtar says, "Ah yes. The final step of your becoming ritual." : Eskander Akhtar crosses his arms. : Eskander Akhtar says, "I suppose you're ready. Take your powder to Errol, he will tell you what to do next." : Eskander Akhtar says, "Don't just stand around... go already!" Hand the Purified Entheogenic Powder to Errol Shrewtender and he responds: Errol Shrewtender Takes your powder from you, holding it in his hands gingerly. He unfolds the package, taking a sniff. After a moment, he nods. : Errol Shrewtender says, "This is good. Very good, I expect nothing less from Eskander's teachings." : Errol Shrewtender takes a breath, giving you a single nod. : Errol Shrewtender says, "Very well." : Errol Shrewtender says, "For your final task, you must prepare the last of the materials needed for your Becoming Ritual." Errol Shrewtender closes his eyes, taking another deep breath. : Errol Shrewtender says, "Your Becoming Ritual signifies the final rite of passage, and completes the last step of your initiation. However, the materials for the ritual are difficult to come by, and you will face many dangers. : Errol Shrewtender says, "We need you to acquire a Duskglow pod, grave dust, and a deepgloom mushroom." Errol Shrewtender says, "Masoumeh can help you find those, ask her for the details." Errol Shrewtender fishes around in his pocket. ''You receive Order for Selenite from Errol Shrewtender.'' : Errol Shrewtender says, "Take this order to her, we need this fulfilled for the last material, the selenite crystal powder." : Errol Shrewtender says, "Once you have acquired all the ingredients, return them all to me and I will mix them for you." : Errol Shrewtender says, "Good luck!" ''You receive your items back from Eskander Akhtar.'' Hand the Order of Selenite to Masoumeh Akhtar (next to Errol Shrewtender) and she responds: Masoumeh Akhtar takes the note from you. : Masoumeh Akhtar says, "Ah! Yes, please go speak with Foreman Stonehammer at the old Quarry in Sungreet Strand. He can provide you with the selenite powder." Masoumeh Akhtar purses her lips. : Masoumeh Akhtar says, "He's kind of an ass, though, so if he gives you a hard time..." Masoumeh Akhtar sighs. : Masoumeh Akhtar says "Just do what he asks." ''You receive your items back from Eskander Akhtar.'' Asking Masoumeh Akhtar about the ingredients Errol Shrewtender mentioned gives clues to their whereabouts. You say, "duskglow pod" : Masoumeh Akhtar says, "Duskglow pods are aquatic plants that thrive in heat, they can be found in the Shaded Dunes, but only at night. You should look for them where there's an oasis with glowing water and nobody around to disturb them." You say, "grave dust" : Masoumeh Akhtar says, "Grave Dust... you can find something like that deep in the Tomb of the Last Wyrmsbane." Masoumeh Akhtar looks over to you. : Masoumeh Akhtar says, "Please be careful. It is a dangerous place. I would look for the dust in a room where revered skeletons are interred." : Masoumeh Akhtar says, "Good luck!" You say, "deepgloom mushroom" : Masoumeh Akhtar says, "The Ashira are known for harvesting the deepgloom mushroom deep in Tel Ekir, but I can't imagine them wanting to trade it to you..." : Masoumeh Akhtar says, "They enjoy a lot of humidity, maybe they'd sprout next to a waterfall?" Details: {{Spoiler |[[Duskglow Pod]] (say /take pod at the oasis north of the Caves of Irem (There WAS NOT a sound of a bard song or chimes)) Can't be collected before lvl 8 }} {{Spoiler |[[Deepgloom Mushroom]] (say /take Mushroom in the cave behind the waterfall (There is a sound of a bard song or chimes)) }} {{Spoiler |[[Grave Dust]] (say /take dust in one of the side cutouts leading up to the bone construct (There is a sound of a bard song or chimes)) }} '''Foreman Stonehammer''' Location Details: {{Spoiler|In Sungreet Strand, at the Quarry, on a platform in the North west corner, with [[Sister Elara]]. }} : Foreman Stonehammer says, "Aye, I see ya there traveler. What buisness do ya have at the quarry? Make it quick, I don't have all day." Pass him the [[:Order for Selenite]] : Foreman Stonehammer says, "I'd be glad t' give ya yer powder... but first ya gotta do somethin' for me." : Foreman Stonehammer says, "One of those damn goblin sneaks made off with my favorite canteen! If ya get it back for me, I'll give ya yer powder." : Foreman Stonehammer says, "Oh, don't look at me like that! Yer lucky I'm even handin' it over!" {{Spoiler |[[Battered Canteen]] Can be found as a drop from [[a goblin sneak]] nearby (level 8-10) }} Handing in just the [[Battered Canteen]]: : Foreman Stonehammer snatches the canteen from your hands. : Foreman Stonehammer says, "Wait a sec! Didn't you have an order to give me?" Handing in the [[Battered Canteen]] and the [[Order for Selenite]]: : Foreman Stonehammer snatches the canteen from your hands while the order falls to the ground. : Foreman Stonehammer says, "Hot damn! You just saved me from gettin' an earful from the missus!" : Foreman Stonehammer fishes through his pockets for a moment, discarding a wad of lint, an unidentifiable hairball, and a few pieces of paper. Finally, he retreives a small cloth bag and wipes away a greasy substance from it onto his sleeve. : Foreman Stonehammer says, "Here ya go! No takebacks!" : Foreman Stonehammer grins broadly. {{Exp}} You receive [[Powdered Selenite]] from [[Foreman Stonehammer]] Once you've acquired all the ingredients hand them back to Errol Shrewtender and he responds: : Errol Shrewtender says, "This is very good progress." ''Errol Shrewtender combines the material in a pouch, creating a slurry of sorts.'' : Errol Shrewtender says, "Here, take the slurry I just made out of the ingredients you gave me and mix it inside your pouch with the purified powder, this'll be the base of your elixir." ''Errol Shrewtender shakes his head, his expression sullen.'' : Errol Shrewtender says, "Unfortunately, there isn't anything we can do beyond this for now." : Errol Shrewtender says, "Not until we get our Ancient Urn back that is. It's been a part of the guild since before it's founding, you see, and it's necessary for the final preparation step of your Becoming Ritual." : Errol Shrewtender says, "Once you feel ready, show me or Masoumeh your elixir and we will share more details with you." {{Exp}} You receive [[Shimmering Slurry]] and [[Blessed Spirit Pouch]]. Combine: [[Shimmering Slurry]] and [[Purified Entheogenic Powder]] inside the [[Blessed Spirit Pouch]] to create [[Muddy Elixir of Becoming]] == Part 3 - Retrieve the Urn == Hand [[Muddy Elixir of Becoming]] to [[Errol Shrewtender]] : Errol Shrewtender says, "To move forward with the Becoming Ritual, we must find the urn. Our members have been searching desperately for it, investigating thieves and the like, but I have a feeling you might have better luck." : Errol Shrewtender says, "Please speak to Masoumeh and ask her about the urn, she should have further details." Hand [[Muddy Elixir of Becoming]] to [[Masoumeh Akhtar]] : Masoumeh Akhtar says, "Oh, yes, you have the elixir but our ancient urn is gone..." ''Masoumeh Akhtar presses her fingers together, fidgeting slightly.'' : Masoumeh Akhtar says, "It was unfortunately stolen a few nights ago. Old Mother Roshan overheard the name of one of the thieves - a graverobber by the name of 'Ariblast' - but that is all we have to go on. Perhaps if you poked around in the yards surrounding the city, you might be able to find out more." ''Masoumeh Akhtar frowns.'' : Masoumeh Akhtar says, "I wish I had more to go on... Good luck." Spoiler Details: {{Spoiler |[[Ariblast the Wicked]] in [[Tomb of the Last Wyrmsbane]] drops the [[Ancient Painted Urn]] }} Handing [[Errol Shrewtender]] just the [[Ancient Painted Urn]]. ''Errol Shrewtender holds the urn joyfully, as a smile emerges on his lips.'' : Errol Shrewtender says, "You got it back! We owe you a great debt!" ''Errol Shrewtender bows to you.'' : Errol Shrewtender says, "I require the elixir as well. Please hand me both items and I will proceed." Handing [[Errol Shrewtender]] the [[Ancient Painted Urn]] and the [[Muddy Elixir of Becoming]]. ''Errol Shrewtender holds the urn joyfully, as a smile emerges on his lips.'' : Errol Shrewtender says, "Most excellent indeed! Now we can proceed with the ritual." ''Errol Shrewtender carefully places the urn on the ground and pours the elixir into it. He begins to mutter what sounds like a hymn, and the faintest tingle runs up your spine.'' ''Errol Shrewtender hands the elixir back to you with a beaming smile.'' : Errol Shrewtender says, "Now you're almost ready to walk your waking dream." : Errol Shrewtender says, "The final step involves your elixir and your pouch. Hand them to me, and I will finalize the ritual preparations!" You receive [[Bubbling Elixir of Becoming]] from [[Errol Shrewtender]]. Handing [[Errol Shrewtender]] the [[Blessed Spirit Pouch]] and the [[Bubbling Elixir of Becoming]]. ''Errol Shrewtender pours a mysterious liquid onto the spirit pouch, which flows down it and drips into the eilxir.'' : Errol Shrewtender says, "Now your pouch is cleansed and your elixir is purified!" ''Errol Shrewtender smiles at you warmly.'' : Errol Shrewtender says, "Walk your waking dream by drinking the elixir, then the Becoming Ritual will be complete! Don't be scared now... stand proud and tall!" You receive [[Awakened Spirit Pouch]] from [[Errol Shrewtender]]. You receive [[Purified Elixir of Becoming]] from [[Errol Shrewtender]]. {{Exp}} ''Your faction standing wiht the Seekers of the Lost Eye got better.''
Upon consuming the [[Purified Elixir of Becoming]]
''A burning surge floods your chest. Fear, fire, and the weight of past failures crash over you. It feels as though you are teetering on the edge of an abyss, consumed by everything you have tried to forget.''
''A voice stirs from within, urging you not to be afraid. Pain and failure are your teachers. You push forward, and the haze lifts. Your feet move again, and the salty sea breeze fills your nostrils.''
