Spellblade Starter Quest (Night Harbor).title: Spellblade Starter Quest (Night Harbor)
Spellblade Starter Quest (Night Harbor).content:
{{Quest | imagefilename = phicon.png | width = 100px | caption = Placeholder Image |Start Zone = [[Night Harbor]] |Quest Giver = [[Torn Note (Spellblade)|Torn Note]] |Minimum Level = 1 |Classes = [[Spellblade]] |Related NPCs = [[Jaffar Jhaym]] [[Njau Hansou]] [[Buckmarr Gorstagg]] [[an ashira raider]] |Related Items = [[Scorched Skeletal Remains]] |Quest Rewards = }} == Reward == * Experience * [[Spellbinders Blade Talisman]] == Walkthrough == === Part 1 - Req. Lvl 1=== '''Read [[Torn Note (Spellblade)|Torn Note]] you start with as a new Spellblade character:''' 
Seek out Jaffar Jhaym in the Spellbinders Spire. It is located in Night Harbor's northeastern district of Sageside. You can often find him in the Spire's observatory.

You will need to use the translocation devices below the wizards' tower to reach the academy grounds. Don't be alarmed.

Your interest in advancement as a Spellblade is well served by Master Jhaym's tutelage. He is both quite accomplished and well regarded within Night Harbor.

Good luck!
'''Give Torn Note to [[Jaffar Jhaym]].''' {{exp}} :Jaffar Jhaym examines your note and then smiles broadly at you. : Jaffar Jhaym says, "Very well met! Welcome to the Spellbinders Spire!" : Jaffar Jhaym says, "While I will not be training you myself, I'm always excited to meet one of our new Spellblades!" : Jaffar Jhaym says, "I am sure we will get better acquainted in the days to come, but for now, you will be under the tutelage of Master Njau Hansou. You likely passed him in the training yard on your way up." : Jaffar Jhaym says, "Take your note to Njau, he will know what to do from there." You receive [[Torn Note (Spellblade)|Torn Note]] from [[Jaffar Jhaym]]. :Jaffar Jhaym bows slightly with a smile. '''Give Torn Note to [[Njau Hansou]].''' :Njau Hansou nods at you in a welcoming manner. : Njau Hansou says, "I take it you've spoken to Jaffar already... wonderful! Let us start then." : Njau Hansou says, "We will test your proficiency with the most basic weapon infusion... the arcane infusion. This task will serve several purposes, though." : Njau Hansou says, "As you likely know, we at the Spire investigate the misuse of magic in Night Harbor... but there is also a form of Corruption at play in this entire region of Azuur. We wish to learn more." : Njau Hansou says, "You are to take this bag, fill it with the remains of the undead you find in the desert and then seal it. Should you correctly infuse your weapon, the remains you find shall bear the charred makings of a successful strike." You receive [[Njau's Bone Bag]] from [[Njau Hansou]].'''''' :Njau Hansou sends you off with a sharp nod. '''Kill [[a rotting skeleton|skeletons]] outside the gates of Night Harbor (or in the Concourse of Souls) for [[Scorched Skeletal Remains]].''' :Option: Since you cannot advance to next step until you are much higher level, you could skip the combine and keep the handy 6-slot bag until you are ready to continue. :Combine 6 [[Scorched Skeletal Remains]] within the [[Njau's Bone Bag]] to acquire the [[Bag of Scorched Bones]] '''Give the [[Bag of Scorched Bones]] to [[Njau Hansou]]''' {{exp}} :Njau Hansou nods in an appreciative manner, while through the bag. : Njau Hansou says, "This is excellent work. I can tell your proficiency with a blade leaves nothing to be desired. You are a welcome addition to our ranks." : Njau Hansou says, "Please deliver the bag to Buckmarr in the Concourse of Souls. You will find it in the necropolis to the west of here. It is rather hard to miss its ominous green glow..." You receive [[Bag of Scorched Bones]] from [[Njau Hansou]]. :Njau Hansou smiles. : Njau Hansou says, "Buckmarr can be somewhat irritating, but I trust him. So, please bring me any updates he may have for us." '''Give the [[Bag of Scorched Bones]] to [[Buckmarr Gorstagg]]''' {{exp}} :Buckmarr Gorstagg looks through the bag, then at you. : Buckmarr Gorstagg says, "Well, these are interesting scorch marks. I suppose that's what you people are in the habit of doing. However, I find it interesting that both of our guilds are in the business of keeping magical things in check for the city, yet take such wildly different approaches." :Buckmarr Gorstagg thinks for a moment. : Buckmarr Gorstagg says, "If the council put me in charge of running things, I'd likely have a much more efficient solution for dealing with the use of magic, etcetera, etcetera. But... I'm too busy for that anyway." : Buckmarr Gorstagg says, "Speaking of which, please take this research back to Njau. He's bound to be impressed by my conclusions. And don't let that nosy librarian see it. He's a pest." You receive [[Buckmarr's Research]] from [[Buckmarr Gorstagg]]. '''Give [[Buckmarr's Research]] to [[Njau Hansou]]''' {{exp}} :Njau Hansou unfurls the scroll and quick reads over it, pausing a moment to quickly glance around. : Njau Hansou says, "Thank you for bringing me this." : Njau Hansou says, "Your next tasks will be in support of Petra's Inquisitors. They have been assigned to investigate a group of smuggler's at a camp far west of here, along the shores of Shaded Dunes." : Njau Hansou says, "If you observe any of her trainees doing anything out of the ordinary, please report it directly to me. Do not speak to anyone else." : Njau Hansou says, "You will, of course, be there for legitimate reasons. Engage the smugglers cautiously, but aggressively. Use overwhelming violence in every engagement." : Njau Hansou says, "I believe them to have a logbook in their possession. Please return it to me intact." : Njau Hansou says, "This is not all, however. Are you ready to learn of your other tasks?" : You say, "What other tasks?" : Njau Hansou says, "Wonderful." : Njau Hansou says, "I also need you to investigate an ashira camp on the way to the smugglers. I have heard reports that they are attempting to raid the smugglers' camp... I am interested in their intentions. Please bring me any evidence you find." == Njau Hansou glances around before continuing. : Njau Hansou says, "Again, if you see any inquisitors engaging in suspicious activities, please make note of it. I know it is unlikely, but..." : Njau Hansou says, "...Do not misunderstand, the inquisitors are our allies. We have received reports that cultists ambushed several of Petra's recruits in the city, which has caused such suspicion." : Njau Hansou says, "When you are walking about, keep an eye out for movement in the shadows. Should you discover any of these cultists, engage them immediately. It would be of great interest if you could recover anything that might hint at their origins." : Njau Hansou says, "Keep in mind, this task is separate from your work at the camps." : >> See [[Cultists in Night Harbor]] === Part 2 - Req. Lvl 5 === : I did not take any notes or screenshots on exactly what the items are called below. If anyone can get those details please edit them below. *added correct damaged logbook name '''Kill [[an ashira raider]] in [[Shaded Dunes]] and loot missing logbook pages 1-6''' :NOTE:The raiders spawn at the middle oasis camp, they share a spawn with [[an ashira warrior]] and [[an ashira shaman]], so you'll need to kill them for a chance at a raider spawn. :Watch out for the nearby [[an ashira spearfisher]] and the invisible [[an ashira ambusher]]. They are higher level and much more dangerous. '''Kill [[Toma the Two-Faced]] in [[Shaded Dunes]] and loot *[[Smuggler's Damaged Logbook]]''' :NOTE:The smuggler's camp can be found on the far South-West side of Shaded Dunes. Follow the water to a small river and it's across the river. :At night the smugglers despawn/respawn as wererats. :The logbook is a 6-slot container :Combine the six logbook pages in *[[Smuggler's Damaged Logbook]] to create *[[Smuggler's Logbook]] '''Return the [[Smuggler's Logbook]] to [[Njau Hansou]]''' {{exp}} : Njau Hansou says, “This is fantastic work. It is interesting that the Ashira were only able to escape with a few pages. Though, perhaps that is all they were looking for. We will focus on what is said on those pages when we analyze this.” : Njau Hansou says, “If we find the Ashira knowingly took those specific pages, then that may also give credence to the idea that they are a more intelligent race than we’ve assumed.” : Njau Hansou says, “I may have to explore that idea more later.” : Njau Hansou says, “For now, take this. The wand I just handed you is a Wand of Spectral Sharding. Stow it somewhere safe and ask me about it, and I will tell you how it is to be used in your next assignment.” You receive [[Wand of Spectral Sharding]] from [[Njau Hansou]]. '''You have to ask Njau about the wand to get the next dialogue. This may be an optional step''' : Njau Hansou says, “Great. The wand is to be used against four specific ghosts found within the depths of the Tomb of the Last Wyrmsbane, which is located at the excavation site just west of the city gates.” : Njau Hansou says, “While engaged with these ghosts, you can use the wand to crystallize some of their spectral essence. This is essentially trapping a tangible piece of them in our Material Plane for use in analysis.” : Njau Hansou says, “Bring me a shard from each of the following ghosts - High Marshal Fionna, Lieutenant Gregan Snyde, Jakob Geffrey, and Timmon Bell. Return their spectral essences to me along with the wand I just gave you.” : Njau Hansou says, “Do take care. Little is known about the tomb, and it is very dangerous. Do not go alone.” '''Loot [[Crystallized Shard]]'s from [[High Marshal Fionna]], [[Lieutenant Gregan Snyde]], [[Jakob Geffrey]] and [[Timmon Bell]] in [[Tomb of the Last Wyrmsbane]]''' : NOTE:You have to click each ghost with the [[Wand of Spectral Sharding]] in order to get the [[Crystallized Shard]] to drop '''Return the four [[Crystallized Shard]] and the [[Wand of Spectral Sharding]] to [[Njau Hansou]]''' {{exp}} : Njau Hansou says, “Your work has been extraordinary. We will send these shards to be analyzed immediately.” : Njau Hansou says, “For now, please take some time to recover from your adventures. Go into the city and explore. Enjoy some food and drink. Perhaps watch a performance from the Azure Veils.” : Njau Hansou says, “Take this for your efforts. We will speak again soon.” You receive [[Spellbinders Blade Talisman]] from [[Njau Hansou]]. Wizard Starter Quest (Night Harbor).title: Wizard Starter Quest (Night Harbor)
Wizard Starter Quest (Night Harbor).content:
{{Quest | imagefilename = phicon.png | width = 100px | caption = Placeholder Image |Start Zone = [[Night Harbor]] |Quest Giver = - |Minimum Level = 1 |Classes = [[Wizard]] |Related NPCs = [[Olvin Viscus]], [[Veygan Antorious]], [[Jabir Il-hamar]], [[Adimah Starseeker]], [[Domas Starseeker]],
[[Rallin Wizzentrop]], [[Hamsar]], [[Lanna Ivintoria]], [[Liyna Esueiruc]] }}

== Reward == * Experience
  • [[Academy Student's Robe]]
  • [[Gilded Academy Student's Robe]]
== Walkthrough == === Part 1 - Req. Lvl 1=== ** you will need 2 snake skins if you want to get them before you start ** Read [[Carefully Rolled Note]] you start with as a new Wizard Character: 
Student ,

You have been enrolled in the introductory course 
at the Chartered Academy of Arcane Inquiry.

Diligently report to the admissions officer — Olvin
Viscus — to complete the application process.

The Academy is located in the heart of Sageside, in
the northeastern part of the city. The floating 
wizard tower is your destination. Take the
translocation devices to enter.

Please do not tarry in your visit; knowing how to 
manage your newfound powers is of the utmost
importance.

Signed,

— High Doctore Jabir Il-hamar
''' Head to the wizard tower in the north eastern corner of Night Harbor and Turn in your [[Carefully Rolled Note]] to [[Olvin Viscus]]'''
{{exp}}
:Olvin Viscus peers at you over his thick spectacles. : '''Olvin Viscus says,''' "No, I am not interested in buying an — Oh, a new student? Well, give it here, then!" : '''Olvin Viscus says,''' "Welcome to the Chartered Academy of Arcane Inquiry. I am Olvin Viscus, head administrator of the Academy. I am sure you are eager to learn your first spells, but first, you must introduce yourself to the staff here." :Olvin Viscus reaches into his desk and pulls out a long scroll of parchment, then takes a leather folio and places the scroll inside. He thrusts it into your hands. : '''Olvin Viscus says,''' "All five heads of the various schools must sign off on your application before you are formally inducted into the school. They can be found within the Academy grounds, the Grand Library, or elsewhere in Sageside if they are not in their offices. Make haste, get all five signatures, and bring your prospectus back to me. Hurry now, !" You receive [[Academy Prospectus]] from [[Olvin Viscus]].
You receive [[Academy Folio]] from [[Olvin Viscus]].

; You say, "who Doctores" : '''Olvin Viscus says,''' "Our halls are home to some of the most ardent researchers of mystical lore in Szuur—no, in all of Aêthoril!" : Olvin Viscus bows slightly as he begins his spiel. : '''Olvin Viscus says,''' "Our illustrious head doctore is none other than Jabir Il-hamar, Doctore of the School of Elemental Mastery. He can be found atop our tower, looking out over the city when he is not busy in his office." : '''Olvin Viscus says,''' "Next is the Doctore of the School of Celestial Investigation, Adimah Starseeker. She typically works in the orrery, but if she is not there, she may be out doing her research." : '''Olvin Viscus says,''' "Doctore Rallin Wizzentrop is the head of the School of Aberration Research. He can usually be found within the tower itself, accompanied by his wonderful dragon companion. Though we haven't been seeing much of the latter lately, he often sends the creature out on errands." : Olvin Viscus pauses to take a deep breath before continuing. : '''Olvin Viscus says,''' "Doctore Veygen Antorious can be found within the tower. This maverick of the School of Aethernautical Exploration often has his head in the clouds, but that is not a bad thing. He is a skilled airship pilot and even possesses the power to travel to other planes. His ability is not to be taken lightly." : '''Olvin Viscus says,''' "Finally, you can find Doctore Lanna Invintoria in the Grand Library. She was originally an honored guest from Calafrey, but she decided to join our school! She teaches Humanoid Studies and is a skilled linguist, anthropologist, and historian." : Olvin Viscus claps his hands, feeling accomplished. : '''Olvin Viscus says,''' "And those are the wonderful heads of our five schools." ==== Veygen Antorious ==== '''Head up the tower and hand your [[Academy Prospectus]] to [[Veygen Antorious]]''' : Veygen Antorious inspects the form, then looks you over with a stern gaze. : '''Veygen Antorious says,''' "Hmm..." : Veygen Antorious strokes his beard as he appraises you. : '''Veygen Antorious says,''' "Yes, I think you'll do. Allow me to sign your form, but know that I expect great things from you—as I do from every prospective student of the Academy. You're a little older than some of the other novices, but I expect you'll catch up in your studies quickly." : Veygen Antorious signs your form with the flick of a quill. : '''Veygen Antorious says,''' "I suppose congratulations are in order. Let's hope that the other faculty heards are in agreement with my choice." : Veygen Antorious smiles at you warmly. You receive [[Academy Prospectus]] from [[Veygen Antorious]].
You receive [[Veygen's Prospectus]] from [[Veygen Antorious]].

==== Jabir Il-hamar ==== '''Head further up the tower and hand your [[Academy Prospectus]] to [[Jabir Il-hamar]]''' : Jabir Ilhama smiles takes the letter from you, grasping it in his spindly fingers. : '''Jabir Il-hamar says,''' "Ah, I see. A new student wishes to enroll in our illustrious Academy." : Jabir Ilhama strokes his long beard, carefully looking over you. : '''Jabir Il-hamars ays,''' "If you wish to join our ranks, I don’t want any sort of whining, complaining, or any other such nonsense. Such trifling gives me a headache, and if you are half as wise as you’re expected to be, you will know that being a pain to me in particular is a poor decision for a student." : Jabir Ilhama sighs, shaking his head. He takes out a long quill, along with a piece of parchment, writing out a statement, before signing both papers, handing them back to you. : '''Jabir Il-hamar says,''' "Do not make me regret allowing you into this Academy." : Jabir Ilhama watches you closely as you leave. You receive [[Academy Prospectus]] from [[Jabir Il-hamar]].
You receive [[Jabir's Prospectus]] from [[Jabir Il-hamar]].

==== Adimah Starseeker ==== '''Head to the bottom of the tower and take the teleporter to the Library. (Inside the Grand Library entry floor, on the left side upon entry.) : Hand your [[Academy Prospectus]] to [[Adimah Starseeker]]''' : Adimah Starseeker holds up a finger as she continues to read her tome. : '''Adimah Starseeker says,''' "Hold." : Adimah Starseeker does not look up from the pages. : Adimah Starseeker furiously writing something down in her notebook before finally meeting your eyes. She snatches the paper from your hand quickly. : '''Adimah Starseeker says,''' "Ah, so you wish to join our academy." : Adimah Starseeker looks you over for a moment as she places the prospectus on her desk. She takes one of her notebooks and passes it to you. : '''Adimah Starseeker says,''' "Bring this to my adjunct, Domas. You can find him tending to the orrery. He should return my prized quill to you. Bring it back to me, and I will sign your prospectus." : Adimah Starseeker immediately returns to her work, brushing the prospectus aside on her desk. You receive [[Adimah's Notebook]] from [[Adimah Starseeker]].

'''Head back to the top of the wizard tower and hand [[Adimah's Notebook]] to [[Domas Starseeker]] : Domas Starseeker flips through the book's pages. : '''Domas Starseeker says,''' "Ah, I see you've spoken with my mother. Very well... I take it she wants her quill back, yes? She left it in one of the other notebooks she gave me, you see. She tends to use them as bookmarks." : Domas Starseeker quietly tuts. : '''Domas Starseeker says,''' "Well, here's the quill. Hopefully, she'll be happy with it. And tell her to get some rest; she's always staying up too late." : Domas Starseeker shakes his head with a sigh. You receive [[Golden-Feathered Quill]] from [[Domas Starseeker]].

'''Return back to [[Adimah Starseeker]] and hand her the [[Golden-Feathered Quill]]. : Adimah Starseeker holds up a finger, once again nose-deep in her tome. : '''Adimah Starseeker says,''' "Hold." : Adimah Starseeker sharply glances to your hands. : '''Adimah Starseeker says,''' "Ah, my quill. Wonderful." : Adimah Starseeker takes the quill in a surprisingly slow and gentle manner. : '''Adimah Starseeker says,''' "Hm, Domas cleaned it for me. I should reward him for that." : '''Adimah Starseeker says,''' "Ah, right! Your prospectus! Here you are." : '''Adimah Starseeker says,''' "Now, if you'll excuse me, I have a lot more work to do." You receive [[Academy Prospectus]] from [[Adimah Starseeker]].
You receive [[Adimah's Prospectus]] from [[Adimah Starseeker]].

==== Rallin Wizzentrop ==== '''Head back to the tower and hand your [[Academy Prospectus]] to [[Rallin Wizzentrop]]''' : Rallin Wizzentrop takes your prospectus, stuffing it into his pocket. : '''Rallin Wizzentrop says,''' "Yes, yes, a work order... Tell Hamsar I've already completed his special item." : Rallin Wizzentrop waves his hand dismissively towards you, before hand you a small wooden box. You receive [[Delivery for Hamsar]] from [[Rallin Wizzentrop]].

'''Head back to the library and hand the [[Delivery for Hamsar]] to [[Hamsar]]''' : Hamsar perks an eyebrow as he takes the box from you. Propping up the lid, he peeks inside before his expression lights up. : '''Hamsar says,''' "Oh, I see. Ya brought this from Rallin. Wonderful! I’ve been waiting all month fer him to fix this fer me." : Hamsar adjusts the toolbelt around his waist, then notices you still standing there. : '''Hamsar says,''' "Oh, he kept yer prospectus? That’s unfortunate fer ya… I’ll make sure t’write something on this here receipt." : Hamsar scribbles on the scrap of paper before handing it back to you. : Hamsar grins broadly with sparkling teeth. : '''Hamsar says,''' "Good luck, newbie!" You receive [[Hamsar's Receipt]] from [[Hamsar]].

'''Return to [[Rallin Wizzentrop]] and hand him [[Hamsar's Receipt]]''' : Rallin Wizzentrop takes the receipt from you. He looks over it, adjusting his thick spectacles, before reaching into his pocket, pulling out a now grease-stained prospectus. He wordlessly stamps it, and, along with what seems to be a pre-signed form of acceptance from his department, passes both to you. You receive [[Academy Prospectus]] from [[Rallin Wizzentrop]].
You receive [[Rallin's Prospectus]] from [[Rallin Wizzentrop]].

==== Lanna Ivintoria ==== '''Head to the Library to hand your [[Academy Prospectus]] to [[Lanna Ivintoria]] : Lanna Ivintoria takes the prosepctus from you ginerly, looking over it, before she nods. : '''Lanna Ivintoria says,''' "Ah, very well, you wish to study at our Academy?" : '''Lanna Ivintoria says,''' "I will sign your prospectus, but I require proof of your arcane prowess. Bring me two snake skins. I require their use in one of my experiments. Any snake you find around Night Harbor will do. Do this, and I will provide you with a signature." : Lanna Ivintoria hands you back the unsigned prospectus. You receive [[Academy Prospectus]] from [[Lanna Ivintoria]].

'''Head out the North Gate of Night Harbor and kill [[a snake]]s until you receive two [[Snake Skin]]s. : Alternatively you can buy these.

'''Return to [[Lanna Ivintoria]] and hand her your two [[Snake Skin]]s. : Lanna Ivintoria examines the skins carefully. : '''Lanna Ivintoria says,''' "Wonderful, wonderful, they are in fine condition. Yes, this will do. Very well, here is your signed prospectus, as promised." You receive [[Lanna's Prospectus]] from [[Lanna Ivintoria]].

==== Becoming a student ==== '''Combine all 5 notes in to the [[Academy Folio]] as well as the original [[Academy Prospectus]] to receive the [[Complete Academy Prospectus]].''' : Hand the [[Complete Academy Prospectus]] to [[Olvin Viscus]] : Olvin Viscus thumbs through the folio. : '''Olvin Viscus says,''' "Ah, splendid! I take it you had no difficulty receiving signatures from our illustrious staff?" : Olvin Viscus pulls out a large, ornate brass stamp that, after whispering a few arcane words, glows hot in his hand. He places a cold piece of wax on the closed folio, then presses it shut with the red-hot seal. The wax bubbles for a moment before settling, leaving the crimson seal of the Academy in its place. : '''Olvin Viscus says,''' "Please, , take this to our headmaster. I am sure you know who he is by now, he did have to sign one of your forms after all. Do not tarry!" : Olvin Viscus sends you off with a little wave. You receive [[Approved Academy Prospectus]] from [[Olvin Viscus]].

'''Head up the tower to [[Jabir Il-hamar]] and hand him the [[Approved Academy Prospectus]].'''
{{exp}}
: Jabir Il-hamar takes the folio from you, inspecting the seal, before quickly leafing through it. : '''Jabir Il-hamar says,''' "Very well. It’s all here, it seems. Your diligence has paid off, for you are now a Grade 0 Student at the Chartered Academy of Arcane Inquiry." : Jabir Il-hamar waves his hands, and a scarlet robe, perfectly sized for you, appears in your arms. : '''Jabir Il-hamar says,''' "Wear it with pride, . Now, go and practice your magic. Once you have learned a few more spells, return to me, wearing your robes, and I will offer you your first assignment." You receive [[Academy Student's Robe]] from [[Jabir Ilhamar]].

=== Part 2 - Req. Lvl 4=== Once you are level 4, go back to [[Jabir Il-hamar]] and hail him. Must be wearing "Academy student's robe". : Jabir Il-hamar strokes his beard as a worried expression crosses his face. : '''Jabir Il-hamar says,''' "I'm afraid I have bad news. A few days ago, one of your fellow students was sent to the Tomb of the Last Wyrmsbane... but he has yet to return."
; You say, "who was the student?"
: '''Jabir Il-hamar says,''' "Viridon is his name... he's an experienced student." : '''Jabir Il-hamar says,''' "Please go out there, find him, and bring him back to us safely. It's advisable that you take companions with you."

Head to [[Tomb of the Last Wyrmsbane]], the [[Scorched Academy Folio]] is a random drop off skeleton mobs in the tomb.
Return to [[Jabir Il-hamar]] '''Turn in [[Scorched Academy Folio]] to [[Jabir Il-hamar]].''' : '''Jabir Il-hamar says,''' "A folio from our academy? Why are you..." : Jabir Il-hamar looks at you in shock. : '''Jabir Il-hamar says,''' "No, this cannot be! Are you telling me this belonged to Viridon?" : Jabir Il-hamar mutters in disbelief, thrusting the folio back into your hands. : '''Jabir Il-hamar says,''' "This is dreadful news! I hope no ill has befallen him. We must investigate... will you help me?"
; You say, "I will help you investigate"
: '''Jabir Il-hamar says,''' "Thank you, player" : '''Jabir Il-hamar says,''' "Please bring Viridon's folio to Liyna in the Grand Library. She'll analyze it and help us find a lead. Go at once!"

Head to the Grand Library and seek out [[Liyna Esueiruc]] who is on the lower floors.
'''Turn in [[Scorched Academy Folio]] to [[Liyna Esueiruc]].'''

Note: I got the following upon handing the folio over... : Liyna Esueiruc looks at the folio, then back to you. : '''Liyna Esueiruc says,''' "A folio? I'm not one of the Academy's Doctores." : Liyna Esueiruc hands back the folio. You receive [[Scorched Academy Folio]] from [[Liyna Esueiruc]].

...so, I repeated the hand-in and it advanced..
'''Turn in [[Scorched Academy Folio]] to [[Liyna Esueiruc]].'''

: Liyna Esueiruc pulls a loupe from her pocket and inspects the folio. : '''Liyna Esueiruc says,''' "There's odd traces of runic charring on this. It looks like whomever was carrying it was hit by a necromantic spell." : '''Liyna Esueiruc says,''' "You've done well to stay out of trouble. Ask Jabir for a just reward." : '''Liyna Esueiruc says,''' "I still need more time to investigate, but when you see Jabir, please hand him this message from me." : '''Liyna Esueiruc says,''' "We'll speak again, student. Fear not, we'll get to the bottom of this."
You receive [[Small Note]] from [[Liyna Esueiruc]].

{{exp}}


Return to [[Jabir Il-hamar]] and turn in your [[Small Note]] from Liyna.
You receive your items back from Jabir Ilhamar.

: Jabir Il-hamar looks at the folio as his spectacles slide down to his nose. : Jabir Il-hamar suddenly drops the folio in shock. : '''Jabir Il-hamar says,''' "Yes... right... of course." : '''Jabir Il-hamar says,''' "Student... thank you... We'll investigate your findings. Please do not worry yourself with it any longer." : '''Jabir Il-hamar says,''' "You've earned yourself a reward. Pick up the folio, would you? And hand me your robe as well, I have a new one for you."
Turn in your [[Academy Student's Robe]] and [[Small Note]] to [[Jabir Il-hamar ]].
: Jabir Il-hamar takes your old robe and quickly swaps it with a new one. : '''Jabir Il-hamar says,''' "You deserve this, Player." : Jabir Il-hamar pats you on the shoulder.
You receive [[Gilded Academy Student's Robe]] from [[Jabir Ilhamar]].


; You say, "Hail, Jabir Il-hamar ." : '''Jabir Il-hamar says,''' "Return to me after you've studied a while longer." === Part 3 - Req. == Walkthrough for Rogue == === Part 1 - Req. Lvl 1=== '''Read [[Anonymous Letter]] you start with as a new Rogue character:''' 
This letter reaches you not of insignificant reason. We have witnessed your ability to blend into the shadows and become as a leaf on a branch to those who tread past.

It was fated chance that you were noticed at all, and that is precisely why this missive finds you now. Your talents would be indispensable to Faelindral, so I would propose a meeting with Elyndiir Nightshade to discuss an opportunity to put said talents to the test.

Should this letter spark your interest, deliver it into the hands of the aforementioned within the Lambent Lantern. You can find it behind the bank, or by climbing the ascent opposite the Willows Whisper stage.

You can ask a guard for direction to the Lambent Lantern if required, but do not inform them of the reason.

Yours,
An Admirer
'''Give [[Anonymous Letter]] to [[Elyndiir Nightshade]] in the Lambent Lantern Inn. (behind Bank).''' {{exp}}
Your faction standing with [[Lambent Wanderers]] got better.
Your faction standing with [[Fellstone Orcs]] got worse.
:Elyndiir Nightshade perks a brow as she accepts the letter. While reading its contents, the corner of her mouth curls upward into a small smirk. : Elyndiir Nightshade says, "Looks like you were found out by Naery. Still, you seem to had made an impression on her, and that in itself is an accomplishment." : Elyndiir Nightshade says, "And now I'm to offer you a chance to prove yourself? I wish that girl would at least discuss things with me before sending prospects backstage. Here, take this." :Elyndiir Nightshade produces a sealed leaf scroll and holds it out for you with a dull expression. : Elyndiir Nightsade says, "You're really looking for an opportunity?" :You say, "I'm always looking to exploit an ''opportunity''!" You receive note for [[Myrielle Softglade]] (Head to Traders District, Weapons and armor, inside on first level) : Elyndiir Nightshade says, "You can start by making your way to the Traders Terrace and handing this letter to Myrielle Softglade." : Elyndiir Nightshade says, "Foreign trade has slowed lately and that makes for bad business. If Myrielle has an idea of what might be wrong, you're going to help her get to the bottom of it." : Elyndiir Nightshade says, "When you're done, come fill me in on what you find. And avoid stepping onto the stage when you leave, or the bards will start giving me a headache." You receive "[[Note for Myrielle Softglade]]" from Elyndiir Nightshade. ====Part 1a - Find ingredients==== You say, "Hail, Myrielle Softglade" : Myrielle Softglade says, "Fair shades to you, Rogue. How did I know you were a Rogue? Ha, don't worry, I just have an eye for these things." Hand her the note. {{exp}}
Your faction standing with [[Lambent Wanderers]] got better.
Your faction standing with [[Fellstone Orcs]] got worse.
:Myrielle Softglade accepts the letter with interest, giving you a polite smile before unsealing it and looking over the contents. She clears her throat and immediately lowers her voice. : Myrielle Softglade says, "Elyn sent you? No offense, but I was hoping she'd send one of her more experienced agents." : Myrielle Softglade says, "Ah, it's no matter. Here, take this. Maybe you'd be able to help with a little... experiment?" :Myrielle Softglade offers you a small, nondescript jar with a corked lid. You receive "[[Sample Jar]]" from Myrielle Softglade. ''Combine'' the following in the '''Sample Jar''':
  • 2 Raw Bat Meat
  • 2 Wasp Venom Sacks
  • 2 Raw Wolf Meat
You craft [[Gruesome Sample Jar]].
Sample Jar is consumed while crafting. ====Part 1b - Ewww! ==== Hand Myrielle the jar. {{exp}}
Your faction standing with [[Lambent Wanderers]] got better.
Your faction standing with [[Fellstone Orcs]] got worse.
:Myrielle Softglade takes the jar, then immediately seems to regret her decision as she sharply turns her face away, holding the jar out and as far from herself as possible. : Myrielle Softglade says, "Wyrd's way, this is revolting! Quick, take it! Take it back!"
:Myrielle Softglade fumbles the sample jar back to you, nearly dropping it in the process.
: Myrielle Softglade says, "Ugh! I'm just going to take your word for it that all the proper samples were inside the jar. Are you ready to meet my contact now?
You receive [[Gruesome Sample Jar]] from Myrielle Softglade. : You say, "Yes. Who is your ''contact''?" : Myrielle Softglade says, "Sylwine Brightspirit is a good friend of mine who's always looking for new reagents for her potions at the Well of Order. She said she'd be willing to take a look at anything that I brought her."
: Myrielle Softglade says, "Of course, we don't really need any potions, but that's beside the point. If anything is wrong with those samples, she should be able to figure it out!"
: Myrielle Softglade says, "I just hope she doesn't mind the foul stench..."
Bring to [[Sylwine Brightspirit]] located at Well of Order (inside Herbalism/First aid house) {{exp}}
Your faction standing with [[Lambent Wanderers]] got better.
:Sylwine Brightspirit accepts the jar with an arched brow, holding it up and swirling the contents. She inhales a sharp breath before turning back to you with a forced smile. : Sylwine Brightspirit says, "Myrielle sent you here with this, did she? Here, take it back for a moment. I'd like you to do something for me first."
:Sylwine Brightspirit hands back the sample jar. You receive [[Gruesome Sample Jar]] from Sylwine Brightspirit. : Sylwine Brightspirit says, "I want you to open that jar for me and take a good whiff. Really let is invade your nasal passage. Then, tell me what you think it smells like."
:Sylwine Brightspirit folds her arms over her chest and watches you.
While holding the jar (on the cursor), type: 
/open jar
:You open the jar with a delicate pop of the corked lid. An ominous odor wafts from the mixture of fauna samples, and Sylwine nods at you expectantly. You receive [[Foul-Smelling Jar]]. Give the jar back to [[Sylwine Brightspirit]] {{exp}}
Your faction standing with [[Preservers]] got worse.
:Sylwine Brightspirit grimaces as she eyes the jar, involuntarily rolling her eyes. She reseals the lid and writes out a small receipt, which she slides over the counter to you. : Sylwine Brightspirit says, "Here's the receipt for the job. You can bring it back to Myrielle. This is going to take me a while, because of the contamination. That foolish girl..."
You receive [[Gruesome Sample Receipt]] from Sylwine Brightspirit : Sylwine Brightspirit says, "She may be pretty and knows all the right words, but she's still two flowers short of a bouquet, if you catch my meaning."
: Sylwine Brightspirit says, "In fact, you can tell her I said as much when you return to her!"
====Part 1c - Finishing up==== Upon giving the receipt back to [[Myrielle Softglade]] {{exp}}
Your faction standing with [[Lambent Wanderers]] got better.
:Myrielle Softglade turns pale as she reads the obviously strong-worded language that was included in the receipt. : Myrielle Softglade says, "A-ah, I... I see. Ahem. Well, it seems that we may have to wait a while to find out the results. You've proven that you're capable of some simple tasks, at least!"
: Myrielle Softglade says, "Here's a note for Elyn at the Willows Whisper. I'm sure that she can find something to keep you busy while we wait on Sylwine's tests."
You receive [[Note for Elyndiir Nightshade]] from [[Myrielle Softglade]]. : Myrielle Softglade says, "I hope that she isn't too upset..."
Upon giving Note to [[Elyndiir Nightshade]]
{{exp}}
Your faction standing with [[Lambent Wanderers]] got better.
Your faction standing with [[Fellstone Orcs]] got worse.
:Elyndiir Nightshade skims over the note with a sharp eye, looking somewhat skeptical. : Elyndiir Nightshade says, "So Myrielle is having Sylwine run tests on some animal parts? I suppose that's one angle we hadn't considered."
: Elyndiir Nightshade says, "We had you tailed during your journey to see how you'd perform. You're a little dull around the edges, but I feel like we could hone you into a fine agent."
: Elyndiir Nightshade says, "Speaking of..."
:Elyndiir Nightshade extends her hand, then, with a quick flourish, reveals a small elven dagger seemingly pulled from nowhere. She offers it to you, hilt first. You receive [[Lambent Prospect Dagger]] from Elyndiir Nightshade. : Elyndiir Nightshade says, "Any prospect of ours needs to be able to defend themselves. You earned it, but you could also earn a lot more. You interested?"
You receive [[Lambent Prospect Dagger]] from Elyndiir Nightshade. You say, "Of course, I'm ''interested''!" : Elyndiir Nightshade says, "Hmm, not so fast. Why don't you get a little more practice with that dagger first? Come back and show me the blade once you've had a chance to put it through its paces."
=== Part 2 - Req. Lvl 4+ ===
You say, "I'm still ''interested.''"

: Elyndiir Nightshade says, "Glad to hear it. Though let me get a look at that prospect dagger of yours first to make sure that it's been properly worked in."
Give [[Lambent Prospect Dagger]] to Elyndiir Nightshade.
:Elyndiir Nightshade grins knowingly beneath her cowl as she twirls the dagger expertly between her fingers, then offers it back to you, handle first.
You receive [[Lambent Prospect Dagger]] from Elyndiir Nightshade. : Elyndiir Nightshade says, "Looks sufficiently worked-in to me, prospect. Good."

''Elyndiir Nightshade says,''
: I imagine this next task is going to require a lot more subtlety than the last, though. Another of our group, [[Ereldian Brambleshade]], is keeping tabs on the faerie population to the north."
: It's a difficult job to discern any sort of sense from such a chaotic group, but we have many who rely on us to piece that chaos into something more... comprehensible. Digestible, even."
: I want you to head down the northern lift that leads into fae territory and meet with Ereldian. He should be posted in the area, and you're going to help him gather some information."
: Keep in mind that we don't want to harm any of them if we can help it. Just show him your dagger to let him know that you're one of us."

====Part 2a - Loud and Clear ==== Give [[Lambent Prospect Dagger]] to Ereldian Brambleshade. (He is at the base of the Pixie lift)
:Ereldian Brambleshade nods thoughtfully, looking you up and down taking note of the dagger you carry.
: Ereldian Brambleshade says "Ah, so Elyndir finally found time to send me an assistant? I've been requesting aid for weeks and I'm at my wits end when it comes to these capricious creatures!"
:Ereldian Brambleshade sighs softly as he runs a hand through his long auburn hair. Somehow, he suddenly produces an item that resembles a small pipe and offers it to you. You receive [[Eavesdropper Earring]] from Ereldian Brambleshade. You receive [[Lambent Prospect Dagger]] from Ereldian Brambleshade.

''Ereldian Brambleshade says,''
: If you're going to help me, you're going to need this. It's called an eavesdropper. It should allow you to listen : in on conversations that you otherwise wouldn't be able to.
: Be sure not to lose it! If you do somehow misplace it, return to me and ask for a new one.
: Go ahead and stick it in your ear... not too far, mind you, then activate it.
: Once that's done, let me know when you're ready to hear the plan.

Right-click the earring (equip first if necessary).

You say, "What is the ''plan'', then?" :Ereldian Brambleshade nods and takes a deep breath. : Ereldian Brambleshade says "IS IT WORKING? CAN YOU HEAR ME?"
:Ereldian Brambleshade clears his throat, but to your ears, it sounds like thunder clapping inside your brain. Thankfully, he then lowers his voice to a whisper, yet you are able to hear him as though he spoke plain.
''Ereldian Brambleshade says,''
: I shall take that as a yes. Apologies, I fear that some of the fae's... whimsical nature may be rubbing off on me due to my prolonged station here.
: It is precisely for that reason that I have an offer for you, if you are interested.

You say, "Of course, I'm ''interested''!" ''Ereldian Brambleshade says,''
: There are two prominent fae in the area who Elyndiir wants you to spy on... Two fae who've been tormenting me for what feels like an entire age.
: Lilika and Luonu Thinsticks are their names. They're a pair of vicious pranksters whose careless antics have taken the lives of more than a few travelers.
: You're to find their dwelling along the cliffside, across the footbridge and past the ruins to the west. Then, wait until the cover of nightfall when the pair return home and use stealth with the eavesdropper to find out what they're plotting next.
: Though, you could also find a more... permanent solution to their meddling, if you're willing?"

You say, "I'm ''willing''. Sounds like fun!" ''Ereldian Brambleshade says,''
: After you've listened in on their plans, if you manage to catch one of them alone, yo can always end their pathetic little life. I'll make it worth your while if you bring me one if their ridiculous acorn hats.
: Otherwise, you can simply listen in on them and take your findings to Elyndiir at the Whisper. Though I promise you, no one would mourn the loss of either of those two scoundrels.
: Think on it before yo depart, assistant. Oh, and be sure to keep this just between us. Elyndiir has too soft a heart for this sort of business.

====Part 2b - Mischief ==== {{Spoiler |Go as directed, all the way to the circle of mushrooms at the end.''
/look
}} ''(If you do not have the earring activated:)'' :Muffled voices can be heard from within this tilted toadstool home. You make out what sounds like laughter and childish giggles, but the voices are otherwise too faint to understand. ''(If you are not in stealth:)'' :Muffled voices can be heard from within this tilted toadstool home. They quiet as you approach, suspicious of lumbering footsteps nearby. Otherwise: :You approach the toadstool home under the cover of darkness, coming close enough to make out what they are saying. The eavesdropper earring is working! : Lilika Thinsticks says, "Someone was out there... wasn't there?" : Luonu Thinsticks says, "There's no one there, Lilika, look! Now tell me your idea!" : Lilika Thinsticks says, "We can't be too careful with that Ereldian guy snooping around! You know he's just itching to punish us." : Luonu Thinsticks says, "You mean he isn't just itching from the glitter you slipped into his pants?" :Lilika Thinsticks and her brother Luonu snicker to themselves. : Luonu Thinsticks says, "Now out with it! I'm dying to hear your plan!" : Lilika Thinsticks says, "You won't be the only one dying! I noticed a weak spot in the cliffside near the road. Wouldn't it be funny if a whole caravan got trapped under a landslide?" : Luonu Thinsticks says, "Oh, wow! Would they know it was us?" : Lilika Thinsticks says, "They'd probably just blame those dumb orcs! They hate them a lot more than they hate us." : Luonu Thinsticks says, "It'd be even better if we could drop rocks on that Ereldian." : Lilika Thinsticks says, "You mean Smelldian?" :Luonu Thinsticks snickers. : Lilika Thinsticks says, "Now take a nap! You spent the whole day drinking mushroom dew. I'm going to take a walk and check on that cliff." :Luonu Thinsticks grumbles and obeys his sister's wishes. :You quickly scribble down what you managed to overhear. You receive [[Thinsticks Prank Plan]].
====Part 2d - Murder she wrote? ====
'''If you decide to kill [[Lilika Thinsticks]]:''' : Lilika Thinsticks says, "HEY, WHO ARE YOU?!" {{exp}}
Your faction standing with [[Citizens of Faelindral]] got worse.
Your faction standing with [[Court of Summer]] got worse.
Your faction standing with [[Court of Winter]] got better.
: Lilika Thinsticks says, "I didn't... mean to..." : --You loot [[Acorn Hat]] from Lilika Thinstick's corpse.-- Give the helmet to Ereldian Brambleshade. {{exp}}
Your faction standing with [[Court of Summer]] got worse.
:Ereldian Brambleshade lets out a loud guffaw as you show him the acorn hat, then breaks down into a fit of laughter that borders on maniacal. : Ereldian Brambleshade says "Haha-ha! You've done all of the Weald a fantastic service for this!"
: Ereldian Brambleshade says "That creature was nothing more than a conniving murderer. You've done the right thing. Perhaps I'll finally be able to sleep in peach tonight."
: Ereldian Brambleshade says "My thanks, friend. You'll go far if you keep this up. Here, take this."
:Ereldian Brambleshade leans in close and presses a small ring into your palm. : Ereldian Brambleshade says "You've earned it. Keep it close by. It may be of use to you in the future, should we require more of your... services."
: You receive [[Loop of Shaded Vine]] from Ereldian Brambleshade. ====Part 2e - Finishing up ==== '''Before running back''': Give [[Thinsticks Prank Plan]] to [[Ereldian Brambleshade]].

''Ereldian Brambleshade says,''
: Such a vile prank. : The fae ought to be purged from this world, and this is even more proof of that. Bring this information back to Elyndiir. : Perhaps it'll be enough to show her that we should be taking a more... direct stance against their antics. You receive your items back from Ereldian Brambleshade.
Give [[Thinsticks Prank Plan]], [[Eavesdropper Earring]] and [[Lambent Prospect Dagger]] to [[Elyndiir Nightshade]].
If you just hand in the note: ''Elyndiir Nightshade says,'' : I see you've got some information, but how did you come about it? Ereldian should have provided you with the tool necessary to obtain this. If you hand in the note and earring: ''Elyndiir Nightshade says,'' : Good, good. It looks like you did some excellent snooping out there. : Show me your prospect dagger as well, so that you can be properly compensated. Otherwise: {{exp}}
Your faction standing with Lambent Wanderers got better.
''Elyndiir Nightshade says,''
: They're planning on causing a rock slide? Those Thinsticks are going too far this time. I'll send word to the Keepers to watch the hills for any trouble. You did good today, prospect. : We keep a tenuous peach with the fae, but their so-called pranks are growing more and more dangerous. It's why we have to keep one step ahead of them like this. :Elyndiir Nightshade draws a short blade, examining it closely before offering it to you alongside a sheaf of paper. You receive [[List of Results]] from Elyndiir Nightshade. ''Elyndiir Nightshade says,''
: In the meantime, you should take this opportunity to check in with Myrielle. Hopefully she's found something out about that slop she had you put together earlier. : You know the drill by now, yeah? Give her the note and return to me once you have something to show for it. : Also, don't lose the edge I've given you. You'll need it if you want to become a full Wanderer. You receive [[Lambent Prospect Blade]] from Elyndiir Nightshade. === Part 3 - Req. Lvl 4 ===
Give [[List of Results]] to [[Myrielle Softglade]].
{{exp}} Your faction standing with Lambent Wanderers got better.
====Part 3a - Wolves ====
''Myrielle Softglade says,''
: Oh! Welcome back, prospect. Are you as excited as I am to read over these results? You and I make a great team, uncovering the mysteries of the perilous roads! : Now, let's see here... :Myrielle Softglade unseals the note; a wide smile quickly spreads across her face as her gaze darts back and forth across the page, absorbing its contents. : Myrielle Softglade says, "Myrielle, concerning the samples you had delivered... blah, blah, blah... clear signs of contamination... ooh, that sounds ominous! ...Resulted in a failure on your part due to..." :Myrielle Softglade slowly trails off as an embarrassed flush creeps up her cheeks. She clears her throat and immediately rolls up the note, sliding it behind her back. ''Myrielle Softglade says,''
: You know what? Never mind those results! The animals you collected parts from were clearly not any real threat to merchant caravans. : Bats, wasp drones, and little wolf pups? Why, even I could handle creatures such as those! I've heard rumors of much stronger beasts that have been prowling the roadways.
You say, "What ''beasts''?"

''Myrielle Softglade says,''
: The mature wolves in particular seem to be in a frenzy of late. I've been speaking to some of my trade partners, and apparently some rabid wolves have been causing an uproar along the road to Keepers Bight : Not only that, but there's also a large den of wolves near the Wyrdgate to the west that has been assaulting travelers! : I'm not sure which is worse, diseased animals or made ones, but we're going to have to do something about the wolves if we're to maintain our current trade routes. : Meaning, we're left with only one option...
You say, "And the ''option'' is?"

''Myrielle Softglade says,''
: I've heard Aerin Mossfang is particularly upset about the rabid wolves. She's sent a number of her beastmasters to sort out that particular issue. : That still leaves the made den of wolves to the west, however. : I'm sure the Ardent Keepers wouldn't like what I'm proposing, but we need a more immediate resolution to the current trade dilemma! : Wolf packs normally follow an alpha leader, right? It could be that the pack is simply following the whim of a mad leader to randomly attack traveleres. : So... I suggest you seek out the den and eliminate the pack's alpha. At the very least, it'll keep the wolves contained to the den until a more permanent solution can be discovered. : Bring me the alpha's fang when it's been dealt with.
Go to the wolf den on the west side of Evershade Weld and kill beguiled wolves to spawn [[A beguiled alpha wolf]] and loot its [[Alpha Wolf Fang]].
Note that it is a rare drop off a fairly rare mob.
Give [[Alpha Wolf Fang]] to [[Myrielle Softglade]]. :Myrielle Softglade gazes down at the fang as her bottom lip begins to quiver. :Myrielle Softglade says, What a horrible thing we had to do... you had to do. I'm so sorry, ''Villette''." :Myrielle Softglade says, "May I see your blade as well as the fang? I want to offer a prayer to poor creature that lost its mind to madness." You receive your items back from Myrielle Softlade. You say, "Yes, the madness was unsettling!" {{exp}}
Your faction standing with Lambent Wanderers got better.
Your faction standing with Naelira's Court got worse.
:Myrielle Softglade runs the fang along the edge of your blade as she closes her eyes, offering a s prayer. :Myrielle Softglade says, "Alashore, forgive us for being unable to protect one of the forest's mas souls. Their life had to be cut short in exchange for the lives of your servants." :Myrielle Softlade says, "The wasps, also." :Myrielle Softglade says, "Then there were those pups, too..." :Myrielle Softglade clears her throat softly. :Myrielle Softlade says, "I, umm... I'm not particularly reverent. Are you? I'm sure the gods don't mind, since they're all sleeping anyway!" :Myrielle Softglade quickly scribbles out a note and hands it to you, alongside your blade. :Myrielle Softglade says, "Take this note back to Elyn for me. We should hopefully be seeing a bit more trade with the roads kept clear. Thanks again for all your work, ''Villette''!" You receive [[Lambent Prospect Blade]] from Myrielle Softglade.
You receive [[Scribbled Note]] from Myrielle Softglade.
====Part 3b - Finishing up ==== Give [[Scribbled Note]] to [[Elyndiir Nightshade]]
{{exp}}
Your faction standing with Lambent Wanderers got better.
:Elyndiir Nightshade takes the scribbled note and looks over it, then lets out a soft sigh. :Elyndiir Nightshade says, "I don't really agree with Myrielle's choice of action, but hopefully this sorts out our trade problem. Well done." :Elyndir Nightshade says, "I feel like you've dealt with enough of our more... interesting members, ''Villette''. If you've stuck around with us for this long, then you can probably be trusted with some more involved work." :Elyndir Nightshade says, "Here, take this." :Elyndiir Nightshade retrieves a mask made of leaves and offers it to you. :Elyndir Nightshade says, "This may help you keep some anonymity during your next mission, though you may need to work on your skills before then." :Elyndir Nightshade says, "Return to me and show me that blade of yours once you've strengthened your technique enough to incapacitate a foe," You receive [[Mask of the Forest Walker]] from Elyndiir Nightshade. === Part 4 - Req. Lvl 10+ === Give [[Lambent Prospect Blade]] to [[Elyndiir Nightshade]]
:Elyndiir Nightshade twirls the blade around her dexterous fingers and offers it back to you. :Elyndiir Nightshade says, "Looking good, prospect. Keep that blade close, as you'll be needing it. You'll also want this parchment, assuming you think you have what it takes to look into a little quarrel we've been having with the humans." You receive [[Blank Parchment]] from Elyndiir Nightshade.
You receive [[Lambent Prospect Blade]] from Elyndiir Nightshade.
====Part 4a - Road Trip ==== You say, "A quarrel?" :Elyndir Nightshade says, "You may be familiar with the human village out in Keepers Bight known as Penshaw." :Elyndir Nightshade says, "They call it one of their kontors, or trade posts, which means there hav been a number of new trade deals offered by the factions of Night Harbor in recent days." :Elyndir Nightshade says, While many of our dealings with the humans have been beneficial, there are still bad actors that have clearly tried to swindle us into abusive deals or find ways to take advantage of our natural resources." :Elyndir Nightshade says, "The Iron Emissaries in particular are an arm of the human race that is notorious for their greed. What I need you to do is travel to Penshaw and determine whether one of their latest trade envoys is legitimate." :Elyndiir Nightshade says, "There's one sure way that you'll be able to make that determination." You say, "What way will I determine that?" :Elyndir Nightshade grins, brushing an errant strand of her ebon hair back behind a long ear. :Elyndir Nightshade says, "You'll do what we do best, prospect. Spy." :Elyndir Nightshade says, "Rather than rouse suspicion by hailing every person you come across, I want you to venture into the village undetected and try to overhear any conversations regarding a new trade envoy from Night Harbor." :Elyndir Nightshade says, "The tavern might be your best bet, as that's where gossip can get a little more candid." :Elyndir Nightshade says, "If you manage to sniff out where this envoy is staying, you'll want to sneak into their dwelling and politely browse through their belongings without anyone noticing. It might be wise to wait until nightfall when they're asleep to do so." :Elyndir Nightshade says, "You're looking for any sort of paper trail. Ledgers, receipts, or anything of the sort to verify their trade dealings, Copy anything you find onto the blank parchment I gave you, then return it to me." :Elyndir Nightshade says, "Oh, and no violence, prospect. Not unless I determine that a message needs to be sent." {{spoiler |Travel to Keeper's Bight and go to the inn on the north side of town. You will find a sleeping emissary there at night and they despawn at 6am in the morning. Next to the sleeping emissary there is a chest.
Type ''/open trunk'' }} :You quietly open the envoy's trunk. Within are a set of folded traveler's clothes and a leather-bound merchant's ledger. {{Spoiler |Type ''/inspect ledger'' }} :You quietly and carefully begin to peruse the contents of the merchant's ledger. Much of the documentation seems insignificant to you, but perhaps Elyndiir would be able to make more sense of it if you were to take a copy. {{Spoiler |Type ''/take copy'' }} :You copy down as much information as you can onto the blank parchment. Once finished, you tuck the copy into your belongings and quietly close the trunk. The envoy continues to snore soundly, unaware of your presence.
You receive [[Copy of a Merchant's Ledger]]. ====Part 4b - Reporting In ==== Give [[Copy of a Merchant's Ledger]] & [[Lambent Prospect Blade]] to [[Elyndiir Nightshade]]
{{exp}}
Your faction standing with Lambent Wanderers got better.
:Elyndiir Nightshade takes a look over your blade before nodding in satisfaction and returning it to you. ''Elyndiir Nightshade says,''
:Well done. You're becoming quite the asset, prospect. Let's take a look at what manner of trade this envoy was involved in... :Elyndiir Nightshade begins poring over the copy that was brought to her. Her sharp gaze narrows as it passes over a series of names you had copied from within the merchant's ledger. :Tsk... just wonderful. See these names here? Garrus and Wilna. They're known to be part of the group of poachers that have been giving the Ardent Keepers the run-around for quite some time. :It appears that our envoy friend has already been in touch with, and made deals with these scoundrels, and now they have the gall to bring trade offers to our doorstep? :I won't have it. Faelindral does not negotiate with poachers, nor those that profit from their murderous gains. I believe it's time we taught these Iron Emissaries a lesson. You receive [[Lambent Prospect Blade]] from Elyndiir Nightshade.
You say, “Oh good, a ''lesson''!”
''Elyndiir Nightshade says,''
:That blade of yours will be the lesson, prospect. Perform this next task and I'll see that you're made into a full-fledged Wanderer. :Are you ready to hear the plan? ====Part 4c - The Plan ==== You say, “Of course, I'm ready to hear the ''plan''!” ''Elyndiir Nightshade says,''
:By now, the envoy has already left Penshaw and made their way to the Hanging Gardens; that's the name of the treetop inn located on the eastern side of the Bight, past the valley that leads to Scarwood. :They'll be heading toward Evershade sometime during the early morning hours. It's on that route where you'll strike. :Be careful, though. There's a good chance the envoy will have strong escorts. If you wait for the right opportunity, you should be able to separate them from their guards using a well-timed sap or blow to the back of the head with the pommel of your blade. :Once your target is alone, strike hard and fast. Eliminate the scoundrel and bring me their full ledger so we can show the council just how untrustworthy these humans can be. {{spoiler |The emissary is level 15. They spawn by the treehouse in Keeper's Bight around 7am and walk to the Evershade Weald zone line. They are accompanied by two guards of higher level. }} Give [[Bloodied Merchant Ledger]] & [[Lambent Prospect Blade]] to [[Elyndiir Nightshade]]
{{exp}}
Your faction standing with Lambent Wanderers got better.
:Elyndiir Nightshade nods as she accepts the ledger and conceals the bloodied object inside of a ledger satchel. She then extends her hand toward you with a flourish and presents the hilt of an elegant elven stiletto. ''Elyndiir Nightshade says,''
:You're proven and now blooded. In my eyes, you're a prospect no longer. :The Lambent Wanderers are an eclectic group, but we put the interests of Faelindral first and foremost, just as you did today. :This stiletto marks you as one of our agents. There may come a time when you're call upon for more assignments, but for now, you're free to make your own story. :Shades of the Weald watch over you. Thanks again. You receive [[Lambent Stiletto]] from [[Elyndiir Nightshade]].
