Wizard Starter Quest (Underdocks).title: Wizard Starter Quest (Underdocks)
Wizard Starter Quest (Underdocks).content:
{{Quest | imagefilename = phicon.png | width = 100px | caption = Placeholder Image |Start Zone = [[Underdocks]] |Quest Giver = - |Minimum Level = 1 |Classes = [[Wizard]] [[Enchanter]] |Related NPCs = [[Marshal Harding]] }} == Reward == * Experience
  • [[Musty Tunic]]
  • [[Hammered Iron Ring]]
== Walkthrough == === Part 1 - Req. Lvl 1=== Read the [[Recruitment Notice]] you start with as a new Wizard character: 
Calling all hot-blooded--

MEN-AT-ARMS,
SORCERERS,
HUNTERS,
and OLD DOGS.

--be you unemployed, dispossessed, or outlawed.

The DESCENDIAN ORDER holds muster in the Underdocks, EASTERN DISTRICT. Pass inspection for steady work.

GOOD PAY.

Marshal Harding
'''Ensure your language settings are set to Common Tongue, Marshal Harding cannot understand Deep Tongue as of 2026-09-10.''' '''Take a lift down to the Underdocks Citadel. Then, head east to the Eastern District. You will need to swim across or wait for the raft. Climb the staircase immediately across from the raft docking location to find [[Marshal Harding]] and hand him your [[Recruitment Notice]].''' {{exp}}
Your faction standing with The Descendian Order got better. : Marshal Harding looks you over. : Marshal Harding says, "You can read this, then? You look like you crawled out of a gutter. Have you come to serve in the Order?" You say, "I have come to serve in the Order" : Marshal Harding waves the leaf of paper in your face. : Marshal Harding says, "The Descendian Order. I pray you fight better than you read, if you wish to earn your keep." You say, "I wish to earn my keep" : Marshal Harding laughs. : Marshal Harding says, "As a scullion, no doubt, by your dress." : Marshal Harding rummages through a crate and hands you a shirt. : Marshal Harding says, "It could do with a wash, but at least you might seem to be a page rather than a pauper. Can you fight, then?" You receive [[Musty Tunic]] from [[Marshal Harding]]. You say, "I can fight" : Marshal Harding says, "I'll have the truth of it. Fill this satchel with the shells of deep beetles." : Marshal Harding hands you a threadbare sack. You receive [[Beetle Shell Collection Bag]] from [[Marshal Harding]]. : Marshal Harding says, "Do not return if this task is too great." '''Facing Northwest, follow the tunnel out of the Eastern District to the Underdocks wall where you can begin hunting [[a deep beetle]].''' '''Combine 6 [[deep beetle carapace]] in the [[Beetle Shell Collection Bag]] and turn the bag into [[Marshal Harding]]''' : Marshal Harding says, "An adequate performance for a scullion. Bring this letter to Maude Asterace. She will judge your worth." You receive [[Note]] from [[Marshal Harding]] '''Head to [[Maude Astarace]]. She is in the building to the left of [[Quartermaster LLarne]] above the bounty office.''' '''Hand in the [[Note]] to [[Maude Astarace]]''' : Maude Astarace says, "A new recruit! I hope you live a little longer than the last one. The marshal is not always the most discerning fellow. Never mind about that. Take this ring and assist me with my research." You receive [[Hammered Iron Ring]] from [[Maude Asterace]] You say, "What research?" : Maude Astarace says, "The Delvestone and Deepcut quarrel over rocks, and I wish to know why. Their petty conflict is our good fortune, since the mining company will pay us to reclaim their crystals." : Maude Astarace says, "Venture into the Darrowdwell mine above the citadel and fill this box with crystals from the Deepcut miners." You receive [[Empty Crystal Box]] from [[Maude Astarace]] : Maude Astarace says, "In truth, I care not how you acquire these crystals." '''Head to Darrowdwell mine. You will need to kill [[a deepcut miner]] to get 8 crystals and combine inside the [[Empty Crystal Box]].''' '''Head to back to [[Maude Astarace]] and hand her your [[Full Box of Crystals]].''' You receive [[Darrowdwell Crystal Bounty]] from [[Maude Astarace]] : Maude Astarace says, "What is this?" : Maude Astarace says, "These are not diamonds, nor sapphires, nor even jaspers. Lusterless rocks, all!" : Maude Astarace says, "I suppose you have earned some coin for your part. The miners can have their rocks, but something is amiss. Take this to the paymaster along with your guild signet." '''Head to bounty office. turn in [[Darrowdwell Crystal Bounty]] and [[Hammered Iron Ring]] to [[Elara Venn]].''' You receive [[Polished Iron Ring]] from [[Elara Venn]] : Elara Venn says, "A contract fulfilled. The Delvestone appreciate your work, Wizard, even if the sorceress does not. Here is your share, and a signet befitting your place." '''Head to back to [[Maude Astarace]] and hail her.''' : Maude Astarace says, "I do not believe for a moment that the delvestone would spill their blood or their coin for those worthless rocks. I require your assistance once more, adventurer." You say, "What assistance?" : Maude Astarace says, "I must have a sample of whatever mineral lies at the heart of this territorial squabble. We must look beyond the Darrowdwell. Look for other caves where the Deepcut mine and find the thing they fight and die for." : Maude Astarace says, "Do this, and I will reward you personally." '''Head to the north east Deepcut Bandit Cave. You will need to kill [[A deepcut miner]] to get a [[Faintly Glowing Crystal]]''' '''Head to back to [[Maude Astarace]] and hand her the crystal.''' : Maude Astarace cackles gleefully. : Maude Astarace says, "Oh yes. Something lingers within this crystal... but what? I shall find out. I thank you, adventurer. You are most useful. Run along now, for I have much work to do." You receive [[Walking Stick]] from [[Maude Astarace]] [[Category:Quests]] [[Category:Underdocks Quests]] [[Category:Wizard Quests]]

Wererat Fight Club.title: Wererat Fight Club
Wererat Fight Club.content:
{{Quest | imagefilename = Draznax.png | width = 300px | caption = | Start Zone = [[Underdocks]] | Quest Giver = [[Draznax]] | Minimum Level = 4 | Maximum Level = 15 | Classes = ALL | Related NPCs = Warerats in Underdocks }} == Notes == This quest is repeatable. == Rewards == * Experience * 50 copper * Faction with [[The Fight Club]] == Walkthrough == '''This quest begins in the [[Underdocks]] upper city district by talking with [[Draznax]]. Draznax is located in the center of the mercenary camp, near the wagons on the southern east portion of the upper city.''' You say, "Hail, Draznax." : Draznax says, "Hey! Welcome to Ruff's Fight Club." : Draznax looks around timidly. : Draznax says, "I'm the assistant to the assistant, which makes me pretty important around here. I'm tasked with keeping things orderly, safe and secure. But we have a rat problem..." You say, "What rat problem?" : Draznax grins and looks over his shoulder quickly. : Draznax says, "I can't even think straight with all the chittering coming from the rat's complex down the block. The wererats came over here and attacked us. Tried to steal our food and booze!" : Draznax says, "It's time to send them a message... a deadly one! Go find the rats and chop off their heads. Bring those back to me for your just rewards." '''Draznax would like you to hunt some wererats and return a [[Severed Wererat Head]]. Note that this is different from the Night Harbor Shadow Knight quest item [[Wererat Head]].''' '''The closest Wererats are in a building on the southwest side of the upper city. These Wererats con red to a level 4 as of 2026-09-11.''' '''Wererats can also be found in the newbie hunting area below the Underdocks. The easiest Wererats are level 5-8 and drop heads at a roughly 30% drop rate as of 2026-09-11. Heads are non-unique and tradable, and likely used for faction grinding.''' '''Hand in [[Severed Wererat Head]] one at a time to [[Draznax]].''' {{exp}}
Your faction standing with The Fight Club got better. You receive 50 copper from Draznax. : Draznax says, "Great job! That'll teach those vermin their place." '''Once you are level 16, this quest is no longer completable.''' : Draznax eyes you up and down, then looks at the head. : Draznax says, "The boss wants those rats scared of the little guys, not somebody your size. Keep it." You receive your items back from Draznax.

Underdocks Starter Quest.title: Underdocks Starter Quest
Underdocks Starter Quest.content:
{{Quest | imagefilename = phicon.png | width = 100px | caption = Placeholder Image |Start Zone = [[Underdocks]] |Quest Giver = [[Marshal Harding]] |Minimum Level = 1 |Classes = [[Archer]] [[Beastmaster]] [[Elementalist]] [[Enchanter]] [[Fighter]] [[Ranger]] [[Wizard]] |Related NPCs = [[Marshal Harding]] [[Simrut the Green]] [[Gunder Dinnig]] [[Maude Astarace]] |Quest Rewards = [[Musty Tunic]] [[Hammered Iron Ring]] [[Polished Iron Ring]] [[Hargrul's Skullcracker]] [[Hargrul's Tenderizer]] [[Ratkiller]] }} __TOC__ == Walkthrough == === Part 1 - Deep Beetles - Req. Lvl 1 === Read the [[Recruitment Notice]] you start with as a new Archer, Ranger, Enchanter, Beastmaster or Fighter characters. 
Calling all hot-blooded--

MEN-AT-ARMS,
SORCERERS,
HUNTERS,
and OLD DOGS.

--be you unemployed, dispossessed, or outlawed.

The DESCENDIAN ORDER holds muster in the Underdocks, EASTERN DISTRICT. Pass inspection for steady work.

GOOD PAY.

Marshal Harding
'''Ensure your language settings are set to Common Tongue, Marshal Harding cannot understand Deep Tongue as of 2026-09-10.''' '''Take a lift down to the Underdocks Citadel. Then, head east to the Eastern District. You will need to swim across or wait for the raft. Climb the staircase immediately across from the raft docking location to find [[Marshal Harding]] and hand him your [[Recruitment Notice]].''' {{exp}}
Your faction standing with The Descendian Order got better. : Marshal Harding looks you over. : Marshal Harding says, "You can read this, then? You look like you crawled out of a gutter. Have you come to serve in the Order?" You say, "I have come to serve in the Order" : Marshal Harding waves the leaf of paper in your face. : Marshal Harding says, "The Descendian Order. I pray you fight better than you read, if you wish to earn your keep." You say, "I wish to earn my keep" : Marshal Harding laughs. : Marshal Harding says, "As a scullion, no doubt, by your dress." : Marshal Harding rummages through a crate and hands you a shirt. : Marshal Harding says, "It could do with a wash, but at least you might seem to be a page rather than a pauper. Can you fight, then?" You receive [[Musty Tunic]] from [[Marshal Harding]]. You say, "I can fight" : Marshal Harding says, "I'll have the truth of it. Fill this satchel with the shells of deep beetles." : Marshal Harding hands you a threadbare sack. You receive [[Beetle Shell Collection Bag]] from [[Marshal Harding]]. : Marshal Harding says, "Do not return if this task is too great." '''Facing Northwest, follow the tunnel out of the Eastern District to the Underdocks wall where you can begin hunting [[a deep beetle]].''' '''Collect 6 [[Deep Beetle Carapace]], place them in the [[Beetle Shell Collection Bag]] and click combine to create [[Full Beetle Shell Collection Bag]].''' === Part 1 - Notes & FAQ === '''Keep to the area right by the gate back into the Undercity. There are a few white con mobs that spawn there, such as [[a dusky rat]] and [[a young shadewing]]. Kill these to get to level 2, where you can then move on to the deep beetles.''' '''Hand in the [[Full Beetle Shell Collection Bag]] to [[Marshal Harding]]''' {{exp}}
Your faction standing with The Descendian Order got better. '''At this point depending on your class he will tell you to take a note to one of a few different NPCs. As a beastmaster or fighter it will be [[Gunder Dinnig]], as an archer or ranger it will be [[Simrut the Green]]. As an enchanter, elementalist, or wizard the next step is at [[Maude Astarace]].''' : Marshal Harding says, "An adequate performance for a scullion. Bring this letter to Simrut, the hunter. He will decide what becomes of you." Or : Marshal Harding says, "An adequate performance for a scullion. Bring this letter to Gunder Dinnig, who will put you to work." Or : Marshal Harding says, "An adequate performance for a scullion. Bring this letter to Maude Astarace. She will judge your worth. You receive [[Note]] from [[Marshal Harding]]. ''' [[Simrut the Green]] is a goblin standing near some tall stones next to the Archery range.''' ''' [[Gunder Dinnig]] is a halfling located just up the stairs nearby.''' ''' [[Maude Astarace]] is a gnome located in the building next to the quartermaster.''' '''Hand the correct NPC your [[Note]]''' {{exp}}
Your faction standing with The Descendian Order got better. : Simrut the Green says, "Hrum! Is it a hunter? Yes, yes. You get a hunter's ring." Or : Gunder Dinnig says, "A new one, fresh from the field then!" : Gunder Dinnig sniffs : Gunder Dinnig says, "Not so fresh as I would have liked. We will have to get that sorted. Accept this ring as a token of your service. Take care not to lose it, lest our comrades mistake you for a poor grotto bandit." : Gunder Dinnig sighs. : Gunder Dinnig says, "It has happened before. Come now, there is work to do, stripling." Or : Maude Astarace says, "A new recruit! I hope you will live a little longer than the last one. The marshal is not always the most discerning fellow. Never mind about that. Take this ring and assist me with my reearch" You receive [[Hammered Iron Ring]]. '''This ring will have a different stat depending on your class, and the follow up quest will also vary.''' === Part 2 for Archer/Ranger - Wererats - Req. Level 5 === '''After receiving your Hammered Iron Ring, Simrut continues talking...''' : Simrut the Green says, "Have you seen the rats? You say, "What rats?" : Simrut the Green says, "Rats! Sneaking, snarling, killing! Hunt bandits, they says. Hunt rats, I says! Riddrick is gone, They took him, I says. I knows. The rats. Big rats. Will you hunt?" You say, "Who is Riddrick?" : Simrut the Green says, "The scout. He hunted the rats, too. Will you hunt?" You say, "I will hunt the rats" : Simrut the Green says, "Yes, yes. Good. Hunt rats, find Riddrick!" '''If you ask Simrut about the aforementioned bandits, he has this to say:''' You say, "What about the bandits?" : Simrut the Green says, "Deepcuts, the deep cutters." '''This may be a breadcrumb tie in to the [[Deepcut Bandit Bounty]] quest.''' '''You will need to head back the tunnel to the newbie hunting area. You are looking for Wererats, which have a rare chance of dropping [[Riddrick's Ring]]. You can find them by following the North wall out of the newbie gate until you find their encampment. You will likely need a party as the Wererats cluster in groups consisting of fighters, shamans and archers.''' '''Hand [[Simrut the Green]] [[Riddrick's Ring]].''' {{exp}} Your faction standing with The Descendian Order got better. : Simrut the Green says, "Riddrick's ring! Hrum. No, no. It won't do. No." : Simrut the Green says, "It won't do, <>! But it is proof. Give these to the lordling, Vosirek. The council must listen." You receive [[Riddrick's Ring]] from [[Simrut the Green]]. You receive [[Simrut's Report]] from [[Simrut the Green]]. '''Facing the same direction as [[Simrut the Green]], head up the stairs towards [[Gunder Dinnig]], walk through the Archer / Ranger building, and you will see [[Sir Vosirek]].''' '''Hand [[Simrut's Report]] and [[Riddrick's Ring]] to [[Sir Vosirek]].''' {{exp}} Your faction standing with The Descendian Order got better. : Sir Vosirek shakes his head. : Sir Vosirek says, "The latest victim of Simrut's obsessions, I see. He knows the council will not approve of this. Riddrick has likely deserted, or else died senselessly pursuing this folly. There is no coin to be had in rat-hunting." : Sir Vosirek tears a page out of Simrut's report and scrawls a note on the back. : Sir Vosirek says, "You have my sympathy, <>. Give this to the paymaster along with your guild signet ring." You receive [[Scrap of Paper]] from [[Sir Vosirek]]. You say, "Who is the paymaster?" : Sir Vosirek says, "You'll find Elara downstairs." '''Head downstairs to find [[Elara Venn]].''' '''Hand the [[Scrap of Paper]] and your [[Hammered Iron Ring]] to [[Elara Venn]].''' {{exp}} Your faction standing with The Descendian Order got better. : Elara Venn shakes her head. : Elara Venn says, "Oh, Urzebol take Simrut's rats. But you followed orders, and there are always opportunities for those who follow orders. Take this ring." You receive [[Polished Iron Ring]] from [[Elara Venn]]. You receive 10 silver from Elara Venn. === Part 3 for Archer/Ranger - Riddrick - Req. Level 8+ === '''Return to [[Simrut the Green]] and Hail him.''' You say, "Hail, Simrut the Green." : Simrut the Green says, "Hrumm. No help from council, no. Must find Riddrick." You say, "But Riddrick is dead. We found his ring!" : Simrut the Green says, "Not dead, I says. Lost his ring, not dead. The rats have him!" : Simrut the Green grins at you. : Simrut the Green says, "Find Riddrick!" '''At this point, you are on the search for [[Riddrick the Cursed]], a rare wererat spawn. You will need to be level 12-14 and you may need a group to successfully find and put an end to Riddrick.''' '''Upon killing [[Riddrick the Cursed]], loot [[Riddrick's Head]] and return to [[Simrut the Green]].''' '''Hand [[Riddrick's Head]] to [[Simrut the Green]].''' Missing dialogue here... {{exp}} Your faction standing with The Descendian Order got better. You receive [[Ratkiller]] from [[Simrut the Green]]. You can trade [[Ratkiller]] back to [[Simrut the Green]] for [[Ratbiter]] if you choose. === Part 2 for Enchanter/Elementalist/Wizard - Deepcut Miners in Darrowdwell Mines - Req. Level 4+ === '''After receiving your Hammered Iron Ring, ask Maude about her research...''' You say, "What research?" : Maude Astarace says, "The Delvestone and Deepcut quarrel over rocks, and I wish to know why. Their petty conflict is our good fortune, since the mining company will pay us to reclaim their crystals." : Maude Astarace says, "Venture into the Darrowdwell mine about the citadel and fill this box with crystals from the Deepcut miners." You receive [[Empty Crystal Box]] from [[Maude Astarace]]. : Maude Astarace says, "In truth, I care not how you acquire these crystals." '''Hand in the [[Full Box of Crystals]] to [[Maude Astarace]]''' {{exp}}
'''After receiving [[Full Box of Crystals]], Maude Astarace continues talking...''' : Maude Astarace opens the box and rummages throught it. : Maude Astarace says, "What is this?" : Maude Astarace says, "These are not diamonds, nor sapphires, nor even jaspers. Lusterless rocks, all!" : Maude Astarace says, "I suppose you have earned some coin for your part. The Miners can have their rocks, but something is amiss. Take this to the paymaster along with your guild signet." '''Hand in the [[Darrowdwell Crystal Bounty]] to [[Elara Venn]] at the Bounty Building nearby with your [[Hammered Iron Ring]]''' Your faction standing with The Descendian Order got better. Elara Venn unfolds Maude's report. : Elara Venn says, "A contract fulfilled. The Delvestone appreciate your work, Class, even if the sorceress does not. Here is your share, and a signet befitting your place." You receive [[Polished Iron Ring]] from Elara Venn. You recieve 10 silver from Elara Venn. === Part 3 for Enchanter/Elementalist/Wizard - Deepcut, Delvestone, Darrowdwell. - Req. Level 8+ ===
'''Return to [[Maude Astarace]] and hail her.''' : Maude Astarace says, "I do not believe for a moment that the Delvestone would spill their blood or their coin for those worthless rocks. I require your assistance once more, Player Name." You say, "I will assist you" : Maude Astarace says, "I must have a sample of whatever mineral lies at the heart of this territorial squabble. Deepcut, Delvestone, Darrowdwell. These are insignificant. Find the thing they fight and die for." : Maude Astarace says, "Do this, and I will reward you personally." You are looking for a [[Faintly Glowing Crystal]] (you only need one) from a Deepcut Miner ( Level 10+ ) in the North Mines. The North Mines can be reached by exiting the North East gate then head kinda like north east of that and to the back of the zone. There are tents of deepcut ( not miners ) outside so you'll know you are in the right place. There are higher level bigger mushroom people in the general area too. '''Return to [[Maude Astarace]] and give her the [[Faintly Glowing Crystal]].''' You gain experience. Your faction standing with The Descendian Order got better. : Maude Astarace says, "Oh, yes. Something lingers within this crystal... but what? I shall find out." : Maude Astarace says, "I thank you, Player. You are most useful. Run along now, for i have much work to do." You receive [[Walking Stick]] from Maude Astarace. : This is repeatable. to be continued === Part 2 for Beastmaster/Fighter - Deepcut Overseers in Darrowdwell Mines - Req. Level 5 === '''After receiving your Hammered Iron Ring, ask [[Gunder Dinnig]] about work...''' : You say, "What work?" : Gunder Dinnig says, "Aye, there are domestic matters we might resolve to our profit. The Delvestone Mining Company quarrel with the Deepcut bandits in Darrowdwell. The company is ill-equipped to to protect their interests, but their pockets run deep." : Gunder Dinnig says, "There is a standing bounty of the heads of Deepcut overseers. Fill this bag and earn your share. Send them packing!" {{Emote|Gunder Dinnig belches.}} You receive [[Empty Overseer Bag]] from [[Gunder Dinnig]]. : You say, "Deepcut overseers?" : Gunder Dinnig says, "A vicious lot. They will give no quarter, and I advise you to do the same. Their miners know how to swing a battleaxe as well as a pick." : You say, "Where is Darrowdwell?" : Gunder Dinnig says, "The mine is carved out of the rock above us. The lift will take you to the rafters." : Gunder Dinnig says, "Watch your step." '''To get to the Darrowdwell, leave Gunder Dunnig and head to the Citadel by the way of the raft. Go up the ramp, then turn right and make your way around, keeping the Citadel on your left. You will see [[Munk]] and what looks like a large, stone elevated square platform nearby. That is the lift to the Overreach. Take the lift all the way up to the top, and enjoy the view! Step off the lift and turn right. The next lift is the one we want, the one labeled "Lift to Darrowdwell Mine."'''

* '''WARNING! There are empty spaces in the rafters at the mines. Be careful, as you will fall all the way down to the Citadel and die.''' * '''WARNING! The [[deepcut miner]] may aggro along with the overseer and assist in combat. (needs verification)''' '''Carefully make your way across the rafters, ignoring the different rafter rats as they aren't aggro. Your goal is the cave/tunnel you see to your left with a torch lighting the entrance.''' '''Collect 6 [[Deepcut Overseer Head]], place them in the [[Empty Overseer Bag]] and click combine to create [[Full Bag of Overseer Heads]].''' '''Hand in the [[Full Bag of Overseer Heads]] to [[Gunder Dinnig]]''' Your faction standing with The Descendian Order got better. Gunder Dinnig Unfastens the Bag. : Gunder Dinning says, "Gruesome work, Player Name. Would that you had a sharper blade... yet a crown hewn is a copper earned. Bring this to Elara, the pay-master, along with your ring." You receive [[Deepcut Overseer Bounty]] from [[Gunder Dinnig]]. : Elara Venn says, "You acquit yourself well, Class. Here is your coin, and a signet that might serve you better." You receive [[Polished Iron Ring]] from Elara Venn. You recieve 10 silver from Elara Venn. === Part 3 for Beastmaster/Fighter - More business with the Deepcut - Req. Level 8+ === '''Return to [[Gunder Dinnig]] and hail him.''' : Gunder Dinnig says, "There is more business with the Deepcut." You say, "what business?" : Gunder Dinnig says, "The bandits have an encampment, a mine where the Delvestone dare not go. My peers wish to rout the blaggards, claim their quarries, and lease them to fill our coffers." : Gunder Dinnig says, "But we must exercise caution. I have a new assignment for you." You say, "what assignment?" : Gunder Dinnig says, "Find their lair, Player Name, and take no quarter. You may claim a bounty for every six hands of the bandits you slay. Bring them to the clerk, Traven, and he will see that you are paid. But that is not your task." You say, "what task?" : Gunder Dinnig says, "I wish to know who is behind this sordid outfit. If we are to extend our reach father into the Deep, we must know. Bring me any evidence you can find, however insignificant it might seem to your eye." '''Travel to the Deepcut bandit camps which can be found if you keep going east a little way in the Underdocks newbie yard and slay them until you acquire a [[Dull Coin]]. Bring this coin back to Gunder.''' Gunder Dinnig squints his eyes at the coin. : Gunder Dinnig says, "One of the bandits carried this? It is an elvish coin, though I do not recognize the sigil. Should it belong to one of the great houses..." : Gunder Dinnig says, "There is no contract fulfilled nor bounty to collect for your work today, Player Name, but you have earned a measure of trust. Take this token to Hargrul in the citadel. He is an old friend of mine, and a blacksmith of formidable skill. You receive a token from Gunder Dinnig. '''Take the token over to the blacksmith shop in the citadel and give it to [[Blacksmith Hargrul]].''' Blacksmith Hargrul holds the token up to the light of the forge. : Blacksmith Hargrul says, "Hmm, 'Tis my token." Blacksmith Hargrul looks you up and down.. : Blacksmith Hargrul says, "I haven't a blade suited to a young Class such as yourself. But a skullcracker will do." You receive [[Hargrul's Skullcracker]] from Blacksmith Hargrul. : Blacksmith Hargrul says, "If ye cannot wield it, return it to me to receive a smaller battle hammer." '''You now have the option to trade it for a one-handed weapon.''' : Blacksmith Hargrul says, "Haven't the strength, I see. Perhaps it's meant for a more capable Class." You receive [[Hargrul's Tenderizer]] from Blacksmith Hargrul. Shadow Knight Starter Quest (Underdocks).title: Shadow Knight Starter Quest (Underdocks)
Shadow Knight Starter Quest (Underdocks).content:
{{Quest | name = | Quest Giver = [[Soren Akedd]] | Start Zone = [[Underdocks]] | Related NPCs = [[Soren Akedd]]; [[Father Fyod]]; [[Lady Tabitha]]; [[a rafter rat]]; [[Myconid Gatherer]]; [[Myconid Truffian]] | Related Items = [[Rafter Rat Tail]], 4; [[Worn Cassock]], 1; [[Initiate's Dull Greatsword]], 1; [[Initiate's Greatsword]], 1; [[Myconid Cap Bag]], 1; [[Myconid Cap]], 8 | imagefilename = phicon.png | width = 100px | caption = Placeholder Image | Minimum Level = 1 | Classes = SHD | Races = | Quest Rewards = [[Worn Cassock]], 1; [[Initiate's Dull Greatsword]], 1; [[Initiate's Greatsword]], 1; [[Chosen Initiate's Greatsword]], 1; (exp) }} == Walkthrough == === Part 1 - Req. Lvl 1 === Read Weathered Note you start with as a new Shadow Knight character: 
 NEEDS TEXT.
Hand Weathered Note to [[Soren Akedd]]. : Soren Akedd says, "You have done well to come when called, [Player]. This is the House of Ygorath, which you may call home, if you are deemed worthy to carry out his work." : Soren Akedd says, "You appear before me as you were in my nightmare, [Player]." You say, 'What nightmare?' : Soren Akedd says, "Nightmares are visits from Ygorath, gifted upon all the fearful of this land. It was my nightmare that called you here to begin his work." You say, 'What is his work?' : Soren Akedd says, "It is the work of trembling hands to raise both the living and the dead upon his altar. It is for their salvation as much as our own." : Soren Akedd says, "Many souls walk Eth-ur practicing feints of valor, but Ygorath's wisdom knows bravery to be a thin sheen upon a bottomless terror. We must usher them into his kingdom with right fear in their hearts." : Soren Akedd says, "This you must do, Shadow Knight, whether by sign or by sword. If you pass the test." You say, 'What is the test?' : Soren Akedd says, "The rabble carry fear in their blood and their bones. Ours are borne by Ygorath. This is your test: take this effigy to the chapel and make of it an offering. Place your effigy upon the altar and receive Ygorath's blessing. Return with what remains." : Soren Akedd says, "But I must warn you... cast your gaze downward and look not upon the visage of Ygorath." ''Go next door to the temple of Ygorath, hold the effigy in your hand (left click on it) and use the mud command "/place effigy" to receive an offering bowl. Go back to Soren and hand in the offering bowl.'' : Soren Akedd says, "Your eyes are open. Take this drape and rise a new servant of Ygorath." {{ReceiveItem|You receive [[Worn Cassock]] from Soren Akedd.}} {{exp}} === Part 2 - Req. Lvl 1 === : Soren Akedd says, "Now go, and do his work. If you would prove yourself a belted knight, report to [[Father Fyod]] upstairs." ''Go upstairs onto the balcony [left of center when facing the yard from inside] and hail [[Father Fyod]].'' : Father Fyod scoffs. : Father Fyod says, "What are you supposed to be?" You say, 'A Shadow Knight' : Father Fyod says, "How convincing." : Father Fyod guffaws. : Father Fyod says, "Stand to it, then. You're a sorry sight, but I've seen worse. Do you wish to become a servant of the Trembling Hand, the chosen of Ygorath?." You say, 'I do.' : Father Fyod says, "Very well. As knights of the temple, our fears guide but do not govern us." : Father Fyod says, "You will go to the rafters above the citadel. It's infested with vermin. Fill this sack with their tails as testimony to your constitution." : Father Fyod says, "You'll return, or you'll die." ''Go up the lift to the mining camp and traverse out onto the rafters that are above the citadel. Kill [[a rafter rat]] (not the diseased ones) until you have 4 tails; fill the bag and combine for a bag of rafter rat tails. Return to [[Father Fyod]].'' : Father Fyod says, "Do not take pride in acquitting yourself of this task. You've proven only that you're not vermin. Whether you have the mettle to stand as a true knight of this temple remains to be seen. But you've earned the right to this blade." {{ReceiveItem|You receive [[Initiate's Dull Greatsword]] from Father Fyod.}} : Father Fyod pauses. : Father Fyod says, "... A right which can be revoked." === Part 3 - Req. Lvl 5 === If you go back to Fyod too early: : Father Fyod says, "I do not require your assistance at this time, fledgling. Return when you're stronger." At level 5: (Worn Cossack and Initiate's Dull Greatsword equipped!) : Father Fyod says, "If you'd like to be of use, go and find Lady Tabitha in her laboratory and see that she has what she needs." ''Go back to the entrance to the temple. [[Lady Tabitha]]'s lab is up the ramp on the right, and a door on the right of that hallway.'' : Lady Tabitha hums to herself. : Lady Tabitha says, "Oh, here's a new one. Who sent you to me? Or have you become a nuisance of your own volition?" You say, 'Father Fyod sent me.' : Lady Tabitha says, "Indeed! Each somehow less promising than the last, it seems. No matter. If you can furnish the ingredients I require, I will endorse your aspiration." You say, 'What ingredients do you need?' : Lady Tabitha says, "I brew many potions your kind rely on, Shadow Knight. Venture into the great cavern and fetch me as many myconid caps as this will carry." {{ReceiveItem|You receive [[Myconid Cap Bag]] from Lady Tabitha.}} : Lady Tabitha says, "I prefer the larger ones." ''Go out the north gate of Underdocks and kill [[Myconid Gatherer]] and [[Myconid Truffian]] - fill the bag with 8x [[Myconid Cap]] (not [[Decomposed Myconid Cap]]) and combine. Turn the combined item back in to Tabitha.'' : Lady Tabitha says, "I thank you, Shadow Knight. The work continues. Give this letter to Father Fyod as a sign of your progress." ''Go back to Father Fyod and turn in the letter.'' : Father Fyod unfolds the letter. : Father Fyod says, "''Adequate''. That's what she wrote." : Father Fyod grumbles to himself. : Father Fyod says, "Better than the last one, to be fair. Hand me the alchemist's letter along with your initiate's sword, and I'll grant you a more capable blade." ''Hand both the letter and your [[Initiate's Dull Greatsword]] to Fyod.'' : Father Fyod says, "Wield this in Ygorath's name. Now leave me be." {{ReceiveItem|You receive [[Initiate's Greatsword]] from Father Fyod.}} === Part 4 - Req. Lvl 13 === If you go back to Fyod too early: : Father Fyod says, "You're still too weak to call yourself a knight." If you are the required level: : Father Fyod says, "Your blade has seen some use, then. Report to [[Father General Lorak]]." ''Father General Lorak is in the center room overlooking the yard, first left after you leave Father Fyod'' You say, "Hail, Father General Lorak." : Father General Lorak says, "I see you carry a blade of the chosen. It is but one instrument of fear. Tell me, have you yet learned to inflict fear on the living?" You say, "Yes." : Father General Lorak says, "The ability to strike fear into the heart of our enemies is the first lesson any true knight of Ygorath must learn. You must carry out a simple task for the temple." You say, "What task?" : Father General Lorak says, "Slay the Deepcut bandits who encroach upon our territory. Collect the blood of those who die in fear and return the samples in this bag." {{ReceiveItem|You receive [[Blood Bag]] from Father General Lorak.}} : Father General Lorak says, "Now go." Kill Deepcut bandits while they are under the effects of [[Fear]], loot their blood. Yes - they must die while feared, drop rate is about 90% Combine 6 Deepcut Blood in the [[Blood Bag]] to craft a [[Full Blood Bag]] ''Hand the [[Full Blood Bag]] to Father General Lorak.'' : Father General Lorak says Bring these to Lady Tabitha. She will be the judge of your work. {{ReceiveItem|You receive [[Full Blood Bag]] from Father General Lorak.}} ''Hand the [[Full Blood Bag]] to Lady Tabitha.'' : Lady Tabitha says A delivery! Let's see. : Lady Tabitha opens the box and inhales deeply. : Lady Tabitha says How delightful. With this material I can distill the humors needed to brew our strongest potions. But I require another ingredient, still. {{ReceiveItem|You receive [[Fearful Humors]] from Lady Tabitha.}} You say, "What ingredients?" : Lady Tabitha says I hear there is one among the Deepcut who calls himself fearless. Fetch me his head with the humors provided, and I will measure his constitution. ''Kill [[Jorlach the Fearless]] and loot his head.'' - He is located in the Deepcut mines (past UD East Gate), after you enter the cave, it is the first cavern to the left - then he is up to the right on a small ledge. ''Hand [[Jorlach's Head]] and the [[Fearful Humors]] to Lady Tabitha.'' : Lady Tabitha looks into Jorlach's lifeless eyes. : Lady Tabitha says Was it foolhardiness or mere stupidity, I wonder? I'll find it out. : Lady Tabitha says You've done well, Shadow Knight. Present this letter to Father General Lorak, along with your knight's blade. {{ReceiveItem|You receive [[Tabitha's Letter]] from Lady Tabitha.}} ''Hand Father General Lorak the Letter and your [[Initiate's Greatsword]] : Father General Lorak says Your acts befit a chosen of Ygorath. Accept this blade as his instrument. {{ReceiveItem|You receive [[Chosen Initiate's Greatsword]] from Father General Lorak.}} === Part 5 - Req. Lvl?? === If you return too early: : Father General Lorak says Leave. : Father Fyod says Obey your superiors and you may prove yourself a worthy knight, [Name].

Syrsil's Stolen Package.title: Syrsil's Stolen Package
Syrsil's Stolen Package.content:
{{NeedsInfo}}
{{Quest
| name          = Syrsil's Stolen Package
| imagefilename = Senior Apprentice Syrsil 2.png
| Quest Giver   = [[Senior Apprentice Syrsil]]
| Start Zone    = [[Underdocks]]
| Related NPCs  = [[Senior Apprentice Syrsil]]; [[Vaslir Vharkith]]; [[Belot]]; [[Freysia Riftrend]]
| Related Items = [[Vharkith's Order]]; [[House Varros Senior Apprentice Robe]]
| Minimum Level =
| Classes       =
| Quest Rewards = (exp); [[Faction|House Varros]]
}}

== Overview ==

[[Senior Apprentice Syrsil]] is stranded in the [[Underdocks]] after failing to recover a package for [[Vaslir Vharkith]] of [[House Varros]]. Syrsil is revealed to be Vharkith's missing senior apprentice, mentioned repeatedly during [[House Varros (Quest)]].

Syrsil accepts [[Vharkith's Order]], the same package requested by Vharkith during Part 5 of his quest, in exchange for experience and improved House Varros faction.

{{QuestNote|'''Quest name unconfirmed:''' "Syrsil's Stolen Package" is a descriptive wiki title. The in-game quest-journal title has not yet been verified.}}

== Walkthrough ==

==== Find Senior Apprentice Syrsil ====

Travel to the [[Underdocks]] in [[Night Harbor]].

[[Senior Apprentice Syrsil]] is located in the tavern on the third floor of the Underdocks Citadel, inside the inn. The tavern is one floor below [[Innkeeper Adrella]] and one floor above the guest rooms.

Syrsil can be greeted with the Ail'trist greeting "Karzzul, Senior." A standard hail also works.

The dialogue below uses '''[square brackets]''' to identify keywords that open additional conversation branches.

===== Greeting and Problems =====

You say in Deep Common, "Karzzul, Senior."

:Senior Apprentice Syrsil says, "Leave me be! I have enough '''[problems]''' as it is."

You say in Deep Common, "problems"

:Senior Apprentice Syrsil says, "You know what it is like to be Ail'trist. It is both a blessing and a '''[curse]'''."

:Senior Apprentice Syrsil says, "At the moment, mostly a '''[curse]'''."

''Senior Apprentice Syrsil looks away sourly.''

===== Curse and the Missing Package =====

You say in Deep Common, "curse"

:Senior Apprentice Syrsil says, "The Shadow graced us with survival in the Deep, yet that survival comes with a price. We must each strive to be the most cunning, the most ruthless, the best. If not, we are quickly extinguished by someone better."

''Senior Apprentice Syrsil grimaces.''

:Senior Apprentice Syrsil says, "Or luckier. My master sent me on what seemed like a simple errand, but it has become intractable. And for each day I languish here, my master's esteem for me will fall further. At this point, even if I do somehow retrieve his '''[package]''', he will probably just kill me for being late with the delivery."

:Senior Apprentice Syrsil says, "Xavbas! If only I had not wasted all my coin on that '''[assassin]''', I could have hired some locals to '''[help]''' me with those zor'thez '''[bandits]'''. But as it stands, I can barely pay for my next drink."

===== Package =====

You say in Deep Common, "packages"

:Senior Apprentice Syrsil says, "My master sent me to retrieve a package from the Descendian Order. However, when I arrived here, that zor'thez e'var'zanai elementalist told me it had been stolen!"

:Senior Apprentice Syrsil says, "Apparently someone called Bel... something. Belath? Beloth? I forget. Whatever her name is, she ran off with my master's package. Now she is sitting there with the other bandits laughing at us!"

:Senior Apprentice Syrsil says, "I tried to track her down, but there is a whole network of mines and camps out there, all full of those '''[bandits]'''. There are far too many for me to fight through without '''[help]'''."

:Senior Apprentice Syrsil says, "And as previously stated, I cannot afford to hire '''[help]'''. So I am stuck in this Shadow forsaken hive of scum and barbarity, listening to this yammering they call a language."

{{QuestNote|The recorded player response was "packages" (plural). The NPC does not respond to "package" (singular).}}

===== Bandits =====

You say in Deep Common, "bandits"

:Senior Apprentice Syrsil says, "Some local riff-raff called the Deepcut... crew or gang? Something like that. Easy for one such as I to dispose of individually, but they are like vermin. Kill one and two more pop up."

===== Assassin =====

You say in Deep Common, "assassin"

:Senior Apprentice Syrsil says, "In '''[Ail'vorith]''' I am the senior apprentice to Vaslir Vharkith of '''[House Varros]'''. The junior apprentice was a little too competent, so I hired someone to nip that problem in the bud. Cannot have any upstarts coveting my position."

:Senior Apprentice Syrsil says, "In hindsight, I should have just killed the newcomer myself, but I was trying to do things the right way and maintain deniability."

''Senior Apprentice Syrsil grimaces.''

===== Ail'vorith =====

You say in Deep Common, "Ail'vorith"

:Senior Apprentice Syrsil says, "Our Shadow-blessed city. It is the glorious capital of the Deep. And instead, I am stuck here with these Shadowless e'var'zanai."

''Senior Apprentice Syrsil looks disgusted.''

===== House Varros =====

You say in Deep Common, "House Varros"

:Senior Apprentice Syrsil says, "One of the seven Great Houses of my people. We in House Varros are the summoners. With our rituals, we bind beings from other planes and wield them in service of our Queen."

===== Help =====

You say in Deep Common, "help"

:Senior Apprentice Syrsil says, "Help? Why would you help me? I already told you I have no more money. All I can offer you is an ally in '''[House Varros]''', assuming my master does not kill me for being late."

{{QuestNote|The "House Varros" keyword here produces the same response documented in the House Varros dialogue branch above. No additional dialogue branch has been confirmed beyond this point.}}

==== Recover Vharkith's Order ====

The stolen package is [[Vharkith's Order]], described as:

:''A wrapped bundle that smells faintly of brimstone.''

The package is associated with the [[Deepcut Bandits|Deepcut bandits]] in the [[Underdocks]].

The item has been documented as dropping from:

* [[Belot]] – A named Deepcut bandit encountered in the bandit camps or the mines behind them.
* Deepcut enemies at '''North Gate East''' – Also listed as a source on the [[Vharkith's Order]] item page.

{{QuestNote|Belot's exact spawn details, the package's drop rate, and any additional drop sources still require verification.}}

==== Return the Package to Senior Apprentice Syrsil ====

Return to [[Senior Apprentice Syrsil]] in the Underdocks Citadel tavern.

Hand [[Vharkith's Order]] to [[Senior Apprentice Syrsil]].

{{exp}}
{{Faction|House Varros|+}}

:Senior Apprentice Syrsil says, "Varsa ai Neth'xan! The Shadow must have sent you to me. Perhaps I am destined for greatness after all."

:Senior Apprentice Syrsil says, "May you hear."

''Senior Apprentice Syrsil nods at you appreciatively.''

== Related Quest: House Varros ==

Syrsil is the former senior apprentice referenced by [[Vaslir Vharkith]] throughout [[House Varros (Quest)]].

Vharkith sends the player to complete the assignment that Syrsil failed to finish. Upon receiving [[Vharkith's Order]], Vharkith promotes the player to his new senior apprentice.

Syrsil's dialogue reveals that he previously hired an assassin against a promising junior apprentice to protect his own position.

Both Syrsil and Vharkith accept [[Vharkith's Order]], granting experience and positive House Varros faction.

{{QuestNote|Players have reported completing both hand-ins using separate copies of the item.}}

== The Senior Apprentice Robe ==

[[Senior Apprentice Syrsil]] can be killed and looted for the [[House Varros Senior Apprentice Robe]].

The robe is restricted to Deep Elves (DEF).

During [[House Varros (Quest)]], Vharkith promotes the player to senior apprentice but explains that he has no more senior apprentice robes available.

He also tells the player that if his former senior apprentice returns, they may deal with him as they wish.

Syrsil's admission that he hired an assassin against a competing apprentice provides further context for the conflict between the two apprentices.

{{QuestNote|'''Alternative outcome:''' Giving Syrsil [[Vharkith's Order]] awards experience and House Varros faction, but does not award the robe. The robe is obtained by defeating Syrsil and looting it. Players have reported obtaining the robe without completing the earlier House Varros assignments.}}

{{QuestNote|'''Faction observation:''' During the recorded encounter, killing Syrsil did not cause a faction loss or provoke the other tavern occupants. The NPC encounter may still be dangerous, and these observations do not establish that every combat situation will behave identically.}}

See [[House Varros (Quest)]] for the full storyline and its Part 6 conclusion.

== Notes ==

* The official in-game quest title remains unconfirmed.
* The dialogue branches for problems, curse, packages, bandits, assassin, Ail'vorith, House Varros, and help have been documented.
* Returning the package and obtaining the robe are different activities with different rewards.
* The robe's drop rate remains unverified.

Rogue Starter Quest (Underdocks).title: Rogue Starter Quest (Underdocks)
Rogue Starter Quest (Underdocks).content:
{{Quest | name = Rogue Starter Quest (Underdocks) | Quest Giver = | Start Zone = [[underdocks]] | Related NPCs = | Related Items = | imagefilename = | width = | caption = | Minimum Level = 0 | Classes = Rogue | Races = any | Quest Rewards = (exp); [[Prankster's Trousers]]; [[Sly Leather Jerkin]]; [[Dagger Of Rapidity]]; }} == Pt 1 Hand in letter == The thieves guild is located on west docks further behind from the herbalist. easiest way to get there is to take the path to the rear buildings behind the enchanters (a purple glow) up the stairs opposite. Then follow the path to the right until you reach the herbalist [[Clarinda Sageforth]] as you approach you will see a gap between the house and the wall to your left, in that gap and up the resulting ramp, into the tunnel, is the thieves guild. [[Slylara Llumare]] is the first NPC you meet on the right. Hand her the letter == pt 2 Bath House == the bath house is located in the Citadel (middle island). The enterance is from the south arch, take the left ramp down, to the next room, then the ramp down to the right. Where you will find [[Bogrun]]. To his left is a series of cubicles, the first one with a sack and a backpack . /look /inspect bag /take trousers Return to [[Slylara Llumare]]. You will receive the [[Prankster's Trousers]]. == Pt 3 at level 5 == Say "im ready"
Most of the quest about investigation part is superfluous.
Go to the last floor of the citadel (Central part of the docks), to the large tavern with a high tent roof.
Find "a miserable drunk".
Hail him and ask "are you girardi".
Hand him the necklace drawing and he will return another drawing to you. This flags your character as being able to acquire the necklace from Valhassen.
On top of the Tailoring shop, next door to the tavern, are [[Lady Valhassen]]'s apartments.
Valhassen has a Day/Night routine that you need to watch to complete this quest (She heads back to her room at 6am game time), during the night she stays in her room going back and forth between the fireplace and the balcony. That's when you want to strike.
Face the fireplace, on the right side of the room is small bookshelf with a lockbox on top.
/look
/inspect Lockbox
/take necklace
Return to [[Slylara Llumare]] and hand her the necklace.
You will receive the [[Sly Leather Jerkin]]. == Pt 4 at level 10 == Say "i have what it takes"
[[Slylara Llumare]] gives you the necklace back.
Turn right to the boxes in the same room and find the passage hidden behind.
Go to [[Erythar]]'s altar in the back of the room.
Click on the necklace and keep it on your mouse.
/place altar
The altar shows you a vision and gives you the name "[[Yorvak]]".
Go to East docks. On the northern part of the coast is a small pirate infested tavern.
Don't go to the second floor directly, the pirates will kill you on sight and see through stealth.
First you'll want to go to the counter and ask [[Yorvak]] about pirates.This will trigger the pirates from upstairs to come down to settle a fight with other patrons.
Now is your chance. When facing the tavern, activate stealth and go to the door on the left. Dodge any pirates going down and pass the lookout.
Go to the chest at the end of the room.
/look
/take dagger
You will receive the [[Dagger Of Rapidity]].

[[File:NightHarbor1.jpg|400px|thumb|right|alt=Night Harbor at Night|Night Harbor at Night]]
Night Harbor is the seat of power for the [[Langsdorfian League]], a confederacy of guilds with a near monopoly on trade and transportation throughout Aêthoril.

Shallow Shoals.title: Shallow Shoals
Shallow Shoals.content:
__NOTOC__ [[File:Shallow shoals.png|400px|right|thumb]]
This Archipelago located off the Western coast of Aêthoril straddles the regions of Szuur and Calafrey. Spanning from Keeper's Bight in the North to Fallen Pass in the South. To the the East is Vale of Zintar, to the West is the endless reaches of the Twilight Sea. Each island hosts its own different ecosystem comprised of various beasts, races, and factions. {{ZoneDetails |QuickLinks = [[Shallow_Shoals#Quests|Quests]] • [[Shallow_Shoals#Items|Items]] • [[Shallow_Shoals#NPCs|NPCs]] |Level = 25-50 |MonsterTypes = [[Orc]], [[Human]], [[Giant]], [[Basilisk]], [[Goblin]], [[Ghost]], Sharks, Elementals, Undead, Snakes |NotableNPC = [[Witchguard Hellblade]], [[Herald of Muurtu]], [[High Sister of Sarinius]], [[High-Priest of Muurtu]], [[Champion of Muurtu]], [[Captain Bilgesneak]],[[Witchguard Primus]], [[Witchguard Kruurgal]] |Items = [[Blade of the Witchguard]], [[Faithpiercer]], [[Girdle of Stern Mercy]], [[Muurtu Shield]], [[Waistguard of Fervor]], [[Witchguard Gauntlets]] |RelatedQuests = |AdjacentZones = [[Vale of Zintar]], [[Keeper's Bight]], [[Fallen Pass]], [[Grimtide Sanctum]] }}

__NOTOC__ [[File:Wyrmsbane.png|400px|right|thumb|Illustration by Goblin of Wyrmsbane entrance]]
''"Our name, our place, and our tomb, all forgotten,'' ''The brief race of time well and patiently won.'' ''The triumphs we fought for, let them be our story,'' ''Not the missteps that rent us undone.'' ''How we are undone."'' - '''Epitaph of the Last Wyrmsbane''' Wyrmsbane Tomb is a dungeon populated with skeletons and ghosts.(WB for short) It's located in a cave on the top of the hill of the west Tel Ekir.title: Tel Ekir
Tel Ekir.content:

Vale of Zintar.title: Vale of Zintar
Vale of Zintar.content:
__NOTOC__ [[File:Vale of Zintar.png|400px|right|thumb|Inside the giant city. Fallen Watch and the floating citadel visible in the background.]]
Vale of Zintar is a coastal desert situated on the West coast of Aêthoril in the Szuur region. To the North is Keeper's Bight, to the East is Glass Flats, to the South is Fallen Watch, to the West is Shallow Shoals. Giants and Giant Undead Skeletons are the dominant force but orcs have also make their pressence known. However, corruption from unknown sources spreads in the South. == Traveling To and From == * [[Fallen Pass]] ==What's in this zone?== In [[Fallen Pass]], up the ramp from the [[Shaded Dunes]] zoneline is [[Mia Tarcut]]. She initially gives a hint for Fallen Watchs existance and works as a quest giver. If she is given a [[Hardened Ooze Pustule]] she will reward the player with [[Recipe: Cleansing Resin & Torch of Purification]] which will teach you to craft both [[Cleansing Resin]] and [[Torch of Purification]]. Just inside a zoneline is [[Marcus Aden]], a vendor that sells [[Scrivener's Satchel]], which can be used to collect page scraps, such as [[Journal Page 5 Scrap 1-5]] and [[Page 1 Scrap]]. A completed set of journal pages can be turned in to XXXXXX for recipes. For example, all page 5s for [[Recipe: Experiment X3]]. Next to [[Marcus Aden]], and also spread throughout the zone, are barrels that respond to mud commands. You can /look them and use /take object or /take ooze for a variety of items, from coins, to [[Bone Chips]], to [[Hardened Ooze Pustule]], to [[Wand of Restoration]]. ===Quests=== {| class="wikitable sortable" cellpadding=5 style="border:1px solid #BBB; width:1100px;" ! style="background-color: #faead3; text-align: left;"|Quest Name !! style="background-color: #faead3; text-align: left;"|Reward !! style="background-color: #faead3; text-align: left;"|Quest Giver !! style="background-color: #faead3; text-align: left;"|Minimum Level |- | Example Quest Name || Example Reward || Example Quest Giver || - Evershade Weald is a starting zone restricted to the [[Wood Elf]] and the [[Halfling]]. Keeper's Bight.title: Keeper's Bight
Keeper's Bight.content:
__NOTOC__ [[File:Keepers Bight.png|400px|right|thumb]]
Keeper's Bight is a coastal temperate forest plateau centrally located on Aêthoril's Western Coast in the Calafrey region. Transitioning from low coastal desert in the South to high forest plateau in the North. Penshaw, under the control of the Red Mantle, provides the region port access with popular shipping routes to Zaedin's Landing and ultimately Night Harbor. To the North is Evershade Weald, to the East is Scarwood, to the South is Vale of Zintar, to the West is Shallow Shoals. The Blacktide Orcs have a dominant foothold in the South while trapping and hunting are common throughout the thick forest plateau. {{ZoneDetails |QuickLinks = [[Keeper%27s_Bight#Quests|Quests]] • [[Keeper%27s_Bight#Items|Items]] • [[Keeper%27s_Bight#NPCs|NPCs]] |Level = 5 - ?? |MonsterTypes = Wolves, Wasps, Snakes, Bears, Drakes, Basilisks, Skeletons, Will-o-wisps, Orcs, Giants |NotableNPC = [[Rarthan Wartide]], [[Belthakar Dunecaller]], [[Widow Vethra]], [[Poacher Tolan]], [[Poacher Garrus]], [[Poacher Wilna]], [[Redpaw]], [[Timberfang]], [[Brukk Goldgut]], [[Mirella Nighthorn]] |Items = - |RelatedQuests = [[Poacher's Knives]], [[Hale's Haul]], [[Left Behind]], [[Wilna's Ring]], [[Growing Threat of the Sangrel Fist]] |AdjacentZones = [[Blacktide Bay]], [[Evershade Weald]], [[Scarwood]], [[Vale of Zintar]], [[Shallow Shoals]] }}

Faelindral.content:
__NOTOC__ [[File:Faelindral.png|400px|right|thumb|placeholder]]
Faelindral is the [[Wood Elf]] home city located within the zone [[Evershade Weald]]. Faelindral is a starting city restricted to the [[Wood Elf]] and the [[Halfling]]. Most of their available classes can start here, apart from the [[Paladin]] and [[Cleric]] from the Halfling class pool. == Traveling To and From == The city of the Faelewyn is accessible from various lifts or bridges in [[Evershade Weald]]. ==What's in this zone?== ===Races=== [[Halfling]] and [[Wood Elf]] can start in this zone (or Night Harbor). No other races can.
(Halfling and Wood Elf can also start in [[Night Harbor]], with the rest of the (non-Deep) races.) ===Classes=== Thus, the following classes can be started here:
(Note that while Halflings can be Cleric or Paladin, they cannot start here.)
  • [[Archer]] (both)
  • [[Bard]] (both)
  • [[Beastmaster]] (both)
  • [[Druid]] (both)
  • [[Fighter]] (both)
  • [[Ranger]] (both)
  • [[Rogue]] (both)
  • [[Shaman]] (Wood Elf)

Night Harbor Sewers is a series of sewers and tunnels beneath the streets of Night Harbor. No details on when it will come back. * ====Night Harbor Sewers==== :1. Example Map POI |}

== Traveling To and From == [[File:Glinting hollow pinecone.png|left|400px]] To get access, one must first complete the [[Glinting Hollow Key Quest]]. From the druid portal in [[Evershade Weald]], head up the hill and into the cave guarded by the Fae Guardians, the zone in is at the lowest potion of the cave, click the pine cone under the dragons skull with your [[Glowing Fae Scale]] on your cursor.

Once inside, the area is keyed to the various locations. (Keys stay on your body through death) First Area: {{Spoiler| Kill various treants for a chance to attain [[Fresh Squirrel Meat]].
Spawn [[Softpaws]] from "Any" flat rock (Successfully spawned from two locations, one in cave at top of ramp with solo treant guarding the cave entrance and in lower cave clockwise from that ramp).
Give [[Softpaws]] a [[Fresh Squirrel Meat]] (you may have to do this while invisible because of faction hits).
From that point on, any mob on the first floor can drop [[Glinting Scale of Nature]].
[[Thornbark]] will drop 6x [[Glinting Scale of Nature]] if killed at this point.
}}
Second Area: {{Spoiler| Kill x5 [[a pale wisp]] while in the central pond water to remove the [[Toxic Fumes]] debuff (for 5 minutes), note: the debuff returns if you kill them while out of the water.
[[Brightspark]] spawns from killing [[a pale wisp]]. [[Strig]] spawns near a bush in the zone up area.
While the debuff is removed kill [[Brightspark]] or [[Strig]] for 6x [[Glinting Scale of Water]].
Killing random area trash results in a singular [[Glinting Scale of Water]].
Killing [[a glowing wisp]] will reset the Event for the area. DO NOT KILL.
}}
Third Area: {{Spoiler| Kill [[a forgotten shadow]] near one of the firepits for 6x [[Glinting Scale of Decay]]
Killing the [[a large shadow]] or [[a whispering shadow]] near a firepit may have a chance at a key as well.
}}
Fourth Area: {{Spoiler| Light the firepits around the area and disable the dot to attain keys. (requires a [[Torch]], other "torch-like" things don't seem to work, unconfirmed if this is a bug.)
CONFIRMED - There is an order to lighting the fires South-East-West-Center-North.
The center platform is missing a ramp on one side, that ramp is on the north facing side.
Use /look to read the inscriptions on each brazier.
* South - Next to a ramp between 2 Dryads and a tree. Carved into the surface is a single leaf, half-charred, half-golden. An inscription reads, 'What lingers longest is not life, but the echo of its passing.' * East - Up a ramp, over the bear cave where [[Hrask]] Spawns. The stone is ridden with ice fractures and feels brittle. An inscription reads, 'First bite of winter... sharp, sudden, and sure.' * West - Up a ramp overlooking the center platform. Carved into the stone's face is a sleeping bear coiled in ice. An inscription reads, 'Deep cold does not rage. It waits.' * Center - On the center platform. The stone is made of a stone gray slate, damp with condensation. An inscription reads, 'Between breath and silence, the veil thins.' * North - At the base of the ramp leading up to the East firepit. A hollow space in the center of the stone holds a single frozen tear. An inscription reads, 'Only when the world remembers its breath... may the heart be lit.' '''After the final brazier is lit (north); you will have 12 minutes without the DoT to get keys''' UNCONFIRMED - Kill [[Hrask]] while the dot is inactive for 6x [[Glinting Scale of Frost]].
Kill [[a snowhide bear]] while the dot is inactive for a chance at [[Glinting Scale of Frost]].
}}
Fifth Area: {{Spoiler| Hail the Drake at the center of the ruins to attain an ice pick.
Kill only non caster elementals, elementals with a mana bar will reset the process.
Once the snare is disabled, find the crack in the ice, equip the pick, right click the pick for [[Glinting Scale of Ice]]
}}
Sixth Area: {{Spoiler| Unknown, involves attaining [[Glinting Scale of Winter]]

Hail the drake at the center of the ruins to start [[Potions for Veylith Frosttongue]]
}}

Underdocks.title: Underdocks
Underdocks.content:
The Underdocks are the main starting zone for Deep Dwarf, Deep Elf, and Deep Gnome races.
''More races can start here depending on class and deity.'' {{ZoneDetails |QuickLinks = [[Underdocks#Quests|Quests]] • [[Underdocks#Items|Items]] • [[Underdocks#NPCs|NPCs]] |Level = 1 - 50 |MonsterTypes = Spiders, Bats, Rats, Wererats, Beetles, Skeletons, Shrooms, Humanoids |NotableNPC = [[Riddrick the Cursed]], [[The Sporefather]], [[Munk]], [[Jumbe]], [[Belot]], [[Jorlach the Fearless]] |Items = [[Ironroot Fists]], [[Riddrick's Head]], [[Ring of the Blue Magus]], [[Shriveled Ghoul Heart]], [[Jorlach's Head]], [[Vharkith's Order]] |RelatedQuests = [[Underdocks Starter Quest]], [[Syrsil's Stolen Package]], [[Mining Picks for Hull]], [[Deepcut Bandit Bounty]], [[Wererat Fight Club]], [[Ratkiller]], [[Find Delilah's Pet]], [[Mushroom Farmers Bounty]], [[Bounty for Simrut]], [[The Small Problem of Deepcut Arsonists]] |AdjacentZones = [[Night Harbor]], [[Caves of Irem]] }}
{|cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0" style="border: 1px solid gray; max-width: 1000px;" width="100%" |- |style="background:#F5F0E8;padding:10px;"| ====Underdocks Zone ==== :A. Night Harbor :B. Caves of Irem |} {|cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0" style="border: 1px solid gray; max-width: 1000px;" width="100%" |- |style="background:#F5F0E8;padding:10px;"| ====Underdocks, Bottom Floor City ==== This is a rough map with poor scaling. Focused on the bottom floor of the UD city. [[File:UnderdocksBottomFloorCity.png|right|border|600px|Bottom floor city map]] |} {|cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0" style="border: 1px solid gray; max-width: 1000px;" width="100%" |- |style="background:#F5F0E8;padding:10px;"| ====Underdocks City Map (Hand Drawn) ==== This is a carefully drawn map of the city with points of interest and lots of boats. [[File:Underdocks map.png|right|border|600px|Hand drawn Underdocks map]] |} {|cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0" style="border: 1px solid gray; max-width: 1000px;" width="100%" |- |style="background:#F5F0E8;padding:10px;"| ====Underdocks Citadel Maps ==== [[File:UDcitadel1.jpg|thumb|Underdocks Citadel map. Schematic map showing which parts of the citadel are connected and what you can find there.]] [[File:CitadelMapByBEEFUS.png|thumb|Ground Floor Vendor Map Plus Floor-By-Floor Breakdown. Pink portals near raft docks lead to respective shores. Tunnels under portals also lead to far shores, but with more rats.]] == Layout == The Underdocks lie inside a large circular cavern. In the middle of the cavern is an '''underground lake''', and standing in the middle of the lake is the '''Citadel''' itself -- a large building. Around the building, out over the water, runs a '''ring of stone walkway'''. The ground-level merchants stand on that '''walkway''', not inside the building. Walking it clockwise from the '''north entrance''': * A '''lift to Overreach''' stands just inside the entrance; two more lifts to Overreach also serve the walkway, for three in total. * The '''butchers' shop''' and the '''leatherworking shop''' occupy the north-east side, the leatherworking shop around the corner from the butchers. * A doorway that seems to lead into the Citadel is actually a '''teleporter pad''' and the mouth of an '''underground tunnel''' -- both lead to the '''eastern shore of the lake'''. A '''raft dock''' sits across from it. * Further on is an '''unused shop area'''. * The '''south entrance''' mirrors the north one. West of it is the '''healers' clinic''' (its second floor holds a Bind Wound trainer). * Past two more buildings, the '''south-west corner''' holds a general goods shop. * North of that: a '''small lift to Overreach''', then a second '''teleporter and tunnel''' leading to the '''west bank''', with '''docks and a ferry''' just outside on the water. * North again: '''two empty market areas''', and then, at the '''north-west corner''', a '''stair up to Forge Row''' and another '''lift to Overreach'''. The walkway closes back at the north entrance. '''The building.''' The Citadel itself is stacked, with many small floors above the walkway level: * The '''basement''', easily accessible from the south ramp, contains an inn ('Mushroom Motel') and public baths which give a 20m +10 CHA buff, 'Fair and Fresh'.
Also of note is [[an opportunistic adventurer]] who will retrieve a lost player corpse for a price. * The '''first major floor''' is an entrance hall, empty at the time of writing. * The '''second''' is '''Forge Row''' -- the smithing quarter, holding a smelting [[Forge]], an [[Anvil]], and the named blacksmith trainer, with Deltan's Smeltery alongside. * Up from the second floor is a small '''viewing area''', referred to as "floor 2.5", which leads on to floor three. * The '''third''' is the '''[[Citadel Exchange]]''' -- "like the Night Market in the harbour cities, but currently mostly empty". It holds a set of largely empty buildings, the bank (with a further lift to Overreach beside it), and the top of the '''Inn'''. The Inn doorway here is its top floor ([[Innkeeper Adrella]]); below that is the '''tavern''' ([[Barkeeper Ravik]], [[Senior Apprentice Syrsil]]), and below that the guest rooms and beds, arranged around a '''glowing tree'''. Storing bags in the bank expands your banking space. * The '''fourth''' is the '''Market Terrace''', a small open area with a mostly empty shopping area. Its only vendor is '''[[Berrie]]''', who sells badly made shoes and has nothing to say. * The '''fifth''' is '''Crown Reach'''. It begins with a fancy open-faced tavern, '''[[High Note|the High Note]]''', whose snooty patrons trade Underdocks gossip while two musicians play; '''resting here grants the rested bonus'''. North of the tavern is an empty store, and north again the currently unnamed tailoring shop. Above the shop is a private residence belonging to '''[[Lady Valhassen]]''', and below it a basement theatre with a stage, seating and a bar, where she watches from the upper balcony. * '''Shortcut:''' jumping off the walkway at the entrance to Crown Reach drops you in front of the bank on the third floor. The Citadel map also shows a Crossroads Room, a Grand Terrace, a Market Terrace, a teleport, and a bath, none of which have been placed yet. == NPCs by place == Where each town NPC stands. For the zone's monsters and their levels, see [[#NPCs|NPCs]]. === The lakeside walkway === {| class="wikitable" |- ! Location !! == Traveling To and From == The easiest way to this zone is to take the boat that goes between [[Underdocks]] and [[Ail'Vorith]] and jump off, or get wizard port directly there. You can also follow the path of the boat first on foot along the shore and then by swimming to get there. In the [[Caves of Irem]], follow the water on the right hand side of the river from the [[Underdocks]] zone line up past the cutthroats and the Giant, then into a green lit tunnel. Blind Midden.title: Blind Midden
Blind Midden.content:
Blind Midden is a dungeon just off Ali'Vorith, the starting zone for the Deep Elf race. {{ZoneDetails |QuickLinks = |Level = 7-25 |MonsterTypes = Ghosts, Slime Cubes, Evil Eyes, Deep Elves |NotableNPC = [[Gorgeous]], [[Flavic the Fisher]], [[Mucky Morgurah]] |Items = |RelatedQuests = |AdjacentZones = [[Ail'Vorith]] }}
